title: Web Director, Digital Experience
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**Web Director, Digital Experience**
We're looking for a proven Web Director to own the strategic direction, performance, and evolution of Qualys.com as a revenue-driving engine. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set the roadmap, define what success looks like, and work directly with our web development team and cross-functional stakeholders to execute against it. You've done this before (ideally at another B2B SaaS or Cybersecurity company) and you know what a modern, high-performing website looks like because you've built one.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Website Strategy & Roadmap: Own the strategic roadmap for Qualys.com, prioritize initiatives based on business impact rather than reactive requests, and defend that roadmap against ad hoc, out-of-cycle asks.
* Performance & Conversion Ownership: Define the KPIs that matter: conversion rate, engagement, and pipeline contribution. Drive the CRO and testing program using A/B tests and behavioral data to actively improve outcomes, not just report on them.
* Personalization Strategy: Design and direct the strategy for using behavioral and audience data to serve tailored content and experiences to key segments.
* Technical Direction: Guide the web development team's priorities and technical approach, translating business goals into a clear execution plan they can build against.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Represent web strategy to marketing, product, sales, and executive stakeholders; resolve competing priorities at the roadmap level rather than case by case.
* Global Strategy: Set direction for multi-language support, international SEO, and region-specific experience strategy.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure that the website meets all required global standards for compliance and regulation.
* Brand & Experience Standards: Partner with Brand/Creative to ensure the site's direction and user experience reflect the company's positioning and visual identity.
* Team Leadership: Manage and actively develop the people on the web team by providing hands-on technical and strategic guidance.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years in digital/web leadership, including 3+ years specifically in a director-level (or equivalent) role owning a corporate website or digital product.
* Verifiable track record of personally leading a website redesign, platform migration, or comparable large-scale initiative end to end.
* Direct experience managing a technical or web development team.
* Demonstrated history of defining and driving KPI/CRO programs with measurable results (be ready to discuss specific outcomes).
* Experience operating cross-functionally with executive-level stakeholders.
* B2B experience required; cybersecurity industry experience strongly preferred.

**Tools & Systems**

* CMS & Hosting: Modern JavaScript framework experience (Next.js/React strongly preferred), hosted on a CDN/edge platform such as Netlify.
* Analytics: Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
* A/B Testing & Experimentation: Experience with an A/B testing platform (Optimizely, VWO, or similar).
* Behavioral & Session Analytics: Experience with a behavioral/session analytics tool (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar).
* Reporting & BI: Looker Studio or Tableau.
* Project Management: Asana or similar.
* Cookie Consent & Privacy Compliance: Experience with a cookie consent/compliance platform (Cookiebot or similar).

title: PMT - Product Validation Lead
description: Our PurposeMastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.Title And SummaryPMT - Product Validation LeadWho is Mastercard?Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.OverviewPayments Network Technology is seeking a Product Management Technical professional to lead product validation and payment-domain outcomes. The role connects customer and business needs with engineering delivery, test coverage, and release acceptance.Roles and Responsibilities Own the vision, working-backwards narrative, and measurable outcomes for assigned capabilities. Translate customer, operational, and business needs into prioritized features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Make and communicate trade-off recommendations across scope, depth, timelines, risk, and technical investment. Coordinate requirements and dependencies with engineering, architecture, testing, operations, and customer-facing teams. Review demonstrations and validation evidence against acceptance criteria before release. Maintain clear product documentation and use production or validation metrics as feedback into the backlog. Identify feature-level delivery or customer risks and drive prioritization and resolution. Define validation strategy for authorization, clearing, tokenization, ISO 8583, and ISO 20022 payment flows. Support defect triage and confirm that resolved behavior meets payment-processing requirements. Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams.Essential Skills Experience in technical product management, product ownership, business analysis, or payment-product validation. Knowledge of payment transaction flows and message standards such as ISO 8583 and ISO 20022. Ability to work with engineers and architects on APIs, data models, non-functional requirements, and operational behavior. Data-driven decision-making and strong product documentation skills. Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.All About You Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle. Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams. Experience applying AI-driven product validation to improve efficiency, expand coverage, and identify defects earlier in the development lifecycle. Payments or financial-services domain knowledge is preferred.Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Vice President, Product Development, Switching as a Service
description: Our PurposeMastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.Title And SummaryVice President, Product Development, Switching as a ServiceOverview and ContextAs part of the Network Products business unit, the Next Generation Network Team is at the heart of Mastercard’s transformation, driving innovation and modernization to ensure the network remains resilient, flexible, and competitive in a rapidly evolving payments landscape.This team is responsible for building Mastercard’s next-generation unified switch and access capabilities, designed to handle all payment and related data flows across transaction types and payment schemes.Within Next Gen Network, the Network Expansion team is driving Product Development for a new product named “Switching as a Service” (SwaaS), which opens a new business model in which Mastercard leverages its next-generation platform to switch domestic payment schemes according to their rules, interchange, and settlement, hosted and operated by Mastercard.Network Products has signed its first large and strategic SwaaS contract and needs to grow its Product Development team to manage its design, build, and run activities.Role SummaryThis VP role will lead a team having Product Development accountability for the Core Switching and Data-related services of the SwaaS. The role will ensure delivery of this scope according to the contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions.Given the large scope and complexity of SwaaS, this individual will partner closely with a large network of actors, such as: other SwaaS Product Development team members managing other parts of the SwaaS, Avanti project management structure, representative from Product and Engineering of each contributing program, Regional lead driving the on-soil relationship with the SwaaS customer and providing product management and GTM role, Customer delivery, Global Customer Care, Security, Network, etc.The individual will also have direct relationship with representatives from the SwaaS customer team to ensure full alignment between their expectations and our solutioning while protecting Mastercard’s interest and goals. This SwaaS project spread across multiple time zones.The role demands a strong product mindset, drive, structure, organization, technical acumen across the scope, and will require a high degree of collaboration across technical, customer-facing, and other stakeholder teams to bring the first SwaaS implementation to home.Key Responsibilities Lead the Product Development team in charge of the Core Switching and Data-related capabilities of the SwaaS product from intake through elaboration, execution, build, and run. Within the SwaaS governance, provide regular & detailed reporting, stay ahead in risk management, and ensure that the resources allocated to SwaaS execution are rightly used in partnership with PMO’s and Finance. Own delivery of the allocated scope and coordinate with Product Management and Engineering teams to meet contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions. Ensure the integrity and consistency of SwaaS delivery across vision, capabilities, scalability, performance, speed-to-market, readiness for growth, and reusability. Build and maintain detailed functional and technical understanding of the delivered platform, including requirements, use cases, architecture, dependencies, interfaces, data flows, runtime operations, support strategies, and maintenance needs. Drive stakeholder alignment across the SwaaS ecosystem, including Product, Engineering, Franchise, Global Customer Delivery, Privacy, and other contributing teams. Lead by example with a hands-on approach, demonstrate product management excellence, and share best practices. Apply logic, reasoning, and sound decision-making to develop solutions with all teams. Clarify concepts and build a shared understanding of what will ultimately be delivered. Define capabilities that enhance the Next Gen platform, respect the platform strategy and principles, and ensure platform integrity. Support other SwaaS Product team members to ensure collective success. Replicate knowledge, share workload across initiatives, provide mutual backup, and help the team scale, learn, and expand its scope. Establish product development discipline in the team, including clear methods, structure, content standards, reliable execution, and high-quality on-time contributions. Recruit, develop, and retain high-performance team while fostering a culture of execution, accountability, and innovation. Identify opportunities for leveraging AI to improve speed, efficiency and quality.All About You Fluent in English 10+ years of product development or product management experience in complex, geographically distributed environments Experience managing and developing teams. People leader. Executive-level stakeholder management and influence in a matrixed organization Expected to bring a strong execution mindset, sound judgment, and practical problem-solving skills Strong technical foundation required to understand complex platform capabilities, dependencies, and delivery risks Prior experience in payments and/or fintech is required; experience with card processing systems, including authorization, clearing, and settlement, is preferred Proven ability to lead cross-functional alignment across product and engineering teams, including dependency management Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities Strong problem solver who can navigate complexity, unblock teams, and identify alternative paths to deliver the outcomes Strong experience with complex technical products and customer integration planning is a plus Excellent analytical, organizational, and workstream management skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate problem statements, frame options and trade-off, and engage internal and external stakeholders clearly. Customer-facing experience is preferred Ability to work with ambiguity and manage complex projects in fast-paced environments Demonstrated ability to work independently and with minimal day-to-day supervision Ability to build effective relationships with senior leaders, internal teams, and external clients Flexibility to work with multiple time zonesLocation: Pune onlyCorporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Videographer & Editor
description:
Job Title: Senior Videographer & Video Editor

**Company:** Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra (Work from Office)  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Salary:** 20,000 to 30,000 per month

Job Summary

Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a creative, skilled, and result-oriented Senior Videographer & Video Editor who can independently manage end-to-end video production, from conceptualization and creative strategy to shooting, editing, post-production, and final delivery.

The ideal candidate must have strong visual storytelling skills, an excellent understanding of cinematography, lighting, sound, editing, and creative direction, and the ability to produce high-quality videos that meet client expectations and business objectives.

We are looking for someone who takes complete ownership of every project, understands the client's vision, proactively suggests creative ideas, and consistently delivers engaging, professional, and impactful video content within committed deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end video production, including concept development, creative planning, pre-production, shooting, editing, post-production, and final delivery.
* Understand client briefs, campaign objectives, target audiences, and brand guidelines to develop effective video concepts and production strategies.
* Plan shoots, prepare shot lists and storyboards, arrange equipment, and coordinate locations, talent, and production requirements.
* Independently handle professional video shoots for corporate films, brand videos, advertisements, social media content, reels, interviews, testimonials, product videos, and promotional campaigns.
* Operate cameras, lenses, lighting equipment, stabilizers, gimbals, microphones, and other production equipment effectively.
* Execute high-quality cinematography, framing, camera movements, lighting setups, and audio recording.
* Edit videos professionally using Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or other relevant editing tools.
* Perform colour correction, colour grading, sound design, audio mixing, transitions, motion graphics integration, subtitles, and visual effects wherever required.
* Create platform-specific video formats for Instagram Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, Meta Ads, websites, and other digital platforms.
* Develop engaging visual storytelling techniques, hooks, pacing, and creative narratives that capture audience attention.
* Collaborate with creative strategists, designers, copywriters, performance marketers, and account managers to deliver videos aligned with campaign objectives.
* Take ownership of project timelines, shoot schedules, editing deadlines, revisions, and final deliverables.
* Review video output for visual quality, audio clarity, brand consistency, technical accuracy, and client requirements before submission.
* Incorporate client and internal feedback efficiently while maintaining production quality and delivery timelines.
* Organize and maintain video footage, project files, backups, assets, and production equipment.
* Stay updated with emerging video trends, cinematography techniques, AI-powered video tools, editing innovations, and social media content formats.
* Proactively suggest creative improvements and take complete responsibility for the quality of the final output.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 4–7 years of professional experience in videography, video editing, and end-to-end video production.
* Strong hands-on expertise in professional camera operation, cinematography, lighting, and audio recording.
* Excellent proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve.
* Practical knowledge of colour grading, sound design, motion graphics, transitions, and visual effects.
* Experience producing advertising films, corporate videos, promotional videos, branded content, and social media videos.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling, composition, shot planning, camera movements, and editing techniques.
* Ability to independently plan and execute shoots with minimal supervision.
* Knowledge of different video formats, resolutions, aspect ratios, codecs, and platform-specific export requirements.
* Strong time management, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle multiple projects, manage revisions, and deliver high-quality output within deadlines.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating shooting, editing, storytelling, and post-production capabilities.

Preferred Skills

* Experience working with a digital marketing or advertising agency.
* Knowledge of motion graphics and Adobe After Effects.
* Experience shooting advertisements, brand campaigns, real estate videos, corporate films, interviews, and client testimonials.
* Understanding of performance marketing creatives, video hooks, audience engagement, and platform-specific content requirements.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted video production and editing tools.
* Experience independently managing production equipment, shoot logistics, and on-location shoots.

Performance Expectations

* Take complete ownership of assigned video projects from brief to final delivery.
* Deliver visually appealing, professionally edited, and client-ready videos.
* Meet all agreed shoot schedules, editing timelines, and final delivery deadlines.
* Maintain high standards of cinematography, sound, editing, colour grading, and storytelling.
* Minimize avoidable errors and revisions through careful planning and quality checks.
* Proactively communicate project progress, challenges, and production requirements.
* Ensure that every video aligns with the client's expectations, brand identity, and campaign objectives.
* Consistently bring fresh creative ideas and improve the quality of the agency's video production output.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a highly creative, technically strong, and ownership-driven professional who can handle video production independently without requiring constant supervision.

The candidate must be capable of thinking strategically, planning shoots, operating equipment, directing visual execution, editing professionally, incorporating feedback, and delivering a polished final video that delights the client.

We value professionals who combine creativity with accountability, complete tasks on time, solve problems independently, and take pride in the quality of their work.

Application Requirements

Candidates must share their portfolio or showreel showcasing their best video production and editing work. Please highlight projects where you personally handled shooting, editing, and post-production from start to finish.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Video production: 2 years (Preferred)
* Videography: 2 years (Preferred)
* Video editing: 2 years (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

description:

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Head of Marketing to lead our marketing strategy, drive business growth, strengthen client relationships, and expand our presence in the events and experiential marketing industry.

- Understand client objectives and translate them into effective marketing solutions.

- Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and repeat business.

- Ensure proposals and creative solutions align with client objectives, brand guidelines, and commercial expectations.

- Work closely with finance and operations teams to ensure commercial viability and project profitability.

- Support pricing strategies, budgeting, negotiations, and commercial decision-making.

- Ensure marketing commitments are aligned with operational capabilities and delivery timelines.

- Collaborate with internal teams to maintain quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction.

- Client Relationship Management

- Brand Experiences & Integrated Marketing

- Commercial Negotiation & Financial Acumen

- Team Leadership & Performance Management

- Achievement of annual revenue and business growth targets.

- Growth and retention of existing client accounts.

- Development of a strong and sustainable business pipeline.

- Improvement in profitability and commercial performance.

- Client satisfaction and long-term business relationships.

title: Co-Founder with investment
description:

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, take initiative, and make data-informed decisions.

title: Regional Business Manager

• Negotiate & close annual contracts, trade terms, margins, and joint business plans with partners. • Build and maintain senior relationships with partner leadership, category and marketing teams.

• Handle internal and external escalations and resolve commercial disputes and claims.

• Plan initiatives with partners to unlock new-to-brand customers, especially during marquee sale events.

• Run sampling and retargeting programmes that bring new customers back to repeat.

• Identify new categories, sub-categories, and launches that can grow our market share on each platform.

• Keep the active assortment well stocked, with weekly checks by partner, and getting timely purchase orders from the partner.

• Close assortment gaps by platform and city and propose new launches to fill them.

• Share a monthly rolling sales forecast with the supply chain team and maintain accuracy.
**Marketing, visibility, and events**

• Close monthly marketing and event calendars within partner deadlines, with offers, spend, and stock planned together.

• Guide the visibility and performance marketing plans and keep spend within the agreed budget.

• Make sure we are ready for every marquee partner event, from stock to visibility to content.

• Keep prices consistent across platforms.

• Oversee catalogue quality, content and search visibility on partner platforms.

• Make sure partner bills, claims and settlements are raised and cleared on time with the finance team.

**Team leadership and cross-functional work**

• Lead, coach and develop the channel partner team, set clear goals and carry out regular reviews. • Work closely with supply chain, finance, brand marketing, technology, & analytics teams.

• Report to the senior leadership team and work with group teams as the brand scales globally.
**Strategic partnerships**

• Explore and onboard new marketplaces and channel partners that suit the brand's positioning and long-term goals.

**What we are looking for Experience and qualifications**

• 8-10 years in e-commerce, key account management or category management, with at least 4 years leading marketplace and quick commerce business for a beauty, personal care, FMCG, fashion or lifestyle brand.

• Proven ownership of revenue and margin P&L, including trade terms and marketing spends.

• Track record of negotiating and closing annual contracts and joint business plans with leading marketplaces and quick commerce platforms.

• Experience leading a team of key account managers and marketing or performance specialists.

• MBA or PGDM preferred.

Skills

• Strong negotiation and commercial judgement, with a clear view of margins and trade-offs.

• Comfort with data: sales forecasting, dashboards, advertising metrics and new-customer analysis. • Good understanding of how quick commerce works, including availability, days of stock, and store and city-level assortment.

title: Manager / Sr. Executive – Affiliate & Brand Alliances (Beauty / D2C)
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an owner who can scale affiliate, cashback, coupon and fintech/super-app partnerships into a core revenue channel. The goal is low-CAC incremental sales and new-customer acquisition across our D2C website and marketplace.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Affiliate Programs
* Build and scale the in-house D2C affiliate program on Shopify Plus, covering partner onboarding, tracking links, payouts and fraud control.
* Manage third-party affiliate networks and portals (Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission, Impact, etc.) and continuously add new publishers.
* Onboard influencers, creators, content/review sites and deal communities as affiliate partners.
* Cashback & Coupon Ecosystem
* Build partnerships and run campaigns with cashback portals (CashKaro, GoPaisa, etc.) and coupon portals (GrabOn, CouponDunia, etc.).
* Own the brand-wise coupon strategy: code structure, discount depth, exclusivity, leakage control, and monitoring of coupon abuse and brand-bidding.
* Super-App & Rewards Partnerships
* Launch offers, coupons, rewards and co-branded campaigns on platforms such as PhonePe, Paytm, Google Pay and Zomato.
* Explore new platforms and bank, fintech and loyalty partnerships that bring in high-intent customers.
* Planning & Campaigns
* Create a partner-wise campaign calendar for launches, festive sales (Diwali, BFCM, EOSS) and key SKUs.
* Negotiate commission structures: CPS/CPA, tiered, performance-linked and exclusive deals.
* Tracking, Analytics & Reporting
* Track clicks, orders, AOV, new vs. repeat customers, CAC, ROAS, commission payouts and incrementality.
* Ensure accurate attribution (UTM, coupon-level, network-level) and catch fake or duplicate conversions.
* Build weekly/monthly dashboards and partner scorecards; pause low performers and scale winners.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Work with Brand, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Creative, Finance and Tech teams on offers, creatives, tracking setup and payout reconciliation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field (MBA/PGDM preferred).
* 3–6 years of experience in affiliate, partnerships, performance or e-commerce marketing. Beauty, D2C or FMCG background preferred.
* Hands-on experience with affiliate networks/platforms (Impact, Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission) and cashback/coupon portals.
* Strong understanding of coupon-led and offer-led growth (CPS/CPA, margin math, abuse control).
* Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-management skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of GA4 and Shopify analytics.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with super-app/fintech offer platforms (PhonePe, Paytm, GPay, Zomato) or bank/credit-card reward partnerships.
* Understanding of marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Nykaa).

Success Metrics (first 6–12 months)
  
  

* Share of revenue and new-customer count from the affiliate/partnership channel.
* Blended CAC and ROAS within target.
* Number of active partners and top-partner concentration.
* Minimal coupon leakage and invalid payouts.

title: Senior Talent Partner
description:
Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology- enabling faster, better, connected insights.
  
  
Konovo provides healthcare organisations with access to over 2 million healthcare professionals—the largest network of its kind globally. With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. Our customers include over 300 global pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, research agencies, and consultancy firms.
  
  
As we transition from a service-oriented model to a product-driven platform, we are expanding our hybrid Bengaluru-based team. As Senior Talent Partner, you will play a critical role in building the talent density that fuels our company's growth. We believe great companies are built by great people, and you will serve as a culture champion who helps business leaders meet ambitious business outcomes by building exceptional teams.
  
  
This is a hybrid role based out of Whitefield, Bengaluru. You will work UK hours (approximately 2:00-11:00pm IST) with occasional flexibility required to support business needs.
  
  
You will primarily own non-technology hiring for our Bengaluru innovation hub across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Finance (with occasional support on other roles as needed). You will do this as you strengthen the systems, documentation, training, and operational discipline that enable scalable recruiting. You'll partner cross-regionally to support global hiring initiatives and maintain consistency in tools, documentation, and quality standards in Konovo's Talent function without losing speed or ownership locally.
  
  
You will act as a trusted advisor to hiring leaders, bringing structure, clarity, and accountability to every search. Behind the scenes, you will ensure our hiring bar remains high and our processes disciplined, efficient, and equitable. Externally, you will represent Konovo with professionalism and warmth, cultivating an exceptional candidate experience at every stage. As Senior Talent Partner, your work will be critical to our success.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact:**

* Own full-cycle hiring across non-technology functions that strengthen our India innovation hub and directly support business growth
* Own searches end-to-end as an individual contributor (intake and job search blueprint design, pipeline, coordination, interviews, offer, close) without a coordinator or sourcer, while partnering with and leveraging hiring managers as accountable partners in the process
* Increase hiring efficiency by reducing time-to-fill and improving candidate conversion
* Build operational rigour in Greenhouse by continuously optimising workflows, automations, reporting, and documentation to improve visibility and accountability
* Operate with urgency and ownership in a lean environment, balancing multiple priorities without waiting for direction
* Drive hiring manager accountability through tight intakes, qualification design, clear scorecards, fast feedback loops, and decision discipline
* Proactively leverage AI and automation to eliminate manual work, improve candidate evaluation quality, and increase recruiting throughput
* When a leader comes with a prescribed approach, you step back to clarify the outcome, surface assumptions and tradeoffs, and use your subject matter expertise to align stakeholders on the most effective path to a high-quality hire.
* Equip hiring managers to make stronger decisions by introducing structured interviewing, clearer evaluation criteria, and data-backed market insights
* Build repeatable hiring playbooks that enable future scale beyond India
* Partner directly with VP Talent, Managing Director, India, and executive leaders to translate business priorities into disciplined hiring plans
* Elevate candidate experience in a way that improves offer acceptance rates and long-term retention
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements that increase speed without lowering the hiring bar
* Strengthen global recruiting consistency by partnering cross-regionally to standardise tools, documentation, and quality standards
* Seek and incorporate feedback quickly, while confidently holding a high hiring bar
* Ensure every candidate interaction reflects Konovo's talent values that we're smart, nice, and get things done

**What We're Looking For:**

* 3+ years of in-house recruiting experience within a SaaS or technology-led environment
* Demonstrated ownership of full-cycle hiring across multiple functions and seniority levels
* Proven experience configuring and managing ATS workflows, ideally Greenhouse, including job setup, structured interview kits, automation, reporting, and workflow optimisation
* Comfort using AI and automation to reduce manual work (e.g. intake synthesis, outreach drafts, interview kits, reporting, information workflow streams, and documentation). You don't need formal "AI at work" experience, but you should be actively experimenting and able to apply it responsibly
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into recruiting workflows to drive measurable gains in efficiency or quality
* Strong operational mindset with the ability to build documentation, create structure, and drive process discipline
* Confidence partnering with senior leaders and influencing hiring decisions with data and market insights
* Experience supporting hiring across multiple geographies is a plus
* Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing 5+ concurrent searches
* Clear, concise communicator with sound judgement and high integrity
* High EQ with the confidence to challenge when needed and the humility to adapt quickly when coached
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, asking sharp questions early, and adapting quickly as priorities evolve
* Builder mindset- you are willing to do the work hands-on, improve the system as you go, and raise the hiring bar without adding unnecessary process

**Why Join Konovo?**

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation that is shaping the future of healthcare decision-making.
* Join a fast-growing global team with opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment that fosters innovation and flexibility.
* Experience a workplace that puts employees first, offering a workplace designed for growth, well-being, and balance.
* Become a part of an organisation that prioritizes your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy. Our employee-centric policies ensure a rewarding and fulfilling work experience.
* Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organisations innovate faster.

This is just the beginning of what we can accomplish together. Join us at Konovo and help shape the future of healthcare technology!
  
  
**Apply now to be part of our journey.**

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition (Skillz)
description:
**About The Company**
If you want to build, own, and see your impact — join Skillz and level up your career.
  
  
Skillz is the competition infrastructure platform that powers real-money, skill-based tournaments inside mobile games. We didn't just enter the competitive gaming market — we invented it. Founded in 2012 by entrepreneur and inventor Andrew Paradise, Skillz built the category from scratch: the patented matchmaking, identity, payments, fraud protection, and developer tools that make fair, real-stakes competition possible at scale.
  
  
Skillz hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide and is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi-million dollar franchises by enabling real-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
  
  
Today, Skillz is part of FIRY — a global holding company operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Alongside RZR, our AI-driven ad network, and Beamable, our backend and LiveOps platform, Skillz sits at the center of a compounding data flywheel that no standalone competitor can replicate. 800,000+ daily tournaments. $7.5 billion in lifetime prizes paid to players. 90 million registered users.
  
  
We're a high-conviction team of builders who came from Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, X, Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, Wynn Resorts, and more. We operate like a startup, hold ourselves to high standards, and move fast with purpose. If you want to work on infrastructure that matters — and be part of a team that fights for what it builds — Skillz is the right place.
  
  
**About The Role**
Skillz is looking for a Manager, Talent Acquisition to join our Bangalore team as second-in-command to the Senior Manager, TA. This is a hybrid role that blends hands-on recruiting with day-to-day team leadership. You'll own priority searches yourself while coaching and guiding a team of recruiters to hire high-quality talent across our technical and business functions.
  
  
You'll play a direct role in driving recruiting profitability: cutting time-to-fill, growing our direct-sourcing capability, and reducing our reliance on external agencies. At the same time, you'll build team capacity through coaching, consistent hiring standards, and hands-on problem-solving — stepping in as the Senior Manager's delegate to keep recruitment operations running smoothly as hiring demand grows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as second-in-command to the Senior Manager, TA; serve as their delegate, ensuring continuity of recruitment operations, and escalating risks in their absence.
* Own full-cycle recruiting for priority and hard-to-fill roles across technical, product, data, and business functions, with an emphasis on sourcing Tier 1 talent from B2C technology companies.
* Provide day-to-day leadership to a team of recruiters including coaching, setting clear expectations, reviewing performance, and delivering feedback that improves productivity.
* Build and maintain direct-sourcing pipelines and market maps to reduce agency dependency and raise quality of hire.
* Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to turn workforce priorities into structured search strategies and measurable hiring plans, constructively pushing back on requirements when needed.
* Track funnel metrics, conversion rates, and requisition ageing to spot bottlenecks and resolve operational blockers across the team's portfolio.
* Uphold hiring standards and process consistency to protect candidate experience and hit timelines.
* Lead offer negotiations and closing conversations, managing compensation expectations and counteroffers to land great talent within budget.
* Build lasting relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and stakeholders across the business.
* Support the Senior Manager, TA in driving down time-to-fill and minimizing the productivity loss that comes with open roles.

**Key Competencies**

* Team Leadership & Coaching — guiding recruiters, setting expectations, and improving team performance.
* Technical & Business Acumen — fluent in evaluating engineering, product, and data talent from Tier 1 B2C companies.
* Strategic Recruiting — translating priorities into search strategies, market maps, and hiring plans.
* Stakeholder Management — building credibility with leaders and constructively challenging requirements.
* Execution & Accountability — strong ownership of outcomes, timelines, and candidate experience.
* Data-Driven Decision-Making — using metrics to spot risk and improve outcomes.
* Problem-Solving & Adaptability — resolving bottlenecks and thriving amid shifting priorities.
* Offer Negotiation & Closing — managing compensation conversations and counteroffers with confidence.
* Relationship Building — sustaining trust across candidates, recruiters, and stakeholders.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong track record hiring technical, product, data, or business talent.
* 1–2+ years formally managing, mentoring, or leading recruiters day-to-day.
* Demonstrated success hiring Tier 1 talent from B2C technology, consumer internet, gaming, fintech, e-commerce, travel-tech, food-tech, or other scaled consumer businesses.
* Experience running priority or hard-to-fill searches independently while overseeing other recruiters' delivery.
* Strong direct-sourcing skills; experience with building market maps and proactive pipelines without heavy reliance on agencies.
* End-to-end recruitment lifecycle experience: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, debriefs, references, negotiation, closing, and onboarding.
* Background in a startup, turnaround, or fast-scaling environment where priorities shift quickly.
* A track record of tenure and growth; ideally two-plus years at one or more organizations, with internal promotions or expanded scope.
* Genuine interest in gaming, consumer technology, and digital products.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate and work regularly from the Skillz Bangalore office.
* Background hiring for B2C tier-1 profiles at B2C tech companies (not consulting/agency-side).

**Location:**
Hybrid in Bangalore, India
  
  
**Travel Requirement:**
Less than 10%
  
  
**Why Skillz**

* You're building infrastructure, not just features. Skillz is the competition layer for mobile gaming — the matchmaking, payments, identity, and fraud systems that make real-stakes competition trustworthy at scale. The work here compounds. Every improvement to the platform makes every tournament on it better.
* Founder-led. Andrew Paradise founded Skillz in 2012 with a single conviction: that fair, real-money skill-based competition should exist at scale. Thirteen years later, he’s taken the company public on the NYSE, built a portfolio of three independent businesses, earned 90+ patents, and won the largest false advertising verdict in U.S. history. He is still here — still the founder, still the CEO, still building. That kind of long-term commitment and alignment is rare in any company. At Skillz, it defines the culture from the top down.
* Part of a compounding ecosystem. Skillz is one of three businesses inside FIRY — alongside RZR, our AI-powered performance ad network, and Beamable, our developer backend platform. Your work spans gaming, ad tech, identity, payments, and ecommerce. The platform you build on gets smarter and more valuable with every player, developer, and advertiser that enters the ecosystem.
* Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more.
* Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays.
* Las Vegas Headquarters. Skillz operates in a five-day-a-week, collaborative office environment at our 36,000+ square foot Las Vegas HQ. Free daily catered lunch, snacks, a full-size gym with showers, commuter benefits, team events, and more.
* Recognized Success. Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion-Dollar Startups, and the #1 fastest-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.

Join Skillz and Let's Redefine the Boundaries of Gaming!
  
  
Together, we'll create a world where skill, passion, and innovation thrive. We look forward to having you on board!
  
  
Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance

.

Block Duration Stipend Blocks 1–3 75 working days

At the end of

.

**all six internship blocks (150 working days)**
with

**Fresher employment opportunity**
with the organization.

* **Experience:**
  3-8 years

  Hyderabad, Telangana, India

  US Night Shift ([Insert Hours, e.g., 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST])

We are looking for an ambitious, multi-domain
**US Bench Sales Recruiter**
with proven expertise in marketing consultants across
**Information Technology (IT), Corporate/Non-IT, and Pharmaceutical/Life Sciences**
sectors.

In this role, you will take ownership of a diverse consultant pool (H-1B, OPT, CPT, H4-EAD, Green Card, and US Citizens). Your core objective is to minimize bench downtime by aggressively mapping skills to open market demands, securing
**Right to Represent (RTR)**
agreements, submitting profiles to Tier-1 prime vendors and direct clients, and closing profitable C2C or W-2 contracts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Multi-Domain Consultant Marketing**

* **IT Verticals:**
  Market software developers, cloud/DevOps engineers, data analysts, and QA automation specialists.
* **Non-IT Verticals:**
  Market finance/accounting professionals, HR specialists, supply chain experts, and administrative consultants.
* **Pharma & Life Sciences Verticals:**
  Market clinical SAS programmers, clinical data managers, pharmacovigilance (PV) specialists, regulatory affairs associates, and validation/compliance engineers.
* Prepare customized, targeted "Hotlists" and market them daily to an established network of US prime vendors, MSPs, and implementation partners.
* JobLeads



**2. Sourcing & Submissions**

* Source C2C and W-2 contract requirements across US job boards (Dice, TechFetch, Indeed, LinkedIn, and specialized life-science/corporate portals).
* Review and filter job postings to align with candidate tech stacks, regulatory backgrounds, geographic choices, and remote/onsite constraints.
* Secure signed
  **Right to Represent (RTR)**
  confirmations and swiftly submit tailored resumes to prime vendors.



**3. Rate Negotiation & Closures**

* Negotiate competitive bill rates with vendors and fair pay rates with consultants to ensure optimal profit margins for the company.
* Coordinate multi-round technical, compliance, and client interviews between vendors and bench consultants.
* Drive the end-to-end placement cycle, including background checks, onboarding document coordination, and initial project start confirmation.



**4. Vendor Relationship Management**

* Build and preserve long-term professional relationships with US account managers, delivery managers, and tier-1 vendor lists.
* Maintain clean daily logs in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) tracking submissions, interview statuses, active hotlists, and vendor feedback.

**Key Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  [Insert, e.g., 2 to 5+] years of core experience in US Bench Sales recruitment, with a track record spanning IT and either Pharma/Life Sciences or Non-IT staffing.
* **Domain Fluency:**
  Basic understanding or ability to quickly grasp technical stacks, corporate workflows, and clinical research/regulatory terms (e.g., SAS, CDISC, SDTM, GxP validation).
* **US Staffing & Visa Knowledge:**
  Sound understanding of US work authorizations (
  **H-1B, OPT, H4-EAD, Green Card, US Citizen**
  ) and contract models (
  **C2C, W-2, 1099**
  ).
* **Communication & Negotiation:**
  Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills to interact smoothly with corporate US staffing partners.
* **Target-Driven:**
  Goal-oriented approach with a proven history of meeting daily submission benchmarks and securing monthly placement quotas.
* **Shift Flexibility:**
  Readiness to work US night shifts consistently.

description:
About Birlasoft:

Birlasoft is a global technology company enabling “next-generation” digital transformation through expertise in Cloud, AI, Data, and enterprise solutions. Combining industry proficiency with advanced digital capabilities, it helps businesses accelerate change with speed, scale, and purpose, delivering “future-ready” solutions that enhance agility, resilience, and customer experience. Part of the CKA Birla Group and led by Chairman Mrs. Amita Birla, Birlasoft’s nearly 12,000 professionals drive innovation while building a diverse, inclusive, and learning-oriented culture. With a strong focus on sustainability and long-term value creation, Birlasoft transforms enterprises and communities, earning its reputation as a trusted partner and one of the best places to work.

**Role:**
Specialist- Talent Acquisition

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration

**Experience :**
7-10 Years

**Role & responsibilities:**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for assigned positions across functions, levels, and hiring categories.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, team structure, success profiles, and hiring timelines.
* Draft, refine, and publish job descriptions aligned to business needs and market realities.
* Source candidates through multiple channels including job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, internal databases, social media, and direct outreach.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of active and passive candidates for current and future hiring needs.

* Monitor hiring metrics such as time to source, time to fill, offer-to-join ratio, and source effectiveness.
* Support diversity hiring, internal hiring, and strategic talent pipelining initiatives wherever applicable.
* Ensure a positive and professional candidate experience across every stage of the hiring journey.
* Stay updated on market trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and hiring best practices in the Noida and NCR talent market.
* Collaborate with HR operations, onboarding, and business stakeholders to enable smooth handover of selected candidates.

company: Lifecare Diagnostic and Research Center Pvt Ltd
description:
**Company Description**
Lifecare Diagnostic and Research Center Pvt Ltd, established in 1995, is a premier full-service diagnostic center offering advanced laboratory, imaging, and digital pathology services. The organization focuses on integrated diagnostic solutions that support physicians in personalizing patient care and improving health outcomes. Lifecare is committed to delivering high-quality testing, reliable service, and tailored solutions for complex clinical needs. A diverse and highly skilled team of medical professionals, including physicians, scientists, technologists, and specialists, collaborate to ensure accurate and timely diagnostics. Lifecare serves patients, collection centers, and acts as a reference laboratory for clinics and hospitals both nationally and internationally.

**Role Description**
The Human Resources Manager will oversee the full spectrum of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations for Lifecare’s diagnostic and laboratory teams. This full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai involves partnering with department heads to identify staffing needs, develop job profiles, and manage end-to-end hiring processes. The HR Manager will design and implement HR policies, support training and development initiatives, and ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and organizational standards. Daily responsibilities include handling HR documentation, managing payroll inputs, administering benefits, facilitating employee engagement activities, and resolving workplace concerns professionally and confidentially. The role also includes creating and monitoring HR metrics, recommending process improvements, and supporting leadership with workforce planning and organizational development.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Human Resources management skills, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Candidates should possess skills in HR policy development, compliance with labor laws, and HR documentation and record-keeping.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in training and development, coaching, and supporting career growth initiatives.
* Candidates should possess skills in conflict resolution, negotiation, and fostering an inclusive, respectful workplace culture.
* Candidates should possess strong communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills to work effectively with clinical and non-clinical teams.
* Candidates should possess organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Relevant experience as an HR Manager or similar HR leadership role, preferably in healthcare, diagnostics, or related industries.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Proficiency with HRIS systems and MS Office tools, and comfort working with data and HR metrics.
* Demonstrated commitment to ethical practices, confidentiality, and continuous improvement in HR processes.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and enthusiastic
**Talent Acquisition Intern**
to support our recruitment team in sourcing, screening, and coordinating with candidates throughout the hiring process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
* Coordinate interview schedules and follow up with candidates.
* Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Assist in job postings and candidate communication.
* Support the Talent Acquisition team in day-to-day recruitment activities.

**Required Skills**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of recruitment and hiring processes.
* Knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced environment.

**Eligibility**

* Graduate in HR, Management, or a related field.

title: Staff Recruiter
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We’re hiring a senior full-cycle recruiter to run searches across Revenue, GTM (Pre/Post Sales - Solutions Architect roles with secondary coverage for G&A as bandwidth allows (e.g., Marketing, Legal, People Ops, IT, Procurement, Executive Support). You’ll partner with senior leaders to shape hiring plans, run efficient recruiting processes, and deliver strong, vetted pipelines on tight timelines.
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role, you will own full-cycle hiring for GTM and G&A roles, including intake, calibration, sourcing, candidate assessment, offer strategy, and close. You will also flex to G&A requisitions as bandwidth permits, building pipelines and running structured processes for Finance, Legal, People Ops, IT, Procurement, and Executive Support. You’ll advise hiring managers on scoping, leveling, compensation bands, interview design, and decision quality, while running structured, fair processes that improve pass-through quality. Success in this role requires operating by the numbers, championing candidate experience, collaborating cross-functionally with People Ops/HRBPs, Finance, and Legal, and continuously improving recruiting tools, process quality, and market intelligence.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting, including GTM (Marketing/Revenue) and G&A roles in high-growth tech or adjacent industries.
* Demonstrated success recruiting G&A roles (Finance, Legal, People/HR).
* Success hiring across Manager/Director levels and hard-to-fill specialties.
* Expert intake/calibration skills; you translate fuzzy needs into crisp profiles and assessment plans.
* Strong offer strategy/closing chops with data-informed guidance on compensation, leveling, and risk tradeoffs.
* Data fluency: manage a funnel, forecast timelines, and drive decisions with metrics.
* Systems: ATS (e.g., Greenhouse), LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, Tableau.
* Context switching: ability to move seamlessly between GTM and G&A portfolios while maintaining quality and speed.

**Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.**

* You love to run efficient recruiting processes and deliver strong, vetted pipelines on tight timelines.
* You’re curious about hiring plans, market intel, and how to improve pass-through quality across GTM and G&A searches.
* You’re an expert in full-cycle recruiting, stakeholder partnership, and structured candidate assessment.

**Why CoreWeave?**
**About**
At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:
  
  

* Be Curious at Your Core
* Act Like an Owner
* Empower Employees
* Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
* Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take off, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!
  
  
The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

**Location: Delhi**

**Budget: 10 to 15 LPA**

**Qualification: MBA/PGDM/MHRM in Human Resources or equivalent**

**Preferred Experience: Healthcare, hospital, clinic or multi-location organization**

**experience will be an advantage.**

**About the Role**

The HR Manager will be responsible for managing and overseeing day-to-day HR operations, recruitment, manpower planning, employee relations, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, performance management, employee engagement and exit processes. The role will ensure effective implementation of HR policies, processes and applicable statutory requirements across assigned locations.

**Responsibilities**

* **HR Operations**
* Manage end-to-end HR operations for assigned locations and business functions.
* Ensure effective implementation of HR policies, processes and procedures.

* Manage recruitment consultants, job portals and other hiring sources.
* Conduct HR interviews and salary negotiations.

* Coordinate resolution of employee payroll and salary-related queries.

* Ensure payroll inputs are accurate and submitted within defined timelines.

* **Statutory Compliance**

* Keep Management/HR Head informed about significant compliance issues or changes in applicable regulations.

* **Employee Relations & Grievance Handling**
* Handle employee grievances and workplace-related concerns.
* Investigate employee issues and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Maintain professional and positive employee relations.
* Support management in handling disciplinary and employee-related matters.
* Prepare/coordinate appropriate employee communications wherever required.
* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies and procedures.
* Escalate critical or sensitive matters to the HR Head/Senior Management.

* **Performance Management**
* Coordinate employee performance review and appraisal processes.
* Ensure KRAs/KPIs are defined and reviewed for employees.
* Monitor probation and performance review timelines.
* Support managers in addressing performance-related concerns.
* Coordinate Performance Improvement Plans wherever required.
* Identify employee training and development requirements.

* Promote a positive and professional workplace culture.
* Gather employee feedback and recommend improvements.

* Coordinate issuance of relieving and experience letters.
* Maintain accurate employee separation records.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (AI Hiring)
description:
**Location:**
Noida

**Job Summary**

We are searching for a high-impact
**Talent Acquisition Specialist**
with a strong
**IT Product / AI hiring mindset**
. This role goes beyond traditional sourcing and execution. We are seeking a
**Talent Advisor**
who can influence hiring decisions using market insights, engage senior AI and engineering talent, and act as a trusted partner to business and HR leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Recruitment Ownership**

* Manage full-cycle recruitment for niche and senior-level roles.
* Drive hiring from JD intake to joining, ensuring speed, quality, and an excellent candidate experience.

**2. Quality-Driven Talent Sourcing**

* Consistently identify and engage top-quality talent across
  **Data & AI**
  , AI Architecture, AI Research, AI Engineering, Product Management, Machine Learning, Ecosystem Partnerships, and cloud-native AI talent with expertise in
  **leading cloud AI platforms, Generative AI, LLMs, data platforms, and modern MLOps ecosystems**
  .
* Use mainstream sourcing channels effectively:
  **LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, networking, and employee referrals**
  .
* Demonstrate hands-on experience and curiosity to explore non-traditional sourcing channels, including
  **GitHub, Stack Overflow, and LLM / AI-based candidate search tools**
  .
* Continuously experiment with new sourcing approaches to improve talent quality and pipeline health.

**3. Talent Market Insights & Advisory**

* Conduct in-depth talent intelligence research on skill availability, talent geography, compensation benchmarks, and competitor hiring patterns.
* Use insights to
  **influence Hiring Managers and Leaders**
  and
  **recommend JD refinements based on market realities**
  .
* Develop a strong understanding of emerging AI and cloud technology trends, particularly within the
  **enterprise AI ecosystem**
  , including
  **Generative AI, LLMs, MLOps, data platforms, and cloud AI services**
  , to assess talent availability and advise hiring leaders.
* Build credibility as a
  **Talent Advisor**
  , not just an execution partner.

**4. Senior Talent Engagement & Influence**

* Confidently engage with senior and niche technical talent.
* Effectively pitch HCLTech's AI vision, growth opportunities, cloud and GenAI initiatives, and business impact, including strategic programs leveraging
  **AI technologies and modern data platforms**
  .
* Build long-term relationships with passive candidates.

**5. Offer Management & Negotiation**

* Lead offer discussions and negotiations with candidates.
* Partner with HR and Hiring Leaders to
  **justify salary proposals using market data, benchmarks, and candidate value**
  , and
  **secure timely approvals without compromising talent quality**
  .
* Ensure win-win outcomes for both HCLTech and candidates.

**6. Candidate Engagement & Joiner Conversion**

* Own the post-offer engagement strategy, including
  **structured candidate engagement plans**
  and
  **strong alignment and engagement throughout the notice period**
  .
* Proactively ensure
  **Hiring Leaders connect with offered candidates**
  .
* Deliver a
  **95%+ offer-to-join conversion ratio**
  .

**7. ATS & Compliance Excellence**

* Work extensively with the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Ensure
  **100% recruitment process compliance**
  through the ATS.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4 to 9 years of IT full-cycle recruitment experience.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* **Mandatory experience in AI / Data & AI hiring**
  , with exposure to hiring talent across AI, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, MLOps, Generative AI, and Cloud Architecture roles.
* Ability to operate as a trusted Talent Advisor to Hiring Managers and Leaders.

**Preferred Technical Awareness**

* Familiarity with leading AI and cloud technology stacks, including
  **major cloud AI platforms, Generative AI and LLM frameworks, data engineering platforms, MLOps tools, and container technologies such as Kubernetes**
  , enabling deeper talent conversations and market intelligence discussions.

title: US IT RECRUITER
company: Few Logics IT Systems LLP / Vision Infotech Inc.
description:
**Company Description**
Few Logics IT Systems LLP / Vision Infotech Inc. is a technology-focused organization that partners with clients to deliver IT solutions and staffing services across diverse industries. The company emphasizes building long-term relationships through reliable service, transparent communication, and a strong understanding of clients’ technical needs. Team members collaborate closely with stakeholders to support growth and innovation while maintaining high professional standards. Working here offers the opportunity to engage with dynamic projects and contribute to the development of scalable IT talent strategies.
  
**Role Description**

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**Location:**
Noida (On-site)

**Company:**
Zynence Labs Pvt. Ltd.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Industry:**
AI / Deep Tech / SaaS / Technology

About Zynence

Zynence is building an AI-native, full-lifecycle hardware engineering platform designed to transform how physical products are conceptualized, designed, developed, validated, and manufactured. Our platform brings together requirements engineering, system architecture, BOM and cost optimization, electronics and PCB design, firmware development, AI-native 3D CAD, simulation, validation, and manufacturing readiness within a connected, intelligent engineering environment.

We are an early-stage deep-tech startup with ambitious plans to build a globally scalable engineering technology company. As our team grows, we are looking for an HR Generalist who can take ownership of our people operations, build scalable HR processes, and help us attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and execution-oriented
**HR Generalist**
to independently manage day-to-day HR functions while helping establish the people infrastructure of a growing technology startup.

This is a hands-on role involving recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, HR operations, policy implementation, performance management coordination, and statutory compliance support.

You will work directly with the founders and functional teams, taking ownership of HR activities from workforce planning and talent acquisition to employee lifecycle management and organizational development.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating in an early-stage environment, can build processes from scratch, and understands that effective HR is about enabling people and business growth—not simply managing documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for technical, product, business, and operational roles.
* Collaborate with founders and hiring managers to understand hiring requirements, define job descriptions, and establish candidate evaluation criteria.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, referrals, campus networks, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen applications, conduct initial HR interviews, and coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
* Maintain structured candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers, and applicant databases.
* Coordinate salary discussions, offer negotiations, reference checks, and joining formalities.
* Develop and maintain talent pipelines for upcoming hiring requirements.
* Build relationships with colleges, universities, and training institutions for internships, fellowships, and campus recruitment.
* Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-hire, sourcing effectiveness, interview conversion, and offer acceptance rates.

2. Employee Onboarding & Lifecycle Management

* Own the complete employee onboarding process, from offer acceptance through joining and initial integration.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, employment agreements, and onboarding documentation.
* Coordinate employee verification, system access, induction schedules, and departmental introductions.
* Conduct structured onboarding sessions covering company policies, processes, and expectations.
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, and HR documentation.
* Manage employee confirmations, transfers, role changes, and other lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate employee exits, clearance procedures, exit interviews, and full-and-final settlement documentation.

3. HR Operations & Administration

* Establish and maintain standardized HR processes, documentation, trackers, and operating procedures.
* Manage employee attendance, leave records, holidays, and related HR administration.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, and compensation changes.
* Maintain employee databases and HR management systems.
* Ensure timely issuance and maintenance of employment-related documents.
* Support workforce planning, headcount tracking, and HR reporting.
* Coordinate with finance, administration, and external consultants on HR-related matters.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR activities and improve operational efficiency.

4. HR Policies & Statutory Compliance

* Support the development, implementation, and periodic review of company HR policies.
* Coordinate applicable statutory compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, professional tax, gratuity, and other employment-related obligations.
* Maintain employment records and documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.
* Coordinate with external payroll, legal, and compliance consultants where necessary.
* Support the implementation of workplace conduct, grievance redressal, and POSH-related policies and procedures.
* Ensure employee information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection requirements.
* Stay informed about relevant changes in employment regulations and HR practices.

5. Performance Management & Employee Development

* Coordinate employee goal-setting, performance reviews, probation evaluations, and appraisal cycles.
* Work with founders and functional leads to establish role-specific KPIs and performance expectations.
* Maintain performance review schedules, documentation, and follow-up actions.
* Support the identification of employee training and development requirements.
* Assist in implementing structured feedback, recognition, and employee development initiatives.
* Help build a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and high performance.

6. Employee Engagement & Workplace Culture

* Act as an approachable point of contact for employee queries, concerns, and HR-related matters.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, internal communications, and team-building activities.
* Conduct periodic employee check-ins and help identify opportunities to improve employee experience.
* Assist in resolving workplace concerns professionally and confidentially.
* Work closely with the founders to establish a collaborative, transparent, and performance-oriented startup culture.
* Support employee retention initiatives and improvements to the overall workplace experience.

7. HR Process Development & Automation

* Build practical, scalable HR workflows suited to a fast-growing technology startup.
* Introduce structured recruitment, onboarding, employee documentation, and performance tracking systems.
* Use AI tools and automation to improve sourcing, administrative workflows, documentation, and HR reporting.
* Develop standardized templates, checklists, dashboards, and internal HR knowledge resources.
* Continuously improve HR processes based on operational requirements and team feedback.

QualificationsRequired

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related discipline.
* **2–5 years of relevant HR experience**
  , preferably in a startup, technology company, or fast-growing organization.
* Hands-on experience managing recruitment and core HR operations.
* Working knowledge of employee lifecycle processes, HR documentation, payroll coordination, and applicable employment compliance requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and common workplace productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring requirements and HR responsibilities independently.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and sound judgment when handling confidential information.

Preferred

* Experience recruiting technical talent, including software developers, AI/ML engineers, electronics engineers, embedded systems engineers, or product professionals.
* Prior experience establishing or improving HR processes in an early-stage startup.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, HRMS platforms, and recruitment tools.
* Experience coordinating performance management and employee engagement initiatives.
* Familiarity with AI-powered productivity and HR automation tools.
* Exposure to campus recruitment, internship programs, or university partnerships.

What We Look For

**Ownership:**
You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through without constant supervision.

**Execution:**
You can translate requirements into action and manage multiple priorities efficiently.

**People Orientation:**
You genuinely enjoy working with people and building positive employee experiences.

**Discretion:**
You understand the importance of confidentiality, professionalism, and fairness in HR decisions.

**Adaptability:**
You are comfortable working in an evolving startup environment where processes and priorities change.

**Process Thinking:**
You look for ways to make HR operations more organized, efficient, and scalable.

**Technology Mindset:**
You are open to using AI, automation, and modern tools to improve how HR functions operate.

Why Join Zynence?

* **Build HR from the ground up:**
  Play a meaningful role in establishing the people operations of an emerging deep-tech company.
* **Work directly with founders:**
  Gain exposure to organizational planning, hiring decisions, and startup growth strategy.
* **Real ownership:**
  Independently manage important HR functions rather than operating within a narrowly defined administrative role.
* **Deep-tech exposure:**
  Work alongside teams developing AI-native engineering technologies and next-generation product development solutions.
* **Career growth:**
  Opportunity to grow into broader People Operations or HR leadership responsibilities as the organization scales.
* **Startup environment:**
  Be part of a collaborative, fast-moving team where initiative and execution are valued.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or send their updated resume to:

**Email:**
sushil@zynence.com

**Subject:**
Application for HR Generalist – Zynence

Please mention your current location, total HR experience, current and expected compensation, and notice period in your application.

**Work Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh (On-site)

* **Company Website:**
  https://zynence.com
