title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
**About SARAS AI Institute**

SARAS AI Institute is an AI-exclusive, fully online, degree-granting institution. Our programs run from foundation certificates through MS degrees, for learners in 20+ countries. We started in 2023 with 25+ learners. Today we have thousands, and our mission is to change 1 million lives with AI education by 2030.

**Location:**
Gurugram ·
**Reports to:**
Co-Founder & COO ·
**Type:**
Full-time

**The role**

This is a hiring role. It is not an HR generalist role. Your job is to get the right people into SARAS, fast. You’ll own recruitment end to end, from the brief to the joining date, and you’ll do most of it yourself.

The rest of HR at SARAS runs on automation. That leaves you free to spend your time on what matters most to us right now: closing great hires.

You’ll be measured on hires closed, quality of hire and speed. Activity doesn’t count.

**What you’ll do**

*Close hires*

* Run the full cycle for roles across academics and faculty, technology, sales, marketing and student success: briefing, sourcing, screening, assessment, closing and offer negotiation.
* Close senior and niche roles, including PhD and industry-practitioner faculty.
* Agree hiring timelines with every business leader and hold both sides to them.

*Build the pipeline*

* Source directly through LinkedIn, referrals, communities and campus channels before turning to agencies.
* Build talent networks in India, and in the US and international markets as we grow.
* Keep a warm bench of candidates for roles we know are coming.

*Run it on data*

* Own the ATS and keep the pipeline visible on one dashboard.
* Track time-to-hire, offer-acceptance rate, source mix and cost per hire.
* Use AI tools to source, screen and schedule faster.
* Manage the few agencies we use on speed, cost and quality.

*Candidate experience*

* Give every candidate, hired or not, a fast, clear and respectful process.
* Sell SARAS well: the mission, the stage and the opportunity.

**What success looks like**

* **60 days:**
  Open critical roles closed or in the final stage. Timelines agreed with every leader. Pipeline on one dashboard.
* **4 months:**
  Hiring is predictable. Time-to-hire is down, offer acceptance is up, and agency use is down.
* **6 months:**
  Leaders see you as the reason they can scale. A warm bench is ready for upcoming roles.

**Who we’re looking for**

* 6–9 years in recruitment or talent acquisition, mostly hands-on and full-cycle.
* A track record of closing senior or niche hires at pace. Be ready to walk us through specific closures.
* Experience in edtech, higher education, tech or a high-growth startup.
* You know your numbers: time-to-hire, acceptance rates, source mix.
* Exposure to US or international hiring is a strong plus.

**How you work**

* You own outcomes and don’t wait to be told.
* You push back on vague briefs and unrealistic asks, and you bring data to back it up.
* You’re a closer. You can sell a role and handle a tough negotiation.
* You move fast, stay hands-on and are comfortable with ambiguity.

**Compensation**

Total compensation, including a performance-linked variable tied to hires closed and time-to-hire, is capped at ₹20 LPA. This is a high-ownership role with a direct line to the leadership team and room to grow into a Head of TA role as the team scales.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
Bengaluru, India

**About Ushur**
---------------

Ushur delivers the world's first Customer Experience Automation platform built specifically for regulated industries. With guardrails and compliance-ready infrastructure, Ushur powers vertical AI Agents for healthcare, financial services, and insurance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Ushur is backed by Third Point Ventures, Tiger Global, 8VC, Iron Pillar, Aflac Ventures, and Pentland Ventures, with a sizable Fortune 500 customer base. Our Bengaluru office is one of two principal locations and is central to how the company is built and run.

We build AI agents for regulated enterprises, and we run our own operations the same way.

About Ushur | Ushur Platform

**Role Details**
----------------

* **Title:** People Operations Specialist
* **Experience:** 5–7 years
* **Location:** Bengaluru, India
* **Work Mode:** Hybrid
* **Reports To:** Director, People Operations

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a hands-on People Operations Specialist to independently manage and continuously improve HR operations for Ushur's India organization, working closely with our global People and Operations teams. You'll own the day-to-day: payroll inputs, benefits, onboarding and exits, HR systems, recruitment operations and employee support. You'll also make that work better. When you see a manual process, you'll simplify it, automate it, or turn it into self-service, using AI and automation where they help, with care for employee data. You'll build and improve these workflows yourself, not just identify them.

**AI-Native Operations**
------------------------

At Ushur, we believe modern People Operations should be increasingly intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. You will actively explore how AI, automation, and better system integration can improve the quality and efficiency of HR operations.

* Identify repetitive, manual processes and implement practical automation.
* Improve employee self-service through digital workflows, knowledge resources, and intelligent assistance.
* Leverage AI tools for appropriate administrative, analytical, reporting, and recruitment-support activities.
* Measure improvements in turnaround time, data accuracy, employee experience, and manual effort.
* Apply human oversight, privacy safeguards, and sound judgment, particularly when handling confidential employee information or supporting people-related decisions.
* We value practical improvements that deliver measurable results, not technology adoption for its own sake.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Payroll and Statutory Compliance**

* Independently manage monthly payroll inputs, validation, reconciliations, and coordination with Finance and payroll partners.
* Administer full and final settlements, including applicable notice-period adjustments, leave encashment, gratuity, and recoveries.
* Manage employee tax declarations, investment proofs, Form 16, and payroll-related queries.
* Implement approved changes to compensation structures, payroll policies, and statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate employee, compensation, attendance, and leave records.

### **Benefits and Vendor Management**

* Administer employee benefits, including health insurance, life insurance and wellness programmes.
* Coordinate enrolments, changes, claims support and benefits queries.
* Prepare annual benefits reviews and renewals using data analysis, vendor comparisons and recommendations.
* Manage relationships with insurers, brokers and other partners, monitor service quality, and coordinate the related admin and invoicing.

### **Onboarding and Offboarding**

* Manage onboarding from pre-joining documents through orientation and HR systems setup, so every new hire has a consistent, welcoming start.
* Coordinate lifecycle changes, including transfers, promotions, compensation updates and documentation.
* Manage offboarding: exit documents, clearances, F&F coordination and benefits transitions.

### **HR Systems and Data**

* Administer our HRIS and applicant tracking system: records, workflows, reporting and data integrity.
* Configure, build and improve HR workflows, approvals and self-service, and fix them when they break.
* Build and maintain operational reports and dashboards that support decisions.
* Respond to employee queries on policies, benefits, documents and HR processes, and prepare employment letters and verifications.

### **Hiring Operations**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment operations: job postings, sourcing, initial screening, interview coordination, offers and background verification.
* Coordinate interviews and candidate communication across distributed teams.
* Keep the applicant tracking system and hiring reports accurate, and improve the candidate experience.

### **Compliance, Audits and Calendars**

* Coordinate HR compliance activities, statutory reporting, POSH-related administration, and required employee training.
* Maintain appropriate records and documentation to support internal and external audits.
* Maintain key People Operations calendars, compliance deadlines, and recurring administrative processes.

### **Performance, Engagement and Recognition**

* Support performance review cycles, compensation administration, and employee recognition programmes.
* Coordinate employee engagement initiatives, feedback surveys, and related activities.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

### **By Day 90**

* Build a strong understanding of Ushur's HR processes, systems, policies, and stakeholders.
* Independently manage core People Operations activities with accuracy and reliability.
* Establish effective working relationships across India and global teams.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities to simplify or automate existing processes.

### **By Month 12**

* Demonstrate consistent accuracy, timeliness, and compliance across core HR operations.
* Improve operational efficiency and the employee experience through measurable process improvements.
* Implement meaningful automation or self-service enhancements.
* Build scalable, well-documented processes that support organizational growth.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Essential**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related technical field (B.Tech, BE, BCA, BSc CS or similar).
* 5–7 years in HR operations, ideally at a startup or scale-up.
* 3+ years preparing accurate monthly payroll inputs (joiners, exits, LOP, variable pay), with a working knowledge of India statutory benefits (PF, ESI, PT, gratuity) to answer employee queries and check F&F inputs.
* Proof that you build things and don't just use them: workflows, reports, trackers or automations you set up yourself in an HRIS, Google Sheets, Apps Script, Zapier or similar.
* You use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT every day to create real work, and you check what they give you before you rely on it.
* You're comfortable reading, testing, and fixing formulas, workflow rules, and simple scripts. You don't wait for someone else to do it.
* Hands-on setup of a modern HRIS and ATS: fields, workflows, permissions and reports.
* You can run onboarding, exits, benefits, employee queries and recruitment operations on your own from start to finish.
* You're careful with data and treat confidential information that way.
* You write and speak clearly with teams in India and the US.

### **Nice to Have**

* An MBA or Master's in HR alongside your technical degree.
* Experience with Rippling or a similar all-in-one HRIS.
* Basic SQL, scripting or working with APIs.
* Experience with benefits renewals, audits or performance review admin.
* Experience at a global B2B SaaS company.

**You'll enjoy this role if** you see a manual process and want to fix it rather than repeat it, and you'd like HR to be an area where operations and technology meet.

**Attributes**
--------------

* **Ownership:** Takes responsibility for outcomes, follows through, and proactively resolves issues.
* **Operational discipline:** Maintains accuracy, confidentiality, and consistency, even under deadline pressure.
* **Problem-solving:** Identifies inefficiencies and takes practical steps to improve them.
* **Service orientation:** Approaches employees, candidates, and stakeholders with empathy and professionalism.
* **Adaptability:** Responds constructively to change, feedback, and evolving business requirements.
* **AI and automation mindset:** Curious about new technologies, willing to experiment, and thoughtful about where human judgment remains essential.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

### **Meaningful Ownership**

Take responsibility for a broad range of People Operations activities and shape how they evolve.

### **AI-Native Environment**

Work in a company at the forefront of enterprise AI, with opportunities to apply automation to real operational challenges.

### **Global Collaboration**

Partner with colleagues across geographies and functions.

### **Company Culture**

A values-driven workplace built on respect, inclusion, and collaboration.

### **Paid Time Off**

Twenty days of flexible paid time off annually.

### **Health and Wellness**

Medical insurance for employees and eligible dependents, preventive health initiatives, and wellness programmes.

### **Compensation and Equity**

Competitive compensation and stock options.

### **Professional Development**

Opportunities for continuous learning, professional certifications, and access to internal learning resources.

title: IT Leader
description:
**About Glean:**

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry's most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean's agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry's broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC's Disruptor 50, Bloomberg's AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner's Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we're helping the world's largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you're excited to shape how the world works, you'll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

**About the Role:**

Glean is looking for a hands-on IT Leader to join our Bangalore IT Support organisation as a technical leader, people manager, and driver of AI-powered IT operations.

In this role, you will lead a team of full-time IT engineers and contractors and take ownership of our identity, endpoint, SaaS, and infrastructure ecosystem, including platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, and Kandji. You will stay close to the technology, resolve high-stakes escalations, guide architecture decisions, and champion automation, while building a high-performing, AI-fluent team that delivers a secure, reliable, and exceptional employee experience.

You will partner closely with Security, HR, Finance, Engineering, and external vendors to architect and maintain IT services that are both secure and scalable. You will also bring a strong AI-first mindset, using AI and automation to transform how IT work gets done across the employee lifecycle.

**You will:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of IT engineers (L1-L3), including full-time employees and contractors, setting clear goals, priorities, and expectations.
* Manage contractor and vendor relationships end to end, including staffing, performance, SLAs, onboarding, renewals, and cost, and ensure consistent quality across the extended team.
* Balance workload and priorities with the other IT Leader in Bangalore, ensuring strong coverage, clear ownership, and operational continuity across IT Support.
* Remain hands-on technically and act as a senior escalation point for complex issues across identity, infrastructure, endpoints, networking, and SaaS applications.
* Own the roadmap, administration, and optimization of Okta, Google Workspace, Kandji, and related identity and endpoint-management platforms.
* Drive AI and automation initiatives across IT: identify high-value workflows, then design, build, and deploy solutions that reduce manual effort and improve employee experience.
* Apply AI to IT workflows such as ticket triage and deflection, knowledge-base creation, onboarding and offboarding, access requests, provisioning, compliance checks, and reporting.
* Lead and deliver IT projects and cross-functional programs from planning through execution, including scoping, timelines, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and outcome tracking.
* Design and implement automation for provisioning, access management, compliance, reporting, and asset lifecycle workflows using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent technologies.
* Lead root-cause analysis for major incidents and drive long-term corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor system health, endpoint compliance, patch status, alerts, and operational risks, and take proactive action.
* Lead proof-of-concept projects to evaluate new IT, security, endpoint, AI, and automation solutions.
* Partner with Security, HR, Finance, and Engineering on identity governance, employee lifecycle management, asset management, and operational workflows.
* Own ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management processes and continuously improve them.
* Ensure accurate SOPs, technical runbooks, knowledge-base articles, system documentation, and process workflows.
* Support ISO 27001, SOC 2, internal audit, policy implementation, and compliance-readiness activities.
* Define and track operational metrics (SLAs, CSAT, ticket trends, automation impact), and communicate risks, trends, and improvement outcomes to senior management.
* Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, efficiency, and employee experience across IT services.

**About you:**

* 14+ years of experience in IT engineering, systems administration, IT operations, endpoint management, or a related field, including 3+ years leading IT teams.
* Strong technical foundation with a track record of staying hands-on while leading others; you are comfortable going deep when it matters.
* Proven experience managing people and contractors, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and building team culture across employees and an extended workforce.
* Experience managing vendors, MSPs, or staff-augmentation partners, including SLAs, performance reviews, and commercial discussions.
* Demonstrated AI fluency: you have worked on AI-related projects and have used AI to automate or improve IT workflows (for example, AI-assisted support, agents, workflow automation, or LLM-powered tooling).
* Strong hands-on experience administering Okta, including SSO, MFA, lifecycle automation, application integrations, and access policies.
* Strong experience administering Google Workspace, including user lifecycle management, groups, access controls, and security settings.
* Hands-on experience with Kandji, Jamf, Intune, or a similar MDM platform.
* Advanced troubleshooting experience across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routing, and firewalls.
* Experience with automation and scripting using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar tools.
* Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or Freshservice.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management.
* Familiarity with endpoint security, identity governance, access control, patch compliance, and security operations.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, internal audits, or similar compliance programs.
* Strong documentation, communication, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work with global teams.
* Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and take ownership from investigation through resolution.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred but not required.

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)

**Compensation & Benefits:**

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We're committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

title: Lead Employee Retention and Engagement
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Lead Employee Retention & Engagement will be responsible for developing and implementing organisation-wide strategies to improve employee engagement, strengthen workforce retention and reduce attrition across Muthoot FinCorp Limiteds geographically distributed operations.

The role will analyse workforce data and attrition trends, identify employees and locations with potential retention risks, and implement timely, targeted interventions. It will also lead employee-connect programmes, stay interviews, engagement surveys and other initiatives aimed at enhancing the overall employee experience.

The position requires close collaboration with business leaders and HR teams across India to understand workforce concerns, recommend corrective actions and ensure the effective execution of retention and engagement plans. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical, stakeholder-management and programme-execution capabilities and be willing to travel extensively.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Retention Strategy &Attrition Analysis***

Develop and implement organisation-wide employee retention strategies aligned with business objectives and workforce priorities.

Analyze attrition trends across roles, locations, tenure groups and business units to identify key reasons and high-risk areas.

Use employee data and workforce indicators to identify potential attrition risks and initiate timely preventive actions.

***Retention Initiatives***

Design and execute targeted retention programmes for critical roles, high-performing employees and locations experiencing high attrition.

Develop and implement engagement initiatives that improve employee experience, motivation, belonging and organisational commitment.

***Employee Connect Programmes***

Conduct structured employee-connect sessions, focus-group discussions and one-to-one interactions to understand employee concerns.

Design and conduct stay interviews with critical and high-performing employees to identify retention drivers and address concerns proactively.

Partner with business leaders, Zonal HR teams and other stakeholders to develop and implement role- and location-specific retention plans

***Employee Feedback and Action Planning***

Gather employee feedback through surveys and interactions, identify key concerns and ensure corrective actions are implemented within defined timelines.

***Retention Metrics and Reporting***

Monitor early attrition, regrettable attrition, retention rates and other relevant metrics, and provide periodic reports to management.

Define KPIs and evaluate the effectiveness and business impact of retention and engagement initiatives.

Prepare dashboards and presentations highlighting attrition patterns, employee concerns, programme outcomes and recommended actions.

***Best-Practice Implementation & Field Visits***

Identify successful retention and engagement practices and facilitate their adoption across regions and business units.

Travel extensively across locations to interact with employees and stakeholders, understand ground-level concerns and support programme implementation.

**KEY INTERACTIONS**

***Internal Stakeholders***

CHRO and Senior Management

Business Heads and Functional Heads

Zonal HR Teams, HR Business Partners, TA Team

Branch and Line Managers

Learning and Development Team

Compensation and Benefits Team

HR Operations and HR Analytics Teams

***External Stakeholders***

Employee-Engagement and HR Consulting Partners

Survey and HR Technology Providers

Industry Networks and Professional Bodies

**KEY DECISION TAKEN**

Identify and prioritise critical roles, employees, locations and business units requiring immediate retention intervention.

Determine appropriate interventions based on attrition risks, employee concerns and business requirements.

Design and implement employee-engagement programmes within approved policies and budgets.

Identify potential attrition cases and decide the level and urgency of preventive action required.

Determine the target groups, locations, frequency and format of employee-connect programmes and stay interviews.

Recommend corrective actions to address concerns relating to managers, workplace culture, career growth, recognition and employee experience.

Decide which critical or unresolved employee concerns should be escalated to HR or business leadership.

Evaluate programme outcomes and decide whether initiatives should be continued, modified, expanded or discontinued.

Determine the key insights, risks and recommendations to be presented to senior management for decision-making.

**KEY SKILLS & BEHAVIOURAL ATTRIBUTES**

Ability to develop and execute retention and engagement strategies aligned with organisational priorities.

Strong analytical skills to interpret attrition trends, employee data and engagement metrics.

Sound knowledge of employee engagement, retention drivers and employee-experience practices.

Excellent communication, presentation, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.

Strong problem-solving ability to identify root causes and recommend timely, practical solutions.

Ability to manage multiple retention and engagement initiatives across geographically distributed locations.

Proactive, adaptable and result-oriented, with the ability to anticipate and address potential attrition risks.

Willingness to travel extensively and engage with employees and stakeholders across India.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE**

Postgraduate degree or MBA/PGDM in Human Resources Management or an equivalent discipline from a recognised institution.

8-10 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3–5 years in employee retention, engagement or employee experience.

Experience in designing and implementing retention and engagement initiatives across multiple locations.

Strong exposure to attrition analysis, employee surveys, stay interviews and HR analytics.

Experience in a large, geographically distributed organisation is preferred.

Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and HR analytics/reporting tools.

Willingness to travel extensively across India.

Location : Chennai,Mumbai,Bengaluru,Hyderabad

title: HR Compliance Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Overview**
The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.
  
  
This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast-evolving compliance landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting & Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:

+ Gratuity Act
+ Shops & Establishments Act (state-specific)
+ POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
+ Leave-related statutory provisions
+ Severance and separation-related compliance

* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops & Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations & HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications And Requirements**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4-7+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state-specific regulations including Shops & Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

* Judgement and Integrity: Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* Collaboration & Communication: Builds strong cross-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* Adaptability: Operates effectively in dynamic, fast-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives and shifting priorities.
* Operational Excellence: Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in HRIS (e.g., Workday), compliance reporting tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).

title: HR Compliance Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Overview**

The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.

This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast-evolving compliance landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting & Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:

  + Gratuity Act
  + Shops & Establishments Act (state-specific)
  + POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
  + Leave-related statutory provisions
  + Severance and separation-related compliance
* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops & Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations & HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4-7+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state-specific regulations including Shops & Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgement and Integrity:** Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* **Analytical & Problem-Solving:** Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* **Collaboration & Communication:** Builds strong cross-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* **Adaptability:** Operates effectively in dynamic, fast-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives and shifting priorities.
* **Operational Excellence:** Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Proficiency in HRIS (e.g., Workday), compliance reporting tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: AVP - Employee Relations and Compliances
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**The AVP – Employee Relations and Compliance** is responsible for developing, governing, and executing the employee relations and HR regulatory compliance framework for the India GCC. This role ensures adherence to applicable labour and employment laws, statutory obligations, employee relations processes, workplace investigations, and compliance governance requirements.

The incumbent will serve as the compliance subject matter expert and governance lead, partnering closely with Legal, Payroll, HR Operations, Facilities, Procurement, external labour compliance vendors, and business leaders to mitigate risk, maintain audit readiness, and ensure an equitable, compliant, and positive employee experience.

The role will be accountable for labour compliance oversight, regulatory monitoring, statutory inspections, compliance audits, policy governance, employee grievance management, disciplinary processes, and employee relations strategy across the India organization.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Regulatory Compliance Governance**

–Own and lead the end-to-end employment and labour compliance framework for the India GCC.

–Ensure compliance with applicable Central and State employment laws, labour regulations, and statutory obligations.

–Establish governance mechanisms for monitoring compliance obligations, statutory filings, registrations, renewals, notices, record maintenance, and payments.

–Build and maintain a compliance calendar and compliance dashboard covering all employment-related statutory requirements.

–Monitor regulatory changes and assess business impact, ensuring timely implementation of new compliance requirements.

–Drive compliance awareness and training programs for People leaders and employees.

–Act as the primary compliance escalation point for labour law matters.

**2. Labour Law & Statutory Compliance Management**

–Oversee compliance with employment related legislation

–Ensure statutory filings, registrations, renewals, inspections, notices, and returns are completed accurately and within timelines.

–Partner with Payroll and HR Operations to ensure all payroll-linked statutory requirements are met.

**3. Employee Relations & Workplace Governance**

–Develop and execute the Employee Relations strategy for the GCC.

–Lead employee grievance resolution, disciplinary actions, misconduct investigations, workplace complaints, and conflict management.

–Drive fair, consistent, and legally compliant employee relations processes.

–Support leaders with performance-related employee matters, conduct concerns, workplace disputes, and behavioral issues.

–Ensure compliance with internal policies, code of conduct requirements, and ethical standards.

–Partner with Legal where required on complex employee matters and litigation risks.

–Lead workplace investigations and ensure appropriate documentation, governance, and closure.

**4. Compliance Vendor & Regulatory Relationship Management**

–Manage relationships with external labour compliance vendors and legal advisors.

–Oversee labour law registrations, statutory record maintenance, compliance audits, regulatory filings, and labour inspection support through vendors.

–Coordinate responses to government authorities, inspectors, labour departments, and other regulators.

–Monitor vendor performance through SLAs, audit outcomes, compliance metrics, and governance reviews.

–Serve as the internal liaison for all labour compliance related regulatory interactions.

**5. Audit, Risk & Controls**

–Lead labour compliance audits and compliance self-assessments.

–Ensure organizational readiness for internal audits, regulatory inspections, external audits, and diligence exercises.

–Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for emerging compliance risks.

–Develop controls to ensure sustainable compliance adherence.

–Drive corrective action tracking and closure of audit observations.

–Maintain evidence repositories and statutory documentation for audit purposes.

**6. Policy Governance & Employee Experience**

–Own policy governance for employment-related policies and procedures.

–Review, update, and implement policies to align with legislative and organizational requirements.

–Ensure compliance requirements are embedded into employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, transfers, promotions, leave management, separations, contractor management, and workforce engagement.

–Partner with business and People leaders to maintain a positive employee experience while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation.

**7. Reporting, Analytics & Governance Forums**

–Develop compliance dashboards and executive reporting mechanisms.

–Provide regular updates to GCC Leadership and People Leadership teams on compliance status, risks, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.

–Use compliance and employee relations data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master’s degree in law, Employment Law, Labour Relations, Human Resources, or related discipline.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and employment compliance and regulatory frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of employee relations and workplace governance practices
* Experience managing employment compliance audits, investigations, and labour inspections.
* Certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, Industrial Relations, or Compliance Management are preferred.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

–15+ years of experience in HR Compliance, Employee Relations, Labour Relations, HR Operations, or Industrial Relations.

–Experience in BFSI GCC, multinational corporations, or regulated environments is strongly preferred.

–Experience working with external compliance and payroll vendors.

–Demonstrated experience managing labour inspections, audits, regulatory inquiries, and investigations.

–Strong experience designing scalable compliance governance frameworks.

**CORE COMPETENCY & BEHAVIOURAL DESCRIPTION**

* Regulatory Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of labour laws, statutory requirements, regulatory frameworks, and compliance governance.
* Employee Relations: Strong capability in grievance management, investigations, disciplinary processes, and workplace conflict resolution.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor compliance and employee relations risks proactively.
* Audit & Controls: Experience designing compliance controls and driving audit readiness.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to partner effectively with business leaders, legal teams, payroll teams, regulators, and external vendors.
* Policy Governance: Strong capability in developing, reviewing, and implementing policies and compliance frameworks.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to use compliance data and people analytics to drive decisions and identify emerging risks.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence leaders at all levels.
* Investigation & Judgment: Demonstrated capability to conduct impartial investigations and make sound risk-based decisions.

title: SR HR MANAGER
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
The HR Manager position is a hands-on working position, reporting to the Sr. Director Business Partner. India HR Manager, the incumbent is an integral part of Weatherford’s matrixed India business and HR leadership community. The role is expected to act as a trusted consultant and partner (coach, advise, counsel) to the assigned business organization(s). The India business is part of the Asia Geozone with ~$400m Revenue and The India hosts multiple business for Weatherford Global support such as Corporate Functions, Research and Development center, Manufacturing and Operations.
  
  
****RESPONSIBILITIES****
SAFETY, SECURITY & COMPLIANCE
  
  

* Maintains the highest standards of corporate governance, ensuring that all activities are carried out ethically and in compliance with Company’s Security, Compliance & HSE policies, Management System, relevant laws, regulations, standards and industry practices and complies with the Company’s Rules to Live By.
* Places Quality, Health & Safety, Security and protection of the Environment as core values while never intentionally placing employees, our processes, customers or the communities in which we live and work at risk.
* Seeks continual improvement in Health, Safety, Security & protection of the Environment, taking into account responsible care, process vulnerabilities, public, customer and employee inputs, knowledge and technology and best business practices to exceed customer expectations.
* Supervisors & Managers should demonstrate effective safety leadership for the health and safety arrangements of all subordinates and for any persons visiting them while on the Company premises.

OPERATIONS
  
  

* Anticipates, identifies and analyzes business opportunities, needs and challenges to deliver solutions which address them.
* Contributes to the Weatherford HR strategy and translates it for the client and India All Business.
* Establishes trusted working relationships with business leadership and staff to be able to actively and effectively advise and provide thought partnership and coaching.
* Ensures key business HR processes (e.g., attraction, performance, retention, compensation, retention, DE&I, employee relations, HRMS, training/development, communication, change management) are delivered with high expectations for quality results both to the client, India Enterprise Level Businesses Operations, and HR.
* Contributes from design through execution on organization, portfolio and leadership changes and the change management of each.

QUALITY
  
  

* Responsible for being familiar with the Company's Quality policies and takes an active role in the compliance and improvement of Weatherfords Management System.
* Maintains service quality as immediate priorities when working across all areas of the business and continually seeks areas for improvement.

COMMUNICATION
  
  

* Effectively communicates with a global, cross-functional and diverse workforce focused on continuous HR service delivery quality and productivity improvement.
* Stakeholder engagement and management to develop and sustain productive client and stakeholder relationships at all levels of the organization.
* Maintains effective communications with all key stakeholders both internal and where appropriate external.
* Supervisors & Managers should clearly communicate expectations, roles and responsibilities to their reports.

FINANCIAL
  
  

* Understands the fundamentals of financial management in a global HR function and what constitutes effective, optimal delivery of cost-effective HR services.
* Provides guidance, tools and action plans to meet talent, financial, productivity, quality and other HR targets.
* All employees have an accountability to the organisation to be financially responsible whether they are in charge of a function budget or simply their own expenses.
* Costs incurred should be within approved budget, processed within agreed time frames & following the relevant financial policy and procedure.

PEOPLE & DEVELOPMENT
  
  

* With guidance, the HR Manager will lead an HR professional and actively engage them in their development (performance, talent identification, succession planning, development)
* Guides the Business Stakeholders at enterprise level and contributes heavily to the HR team to have influence and contribute to Weatherford HR and business organizations
* Collaborates highly across a global, highly distributed, matrixed and transformational business environment
* Contribute to creating a talent pipeline that assures the right people are placed at the right time with the right skill and will
* Contribute to Change & Culture transformation.
* Drive strategies for the recruitment & retention of talent and foster an environment that supports the attraction & retention of a high performing talented workforce
* Employees have a responsibility for developing their own careers within the Company including completing all necessary function, compliance & business standards training to enhance their knowledge, skills and experience
* Employees should engage on a regular basis with their line manager to discuss their personal performance, objectives and opportunities to enhance their skills and experience to support their career potential
* Supervisors are expected to actively engaging their employees to support talent management through Weatherford’s performance management process, including but not limited to talent assessments, succession planning & regular coaching opportunities
* Supervisors should collaborate with Human Resources & Training Development to drive strategies for the recruitment & retention of key personal & to foster an environment that supports the attraction & retention of a high performing talented workforce

VISION & LEADERSHIP
  
  

* Demonstrate leadership, ethical behaviour and adherence to Weatherford standards at all times.
* Contribute to the Weatherford HR strategy and translate it for the client and country such that a compelling vision and purpose is understood.
* Demonstrate leadership, ethical behaviour and adherence to Weatherford standards at all times

**Required**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or a related field.
* Have 15+ years progressive general HR experience, including a demonstrated career track record across multiple HR business partnership roles.
* Have Experience or demonstrated capability leading people or projects.

**Preferred:**

* 8 years of Managerial experience is preferred.

**Required**
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  
  

* High proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Sound knowledge of the energy industry
* Exceptional communication skills

title: Total Rewards Operations Leader/Benefits Manager
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
As the
**Total Rewards Operations Leader/Benefits Manager**
based in Navi Mumbai, you will establish and lead the Mumbai-based Global Total Rewards Operations Hub, delivering compensation and benefits processes across all regions. You will build a high-performing team and scalable operating model that ensures operational excellence, compliance, service quality, and a consistent employee experience through strong governance, controls, service management, and knowledge practices.
  
  
Working autonomously, you will partner with the Global Total Rewards Service Delivery Manager to improve and simplify processes, increase scalability, and advance a globally integrated Total Rewards delivery model.
  
  
You will combine deep compensation and benefits expertise with strong operational leadership and people development skills to independently lead a high-performing global service organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities – Duties, projects, tasks, and activities you would be responsible for in this role**

* Build the Global Operations Hub: stand up the Mumbai-based Total Rewards Operations team, defining team structure, roles, responsibilities, and operating model. Create a scalable delivery model capable of supporting all regions.
* Deliver Operational Excellence: ensure accurate and timely execution of globally compensation and benefits processes, owning service levels, quality standards, and operational performance and metrics.
* Establish Governance and Controls: design and implement operational controls, quality assurance mechanisms, and escalation frameworks. Ensure audit readiness and compliance with established requirements.
* Build Knowledge Management Capability: establish and maintain comprehensive process documentation and work instructions. Ensure operational knowledge is captured, governed, and continuously updated.
* Lead and Develop the Team: manage and develop a team of individual contributors, while building a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement. Build capabilities required to support future growth and expanded scope.
* Operationalize New Processes: transition appropriate activities into the Mumbai hub. Ensure successful onboarding of new global processes and drive disciplined change adoption and operational readiness.
* Partner on Continuous Improvement: work closely with the Global Total Rewards Service Delivery Manager to refine operational workflows. Provide operational insight and execution expertise to process improvement initiatives. Support automation and simplification efforts.

**Qualifications**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Fluent English communication skills (written and verbal).
* A minimum of 10-12 years of HR experience with at least 7 + years relevant experience in Total Rewards

**Below qualification will be added advantage:**

* Previous Global Business Services (GBS) leadership experience.
* Experience creating or managing an HR operations hub.
* Exposure to multiple regions (NA, LA, EMEAI)

**Your skills:**

* Leadership: Coaches talent and builds accountability and engagement.
* Total Rewards Operations: Strong compensation and benefits administration expertise.
* HR Operations Management: Builds operating models, governance, controls, and service performance with disciplined execution.
* Transformation Capability: Builds new teams, leads change, standardizes operations, and turns ambiguity into structured solutions.
* Process Improvement: Promotes service quality and continuous improvement.
* Interpersonal Communication: Communicates clearly and negotiates effectively.
* Critical Thinking: Analyzes data and situations, recommends solutions, and leads implementation.
* Stakeholder Management: Partners effectively with regional Total Rewards, HR Operations, Payroll, and global service delivery leaders.

**Additional Notes**

* Relocation Assistance is not available for this position.
* The ability to accommodate with international time zone is essential
* Willingness to work in the hybrid setup with 4 days from office is must

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:

+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
  
  
As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

description:
**Company Description**
Lifecare Diagnostic and Research Center Pvt Ltd, established in 1995, is a premier full-service diagnostic center offering advanced laboratory, imaging, and digital pathology services. The organization focuses on integrated diagnostic solutions that support physicians in personalizing patient care and improving health outcomes. Lifecare is committed to delivering high-quality testing, reliable service, and tailored solutions for complex clinical needs. A diverse and highly skilled team of medical professionals, including physicians, scientists, technologists, and specialists, collaborate to ensure accurate and timely diagnostics. Lifecare serves patients, collection centers, and acts as a reference laboratory for clinics and hospitals both nationally and internationally.

**Role Description**
The Human Resources Manager will oversee the full spectrum of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations for Lifecare’s diagnostic and laboratory teams. This full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai involves partnering with department heads to identify staffing needs, develop job profiles, and manage end-to-end hiring processes. The role also includes creating and monitoring HR metrics, recommending process improvements, and supporting leadership with workforce planning and organizational development.

* Candidates should possess strong Human Resources management skills, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Candidates should possess skills in HR policy development, compliance with labor laws, and HR documentation and record-keeping.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in training and development, coaching, and supporting career growth initiatives.
* Candidates should possess skills in conflict resolution, negotiation, and fostering an inclusive, respectful workplace culture.
* Candidates should possess strong communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills to work effectively with clinical and non-clinical teams.
* Candidates should possess organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Relevant experience as an HR Manager or similar HR leadership role, preferably in healthcare, diagnostics, or related industries.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Proficiency with HRIS systems and MS Office tools, and comfort working with data and HR metrics.
* Demonstrated commitment to ethical practices, confidentiality, and continuous improvement in HR processes.

title: HR Shared Service Specialist II
description:
**Position Summary**
Reporting to the HR Services Supervisors and/or Managers, the HR Specialist II is responsible for processing HR transactions and exceptions that are escalated from HR Specialist I.
  
  
This position is integral to the processing of end-to-end and specialized service transactions accurately and in compliance with company policies.
  
  
**Role**
The HR Specialist II plays a key role in supporting critical HR initiatives that drive the overall effectiveness of the function. In doing so, they will focus their efforts within one of the following three areas:
  
  

* HR Operations emphasis - Facilitate onboarding processes, manage data integrity, ensure compliance, and provide support for various regional HR Shared Services operations.
* Compensation emphasis - Assist with the annual compensation review, manage ad hoc compensation requests, and process one-time payments along with other regional compensation services.
* Reporting and Mass Data emphasis -Generate human capital reports, manage mass uploads, and utilize established templates for efficient data management and processing.

**Essential Functions**

* Process a wide range of employee transactions within Workday and service a wide range of requests in BMC Helix, ensuring accuracy and adherence to service level agreements.
* Manage and resolve exceptions and level 2 transactions, providing solutions to more complex employee inquiries and issues.
* Provide guidance and support to Tier 1 Specialists, acting as a point of escalation for complex cases.
* Collaborate with HR team members to identify and implement process improvements, aiming to enhance efficiency and employee experience.
* Coordinate and execute Workday transactions related to HR operations, such as job changes, personnel changes, and position management.
* Facilitate the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring all necessary paperwork is completed accurately and efficiently to promote a smooth and positive new joiner experience.
* Maintain organized and up-to-date employee files, ensuring compliance with legal and internal requirements for data privacy and protection.
* Conduct regular audits of HR processes and employee records to ensure compliance with company policies and identify areas for improvement.
* Provide training and support to Tier 1 Specialists on HR operations procedures, enhancing their ability to address employee inquiries and transactions effectively.

We invest in you.

title: Senior Executive-Talent Acquisition
description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for an experienced and driven Senior Executive-Talent Acquisition to manage end-to-end hiring. The role requires strong stakeholder management skills, expertise in recruitment operations, and the ability to drive process improvements, employer branding initiatives, and data-driven talent acquisition strategies.

Key Responsibilities:

Talent Acquisition

•Manage end-to-end recruitment for technical and non-technical positions.

•Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce requirements and hiring priorities.

•Develop sourcing strategies to attract quality talent across multiple channels.

•Ensure timely closure of positions while maintaining a strong candidate experience.

Stakeholder Management

•Build strong relationships with business leaders, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams.

•Conduct regular hiring reviews and provide recruitment updates.

•Act as a trusted talent advisor to business stakeholders.

Talent Acquisition Operations

•Manage and ensure timely and accurate updating and maintenance of all Talent Acquisition trackers, and operational data.

•Manage vendor coordination and contract-related activities, including documentation, renewals, and maintaining vendor records.

•Prepare and maintain quarterly and annual recruitment data and reports for business and leadership review.

•Manage pre-onboarding activities for selected candidates, ensuring all required documentation and coordination are completed before the date of joining.

•Coordinate and track Background Verification (BGV) activities and ensure timely completion as per the defined process.

•Work closely with recruiters, HR, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth and timely execution of TA operations and pre-onboarding processes.

TA Analytics and Reporting

•Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-fill, source effectiveness, diversity hiring, and pipeline health.

•Prepare recruitment dashboards and reports for leadership reviews.

•Use data and insights to support hiring decisions and workforce planning.

Required Skills:

•Strong experience in end-to-end recruitment.

•Strong Knowledge in MS Excel.

•Excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills.

•Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.

•Knowledge of recruitment metrics and dashboards.

•Exposure to employer branding initiatives.

•Experience using ATS platforms and recruitment technologies.

•Understanding of AI tools and automation in Talent Acquisition.

•Strong communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
