title: HCM Technical Delivery Lead
description:
**Overview**

The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Key areas of focus include Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, integrations, reporting, data migration and emerging Oracle AI capabilities.

Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities.
* Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features.
* Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management.
* Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership
* Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare.
* Own or guide solution architecture, configuration and technical design across Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence and, where in scope, Payroll, Talent Management and Workforce Compensation.
* Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns.
* Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms.
* Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance.
* Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose.
* Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues.
* Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues.
* Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases.
* Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption.

Operational Management

* Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues.
* Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk.
* Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation.
* Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria.

People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and quality oversight to technical consultants, analysts and delivery partners.
* Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors.
* Communicate complex technical matters in clear business language and support informed decision-making without overstating certainty or benefits.
* Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams.

Governance, Security and Risk

* Ensure solutions comply with approved architecture, privacy, security, access control, change management and data governance requirements.
* Design and review role-based security, data access and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with relevant control owners.
* Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance.
* Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options.
* Ensure third-party delivery is governed through defined outcomes, quality standards, documentation requirements and knowledge transfer.

The above list of key accountabilities is not exhaustive and may change from time to time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically 10+ years of enterprise applications or IT consulting experience, including substantial hands-on experience delivering Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, enhancements and transformation programmes from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment and post-production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex Oracle HCM technical workstreams or end-to-end delivery in a large, regulated or multinational organisation.
* Strong technical and functional understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM, with depth across Core HR and experience in modules such as Recruiting, Time and Labour and Absence Management. Exposure to Payroll, Talent Management or Workforce Compensation is advantageous.
* Hands-on capability with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP web services, BI Publisher and OTBI.
* Experience with business process analysis, functional consulting, solution architecture, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, environments, release management and production support.
* Demonstrated fluency in business processes, digital transformation and support models, with the ability to connect operating needs to practical technology outcomes.
* Understanding and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite is advantageous.
* Experience managing Oracle quarterly updates, regression impacts, deployment planning and post-production stabilisation.
* Ability to evaluate Oracle AI and automation capabilities pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, privacy, security, control and human review.
* Oracle Cloud HCM certifications are highly regarded. Relevant certifications may include Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, Integration or Oracle Fusion AI capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead technical teams and vendors, set quality expectations and deliver through influence in a matrix environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including structured diagnosis of complex integration, data, security and configuration issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical options, trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong planning, prioritisation and delivery discipline, with the ability to manage concurrent initiatives and production priorities.
* High standards of integrity, discretion and care when handling employee and organisational data.
* Practical, collaborative and outcomes-focused, with the confidence to work with limited supervision, manage multiple priorities, challenge weak assumptions and escalate material risks.

title: SAP CPI Consultant
description:
Role - SAP CPI Integration Consultant

Location – Pune  
Shift Timings: General Shift

We are seeking an experienced SAP CPI Integration Consultant to support our HR technology landscape and enterprise integration initiatives. The resource will be responsible for delivering new integrations and enhancements across SAP SuccessFactors, MyHR, and downstream applications while helping optimize the existing integration architecture. The consultant will also play a key role in the design, development, and implementation of integrations for our upcoming SAP S/4HANA transformation program.

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support integrations using SAP Integration Suite (CPI).
* Deliver new integration developments and enhancement requests across SuccessFactors and connected enterprise systems.
* Analyze and optimize existing integrations to improve reliability, performance, maintainability, and monitoring.
* Partner with business analysts and application teams to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions.
* Develop and maintain reusable integration patterns, best practices, and technical standards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production integration issues, interface failures, and performance bottlenecks.
* Create and maintain technical design documents, interface specifications, support documentation, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, HR technology, and application teams to define future-state integration architectures.
* Contribute to integration design, build, testing, and deployment activities for the SAP S/4HANA implementation program.
* Ensure compliance with security, governance, and data privacy requirements across all integrations.

* Strong experience integrating SAP SuccessFactors, SAP ERP/S4HANA, and third-party cloud applications.

* Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP, OData, RFC, SFTP, and API-based integrations.
* Experience with message mapping, transformation, XML, JSON, XSLT, and Groovy scripting.
* Working knowledge of Java for complex integration requirements and custom development.

* Familiarity with SAP BTP services and API Management.
* Experience with enterprise integration governance, security, and architecture standards.

Based in India, this individual will have significant responsibility for our India operations while owning key HR processes, platforms, and operational capabilities globally. The ideal candidate combines strong HR operations expertise with a practical, hands-on approach to simplifying processes, using technology and automation effectively, and improving the experience of employees and managers.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working across countries, cultures, and time zones and who can build relationships, influence stakeholders, and drive change in a highly collaborative environment. We are particularly interested in someone who has operated successfully in a mid-sized, growing organization and is comfortable both developing scalable approaches and personally driving improvements.

**Key responsibilities**

**•**
Proactively develop and/or evolve core processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, benefits administration, engagement support, employee relations standards and governance, leave, documentation, offboarding, and associated strategic reporting and analysis

• Oversee, simplify and enhance HR processes and policies, eliminating unnecessary activities, handoffs, manual work, and administrative complexity while staying compliant with relevant regulations

• Lead/own the configuration, optimization, governance, and ongoing administration of HR systems, workflows, and related HR infrastructure to ensure operating effectiveness

• Identify and implement opportunities to use HR technology, automation, self-service, analytics, and AI to improve efficiency and employee experience

• Provide strong operational leadership for HR activities in India while ensuring India operations are effectively integrated with global HR processes and practices

• Manage a distributed team and influence team members across regions to drive consistent practices and outcomes while enabling adaptation of processes to local market requirements and ensuring compliance with country-specific employment regulations and practices outside India

• Strengthen HR data quality, reporting, operational metrics, controls, documentation, and compliance

• Serve as thought partner with HR leadership, Finance, IT, Legal, and business leaders globally, building alignment and influencing stakeholders to implement improvements that improve scalability, efficiency, and employee experience.

**Background and qualifications**

• Approximately 10–20 years of progressive HR experience, including significant experience in HR operations, technology, workflows, self-service, analytics and related areas.

• Significant experience working in global, mid-sized or growth-oriented organizations, ideally with responsibility for processes, teams, or initiatives spanning multiple countries and regions.

• Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle and demonstrated experience simplifying and improving those processes.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, project management, communication, and change management capabilities, combined with a collaborative, hands-on approach to getting things done.

title: Manager- HRIS (SuccessFactors and HR Integrations)
description:
**Job Title:**
Manager - HRIS (SuccessFactors and HR Integrations)

**Department:**
Employee Experience (Function: DIT)

**Employment Type:**
Permanent

**Job Purpose:**

We are looking for a Manager to strategically manage, implement, and optimize the organization's Human Resources Information System (HRIS), specifically the SAP SuccessFactors platform. This role ensures robust and seamless integration with all internal and external HR and enterprise-level systems, thereby driving efficiency in HR operations and upholding data governance and integrity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **HRIS Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Governance (SAP SuccessFactors):**
  Formulate and govern the comprehensive HRIS product vision, strategic direction, and multi-year roadmap, focusing on the SAP SuccessFactors suite (including Employee Central, Learning, and Performance Management). Key activities include gathering and analyzing business requirements from HR stakeholders, prioritizing feature development based on strategic alignment and ROI, managing the product backlog, and enforcing system governance standards for data quality, security, and regulatory compliance.
* **Enterprise Solution Architecture, Configuration, and Optimization:**
  Direct the design, configuration, and continuous optimization of SuccessFactors modules to address current and future organizational needs. Responsibilities include translating business requirements into technical specifications, performing system configuration, managing testing cycles (Unit Testing and UAT), and resolving complex, escalated system incidents.
* **HR System Integration and Data Integrity Management:**
  Ensure the development and maintenance of seamless, stable, and secure integrations between SuccessFactors and enterprise systems (such as Financial ERP, Payroll platforms, and third-party vendors) utilizing middleware solutions like SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), IAS/IPS configurations, SuccessFactors integration center, SAP HCM to SF integration, and the BIB replication framework.
* **Cross-functional Stakeholder and Vendor Relationship Management:**
  Serve as the authoritative primary interface among Human Resources, Information Technology, end-users, and external consulting partners or vendors. This involves communicating roadmap updates, managing vendor contracts and service performance against SLAs, and providing expert consultation to the HR function.
* **Advanced Operational Support and Organizational Change Management:**
  Direct escalated L2 and L3 production support and spearhead formal Organizational Change Management (OCM) initiatives associated with deployments and upgrades. Responsibilities include establishing support protocols, managing bi-annual SuccessFactors release management processes, and developing professional training materials and documentation.



**Job Requirements:**

* **Academic Qualifications:**
  Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Human Resources, Business Administration, or an allied field. A Master’s degree (MBA, MIS) or professional HR certification (PHR, SHRM-CP) is preferred.
* **Experience:**
  A minimum of 8–10 years of progressively responsible experience within HRIS, IT, or HR functions, with at least 5 years explicitly dedicated to the management and implementation of SAP SuccessFactors modules (Employee Central expertise is mandatory). Candidates should also bring successful experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Solution Architect, along with demonstrated expertise in HR system integrations using middleware platforms like SAP Cloud Platform Integration/HCI or Dell Boomi.
* **Technical Skills & Knowledge:**
  Profound functional and technical command of SAP SuccessFactors (Employee Central plus 2–3 additional modules such as Compensation, Performance & Goals, Learning/LMS, Recruitment, or Onboarding 2.0). A robust comprehension of HR data models, security paradigms, international data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), integration protocols (APIs, SFTP, OData, SOAP), and practical experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* **Behavioral Skills:**
  Exceptional strategic acumen, advanced problem-solving capabilities, superior stakeholder management, negotiation, formal communication, leadership across cross-functional teams, vendor management, high accountability, and a strong results orientation.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**Location:**
Noida (On-site)

**Company:**
Zynence Labs Pvt. Ltd.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Industry:**
AI / Deep Tech / SaaS / Technology

About Zynence

Zynence is building an AI-native, full-lifecycle hardware engineering platform designed to transform how physical products are conceptualized, designed, developed, validated, and manufactured. Our platform brings together requirements engineering, system architecture, BOM and cost optimization, electronics and PCB design, firmware development, AI-native 3D CAD, simulation, validation, and manufacturing readiness within a connected, intelligent engineering environment.

We are an early-stage deep-tech startup with ambitious plans to build a globally scalable engineering technology company. As our team grows, we are looking for an HR Generalist who can take ownership of our people operations, build scalable HR processes, and help us attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and execution-oriented
**HR Generalist**
to independently manage day-to-day HR functions while helping establish the people infrastructure of a growing technology startup.

This is a hands-on role involving recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, HR operations, policy implementation, performance management coordination, and statutory compliance support.

You will work directly with the founders and functional teams, taking ownership of HR activities from workforce planning and talent acquisition to employee lifecycle management and organizational development.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating in an early-stage environment, can build processes from scratch, and understands that effective HR is about enabling people and business growth—not simply managing documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for technical, product, business, and operational roles.
* Collaborate with founders and hiring managers to understand hiring requirements, define job descriptions, and establish candidate evaluation criteria.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, referrals, campus networks, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen applications, conduct initial HR interviews, and coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
* Maintain structured candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers, and applicant databases.
* Coordinate salary discussions, offer negotiations, reference checks, and joining formalities.
* Develop and maintain talent pipelines for upcoming hiring requirements.
* Build relationships with colleges, universities, and training institutions for internships, fellowships, and campus recruitment.
* Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-hire, sourcing effectiveness, interview conversion, and offer acceptance rates.

2. Employee Onboarding & Lifecycle Management

* Own the complete employee onboarding process, from offer acceptance through joining and initial integration.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, employment agreements, and onboarding documentation.
* Coordinate employee verification, system access, induction schedules, and departmental introductions.
* Conduct structured onboarding sessions covering company policies, processes, and expectations.
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, and HR documentation.
* Manage employee confirmations, transfers, role changes, and other lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate employee exits, clearance procedures, exit interviews, and full-and-final settlement documentation.

3. HR Operations & Administration

* Establish and maintain standardized HR processes, documentation, trackers, and operating procedures.
* Manage employee attendance, leave records, holidays, and related HR administration.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, and compensation changes.
* Maintain employee databases and HR management systems.
* Ensure timely issuance and maintenance of employment-related documents.
* Support workforce planning, headcount tracking, and HR reporting.
* Coordinate with finance, administration, and external consultants on HR-related matters.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR activities and improve operational efficiency.

4. HR Policies & Statutory Compliance

* Support the development, implementation, and periodic review of company HR policies.
* Coordinate applicable statutory compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, professional tax, gratuity, and other employment-related obligations.
* Maintain employment records and documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.
* Coordinate with external payroll, legal, and compliance consultants where necessary.
* Support the implementation of workplace conduct, grievance redressal, and POSH-related policies and procedures.
* Ensure employee information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection requirements.
* Stay informed about relevant changes in employment regulations and HR practices.

5. Performance Management & Employee Development

* Coordinate employee goal-setting, performance reviews, probation evaluations, and appraisal cycles.
* Work with founders and functional leads to establish role-specific KPIs and performance expectations.
* Maintain performance review schedules, documentation, and follow-up actions.
* Support the identification of employee training and development requirements.
* Assist in implementing structured feedback, recognition, and employee development initiatives.
* Help build a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and high performance.

6. Employee Engagement & Workplace Culture

* Act as an approachable point of contact for employee queries, concerns, and HR-related matters.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, internal communications, and team-building activities.
* Conduct periodic employee check-ins and help identify opportunities to improve employee experience.
* Assist in resolving workplace concerns professionally and confidentially.
* Work closely with the founders to establish a collaborative, transparent, and performance-oriented startup culture.
* Support employee retention initiatives and improvements to the overall workplace experience.

7. HR Process Development & Automation

* Build practical, scalable HR workflows suited to a fast-growing technology startup.
* Introduce structured recruitment, onboarding, employee documentation, and performance tracking systems.
* Use AI tools and automation to improve sourcing, administrative workflows, documentation, and HR reporting.
* Develop standardized templates, checklists, dashboards, and internal HR knowledge resources.
* Continuously improve HR processes based on operational requirements and team feedback.

QualificationsRequired

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related discipline.
* **2–5 years of relevant HR experience**
  , preferably in a startup, technology company, or fast-growing organization.
* Hands-on experience managing recruitment and core HR operations.
* Working knowledge of employee lifecycle processes, HR documentation, payroll coordination, and applicable employment compliance requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and common workplace productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring requirements and HR responsibilities independently.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and sound judgment when handling confidential information.

Preferred

* Experience recruiting technical talent, including software developers, AI/ML engineers, electronics engineers, embedded systems engineers, or product professionals.
* Prior experience establishing or improving HR processes in an early-stage startup.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, HRMS platforms, and recruitment tools.
* Experience coordinating performance management and employee engagement initiatives.
* Familiarity with AI-powered productivity and HR automation tools.
* Exposure to campus recruitment, internship programs, or university partnerships.

What We Look For

**Ownership:**
You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through without constant supervision.

**Execution:**
You can translate requirements into action and manage multiple priorities efficiently.

**People Orientation:**
You genuinely enjoy working with people and building positive employee experiences.

**Discretion:**
You understand the importance of confidentiality, professionalism, and fairness in HR decisions.

**Adaptability:**
You are comfortable working in an evolving startup environment where processes and priorities change.

**Process Thinking:**
You look for ways to make HR operations more organized, efficient, and scalable.

**Technology Mindset:**
You are open to using AI, automation, and modern tools to improve how HR functions operate.

Why Join Zynence?

* **Build HR from the ground up:**
  Play a meaningful role in establishing the people operations of an emerging deep-tech company.
* **Work directly with founders:**
  Gain exposure to organizational planning, hiring decisions, and startup growth strategy.
* **Real ownership:**
  Independently manage important HR functions rather than operating within a narrowly defined administrative role.
* **Deep-tech exposure:**
  Work alongside teams developing AI-native engineering technologies and next-generation product development solutions.
* **Career growth:**
  Opportunity to grow into broader People Operations or HR leadership responsibilities as the organization scales.
* **Startup environment:**
  Be part of a collaborative, fast-moving team where initiative and execution are valued.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or send their updated resume to:

**Email:**
sushil@zynence.com

**Subject:**
Application for HR Generalist – Zynence

Please mention your current location, total HR experience, current and expected compensation, and notice period in your application.

**Work Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh (On-site)

  https://zynence.com

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

**Job Description:**
**Overview**
The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.
  
  
This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast-evolving compliance landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting & Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:

+ Gratuity Act
+ Shops & Establishments Act (state-specific)
+ POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
+ Leave-related statutory provisions
+ Severance and separation-related compliance

* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops & Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations & HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications And Requirements**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4-7+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state-specific regulations including Shops & Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

* Judgement and Integrity: Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* Collaboration & Communication: Builds strong cross-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* Adaptability: Operates effectively in dynamic, fast-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives and shifting priorities.
* Operational Excellence: Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in HRIS (e.g., Workday), compliance reporting tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. * 3+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field

* Knowledge of Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, or Malayalam.

* Ability to use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality while maintaining customer confidentiality, accuracy, and professional judgment.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, documents properly, follows through without being chased, and can manage enterprise customers with structure and maturity.

You should be able to separate customer emotion from actual issue impact, avoid overpromising, push back politely when needed, and use data instead of assumptions.

title: Senior Associate - Customer Operations
description:
Laundryheap is a UK-headquartered tech platform delivering on-demand laundry within 24 hours. Founded in 2014, we now serve 17+ global markets across the UK, US, UAE, and beyond. We are expanding rapidly across Europe, Asia, and North America—and we're hiring passionate talent to power our next phase of growth.

We are looking for an energetic and detail-oriented individual to work for us in our overseas office (Bengaluru, India). As we are an international brand working across different time zones, we require the potential candidate to be flexible to work in shift patterns (mostly nights).

**You'll Make a Difference By:**

Reporting to the Associate Lead, you will join our **Linen Operations team**; **Laundryheap Linen is a B2B linen rental and commercial cleaning solution within Laundryheap, designed specifically for short-stay hosts and property managers.** The Linen team runs daily operations through two dedicated functions: Driver Operations and Customer Operations, each split across a morning and a night shift. You will own the Customer Operations function — accountable for how it performs, the standards it runs to, and the processes behind it — while overseeing its shifts day to day as the first point of contact for our business customers: resolving issues on live chat, managing their orders end to end, and making sure the promise we made is the one we deliver.

You will support and work alongside the Driver Operations team, who monitor driver activity, keep routes on track, and step in when something goes wrong on the road. The two sides feed each other — the better you understand what is happening on the ground, the better the answer you can give the client.

**Key Responsibilities**

Ownership & Performance

* Own the Customer Operations function end to end — accountable for its performance, standards and processes across both shifts.
* Own the KPI and SLA metrics for Customer Operations top to bottom: define what gets measured, track it live, report on it, and answer for it.
* Oversee the running of both shifts — set priorities, make the call on escalations, and act as the senior point of reference for the team on duty.
* Monitor performance against targets in real time, spot gaps as they form, and intervene before the client feels them.
* Produce the end-of-shift report — volumes, SLA breaches, complaint themes, root causes, and actions taken.
* Hand over cleanly to the incoming shift, with open issues, risks and context documented so nothing is lost between shifts.

Process Ownership & Standards

* Create, document and own the SOPs for Customer Operations — response targets, SLA matrix, escalation thresholds and situation playbooks.
* Define the rules the shift runs by: client prioritisation, when a last-minute request can be accommodated, and when something must be escalated.
* Treat every recurring failure as a process problem — review it, change the process, and confirm the change worked.
* Build and maintain the knowledge base so the shift runs on documented practice rather than on any one person's memory.
* Identify tooling and automation opportunities, build the case, and see the change through to adoption.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Act as the Customer Operations voice with Driver Operations, warehouse, fleet, inventory and accounts.
* Represent the client perspective in the daily operations call, and escalate issues that need a fix beyond your shift.
* Work with the Driver Operations senior member to resolve conflicts between client commitments and operational capacity, using agreed thresholds rather than case-by-case debate.
* Partner with account managers on client feedback, service reviews and account-specific requirements.

Team Leadership & Development

* Lead improvement projects from problem definition through to a measured outcome.
* Be the person the team turns to when the answer is not in the SOP.
* Onboard and train new members joining your shift, and sign off their competency.
* Review client conversations for quality and coach the team on tone, accuracy and escalation judgement.
* Deputise for the Associate Lead where required.

Customer Communication & Resolution (B2B)

* Respond accurately and promptly across all communication channels, including live chat, to the first response and resolution targets set for the team.
* Own escalated conversations end-to-end, maintaining contact with the customer until the issue is genuinely closed.
* Ensure high standards of tone and language in all written and verbal communications to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Liaise with all stakeholders — warehouse, fleet, inventory, and accounts — to resolve customer complaints in the most efficient and effective manner, referring issues using the correct escalation procedures.
* Act as an ambassador for Laundryheap Linen, using knowledge of the organisation and our offerings to promote Laundryheap positively at any given opportunity.

Order & Account Management

* Receive, review, and process customer orders accurately, verifying quantities, addresses, timeslots, and any account-specific requirements.
* Handle amendments, cancellations, and last-minute requests, balancing what the client needs against what the operation can deliver.
* Create and manage cleaning service orders using internal tools, ensuring end-to-end fulfillment and proactive resolution of operational issues.
* Facilitate smooth onboarding for new clients by addressing live queries and closely monitoring their initial orders to ensure a seamless first-order experience.
* Work closely with account managers to ensure the customer's needs are exceeded and feedback is communicated to all stakeholders.

Operations & Continuous Improvement

* Track KPIs and flag performance bottlenecks, ensuring SLA adherence.
* Maintain internal documentation and knowledge bases.
* Contribute to team goals by initiating or supporting projects aimed at improving operational workflows.
* Collaborate with internal teams across the UK for smooth operations.
* Plan, prioritise, and maintain a busy workload efficiently, whilst ensuring excellent customer satisfaction is maintained throughout the year.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Client responsiveness — first response and resolution times against the agreed SLA.
* Client satisfaction — satisfaction scores, complaint volume, and repeat complaints by theme.
* Resolution quality — issues closed at first contact, without repeated internal handoffs.
* Order accuracy — orders processed correctly first time, including amendments.
* Service delivery — on-time delivery for your accounts, with priority client delays kept to a minimum.
* Flexibility — last-minute client requests accommodated without disrupting the wider plan.

**Minimum Skills Required**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
* Relevant years of experience should be between 2–5 years, including 2+ years in customer service and escalation management (chat/email).
* High proficiency in English (both spoken and written).
* Prior contact with Intercom or any other relevant customer support software.
* Some exposure to operations, logistics, or technical support, preferably with international exposure.
* Proficient in Google Sheets / MS Excel.
* Exceptional analytical and organisational skills.
* Experienced in the investigation of quick resolution and escalation.
* Ability to manage high-pressure, fast-paced live environments with composure.
* Strong multitasking skills in a high-energy environment.
* Experience in night shifts / rotational shifts.
* Stakeholder management.
* Customer-oriented, empathetic, proactive, and solution-oriented.
* Be flexible and supportive of the team.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* Experience supporting UK, US or European clients, with a strong feel for the tone and expectations of Western business communication.
* Former experience in a tech start-up.
* Experience of working in a fast-paced, customer service environment.
* Familiarity with live route planning tools (such as Onfleet) and CRM systems.
* Analytical with an understanding of and passion for data-driven decisions, and comfort with operational data.
* Able to continually seek improved ways of working.
* Speed, flexibility, and agility; ability to work independently in a rapidly changing environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and also well within a team.

**Work Schedule and Patterns**

* 9-hour shift (8 working hours + 1-hour break).
* 5 days a week, including nights and weekends (2 rotational week-offs based on rota).
* Shifts are anchored to UK time.
* Office-based role.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be part of a fast-growing global company with opportunities to learn and grow.
* Work in a collaborative environment where your ideas are heard and valued.
* Gain exposure to international markets and complex customer operations.
* Flat team structure with high visibility and quick growth potential.
* Competitive salary package + shift allowance.
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage.

We love to work with ambitious, proactive people who have a can-do attitude and are confident decision-makers. So, if this sounds like you, take this opportunity and apply to join the International Laundryheap Team today!

Job Title: Service Desk Operations & Governance SME  
Position: Associate Consultant
  
Experience: 6+ Years  
Category: Software Development/ Engineering  
Main location: Bangalore  
Job Code: J0826-2154  
Employment Type: Full Time  
  
Job Description:
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Service Desk professional with strong operational and ITIL expertise to take ownership of the day-to-day operational governance of a multilingual Service Desk environment.  
The role will be responsible for ensuring that Service Desk operations are structured, measurable, governed and continuously improved. The individual will analyse operational performance, identify recurring issues and service gaps, drive corrective actions, ensure adherence to agreed processes and coordinate with L2/L3 teams to improve resolution outcomes.  
The role is not limited to managing people or monitoring queues. The successful candidate will act as a Service Desk subject-matter expert and operational governance owner, bringing structure, discipline and analytical insight into the operation.  
The role will work closely with the Service Delivery Manager, Service Desk Leads, L2/L3 resolver teams, application teams, infrastructure teams, workplace/EUS teams, vendors and client stakeholders.  
Key Responsibilities:  
  
1. Service Desk Operational Governance  

* Own the day-to-day operational governance of the Service Desk.
* Establish and maintain operational routines covering:

o Daily operational review  
o SLA performance  
o Backlog  
o Aging tickets  
o Priority incidents  
o Reassignments  
o Escalations  
o Abandoned/unanswered calls  
o Ticket quality  
o Customer feedback  

* Ensure operational teams follow agreed processes, SOPs and ITIL practices.
* Identify deviations from the operating model and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate ownership and accountability across the Service Desk.
* Maintain operational readiness for changes, new services and project transitions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
2. Performance & Data Analysis  
This should be one of the core responsibilities of the role.  

* Analyse Service Desk performance trends and identify underlying causes.
* Monitor and interpret:

o SLA achievement  
o Response and resolution performance  
o Ticket volumes  
o Backlog  
o Aging  
o Reopen rates  
o First Contact Resolution  
o Escalation rates  
o Call abandonment  
o Customer satisfaction  
o Productivity  
o Quality scores  

* Identify trends rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Produce meaningful operational insights and recommendations.
* Identify recurring operational issues and translate them into improvement initiatives.
* Maintain dashboards and management reports.
* Prepare inputs for weekly/monthly service reviews.
* Highlight risks and emerging issues to the SDM before they become escalations.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
3. Ticket Hygiene & Quality Management  

* Drive improvement in Service Desk ticket quality and documentation.
* Ensure tickets contain appropriate:

o Categorisation  
o Prioritisation  
o User/business impact  
o Troubleshooting performed  
o Worklogs  
o Resolution details  
o Knowledge references  
o Closure information  

* Perform regular ticket sampling and quality audits.
* Identify recurring quality issues by agent/team/process.
* Work with Team Leads to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure tickets are progressed appropriately and do not remain unnecessarily in queues.
* Identify tickets requiring escalation and ensure timely handover to L2/L3.
* Monitor tickets approaching SLA breach and ensure proactive intervention.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
4. Incident, Problem & Escalation Management  

* Provide operational oversight of Major/P1/P2 incidents from the Service Desk perspective.
* Ensure correct prioritisation and escalation based on business impact.
* Support Major Incident Management and ensure appropriate Service Desk participation.
* Identify recurring incidents and candidates for Problem Management.
* Analyse repeat incidents and identify opportunities for permanent resolution.
* Work with L2/L3 resolver groups to drive recurring-problem reduction.
* Track outstanding actions from major incidents and problem investigations.
* Ensure lessons learned are converted into process, knowledge or technical improvements.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
5. Cross-Functional Coordination  
Act as the operational bridge between Service Desk and resolver teams.  

* Coordinate with L2/L3 Infrastructure, Applications, EUS, IAM, Network, Cloud and other support teams.
* Identify bottlenecks in the incident/request resolution lifecycle.
* Challenge unnecessary ticket transfers and ownership gaps.
* Ensure clear escalation paths are followed.
* Drive resolution of aged or stuck tickets across resolver groups.
* Identify recurring dependency issues between Service Desk and other support towers.
* Work with application and infrastructure SMEs to improve knowledge available to the Service Desk.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
6. Process & Continual Service Improvement  

* Identify opportunities to streamline Service Desk processes.
* Review existing workflows and identify unnecessary manual steps.
* Drive continual improvement initiatives around:

o Incident management  
o Request fulfilment  
o Knowledge management  
o Escalation  
o Ticket routing  
o Categorisation  
o Automation  
o Self-service  
o Monitoring integration  

* Identify opportunities for automation and shift-left.
* Improve First Contact Resolution through better knowledge, tooling and training.
* Maintain and improve Service Desk SOPs and operational documentation.
* Support implementation of ITIL-aligned practices.
* Ensure improvements are measurable and demonstrate operational/business benefit.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
7. Knowledge Management  

* Ensure knowledge articles are available and usable by Service Desk agents.
* Identify knowledge gaps from ticket trends and recurring incidents.
* Work with L2/L3 teams to convert technical resolutions into Service Desk knowledge.
* Review the quality and usefulness of existing knowledge articles.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge Management and shift-left practices.
* Identify opportunities for self-service and automation based on recurring requests.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
8. Team Coaching & Operational Enablement  
The role should not replace the Team Leads, but should provide SME-level direction and coaching.  

* Coach Team Leads and senior analysts on ITIL processes and operational practices.
* Support agents in improving troubleshooting and ticket-handling quality.
* Identify capability gaps based on operational data.
* Recommend targeted training and coaching.
* Conduct periodic knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Support onboarding of new Service Desk resources.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
9. Client & Stakeholder Support  
The person will have stakeholder interaction, but the SDM remains the primary client/account owner.  

* Provide operational inputs for client service reviews.
* Prepare factual analysis and recommendations for the SDM.
* Participate in operational governance meetings.
* Support service-related escalations.
* Provide timely updates on operational risks and improvement actions.
* Translate operational data into meaningful business-level insights.
* Support the SDM in preparing service improvement proposals and operational roadmaps.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
10. Governance & Compliance  

* Ensure adherence to agreed governance frameworks and contractual processes.
* Maintain operational evidence required for audits and governance reviews.
* Ensure compliance with ITIL, security and organisational processes.
* Track actions, risks, issues and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain Service Desk operational documentation and control mechanisms.
* Support internal and client audits where required.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
11. Key Deliverables / KPIs  
I would make the role accountable for outcomes, rather than just activities.  
Area Expected Outcome

description:

**About Signify**

**More about the role**

  
  

**Job Summary**

The Regional (Site IT / Hub) Lead is responsible for leading and coordinating user support services within a defined / assigned region. This role ensures that employees receive timely, professional, and effective IT support for workplace technology, including laptops, mobile devices, collaboration tools, business applications, and office IT services. The Team Lead acts as the first point of escalation for support issues, manages the day-to-day performance of the regional support team, and works closely with global teams of infrastructure and security. In addition, collaborates with business stakeholders to deliver a consistent and high-quality support experience. The Regional Site IT Lead is responsible for and will oversee local Field Service Support engineers, Digital Technical Engineers and Service desk agents in a specific DigITal Hub location, and oversee field support for all sites assigned in the region

The Regional Site IT Lead is focused on helping end users to make better use of IT solutions. This will lead to improved productivity as well as improved customer satisfaction.

Key Areas of Responsibility

**1. Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and support a regional team of Technical Engineers, Site IT Leads and Service desk agents.
* Coordinate daily support activities, workloads, priorities, and shift coverage across the region (s).
* Provide guidance on complex incidents, service requests, escalations,
* Support team development through mentoring, feedback, knowledge sharing, and performance input.
* Promote a customer-focused, professional, and service-oriented team culture.

<>·

**2. End user support delivery**

* Ensure high-quality support for end user devices, operating systems, productivity tools, collaboration platforms, printers, peripherals, Fixed and mobile telephony, and standard business applications.
* Oversee incident and service request handling in line with agreed service levels.
* Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely resolution, proper prioritization, and accurate documentation.
* Act as an escalation point for unresolved or high-impact support issues.
* Support onboarding, offboarding, device deployment, asset replacement, and office moves.
* Ensure the regional IT Service desks executes issues and requests in line with expectations, and in accordance to the Global Service desk owner.
* Daily management of activities with the team

**3. Regional IT Operations**

* Coordinate local and regional IT support activities across offices, sites, or countries within the assigned region.
* Ensure regional support processes operate with global IT standards, policies, and procedures.
* Partner with global teams to support infrastructure, network, security, IAM and application-related activities.
* Act as regional hub lead for other teams within the same region of hub
* Assist with regional rollouts, technology refreshes, software deployments, and change initiatives.
* Maintain awareness of regional business needs, local constraints, and service improvement opportunities.

**4. Asset, Compliance & security**

* Ensure accurate management of IT assets, including laptops, mobile devices, accessories, and peripherals.
* Support hardware lifecycle activities, inventory controls, forecasting, disposals. and audit requirements in alignment with Global Hardware Asset Manager.
* Ensure end user support activities follow company security policies and compliance standards.
* Promote secure working practices, including device encryption, access control, patching, and data protection.
* Escalate security incidents or policy breaches through the appropriate channels.

<>·

**5. Service coordinator**

* Manage relationships with managed (security) service providers.
* Acts as local host in global projects, roll-outs & adaptive change requests.
* Provide insight in impact that global initiatives have on local business.
* Monitor all IT incidents & requests escalated by users in the local domain.
* Work with the respective Service Owners and collaborate with the partners to ensure proper follow-up.
* Facilitate contact points for all supporting activities for vendors to perform services onsite when needed
* Track support performance, recurring issues, service trends, and user feedback.
* Contribute to knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Ensure incidents, requests, changes, and problems are handled according to ITIL-aligned practices.
* Support root cause analysis and problem management for recurring end user issues.

**6. Continuous improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve support processes, documentation, automation, and user experience.
* Identify problems & channel towards the relevant Service Owner. Support the problem analysis.
* Monitors local customer satisfaction and engages within DigITal on root cause & the improvements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and standardization of DigITal processes and services.
* Share and drive best practices.

Critical Experiences

**Leadership Expectations**

The Regional (Site IT / Hub) Lead is expected to:

* Customer focus and service excellence.
* Team leadership and coaching.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Clear communication and stakeholder engagement.
* Ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work across cultures, time zones, and regional teams.
* Continuous improvement mindset.
* Understands the regional dimensions
* Stakeholder satisfaction & management

**Your Profile**

**Experience & Expertise**

* 8 –10+ years of experience in end user support, service desk and regional management
* Proven experience in end user support, desktop support, service desk, or workplace technology support.
* Experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring IT support teams.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and/or macOS environments, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, mobile device support, and common enterprise applications.
* Experience working with IT service management tools and ticketing systems.
* Good understanding of ITIL principles, incident management, request fulfilment, escalation management, and change management.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, network connectivity, identity, and access-related issues.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer service skills.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced, multi-site environment.
  

  

**Leadership & Capabilities**

* Strong decision-making capability.
* Excellent communication skills at executive level.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strong organizational and planning skills.
* Passion for continuous improvement.

**Success Measures (KPIs)**

The success of the role will be measured through:

* Regional support tickets are resolved within agreed service levels.
* End users report a high level of satisfaction with IT support.
* Ticket queues are well managed, documented, and regularly reviewed.
* Recurring issues are identified and addressed through service improvement actions.

**Education & Certifications**

You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. * Ensure individual workstreams collectively deliver the intended end-to-end business outcome.

* Own and coordinate the integrated cutover and launch plan.

* Lead delivery through hypercare, stabilization and warranty.
* Monitor operational and process performance against agreed measures.

7. Business Outcomes & Benefits

* Keep delivery anchored to the approved reason and intended outcomes.

PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or equivalent program/project management certification

title: AI Project Specialist

* Proven experience in requirements engineering (BRD/FRD, user stories, process modelling such as BPMN/UML, prioritization techniques, acceptance criteria)

  + Certifications (good to have): PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CBAP, PMI‑PBA

**Things you’ll enjoy**

Join us on a transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues across a global enterprise
* Contribute to innovative AI programmes and work with cutting‑edge platforms to deliver solutions for business needs across Alstom

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Business Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Business Relationship Manager**
**Overview**
The Business Relationship Manager serves as the primary link between the AI team and business units across the organization. The role is responsible for gathering business requirements, prioritizing AI initiatives, supporting technology rollouts, and ensuring successful adoption and business value of AI solutions.
  
  
The role will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and Learning & Development to drive adoption, track usage and satisfaction, and address adoption risks.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibility**

* Own and maintain relationships with business unit stakeholders across the organization, serving as their primary point of contact for AI team engagement.
* Gather business requirements and user needs, translating them into prioritized, well-scoped inputs for the engineering team.
* Define, track, and report on adoption and usage metrics for deployed AI solutions — not just delivery status.
* Design and execute change communication and rollout plans for phased deployments, partnering with Learning & Development on training hand-off.
* Serve as the escalation point for business-unit feedback and concerns regarding AI tooling and automations.
* Identify early signals of adoption risk and drive corrective action before they surface as broader dissatisfaction.
* Facilitate prioritization discussions, bringing business context and stakeholder impact to bear on engineering roadmap decisions.
* Report adoption outcomes, business value, and stakeholder sentiment to executive leadership.
* Build and maintain a repeatable framework for onboarding new business units onto AI-enabled workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of experience in business relationship management, stakeholder management, product management, customer success, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience driving adoption of new technology or business processes.
* Experience defining and tracking adoption, usage, or satisfaction metrics.
* Experience gathering business requirements and working with technical/engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units.
* Working knowledge of AI and automation capabilities and limitations.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* Experience supporting AI, automation, or emerging technology rollouts.
* Experience managing relationships across multiple departments.
* Change management certification such as Prosci ADKAR or CCMP.
* Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA.
* Product/program management certification such as PMP or CSPO.

description:
Manager - ST&S Delivery

JOB DESCRIPTION

Manager/Associate Director - ST&S Delivery

Settlements | iData | Contracts & Confirmations | Accounting, Reporting & Controls

Role Purpose

The Manager, ST&S Delivery will own end-to-end service delivery across assigned Oil & Gas Supply, Trading & Shipping operations covering Settlements, iData, Contracts & Confirmations, and Accounting, Reporting & Control, the role will lead operational teams, manage client governance, maintain service performance and controls, resolve material escalations, and execute the agreed transformation roadmap. The Manager will translate the Delivery Head’s strategic direction into operational plans and ensure accurate, timely and controlled delivery across high-value and time-sensitive processes.

Key Responsibilities

•

Own delivery performance across assigned ST&S processes, ensuring achievement of agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, close-calendar commitments and control requirements.

•

Lead operational delivery across settlements, reference and master data, contracts and confirmations, and accounting, reporting and controls.

•

Establish effective workload management, capacity planning, staffing, prioritization and resource-deployment practices across delivery teams.

•

Monitor volumes, work queues, ageing, exceptions, reconciliations, productivity, quality and operational risks; intervene early where performance is at risk.

•

Lead resolution of material settlement breaks, confirmation mismatches, contract exceptions, data defects, reconciliation differences, accounting issues and control failures.

•

Act as the primary operational contact for assigned client stakeholders and lead service reviews covering delivery, risks, controls, improvement actions and transformation progress.

•

Build effective relationships across trading operations, finance, treasury, legal, tax, credit, risk, compliance, technology and data teams.

•

Ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, four-eye reviews, delegated authorities, segregation of duties, approval protocols, records retention and audit-trail requirements.

•

Oversee operational-risk events, control incidents, audit findings, business-continuity requirements and remediation actions.

•

Prepare and present governance packs covering service levels, quality, ageing, productivity, risk, controls, financial performance and improvement outcomes.

•

Convert the transformation roadmap into executable initiatives, milestones, resource plans, readiness criteria and measurable benefits.

•

Lead process diagnostics and standardization; sponsor workflow, digitization, analytics and automation opportunities after stabilizing performance and addressing source-data causes.

•

Ensure SME participation across design, validation, testing, UAT, knowledge transfer, hypercare and post-implementation reviews.

•

Retain appropriate human review and approval for material commercial, legal, regulatory, accounting and payment decisions.

•

Lead Deputy Managers, Team Leads and operational teams; set objectives, coach leaders, build cross-skilling, maintain succession coverage and strengthen accountability.

Manager - ST&S Delivery

Core Domain & Functional Skills

•

Strong understanding of the Oil & Gas, energy or commodity-trading lifecycle across crude, products, gas, LNG and/or power.

•

Settlements: AR/AP invoicing, pricing validation, payment preparation, netting, cash allocation, collections, disputes, intercompany, ancillary/brokerage settlements and reconciliations.

•

iData: counterparty and bank-account records, payment data, standard settlement instructions, settlement and netting reference data, governance and data-quality remediation.

•

Contracts & Confirmations: contract administration, trade-term validation, physical and derivative confirmations, electronic matching, discrepancy management and counterparty engagement.

•

Accounting, Reporting & Controls: journals, derivative and balance-sheet accounting, P&L and working-capital reconciliations, financial close, controls, audit and reporting support.

•

Ability to manage service performance, capacity, productivity, operational risk, governance and benefits realization in a multi-stakeholder environment.

•

Working exposure to ETRM/CTRM platforms, ERP or finance systems, reconciliation tools, workflow/case-management platforms, automation and reporting dashboards.

Experience & Qualifications

•

11-14 years of relevant experience in Oil & Gas, energy or commodity-trading operations, including at least 7 years in service delivery, operations management or people leadership.

•

Demonstrated experience managing multi-process or multi-team operations in an SLA-driven and control-oriented environment.

•

Strong experience in at least two scope areas, with end-to-end awareness across the wider ST&S lifecycle.

•

Proven ability to manage client stakeholders, service reviews, operational escalations and cross-functional dependencies.

•

Experience in transition, process standardization, workflow implementation, automation, digitization or operating-model transformation.

•

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Commerce, Engineering, Technology, Energy Management or a related discipline. Relevant accounting, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, transformation or change certification is desirable.

•

Fluent business English, with flexibility to support business and market timelines.

Leadership & Behavioural Expectations

•

Strong ownership and accountability for delivery outcomes, controls and stakeholder commitments.

•

Ability to balance service, risk, commercial, people and transformation priorities.

•

Sound judgement, structured problem solving and confidence in managing senior stakeholders and difficult escalations.

•

Clear written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to work across cultures, commodities, regions and systems.

•

A coaching mindset that develops people, protects critical knowledge and promotes continuous improvement.

Measures of Success SLA and KPI achievement | accurate and timely delivery | fewer aged exceptions and recurring breaks | stronger controls | effective client governance | improved productivity and visibility | sustained transformation benefits | capable and engaged teams

title: Manager - Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP FICO/SD with DRC E-Invoicing & E-Reporting - Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) -**
**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD integration and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) capabilities supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital compliance requirements. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.

* Familiarity with modeling languages such as ArchiMate, UML, BPMN (a plus)
* Proven willingness to learn scripting languages to continuously improve the solutions you deliver

**What we offer**

* A competitive salary complemented by variable compensation.
* Company-sponsored Provident Fund and Gratuity benefits in line with local regulations.
* 15 vacation days during your first two years, 20 vacation days in years three and four, and 25 vacation days from your fifth year onwards.

* A health insurance plan designed to support your wellbeing and give you peace of mind.
* Premium IT equipment from day one, plus a personal technology budget to help you create a workspace that suits your needs.

* You're confidently leading consulting engagements, implementations, and training activities, taking ownership from kickoff to successful delivery.

* 1st Interview with Internal Recruiter (45 minutes)
* 2nd Interview with Professional Services Consultant (60 minutes)
* 3rd Interview with our SVP of Professional Services EMEA (60 minutes)

Bizzdesign stands for equity and inclusion. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is essential to our success, and we are committed to building a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
