title: Account Manager
description:
**About Hexnode**

Hexnode is a global leader in Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), trusted in over 100 countries and managing millions of devices worldwide. With continuous innovation across Apple, Windows, Android, macOS, Linux, and tvOS ecosystems, Hexnode is redefining enterprise mobility and cybersecurity. As we expand our Extended Detection and Response (XDR) capabilities, we are building a next-generation data platform designed for massive scale, real-time intelligence, and high-performance security analytics.

**Role Overview**

The Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM) is responsible for building strong, long-term relationships with customers, ensuring they achieve maximum value from our solutions, and driving retention and growth. This role combines customer advocacy, product expertise, and business acumen to help clients succeed while supporting the company’s strategic objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Relationship Management**

• Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.

• Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.

**Onboarding & Adoption**

• Guide customers through onboarding and implementation.

• Drive product adoption by educating customers on features, best practices, and use cases.

**Account Growth & Retention**

• Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.

• Pitch relevant case studies to demonstrate value and encourage expansion.

• Negotiate and secure multi-year contracts with existing customers to strengthen long-term partnerships.

• Proactively manage churn risk and develop retention strategies.

**Customer Advocacy**

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, providing feedback to product and support teams.

• Ensure customer satisfaction by resolving issues promptly and effectively

**Performance Tracking**

• Monitor account health metrics (usage, engagement, renewals).

• Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to customers.

• Expansion Ownership: Proactively identify, qualify, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.

• Strategic Pitching: Utilize case studies and data-driven insights to pitch new modules or seats that solve specific client pain points.

• Contract Negotiation: Lead negotiations for multi-year contracts and renewals to increase Life-Time Value (LTV) and secure long-term partnership.

• Account Planning: Develop annual success plans for high-value accounts that outline specific growth and expansion targets.

**Qualifications & Skills**

• Experience: 2–5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales (preferably in SaaS or technology).

• Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to present to senior stakeholders.

• Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with the ability to understand customer challenges and propose solutions.

• Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly learn and articulate product capabilities.

• Negotiation: Skilled in pitching case studies and securing multi-year contracts.

• Collaboration: Team player with cross-functional coordination skills (Sales, Product, Support).

• Flexibility: Willingness to work across time zones and adapt to customer needs

**Performance Metrics**

• Customer retention rate.

• Net revenue retention (NRR) Customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS).

• Product adoption and usage growth.

• Upsell/cross-sell revenue contribution.

• Number/value of multi-year contracts secured.

• Secure Case Studies from Happy Customers.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

• Customer-centric mindset with a passion for helping clients succeed.

• Strong presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to balance multiple accounts and prioritize effectively.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Argano is seeking a EPM Planning Consultant for our Client Services practice. A consultant in Argano Managed Services is an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM professional responsible for sustaining, optimizing, and continuously improving clients’ production environments after go-live. The consultant manages a portfolio of client priorities, provides functional and technical leadership, and guides incident resolution, service requests, enhancements, and process improvements. The role also mentors other consultants, contributes to reusable practices, and supports strong client satisfaction and long-term account success.

Argano Managed Services helps clients sustain, optimize, and continuously improve their Oracle Cloud environments after go-live. Our consultants combine functional expertise, collaborative problem-solving, and proactive client service to improve business processes and the end-user experience. We value creativity, teamwork, accountability, continuous learning, and a healthy, respectful workplace.

* Serve as a subject matter expert for Oracle Cloud EPM Planning
* Manage multiple client workstreams and service priorities concurrently, balancing incidents, service requests, enhancements, recurring activities, and planned initiatives against agreed priorities and service commitments.
* Act as a functional expert as part of a team and/or independently with no supervision.
* Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders. Keep all parties informed about progress, challenges, and changes.
* Collaborate with clients to understand evolving business objectives, operational challenges, and Oracle EPM needs. Assess existing configurations, usage patterns, recurring issues, and business processes to identify opportunities to stabilize, automate, optimize, and improve user adoption.
* Maintain current knowledge of Oracle Cloud EPM monthly updates and relevant Oracle roadmap developments. Assess client impact, communicate recommendations, and identify opportunities for optimization and innovation.

**Education**
MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of consulting or relevant industry experience, including significant experience supporting and enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud environments after go-live, with prior full-lifecycle implementation experience preferred to demonstrate a strong understanding of application design and downstream impacts.
* Expert knowledge of the Oracle Planning Cloud tools required.
* Hands-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, configuring, or enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud modules such as Workforce, Capital, Projects, Profitability and Cost Management, or Strategic Modeling.
* Strong Essbase calculation script writing skills preferred
* Experience with Groovy Scripts preferred
* Experience with Oracle EPM Data Exchange or Data Management, including troubleshooting data and metadata loads, mappings, integrations, validation failures, and recurring load processes.
* Experience with EDM a plus
* Experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud a plus
* Candidate should be teachable with a strong desire to learn and expand current knowledge base
* Professional services experience in an Oracle Cloud EPM Managed Services, application support, or production-operations role is strongly preferred; experience advising client stakeholders at a strategic level is also beneficial.
* In-depth knowledge of the relevant technologies and systems.

SKILL REQUIREMENTS
  
  

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communication. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
* Service Delivery Management: Prioritize and coordinate concurrent client needs across incidents, requests, recurring operations, and enhancements while maintaining clear ownership, realistic commitments, accurate status, and alignment with service levels.
* Continuous Improvement: Translate recurring issues, service trends, Oracle Cloud updates, and industry practices into practical recommendations that improve stability, efficiency, controls, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Strong commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Strong degree of initiative, accuracy, efficiency, and attention to detail.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.

**About Us**
Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.

Techno-Functional Oracle Fusion Manager – Record to Report (R2R)

**Experience:**
8–15 Years

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Techno-Functional Oracle Fusion Manager to lead solution design, implementation, configuration, integration, and support of Oracle Cloud ERP Financials, with a strong focus on Record-to-Report (R2R) processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Oracle Fusion Financials implementation, configuration, testing, and production support.
* Manage financial modules, including General Ledger (GL), Fixed Assets (FA), Financial Accounting Hub (FAH), Intercompany, Project Accounting, Tax, and Lease Accounting.
* Design end-to-end R2R solutions and align Oracle applications with business requirements.
* Prepare functional and technical specifications, process workflows, and gap analysis.
* Develop OTBI and BI Publisher reports and templates.
* Manage integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, web services, XML, and PL/SQL.
* Support financial data conversion, GL balances translation, revaluation, and reconciliation of sub-ledger modules.
* Work with Oracle Subledger Accounting (SLA), Accounting Setup Manager, Multi-Org Access Control (MOAC), and flexfield configurations.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to resolve complex issues and deliver solutions.
* Provide post-implementation support and drive continuous process improvements.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience in Oracle Fusion Financials and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS).
* Expertise in R2R processes and Oracle Financials module configuration.
* Experience in at least five financial modules, including GL, FA, FAH, Intercompany, and Project Accounting.
* Strong technical knowledge of PL/SQL, Java, XML, REST/SOAP APIs, and web services.
* Experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and application integrations.
* Knowledge of Agile methodologies and solution design.
* Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Experience Requirements**

* Strong Oracle Financials implementation and support experience.
* Experience in at least five Oracle R2R implementations.
* Extensive support experience across GL, FA, FAH, Project Accounting, and Intercompany.
* Hands-on configuration experience in a minimum of five Oracle Financials modules.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience across multiple industries and enterprise transformation programmes.
* Knowledge of Python and cloud technologies.
* Experience working in complex, fast-paced project environments.

description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. We boldly go.
  
  
**Where Is The Work**
Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.
  
  
**Position Summary**
EPM Regional Support Leads are part of the Strategic Reporting Systems team, which manages the global Enterprise Performance Management solution (OneStream , Oracle HFM, Planning and Analytics Cloud) for Trane Technologies, supporting over 700 users in their Actuals reporting and consolidation, as well as their Budgeting and Forecasting processes.
  
  
Regional Support Leads are responsible for the Enterprise Performance Management Customer Support, Training, Access Administration and Communication for their area of responsibility. These positions support the Finance user community and serve as the voice of the customer. They report to the manager of Customer Support.
  
  
The leads directly support the user community as the first line of user support, are responsible for developing training content and leading regional training initiatives, and they work hand in hand with the development team to execute user needs into actionable Financial System performance.
  
  
The person in this role needs knowledge of all of the Financial System applications and be able to support their user communities in hours where additional management and technical support are not available.
  
  
This role will require significant interaction within the finance and business communities. As such, they must exhibit strong collaboration, accounting/financial acumen and communication skills, and effectively engage with peers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* First point of contact for user community (support requests, user communication and socialization of new functionality, etc.) and liaison with Total Financial Systems Team to resolve user issues and improve the user experience.
* Responsible for the voice of the customer of their respective region, and articulate user needs into actionable system improvement and new functionality as well as EPM modules and tools.
* Maintain user access in line with requests and standard practices.
* Continuously improve month end financial reporting, and processes.
* Ability to produce and support user reporting initiatives using SmartView as well as other identified technologies.
* Support standardization of sector and management reporting.
* Train users on application functionality and enhancements
* Ensure timely completion of projects, and delivery of critical and measurable project objectives.
* Communicate effectively upstream to provide timely and accurate information and status updates to the Manager Customer Service and Strategic Reporting.
* Other key responsibilities are determined and communicated including but not exclusive as development support as bandwidth and workload determines.

**Skills/Abilities/Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, MIS or related field required.
* Understanding financial processes.
* 3-5+ years of OneStream, Oracle EPM (Hyperion, Essbase, Planning, FDM…) experience as a user or administrator, or of a similar solution
* Ability to work with excel including macros
* Alternatively, 3-5+ years of data visualization or data analytics experience (Google Looker, Tableau etc).
* Challenge current practice and suggest new ways of working, value-added ideas/ approaches
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects with varying deadlines.
* Ability to prioritize with minimal supervision and interact with employees at all levels.
* Must be a self-starter and be able to work independently or as part of a team.
* Excellent, creative problem-solving skills.
* Experience with business process flow and cause-effect diagramming and analysis.
* Strong collaborative skills and ability to work in a dynamic fast paced environment.
* Excellent verbal, interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Languages: fluent English required, other language(s) a plus

title: Strategic Account Manager (SAM) OR Client Partner (EXP: 15+ Years)
description:
**Job Description: Strategic Account Manager (SAM) OR Client Partner (EXP: 15+ Years)**
**About Bilvantis**
Bilvantis is a Data & AI engineering services company with teams in the US, India, the UK and the UAE. We don't work as a vendor. We work as an extension of our clients' own teams. We put our solutions and accelerators into every piece of repeatable work, and we choose to grow deep within a small set of accounts rather than spread thin across many.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
At Bilvantis, growth comes from going deep in each account. The Client Partner owns that. You'll treat your accounts like a business you run: you deepen the relationships we have, open new ones, and keep finding where Bilvantis can create real value for the client. When that works, the account grows.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Account growth:**

* Own the revenue, margin and growth targets for your accounts, and build and run an account plan for each one.
* Find ways to upsell and cross-sell, from new projects and expanded scope to new service lines and our accelerators.
* Co-sell with partners such as Databricks and other technology alliances.
* Keep the pipeline and forecast accurate, and lead proposals from first idea through to signed contract.

**Relationships**

* Build trusted relationships at several levels of the client: executive sponsors, business leaders, technology heads and procurement.
* Move beyond the people we already know and build new relationships across business units and regions.
* Hold the governance cadence: QBRs, steering committees and executive check-ins.

**Mapping Client Needs To What Bilvantis Offers**

* Know the client deeply: their business, priorities, technology landscape, budget cycles, politics and competitors.
* Know Bilvantis just as well: our solutions, accelerators, case studies and people.
* Connect the two by spotting where we can create value before the client asks, and turning that into a clear story they'll fund.

**Working With Internal Teams**

* Act as the link between the client and the Delivery, Practice, Pre-Sales and Solutions teams.
* Take our existing solutions and people to the client, so they're positioned, staffed and land well.
* Bring client needs and feedback back to the team, and work with them to shape new solutions and offerings.
* Keep a close eye on delivery health and step in early to protect the relationship and our reputation.

**What You Bring**

* Prior Experience: 15+ years in IT Services, including 5+ Years in Strategic Account Management (SAM).
* Stakeholder management: you're at ease with senior client leaders, and just as good at aligning internal teams without having direct authority over them.
* Relationship building: people trust you, inside and outside the company, and you have relationships that have lasted for years to show for it.
* Business and solution sense: enough grounding in Data, AI and cloud to talk about value credibly and know when to bring in the experts.
* Teamwork: a record of winning together with delivery and pre-sales, not working around them.
* Communication: clear and persuasive in writing, in meetings and in front of executives.
* Commercial skill: confident with pricing, SOWs, rate negotiations and contract structures.
* Track record: you've grown named accounts by 50% or more year on year.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in BFSI or Manufacturing.
* Exposure to the Databricks or hyperscaler partner ecosystems.
* Background at a global systems integrator or a growth-stage services firm.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Year-on-year growth in account revenue and margin.
* New logos or business units opened within existing clients.
* Number of executive relationships, and how many levels of the client they span.
* Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy.
* Client satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) and retention.

**Why Join**

* A role that's yours to shape at a company that's growing fast.
* Direct access to leadership, and decisions made quickly.
* Real solutions and accelerators to take to clients, not just people to place.

title: Project Intake Manager - D&C Project Controls Program
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Position Overview
  
The Project Intake Manager serves as the regional point of contact for all incoming project requests within the Design & Construction (D&C) team ranging from new construction, renovations (large/medium) and small scale projects across an organization. This role ensures efficient project initiation by evaluating requests, verifying completeness of information, routing to appropriate resource groups, and coordinating across multiple stakeholder teams. The position combines operational coordination with analytical capabilities to optimize intake processes and provide performance insights with clear SLA targets for each project type.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Request Management & Coordination
  
Serve as primary regional point of contact for all D&C Project Controls Program intake requests to internal clients, partner teams, and D&C leadership, communicating performance, negotiating priorities, and ensuring alignment across business units and regions.
  
Oversees end-to-end intake execution across AMER, EMEA, and APAC, ensuring reactive (1-5 days) and proactive (25–40 day) tracks stay on target while monitoring AI-triage performance and Coordinator workload balance.
  
Determine scoping/feasibility requirements, appropriate resource groups and team assignments based on project characteristics, expertise requirements, and capacity.
  
Facilitate smooth handoffs between intake and project execution teams, ensuring continuity of information and stakeholder expectations.
  
Enforces documentation standards, conducts audits and peer reviews, validates routing accuracy and AI-triage quality, and maintains standardized templates and process documentation.
  
Resolves complex routing decisions, resource conflicts, priority disputes, and ambiguous categorization across stakeholder teams.
  
Information Verification & Quality Control
  
Evaluate completeness and quality of initial project information including scope definitions, budgets, timelines, and stakeholder documentation.
  
Identify gaps in project requirements and engage requestors to gather missing details before assignment.
  
Maintain standardized intake templates and checklists to ensure consistent information capture across all requests.
  
Enforce documentation standards that enable accurate project scoping and reduce downstream rework.
  
Stakeholder Coordination & Communication
  
Lead intake calls (weekly/bi-weekly) and kickoff meetings with internal clients, project sponsors, and D&C Project Controls teams.Coordinate across multiple stakeholder groups including operations, finance, real estate, facilities, and business units.
  
Communicate project status, routing decisions, and next steps to all relevant parties throughout the intake lifecycle.
  
Serve as a trusted liaison between requestors and delivery teams, ensuring alignment on expectations and priorities.
  
Reporting & Analytics
  
Monitor dashboards tracking intake volume, request types, assignment patterns, and processing timelines.
  
Analyze performance metrics including time-to-assignment, request completion rates, and resource utilization.
  
Identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvement within the intake workflow.
  
Prepare regular reports on intake productivity, team performance, and operational efficiency for D&C Project Controls leadership.
  
Process Optimization
  
Continuously evaluate and refine intake procedures to improve efficiency and stakeholder experience.
  
Recommend and implement improvements to intake forms, routing criteria, and coordination protocols.
  
Collaborate with D&C Project Controls leadership to establish service level agreements and performance standards.
  
Maintain comprehensive documentation of intake processes, routing guidelines, and best practices.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
Experience
  
5-7 years of experience in project management, project coordination, change management, operations, or related roles within corporate real estate, facilities management, design and construction, or professional services environments.
  
Demonstrated experience managing workflows across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
  
Background in process improvement, change management and operational efficiency initiatives.
  
Skills & Competencies
  
Strong organizational abilities with excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple concurrent requests.
  
Exceptional communication skills with confidence leading meetings and coordinating across diverse stakeholder groups at all organizational levels.
  
Analytical mindset with ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  
Proficiency in project management principles and understanding of design and construction project lifecycles and project controls methodologies.
  
Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization tools for reporting and analytics.
  
Use and knowledge of ai-tools preferred.
  
Experience with project management systems, intake platforms, or workflow management software
  
Personal Attributes
  
Customer service orientation with commitment to stakeholder satisfaction.
  
Proactive problem-solver who can work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.Adaptable and comfortable managing ambiguity in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, evolving product landscape.
  
Strong business acumen with ability to understand organizational priorities and make sound routing decisions.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Process Improvement Specialist, EU FBA
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about making operations run smoother and more efficiently? Amazon is looking for a Process Improvement Specialist to join our EU FBA Support Operations team, where you will identify opportunities to enhance workflows, reduce waste, and drive meaningful results. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional partners to build and implement solutions that directly impact team performance and the associate experience.  
  
You will bring a data-informed mindset and a knack for problem-solving to tackle real operational challenges. Whether you are analyzing process metrics, creating new standard operating procedures, or coordinating with stakeholders to roll out improvements, your contributions will help us deliver for customers more effectively every day. If you are a curious, detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.  
  
A successful candidate must be able to work independently, thrive in ambiguous environments, effectively influence internal/external partners at all levels of the organization. This role will particularly suit someone with a strong innovative mindset, relationship building skills, operational excellence, superior project management capabilities, and strong people management experience.  
  
Some of the qualities that we are looking for: you are results-oriented (and have a track record of repeatedly delivering great results); you are an innovator (and have already proven it); you have the intellect and horsepower to solve really complex problems (some may say impossible to solve); you are an owner, and do what it takes to make your team successful; you have relentlessly high standards (some may say too high); you are customer obsessed; you operate well in an ambiguous environment; and finally, you have a burning desire to be a part of something really big.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Analyze operational data and process metrics to identify inefficiencies, points of failure, and improvement opportunities within fulfillment center workflows.
* Build and implement process improvement initiatives that enhance team outputs, including developing standard operating procedures and automating repetitive tasks where possible.
* Collaborate with peers, managers, and partner teams to troubleshoot operational issues, escalate risks, and align on solutions that balance time and resources.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to communicate project status, track progress, and drive alignment on improvement plans, ensuring clear and concise updates across all levels.
* Monitor system performance and service levels through defined metrics, using findings to refine processes and sustain long-term operational gains.
* Support development and implementation of Automation through data-driven analysis by coordinating with wider organization and tracking progress
* Identify and implement sustainable improvements for operational excellence using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* Execute strategic projects that deliver improvements in Seller Experience, productivity, and lowest cost-to-serve for Selling Partners and Amazon
* Collaborate with program stakeholders to clarify requirements and objectives. Support writing business and technical requirements documents
* Support establishment of business goals, metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) for success
* Build relationships with key stakeholders across global product, program and operational teams to support scalable solutions

  
A day in the life  
A typical day for an EU FBA Process Improvement Specialist will focus on executing Seller Experience initiatives and reduce Cost to Serve for Sellers and for Amazon, analyzing data to drive efficiency improvements, and collaborating with global teams to enhance seller services. They'll split their work between identifying process gaps, performing execution support, implementing process improvements using Lean/Six Sigma methods. Additionally, you might start your morning reviewing performance dashboards to spot trends or anomalies in s key metrics. From there, you could spend time on observing a workflow firsthand, gathering input to engage directly with stakeholders, sellers and and manage what is working and what could be better. You might draft a new procedure based on your findings, coordinate with a partner team on an upcoming rollout, or present a recommendation to leadership. You will balance hands-on problem-solving with clear documentation and communication throughout the day.  
  
About the team  
Today, over 60% of worldwide purchases on Amazon are for products from third-party businesses, mostly from Small- and Medium-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses (our Selling Partners) to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery returns and customer service to Amazon, utilizing the capabilities that Amazon has built over the last 25+ years.  
  
Our team is dedicated to making Amazon's fulfillment operations as efficient and reliable as possible. We focus on identifying what can be improved across processes, tools, and systems, then work together to turn those ideas into action. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do, and we partner closely with operations, learning, and technology teams to deliver results that matter.  
  
We are building an inclusive environment where new ideas are welcomed and every team member has the opportunity to grow. If you are looking for a role where your analytical skills and initiative can make a real, measurable impact, this is the team for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Transportation, Mathematics, Economics, Physics or another technical field
* Experience in data analysis and reporting
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in technical support

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and make data-driven decisions
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Business, Operations, Logistics, Supply Chain or a related field
* Experience working in supply chain, transportation, project management or management consulting

- Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, macros, SQL, visualization tools - Tableau, Quicksight, etc.  

* 1+ years of integration, testing and automation experience, or degree in advanced technology
* 1+ years of Amazon experience, or experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience using Lean Process Improvement, Six Sigma methodologies or related performance metrics/process improvements to increase efficiency within processes, forecasting, planning, optimization, and logistics

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Program Ops Manager, EU FBA
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon currently seeks a creative, dynamic, and experienced Program and Process Improvement Individual to join our EU FBA Support Operations team and drive organization's transformation through Seller Experience, Escalations and automation initiatives. This role will drive strategic change management, oversee organization process and spearhead programs and drive close execution coordination while ensuring seamless integration of AI solutions. A successful candidate must be able to work independently, thrive in ambiguous environments, effectively influence internal/external partners at all levels of the organization. This role will particularly suit someone with a strong innovative mindset, relationship building skills, operational excellence, superior project management capabilities, and strong stakeholder management experience.  
Some of the qualities that we are looking for: you are results-oriented (and have a track record of repeatedly delivering great results); you are an innovator (and have already proven it); you have the intellect and horsepower to solve really complex problems (some may say impossible to solve); you are an owner, and do what it takes to make your team successful; you have relentlessly high standards (some may say too high); you are customer obsessed; you operate well in an ambiguous environment; and finally, you have a burning desire to be a part of something really big.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Develop and manage data driven analysis by coordinating with wider organization and set goals, track progress and report in weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.  

* Drive complex strategic projects that deliver significant improvements in Seller Experience, productivity, and lowest cost-to-serve for Selling Partners and Amazon
* Collaborate with program stakeholders to clarify requirements and objectives. Write business requirements documents and ensure clear communication and coordination of requirements to the business and development teams.
* Establish business goals, as well as supporting metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) for success
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across global product, program and operational teams to build scalable solutions
* Assess escalation eligibility, severity, seller impact, and urgency; prioritise cases against agreed tiered SLAs.
* Dive deep into case histories, operational data, financial records, and stakeholder inputs to establish facts and identify root causes.
* Develop investigation and resolution plans with clear actions, named owners, dependencies, and timelines.
* Resolve ownership gaps, challenge incomplete findings, and escalate blocked decisions with evidence and recommended next steps.

  
A day in the life  
A typical day will focus on reviewing daily metrics, inflow and status of initiatives to improve Seller Experience and reduce Cost to Serve for Sellers and for Amazon, analyzing data to drive efficiency improvements, and collaborating with global teams to enhance seller services. They'll split their time between identifying process gaps, performing escalations and driving daily executions cultivating AI/automation and program management spirit, working with team, implementing process improvements using Lean/Six Sigma methods, and developing Automation solutions to reduce costs while improving service quality for Amazon's selling partners.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
* Experience recognizing a challenge and working with a variety of teams and data sources to diagnose the problem and recommend solutions
* Experience in stakeholder and communication management
* Experience owning end-to-end programs to drive results
* Experience escalating issues, anticipating and making trade-offs, balance the business need versus other constraints and maximize business benefit while building great customer experiences
* Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions, or experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan
* Experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Engineering (any domain) or foreign equivalent, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
* Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
* Experience using Lean Process Improvement, Six Sigma methodologies or related performance metrics/process improvements to increase efficiency within processes, forecasting, planning, optimization, and logistics

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. * Executive-level understanding of AI-assisted and agentic engineering, including model and tool evaluation, context and knowledge architecture, AI evaluation methods, LLMOps/MLOps, agent permissions and observability, and AI-specific software supply-chain risks.

* Strong record of leading Directors, managers, principal-level talent, global teams, vendors, and strategic partners while building succession depth and durable organizational capability.

* Deep technology breadth across modern architecture, platform engineering, cloud, APIs, distributed systems, data, DevSecOps, quality engineering, observability, reliability, cybersecurity, and regulated production operations.

* Track record of managing significant budgets, investment portfolios, vendor ecosystems, and build-buy-partner decisions using value, risk, cost, and strategic-fit criteria.

* Experience establishing measurable engineering and AI governance using portfolio metrics for value, throughput, stability, quality, security, cost, adoption, talent, and customer outcomes.

title: Client Servicing Manager
description:
**Company:**
Umbrella Aegis

**Location:**
MIDC, Mumbai

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office (On-site Only)

**Industry:**
Advertising | Creative Agency | Digital Marketing

**Experience:**
2–6 Years (Agency Experience Mandatory)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About Umbrella Aegis

Umbrella Aegis is a creative and integrated marketing agency delivering innovative brand campaigns, social media solutions, digital marketing, and impactful communication strategies.

We believe in ideas that make a difference, creativity that delivers results, and strong client relationships that drive brand growth.

We are looking for a
**proactive, confident, and solution-oriented Client Servicing professional**
who understands the fast-paced agency environment and can seamlessly bridge the gap between clients, creative teams, and digital marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Client Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships.
* Understand client objectives, brand positioning, and marketing requirements.
* Manage client expectations, feedback, approvals, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular client meetings, presentations, and performance reviews.

**2. Social Media & Campaign Management**

* Manage end-to-end execution of social media campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
* Coordinate monthly content calendars, campaign plans, and creative deliverables.
* Understand social media trends, content formats, reels, engagement strategies, and digital campaigns.
* Work closely with creative, content, design, video, and performance marketing teams.
* Ensure all content aligns with the client's brand guidelines and campaign objectives.

**3. Creative Briefing & Internal Coordination**

* Convert client requirements into clear, actionable creative briefs.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth and timely execution.
* Review creative output for quality, accuracy, and alignment with client expectations.
* Manage multiple accounts, deadlines, revisions, and priorities simultaneously.
* Take complete ownership of projects from briefing to final delivery.

**4. Strategic Thinking & Growth**

* Contribute fresh ideas for social media campaigns and brand communication.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve client engagement and campaign performance.
* Stay updated on social media trends, competitor activities, and emerging digital platforms.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute to campaign concepts.
* Identify opportunities for account growth and additional services.

Skills & Qualifications

* **Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in a creative, advertising, digital, or social media agency.**
* **Current or previous agency experience is mandatory.**
* **Strong understanding of social media marketing, creative campaigns, and digital content.**
* **Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.**
* **Strong presentation, interpersonal, and client-handling abilities.**
* **Ability to manage multiple clients and projects independently.**
* **Good understanding of creative processes, timelines, and campaign execution.**
* **Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, ownership-driven attitude.**
* **Familiarity with social media analytics, reporting, and performance metrics.**
* **Ability to work under tight deadlines in a dynamic agency environment.**

Who We're Looking For

We don't want someone who simply forwards client briefs to the creative team.

**We want thinkers, problem-solvers, and relationship builders.**

**Someone who:**

* Understands the difference between simply posting content and building a brand.
* Can confidently communicate with clients and challenge briefs constructively.
* Brings ideas to the table instead of just following instructions.
* Takes responsibility and gets things done.
* Understands agency workflows and the importance of deadlines.
* Has a genuine interest in creativity, advertising, and social media.

Mandatory Requirements

**Agency Background:**
Candidates must currently work or have previously worked with a creative, advertising, digital marketing, or social media agency.

**Work Location:**
This is a strictly work-from-office position at MIDC, Mumbai. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available.

**Communication:**
Excellent English communication and professional client-handling skills are essential.

Why Join Umbrella Aegis?

* Work on exciting brands and diverse creative campaigns.
* Collaborate with passionate creative and digital professionals.
* Opportunity to contribute ideas beyond routine client coordination.
* Be part of a dynamic, growth-focused agency environment.
* Take ownership of accounts and grow professionally.

* Working knowledge of MS Office and client or account management tools.
* Strong problem-solving, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Candidates must currently be based in Mumbai.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) -**
**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD integration and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) capabilities supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital compliance requirements. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience.
* 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with design and implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions that support global e-invoicing, statutory reporting, and digital compliance requirements. Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. Ability to translate country-specific statutory and e-invoicing requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, and testing scenarios.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.
* Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos
* Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM

title: Relationship Manager
description:
Job Description: Relationship Manager Prop Trading Firm

Position:
Relationship Manager
Location:
Onsite
Employment Type:
Full-time

About the company

Skillset Squad brings brand strategy, marketing, creative production, technology and business operations together.

Our approach comes from a practical observation: winning attention is only one part of building a business. A company also needs dependable processes, useful systems, clear responsibilities and the ability to deliver what its brand promises.

We work at the intersection of those needs.

Role Overview

We are looking for a customer-focused and sales-driven
Relationship Manager
to own the end-to-end trader experience. You will guide traders through onboarding, evaluation, funding, and payout processes, while building long-term relationships that drive retention and revenue.

This is a
hybrid role
requiring a blend of client success, sales, and operational support, with a strong focus on trader satisfaction and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Trader Relationship Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for trainees, funded traders, and prospective clients.
* Onboard new traders: welcome them, verify accounts, explain evaluation rules, funding stages, and platform setup.
* Manage inbound queries via live chat, email, WhatsApp/Skype, Discord, or CRM in a professional and timely manner.
* Build trust and maintain high levels of trader engagement and loyalty.

Product & Rules Education

* Explain proprietary trading rules clearly:
* Evaluation phases (one-step/two-step challenges)
* Profit targets and minimum trading days
* Daily loss limits and maximum drawdown
* Consistency rules
* News trading restrictions
* Payout cycles and profit splits
* Assist traders with platform-related questions (MT4/MT5/cTrader or in-house platform).
* Educate traders on realistic risk expectations
  do not promise guaranteed returns.

Sales & Upselling

* Identify opportunities to upsell traders to larger account sizes, add-ons, or additional evaluation packages.
* Support conversion from:
* Free trials → Challenge
* Challenge → Verification
* Verification → Funded account
* Funded account → Scale-up plans
* Achieve monthly KPIs related to revenue, retention, and client activation.

Operational Support

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records in CRM systems.
* Coordinate with the risk and operations teams to resolve trader issues, payout requests, and compliance concerns.
* Escalate technical issues to internal support teams and follow up until resolution.
* Track and document trader feedback to help improve products, rules, and user experience.

Brand & Community

* Represent the brand in Telegram/Discord communities, forums, and social media channels.
* Assist in webinars or live sessions when needed.
* Contribute to a positive, long-term trading culture aligned with the companys values.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required Experience

* 2+ years in relationship management, client success, account management, or sales ideally within:
* Prop trading firms
* Forex / CFDs brokers
* Fintech / online trading platforms
* Crypto or digital assets

Knowledge & Skills

* Strong understanding of prop firm business models, evaluation processes, and payout structures.
* Familiarity with trading platforms like
  MT4, MT5, cTrader
  , or similar.
* Experience with CRM tools such as
  HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Intercom
  , or Zoho.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Additional languages (Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Thai, etc.) are a plus.
* Ability to explain complex trading concepts in a simple and empathetic way.

Personal Attributes

* Target-driven and self-motivated.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Able to work in shifts/rotational hours due to global clients.
* Resilient, adaptable, and calm under pressure.
* Genuine interest in trading and financial markets.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Trader satisfaction score (CSAT/NPS)
* Trader retention rate after funding
* Evaluation → funded conversion rate
* Upsell and add-on revenue
* Average response and resolution time
* CRM data accuracy
* Active trader engagement levels

Compensation & Benefits

* Opportunities for growth within a fast-growing prop trading firm

title: Director, Salesforce Program Leader
description:
**Description**
As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully-billable, high-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.
  
  
You will be responsible for the end-to-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will ensure that emerging capabilities, including agentic and generative AI programs, are delivered on time, within budget, and with a strict focus on quantifiable business outcomes.
  
  
You will act as the key strategic advisor and point of accountability, building trust with executive stakeholders and ensuring the customer's long-term success on the platform.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Program Accountability: Assume ultimate accountability for establishing, executing and overseeing program governance to deliver strategic value-realization and recovery plans for strategic customer accounts, ensuring clear governance frameworks for complex multi-cloud and enterprise AI implementation roadmaps.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Engage directly with C-level stakeholders to build trust, define success metrics, and demonstrate measurable platform ROI. You will lead all executive stakeholder forums, like Steering Committees, focusing heavily on Performance Evaluation & ROI to help customers quantify the financial and operational business value of their AI investments.
* Strategic Advisory: Serve as the primary, billable expert providing strategic oversight to ensure program delivery aligns with the customer's core business objectives.
* Risk & Scope Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage program risks, dependencies, and scope changes. You will own the executive-level escalation process and translate complex technical issues—such as AI compliance, data readiness, and security boundaries—into clear business implications.
* Commercial Acumen: Lead and support pre-sales teams in initial scoping, change management, and identifying opportunities for expansion of the running program, accurately sizing the organizational change management and delivery effort required for generative AI and digital agent rollouts.
* Delivery Governance: Define, structure, and oversee complex engagement models (e.g., T&M, Fixed Price), ensuring all delivery commitments, milestones, and scope are meticulously managed. You will champion an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Provide expert guidance and strategic direction to customer, partner (SI), and internal teams (e.g., MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs) to ensure cohesive and successful program outcomes.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a deep subject matter expert on the Salesforce platform, including new products, industry trends, and best-practice implementation strategies involving custom development, integration, and data migration.
* Contract Management: Prior experience in understanding and working with MSA/SOW and ensuring delivery is compliant to the terms laid out there.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years of experience, predominantly in consulting or strategic advisory roles, managing large-scale, complex SaaS/CRM program implementations.
* Platform Expertise: Deep expertise in the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including common implementation patterns, integration challenges, custom development, and data migration strategies, and foundational understanding of Agentforce use cases and data cloud dependencies.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build C-level relationships, navigate difficult conversations, and negotiate high-stakes outcomes.
* Account Recovery: Proven experience in strategic account recovery, risk mitigation, and driving platform adoption in complex, at-risk customer environments.
* Cross-cultural experience: Must have prior experience working in a multi-cultural environment with teams and stakeholders geographically spread.
* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre-sales & delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.
* Mindset: A self-starting, individual contributor mindset with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Leadership: Ability to lead a team of consultants in a matrix environment towards a common goal while navigating customer & internal organizational landscape.
* Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Certifications: Must have at least either of these Project management certification (PMI-ACP / PMP / PgMP / Prince 2) and having Salesforce Certification is an asset. An AI Associate or related AI/ML delivery credential is highly valued.

title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Commercial ownership**

* Own end-to-end e-commerce sales for the UK and EU, delivering monthly and annual targets for revenue, orders and contribution margin
* Build and manage the annual e-commerce budget and P&L, including ad spend, marketplace fees, fulfilment costs and promotions
* Set pricing, promotional calendars and channel-wise assortment to balance growth with profitability
* Forecast demand with the supply chain team and plan stock for each channel to avoid stock-outs and ageing inventory

**Marketplaces**

* Manage and grow seller accounts on Amazon UK & EU (Seller Central/Vendor Central), eBay UK & EU, Etsy and Galaxus
* Identify, evaluate and onboard new marketplaces as needed
* Build and manage Brand Registry, Amazon Brand Store and storefronts on each marketplace, including bundles, multipacks and Subscribe & Save
* Drive listing quality: titles, keywords, A+ content, images, reviews and ratings, and Buy Box health

**Advertising and growth**

* Plan, execute and optimise marketplace advertising (Amazon Sponsored Products, Brands and Display; eBay Promoted Listings; Etsy Ads) within agreed ACoS/TACoS and ROAS targets
* Use deals, coupons, Lightning Deals, Prime Day and Vine to drive trial, reviews and repeat purchase; run external traffic to marketplace listings via Meta, TikTok and Google where it pays back

**Operations and compliance**

* Coordinate with the UK office, FBA and 3PL partners on inbound shipments, stock synchronization and timely dispatch
* Ensure food listings meet UK and EU rules: FSA guidance, EU FIC (Regulation 1169/2011) labelling, allergen declarations for nuts and seeds, nutrition and health claims, and HFSS advertising restrictions in the UK
* Maintain compliance with marketplace policies, GDPR, consumer law, VAT/OSS and returns policies
* Keep customer service, account health and seller ratings at high standards across every channel

**Team leadership and reporting**

* Lead, hire and develop the e-commerce team, setting clear targets and reviewing performance
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly dashboards on sales, margins, ad performance and inventory for leadership
* Generate consumer insights from reviews, search terms, Brand Analytics, customer questions and market research; translate them into new flavours, pack sizes, pricing and listing changes

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing or Operations (or equivalent)
* MBA preferred, ideally in Marketing, E-Commerce or International Business
* Certifications in Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4) or Digital Marketing are a plus

**Experience Skills**

* 5-10 years in e-commerce, with a proven record of managing online sales in UK and EU markets. This is a non-negotiable
* Hands-on experience selling on major marketplaces: Amazon UK & EU, eBay, Etsy and Galaxus; exposure to Bol.com, Kaufland or similar is a plus
* Track record of owning revenue, order and margin targets, and managing an e-commerce P&L and ad budget
* Experience launching a brand on new marketplaces, from account setup and compliance to first-sale and scale-up
* Category experience in food, snacks, FMCG or health foods; working knowledge of food labelling, allergen and shelf-life requirements
* Strong grasp of UK and EU consumer insights: shopper behaviour, snacking trends, price sensitivity, seasonality and competitive landscape, with experience turning data and reviews into product and listing decisions
* Proficiency with Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central, eBay Seller Hub, Etsy Shop Manager, Amazon Ads, Amazon Brand Analytics
* Comfort with multi-currency transactions, VAT/OSS reconciliation and marketplace fee structures
* Strong analytical skills, and advanced Excel/Google Sheets

title: Junior Relationship Manager – School Partnerships & Programmes
description:
Hiring: Relationship Manager – Career Ready India

Organisation: Career Ready India

Location: Mulund, Mumbai

Work Mode: Preferred Work from Office | Hybrid option available (minimum 3 days per week in office)

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Career Ready India

Career Ready India is a nationwide initiative focused on bringing structured career guidance, psychometric assessments, career education, and counselling to students from Grades 8 to 12.

We work directly with schools, principals, and educators to implement our programmes and help students make informed education and career decisions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Relationship Manager who can build and maintain strong relationships with school principals and management teams.

The role involves managing schools that have already joined Career Ready India, ensuring smooth programme implementation, and developing relationships with new schools and principals to expand our network.

This is a relationship-driven role combining school engagement, programme coordination, and network development.

Key Responsibilities

1. School Relationship Management

\* Act as the primary point of contact for partnered schools and principals.

\* Maintain regular communication with school leadership and coordinators.

\* Build long-term relationships and ensure continued school participation.

\* Address school queries and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.

2. Programme Implementation & Coordination

\* Coordinate onboarding and activation of schools after enrolment.

\* Schedule and manage psychometric assessments, student registrations, and offline group career counselling sessions.

\* Coordinate the implementation of Career Ready India platform features and other programme deliverables.

\* Work with counsellors, trainers, and operations teams to ensure smooth execution.

\* Track programme progress, school participation, and pending activities.

3. New School & Principal Engagement

\* Connect with principals and schools that have expressed interest in Career Ready India.

\* Develop relationships with new schools and introduce them to the initiative.

\* Follow up with principals after meetings, events, and school interactions.

\* Support the onboarding of additional schools into the Career Ready India network.

4. Reporting & Follow-Ups

\* Maintain accurate records of school interactions and programme implementation.

\* Track school engagement, scheduled activities, and completion status.

\* Provide regular updates to the management team.

\* Identify opportunities to improve school participation and engagement.

Who We’re Looking For

\* 0–2 years of experience in relationship management, school engagement, education partnerships, account management, or programme coordination.

\* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

\* Comfortable interacting with school principals, directors, and senior educators.

\* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple school relationships simultaneously.

\* Proactive, responsible, and consistent with follow-ups.

\* Familiarity with CRM tools, Excel, and digital platforms.

\* Prior experience working with schools or the education sector will be an advantage.

What We Offer

\* Opportunity to work on a large-scale national education initiative.

\* Direct engagement with school leaders and education professionals.

\* Exposure to career counselling, psychometric assessment, and education technology.

\* A collaborative work environment with scope for professional growth.

\* Flexibility for a hybrid working arrangement.

Interested?

Please share your CV at schools@careerreadyindia.com with the subject line Application – Relationship Manager.

Website: www.careerreadyindia.com

description:

We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

 **Job Description**

This role is responsible for supporting the successful preparation and coordination of new products, features, and capabilities through effective cross-functional coordination, stakeholder management, and operational planning.

The ideal candidate excels at bringing clarity to complex initiatives, proactively identifying risks and dependencies, supporting stakeholder alignment, and coordinating execution against agreed launch plans.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Monitor launch progress, identify potential blockers, and work with relevant stakeholders to address or escalate issues that may impact launch success

**3. Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Engagement**

title: Deputy Manager-Strategy, Organisation & Transformation
description:

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**

**Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**

The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.

We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.

**Why this job’s a big deal**  
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.

You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.

This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads**.**

**In this role, you will:**

**1. Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation**

* Build, maintain, and improve Terraform modules and configurations for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.
* Support platform upgrades, configuration changes, capacity planning, and operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments.
* Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes.

**2. CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement**

* Build and operate governed CI/CD pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.
* Work with GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling.
* Create self-service patterns that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.

**3. MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations**

* Support production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements.
* Help establish repeatable practices for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Contribute to GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.

**4. Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE**

* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Use tools such as PagerDuty, Splunk, New Relic, Arize, or equivalent observability platforms.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, infrastructure problems, endpoint failures, and performance degradation.
* Participate in on-call support, contribute to root-cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventative actions
* Integrate IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.

**5. Cost, Governance & Platform Enablement**

* Improve cloud cost visibility, resource utilization, capacity management, and FinOps practices for data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.
* Document platform standards, operational procedures, troubleshooting guidance, and reusable deployment patterns.

**Who you are:**

* **Degree & Experience:** B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* **Containers & Kubernetes:** Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* **CI/CD & GitOps:** Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* **Automation & Scripting:** Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* **Data & Workflow Platforms:** Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* **MLOps:** Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* **Reliability & Operations:** Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* **Security & Governance:** Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* **Operational Mindset:** Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves:**

* Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers.
* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads.

Number of successful engine application projects executed
