title: Site Support Engineer
description:
**About Signify**
Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.
  
  
At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.
  
  
Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**More about the role**
The
**Site support engineer**
provides hands-on technical support to users, systems, and IT infrastructure at a company location. This role is responsible for troubleshooting hardware, software, network, printer, meeting room, and end-user technology issues. The Onsite Support Engineer acts as the local IT contact for employees and works closely with remote service desk, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams.
  
  
Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  

* Provide face-to-face technical support for employees at the office or client site.
* Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, scanners, docking stations, monitors, and peripherals.
* Install, configure, maintain, and replace IT hardware and software.
* Support Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, VPN, email, collaboration tools, and business applications.
* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, including Wi-Fi, LAN, VPN, and basic switching problems.
* Assist with user onboarding, offboarding, device setup, account access, and equipment handover.
* Support meeting rooms, video conferencing systems, projectors, Teams/Zoom rooms, and AV equipment.
* Escalate complex issues to infrastructure, network, security, or application teams when required.
* Maintain accurate ticket updates, asset records, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.
* Manage local IT inventory, including laptops, accessories, spare equipment, and consumables.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs, warranty claims, and service visits.
* Support IT projects such as office moves, device refreshes, software rollouts, and network upgrades.
* Follow IT security policies, access control procedures, and data protection standards.
* Provide excellent customer service and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical users.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Experience in onsite IT support, desktop support, field support, or service desk support.
* Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems; macOS experience is a plus.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and common office applications.
* Good understanding of computer hardware, peripherals, printers, mobile devices, and basic networking.
* Ability to troubleshoot Wi-Fi, LAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and connectivity issues.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Jira, Freshservice, Zendesk, or similar.
* Strong communication, customer service, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple support requests.
* Good documentation and follow-up skills.
* Update asset ownership, location, status, warranty, serial number, and configuration details.
* Coordinate hardware repairs, warranty claims, replacements, and vendor returns.
* Support secure disposal, recycling, resale, or destruction of retired equipment.
* Experience maintaining asset records in ITSM, CMDB
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record keeping.

**Key Competencies**

* Customer-focused mindset
* Strong troubleshooting ability
* Clear communication
* Patience and professionalism
* Attention to detail
* Ownership and follow-through
* Ability to work under pressure
* Good time management

**Preferred Certifications**

* Experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, SCCM, or endpoint management tools.
* Experience with asset management and IT inventory processes.
* Knowledge of ITIL service management practices.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity controls, MFA, endpoint protection, and patching.
* Experience supporting meeting room and AV systems.
* Ability to support VIP users or executive-level stakeholders.

**Common Tools and Technologies**

* Windows, macOS, iOS, Android
* Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint
* Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID
* Microsoft Intune, SCCM
* ServiceNow
* VPN clients, Wi-Fi tools, remote support tools
* Printers, scanners, meeting room systems, AV equipment

**Everything we’ll do for you**
You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
  
  
Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: Salesforce Service Cloud Administrator
description:
**Why join Safeguard Global?**
👀
  
  
We want to help you
**“work in any way**
” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work. 🚀
  
  
Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first — they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for a
**job that works for you. ✅**
**The role in a nutshell:**
We are seeking a Salesforce Administrator to support the management and ongoing optimization of Safeguard Global’s Salesforce Service Cloud platform. Reporting to the Senior Salesforce Administrator, this role will help maintain the day-to-day operations of Service Cloud, support system enhancements, and assist with user requests and troubleshooting. The Salesforce Administrator will work closely with support and operations teams to translate business needs into platform configurations, automation, and reporting capabilities that improve service delivery and operational efficiency. While the primary focus of this role is Service Cloud, the administrator should maintain a general awareness of Sales Cloud functionality to ensure alignment across the broader Salesforce ecosystem. This role will also support the adoption of Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce, helping implement automation and intelligent service workflows that enhance support operations and improve the overall customer experience.
  
  
**How you will make a difference:**

* Support the day-to-day administration of Salesforce Service Cloud, ensuring system stability, usability, and performance.
* Work closely with the Senior Salesforce Administrator to implement system enhancements and platform improvements.
* Configure and maintain Salesforce features including custom objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, and automation flows.
* Assist with user management, including account setup, permissions, and role-based access controls.
* Provide frontline support for Salesforce users by troubleshooting issues and responding to support requests.
* Collaborate with operations and support teams to gather and document business requirements for system enhancements.
* Assist with maintaining data quality and integrity through monitoring, data cleanup, and governance practices.
* Support testing, validation, and deployment of Salesforce updates and new features.
* Assist with the configuration and monitoring of AI-powered capabilities such as Agentforce agents and service automation workflows.
* Collaborate with technical teams to define, test, monitor, and troubleshoot MuleSoft integrations that enable reliable data exchange and workflow synchronization between Salesforce Service Cloud, Jira, Workday, and other business platforms
* Document system configurations, processes, and user guides to support internal knowledge sharing.
* Maintain awareness of Sales Cloud processes and data structures to ensure alignment across the Salesforce platform.

**What will give you an advantage:**

* 3+ years of experience working with Salesforce
* Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM 201) preferred
* Experience supporting Salesforce Service Cloud environments.
* Knowledge of day to day workings in AWS Telephony platform for inbound and outbound contact handling
* Working knowledge of MuleSoft integration capabilities, connectors, APIs, authentication, data mapping, and flow monitoring to support integrations between Salesforce Service Cloud and platforms such as Jira and Workday
* Basic familiarity with Sales Cloud concepts and objects to maintain cross-platform awareness.
* Experience configuring Salesforce features such as objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.
* Exposure to Salesforce Flow or automation tools is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce or Einstein AI
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical configurations
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

**Who we are and what we do:**
  
  
Safeguard Global is…global!
**We enable global expansion without the risk**
by helping 1,500+ customers recruit, hire, manage, and pay employees in nearly 190 countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. 🌎
  
  
**Our Global Benefits**
:
  
  

* 👨‍💻 Autonomy and Flexibility (work in any way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include life needs like school runs and gym breaks in your schedule, all while maintaining a high standard of work.
* 🌴 Generous leave: Enjoy a competitive leave package including paid bonding leaves for new additions to your family
* 🎁 Make a difference: Get 2 paid charitable days off to contribute to causes you believe in
* 💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
* ✈️ International environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
* ⭐ Human centered culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
* 📚 Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace.

  
  
**Next Steps:**
  
  
To apply, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time.
  
  
**Welcome to the Future of Work!**
🌐
  
  
At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

title: SAP CCM (Condition Contract Management)
description:
**Job Title:**
SAP CCM (Condition Contract Management)
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology / Enterprise Applications
  
  
**Experience Level:**
8–10 Years
  
  
**Role Type:**
Full-time
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced
**Senior SAP Functional Consultant**
with 8–10 years of expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD) / enhancements.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses deep hands-on expertise in
**SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebates, settlements, and accruals—complemented by strong domain knowledge in
**Sales & Distribution (SD)**
and
**Pricing**
. In this role, you will lead enhancement deliveries, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support to ensure seamless business operations and Order-to-Cash (O2C) integration.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enhancements, Projects & Business Analysis
* Enhancement Delivery: Lead and deliver enhancements in CCM processes, including designing new contract types, complex settlement logic, and business-specific rebate models.
* Requirement Gathering: Engage with business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement settings, and seamless integration points with financial modules.
* Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with ABAP/technical teams during custom development, code walk-throughs, unit testing, and deployment.
* Testing & Deployment: Drive System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, ensuring defect-free releases into production environments.
* Process Optimization: Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization across CCM and pricing frameworks.
* Application Support & Maintenance (L2/L3)
* Production Support: Provide high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM processes, ensuring strict SLA adherence and minimal operational disruption.
* Issue Resolution: Diagnose and resolve complex incidents related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing inconsistencies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring issues and implement preventive, sustainable fixes.
* ITSM Ticket Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets efficiently within enterprise ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and troubleshoot period-end settlement runs and financial postings.
* Cross-Module Integration & Governance
* SD/FI Alignment: Collaborate effectively with SD and FI/CO teams to resolve cross-functional issues and ensure accurate O2C financial integration.
* Pricing Accuracy: Leverage deep SD and Pricing expertise to maintain calculation schema integrity and pricing determination rules.
* Change Governance: Strictly adhere to transport management, release governance, and change management procedures (CAB approvals) for all system changes.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain accurate functional design documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions for peer teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Technical & Functional Expertise
  
  

* SAP CCM: 4+ years of focused experience configuring and supporting S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (Customer/Vendor Rebates, Chargebacks, Accruals, and Settlements).
* SAP SD & Pricing: Strong expertise in SD core processes (O2C), pricing procedures, condition technique, access sequences, and condition types.
* SAP FI Integration: Working knowledge of G/L accounting, account determination, split settlements, and revenue recognition impacts.
* RICEF Development: Proven track record in creating detailed functional designs for custom reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.
* ITSM & Tools: Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Solution Manager, ChaRM, or similar change control frameworks.

Experience & Education
  
  

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP consulting experience across both Application Maintenance (Support) and Enhancement/Implementation projects.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* S/4HANA Exposure: Hands-on experience operating in S/4HANA environments is mandatory.
* Certifications (Preferred): SAP Certified Application Associate – S/4HANA Sales or SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management.

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with strong root cause analysis and troubleshooting abilities.
* Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills for engaging with both business key users and technical developers.
* Leadership: Ability to independently manage tasks, mentor junior support team members, and drive delivery timelines.
* Stakeholder Management: Experienced in facilitating workshops, prioritizing backlog items, and managing business user expectations during critical issue resolution.

title: GMS - Senior - Proofpoint
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Proofpoint L3 Operations Engineer serves as the technical SME for the Proofpoint environment and is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, platform optimisation, configuration management, security enhancements, integrations, and engineering support. The role owns complex incidents, problem management, and platform improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Advanced Troubleshooting**

* Resolve complex email delivery and security incidents.
* Perform deep-dive analysis of:

+ Mail flow failures
+ TAP detections
+ DLP events
+ Email authentication failures
+ Encryption issues

* Analyse SMTP transactions, logs, headers, and threat intelligence data.

**Platform Engineering & Administration**

* Design and implement:

+ Security policies
+ DLP rules
+ TAP policies
+ Encryption policies
+ Threat detection tuning

* Configure:

+ SPF
+ DKIM
+ DMARC
+ Secure Email Relay
+ MX Routing

* Support tenant expansion and implementation initiatives.

**Security Enhancements**

* Optimise threat detection and false-positive reduction.
* Evaluate emerging email threats and protection strategies.
* Provide security recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.

**Integrations**

* Integrate Proofpoint with:

+ Microsoft 365
+ Exchange Online
+ SIEM platforms
+ Splunk
+ Sentinel
+ Threat Intelligence platforms

* Support API-based integrations and automation initiatives.

**Problem & Change Management**

* Lead root cause analysis activities.
* Own problem records and long-term remediation plans.
* Review and approve platform changes.
* Participate in CAB activities.

**Technical Leadership**

* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers.
* Develop operational runbooks and knowledge articles.
* Provide escalation support during major incidents.

**Required Skills**
**Proofpoint Expertise**

* Proofpoint Email Protection
* Proofpoint TAP
* Proofpoint Threat Response
* Proofpoint DLP
* Proofpoint Encryption
* Email Fraud Defence (Good to Have)

**Advanced Technical Skills**

* SMTP Protocol Analysis
* Exchange Online
* Microsoft 365 Security Stack
* Email Authentication Frameworks (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
* Secure Email Gateway Architecture
* DNS & MX Routing Design
* API Integrations
* PowerShell Scripting

**Security Knowledge**

* Phishing Protection
* Malware Analysis
* Threat Hunting
* Email Security Architecture
* Incident Response
* Data Loss Prevention

**Monitoring & Analytics**

* Splunk
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Defender for Office 365
* SIEM Correlation

**Experience**

* 6-10 years of Cybersecurity or Messaging Security experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on Proofpoint administration and engineering.
* Experience in enterprise-scale email security environments.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Proofpoint Certified Professional (PCP)
* Proofpoint Certified Guardian
* Microsoft Security Operations Analyst
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* ITIL Foundation

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Microsoft Defender for Office 365
* Mimecast
* Cisco Secure Email
* Exchange Hybrid
* Azure Automation
* Python/PowerShell Automation
* Security Operations Centre (SOC) experience

**EY Managed Services Expectations**

* Strong ITSM discipline (Incident, Problem, Change, Request Management)
* Queue ownership and SLA adherence
* 24x7 support participation
* Continuous service improvement mindset
* Excellent stakeholder communication and reporting skills

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Support Representative
description:
**Company Description**
Mexaware Solutions is a specialist IT solutions company based in Thrissur, Kerala, India, operating at the intersection of innovation and practicality. The team focuses on RFID and Bluetooth (BLE) tracking systems, barcode solutions, web development, mobile applications, and cloud infrastructure with DevOps. Mexaware delivers end-to-end technology solutions for asset management, people monitoring, inventory, point-of-sale, and broader digital transformation. Using a modern tech stack including Node.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Android, AWS, Kafka, MQTT, and Fastify, the company emphasizes simplicity, scalability, and timely delivery. Trusted by industry leaders such as Centena Group and ScreenCheck, Mexaware maintains a client-first mindset and a commitment to excellence.
  
**Role Description**
The Technical Support Representative is a full-time, on-site role based in Thrissur, Kerala. This role involves providing timely and accurate technical assistance to customers, including diagnosing issues, troubleshooting hardware and software problems, and guiding users through solutions. The representative will manage support tickets, document incidents, escalate complex issues to engineering teams, and follow up to ensure resolution and customer satisfaction. Daily tasks include responding to queries via phone, email, or chat, maintaining knowledge base articles, and collaborating with internal teams to improve products and services. The role also requires monitoring recurring issues, suggesting process improvements, and contributing to a high-quality support experience.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
* Hands-on Technical Support and Troubleshooting skills for software, hardware, and network-related issues.
* Solid Analytical Skills to diagnose problems, identify root causes, and propose effective solutions.
* Comfort working with IT concepts and tools; familiarity with web, mobile, or RFID/BLE systems is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional local language skills are a plus.
* Ability to work on-site in Thrissur, manage multiple cases simultaneously, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Prior experience in technical or customer support roles is preferred; exposure to SaaS or IT services is beneficial.
* Relevant diploma or degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is desirable.

title: Service Operations Manager
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Manager, Service Operations is a management role, responsible for leading and overseeing the successful delivery of support services to clients within a Region/Country or Services Division.
  
  
The Manager, Service Operations is a people management role responsible for ensuring achievement of organisational and team objectives and fostering a collaborative and motivated work environment.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Manages service delivery to clients.
* Manages client incidents by investigating and providing solutions that help solve client problems as escalated by team leaders and engineers.
* Works with client delivery teams to evaluate client reviews to ensure proactive incident management at client sites.
* Ensures that the standard client information repository related to technology, operations manuals, etc. is current and accurate.
* Creates and maintains a comprehensive list of client requirements, the scope of deliverables, technology and the delivery model.
* Runs the support services operations in alignment with the service management service operations (SMSO) process, delivering promised outcomes to clients.
* Provides operational support and continuous service improvement post client handover from Technical Services (or other) teams.
* Plans and implements key service improvement priorities based on a continual service improvement approach.
* Ensures that tracking and monitoring of the performance of service delivery through all channels (human, digital, self-service, automated) is carried out, metrics and reports are analyzed, and issues are resolved.
* Responsible for the day to day running of the Support Services Operations team in line with the performance established by the business.
* Ensures maximum uptime and the accurate and early response to client operational issues.
* Responsible for resource planning and work allocation to meet agreed service levels.
* Identifies opportunities for continuous service improvement.
* Engages with clients for technical operations as part of routine operations.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Advanced organizational and team management skills.
* Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written coupled with excellent ability to collaborate with internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Advanced understanding of budgets and cost management.
* Excellent time management, prioritization and delegation abilities.
* Advanced focus on client centricity.
* Highly focused on business outcomes.
* Advanced ability to work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Advanced service management service operations (SMSO) expertise.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Business Administration or related, with significant experience in Infrastructure Service Operations.
* ITIL certification(s) preferred.

**Required experience:**

* Advanced experience in service delivery management position within a large scale (preferably multi-national) technology services environment across a range of services.
* Advanced experience in a service delivery environment including technical and service management exposure.
* Advanced experience leading and managing a team.
* Advanced experience designing, implementing, and running a service delivery model.

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.

title: Partner operations Manager
description:
**About Legodesk**

Legodesk is legal-powered recovery infrastructure for Indian lenders: banks, NBFCs, fintechs and ARCs.

We run our clients' end-to-end legal recovery workflow. That covers legal notices, execution proceedings, suit filing, arbitration, Section 138 cases, insolvency and consumer matters. The work is delivered through our technology platform and a network of partner advocates across India.

We are profitable, ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified, CERT-In empanelled, and incubated at IIM Bangalore's NSRCEL.

**Legal Background not Required**

If you have managed external partners who don't report to you, we want to hear from you. Examples include field agents, collection agencies, delivery or logistics partners, distributors, franchisees, freelancers or empanelled vendors. We will teach you the legal process.

**Why join**

* Build a national legal network with a technology-first operating model.
* Lean, profitable team with direct access to the founders.
* Competitive pay with performance-linked incentives.

**Reports to:**
Revenue team |
**Experience:**
2–4 years

**The role:**
You run the partner network as an operating system. You own allocation, SLAs, performance management, payouts and the processes and tools that let the network scale without adding headcount.

**Responsibilities**

* Own network-level KPIs: allocation turnaround, hearing attendance, update compliance, case throughput and partner cost per case.
* Design and run case allocation by jurisdiction, capacity and partner performance.
* Run the partner scorecard and monthly reviews. Tier, coach or exit partners based on data.
* Administer the milestone-based payout model, with minimal advances and fees released on verified milestones.
* Write SOPs, and work with product and tech to automate allocation, reminders, updates and payouts.
* Lead and develop coordinators as the team grows.
* Report network health and risks to leadership every week.

**Must have**

* 4–7 years in partner or supply operations at a marketplace, gig, logistics, fintech-field or collections company.
* A track record of improving SLAs for a network of external partners at scale.
* Strong analytical skills: you design metrics, dashboards and incentive structures.
* Experience working with product teams on operational automation.

**Good to have**

* Experience of managing coordinators.
* Exposure to legal or collections operations.
* **You might currently be:**
  a Partner Operations Manager, Supply Operations Manager, Fleet or Partner Manager, or Field Operations Manager.

title: Workplace Programs Manager
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* 12 years of experience in workplace programs (e.g., food, events, transportation) or a related area like real estate, sustainability, or project management.
* 12 years of experience in facility management, hospitality, corporate services, or property management.
* Experience in vendor or contract management.
* Experience developing and executing communications and engagement strategy.
* Experience in a leadership role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 15 years of experience in the hospitality industry managing food program, event planning and coordination. Experience in a technical discipline and business, or management, demonstrating a blend of technical acumen and business/financial leadership.
* Significant experience in a high-tech, fast-paced environment with the ability to prioritize multiple and changing initiatives.
* Knowledge and experience managing event operations, Audiovisual (AV) Systems, stage lighting and rigging, event power requirements, hybrid and virtual event technologies, technical production management, etc.
* Fluent in AI/ML tools, understanding of their applicability, functionality, and limitations.

**About The Job**
We are seeking a dynamic and organized Event Manager to oversee and execute high-stakes internal and external events across Google's offices in India. This role focuses on delivering seamless event operations with strong technical expertise in audiovisual (AV) systems, stage lighting, event power setup, and hybrid event technologies. You will be passionate about creating memorable experiences, managing complex technical logistics, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  
  
As the Event Manager for India, you will be responsible for defining an ambitious operational vision, strategic roadmap, and performance standards for event infrastructure and operations across our campus facilities. You will lead technical production teams, AV engineers, lighting technicians, and external vendors to deliver event experiences. You will serve as the single point of accountability for event technology readiness, ensuring high-voltage power stability, seamless hybrid/virtual streaming, and flawless AV/lighting integration across large-scale gatherings, corporate summits, and executive presentations.
  
  
Leveraging deep event management experience and a strong technical background, you will drive core objectives focused on event reliability, technical production quality, and AI integration for event workflows. Specifically, you will implement innovative event tech solutions, maintain strategic supplier relationships with technical equipment vendors, leverage data-driven post-event insights, and manage event budgets to ensure scalable and impactful event execution across India.
  
  
The Real Estate and Workplace Services (REWS) team creates inspiring spaces and innovative services that bring Google’s culture and values to life. We build and maintain all aspects of what keeps our Googley workspaces operating seamlessly across multiple cities and regions globally. We also manage the industry-leading services that help make Google a great place to work -- from how we design healthy and collaborative workspaces, create energizing food experiences, provide convenient transportation and fitness options, to delivering environments where Google and our employees can thrive.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Set the operational vision and technical standards for event execution across India, establishing long-term roadmaps for AV infrastructure, hybrid platforms, and venue tech setup.
* Provide technical leadership to production crews, AV engineers, lighting designers, and sound engineers, ensuring flawless execution of high-stakes events and broadcasts.
* Oversee end-to-end event logistics, power distribution management, stage design, and venue technical readiness across multi-city office spaces in India.
* Establish clear SLAs and performance metrics for external AV providers, staging crews, event technology platforms, and equipment rental partners.
* Build and maintain robust relationships with leading production houses, event tech providers, facility power engineers, and cross-functional Google teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Job desc CarCutter
description:
**About CarCutter**
CarCutter is a leading SaaS solution for automotive image enhancement. Our technology helps dealerships and marketplaces create high-quality vehicle imagery at scale through mobile image capture and AI-powered image processing.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a permanent Customer Support & Automation Lead to lead and transform our Care function.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role combining team management, operational excellence, automation, and AI adoption. You will help build a more scalable, efficient, and data-driven support organization while maintaining a high-quality customer experience.
  
  
You will report to the Head of Customer Experience and Operations, based in Paris, France, and work closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Operations.
  
  
The position is based in Bengaluru, India.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop the Care team, creating a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Manage daily support operations, workload distribution, ticket prioritization, escalations, coaching, and performance reviews.
* Assess and improve support processes, workflows, tools, and team capabilities.
* Own the roadmap for support automation and AI adoption.
* Improve the use of Zendesk workflows, triggers, views, macros, automations, reporting, and integrations.
* Identify opportunities to automate or simplify repetitive support activities.

title: Housekeeping Manager
description:
**Manager – Housekeeping (Bangalore) | Z Hotels | Zolo**

**Own hygiene standards. Lead the team. Protect room readiness.**

**Company Name:**
ZoloStays

**Designation:**
Manager – Housekeeping

**Location:**
Marathahalli - Bangalore

**Salary Range:**
up to 8 LPA (Subject to hike according to market standards)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience Required:**
5 – 7 years in Hotel housekeeping

**Why this role exists**

In hospitality, brand trust starts inside the room. Guests may forgive delays. They may even forgive small service gaps. But they rarely forgive poor cleanliness. At Z Hotels, housekeeping is not just about cleaning rooms.

It is about:

* Protecting guest trust
* Maintaining brand standards
* Ensuring operational readiness every single day

As the hotel business scales:

* Room inventory increases
* Occupancy rises
* Turnaround pressure becomes higher
* Guest expectations become non-negotiable

Cleanliness cannot depend on individuals alone. It must be: Governed + Audited + Enforced consistently.

The biggest operational failures usually happen when:

* Room cleanliness varies across shifts
* Room readiness delays impact check-ins
* Audit discipline weakens
* Linen and consumable leakage increases
* Team productivity is not controlled
* Complaints are handled reactively instead of structurally

Without strong housekeeping leadership:

* Guest complaints increase
* Ratings decline
* Occupancy flow gets disrupted
* Operational costs increase
* Brand credibility weakens

**This role exists to ensure:**

* Zero-compromise cleanliness standards across the hotel
* Rooms remain inspection-ready before guest check-ins
* Housekeeping operations run with strict SOP discipline
* Inventory and costs remain tightly controlled
* Audit and safety compliance stay consistently strong

**If this role is strong:**

* Guest ratings improve consistently
* Check-ins happen smoothly without delays
* Teams operate with discipline and accountability
* Costs remain controlled and predictable
* Brand trust strengthens significantly

**If this role is weak:**

* Complaints and escalations increase
* Readiness delays disrupt operations
* Hygiene standards become inconsistent
* Cost leakages rise
* Operational reliability weakens

This role directly controls: Ratings + room readiness + operational discipline + brand trust

**Your mandate is clear**

* Maintain zero-compromise cleanliness standards
* Ensure room readiness before timelines
* Build disciplined housekeeping execution across shifts
* Control housekeeping inventory and costs
* Ensure audit and compliance readiness consistently

This is not a supervision role. This is a cleanliness governance and operational standards leadership role.

**About Zolo and Z Hotels**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent. People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options. Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

* Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
* Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.
* Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life. Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

**Z Hotels is built on:**

* Consistency
* Reliability
* Operational discipline

The hospitality model works only when:

* Rooms are clean every single time
* Turnaround remains fast and predictable
* Standards are enforced daily
* Costs are controlled tightly without compromising quality

At scale: Housekeeping becomes the backbone of guest experience.

This role directly impacts: Guest trust + ratings + readiness + operational reliability

**What you will be responsible for**

1. Own Cleanliness Governance & Brand Standards

* Conduct regular room inspections across shifts
* Design and enforce housekeeping audit checklists
* Identify recurring hygiene gaps proactively
* Drive deep-cleaning schedules and hygiene programs
* Maintain consistency in room standards daily
* Enforce zero tolerance for hygiene compromise

2. Lead Team Performance & Accountability

* Assign daily workload and operational zones clearly
* Track housekeeping productivity and output
* Conduct structured team reviews and coaching
* Correct underperformance quickly and professionally
* Build supervisory capability and second-line leadership
* Maintain discipline and professionalism across shifts

3. Govern Inventory & Cost Discipline

* Track linen movement, inventory, and usage carefully
* Control shrinkage, pilferage, and damage proactively
* Monitor chemical consumption and usage discipline
* Track vendor supplies, quality, and billing accuracy
* Flag cost overruns and operational leakages early
* Plan procurement requirements proactively

4. Drive Speed, Turnaround & Room Readiness

* Align staffing plans with occupancy forecasts
* Coordinate closely with front office for room readiness
* Prioritize early check-ins and operational urgencies
* Reduce room turnaround time systematically
* Prevent readiness delays during peak occupancy
* Maintain smooth check-in operational flow

5. Ensure Audit, Safety & Compliance

* Conduct regular hygiene and safety audits
* Ensure safe chemical handling and storage discipline
* Maintain equipment handling standards consistently
* Ensure housekeeping documentation remains audit-ready
* Train teams on hygiene, safety, and compliance protocols

6. Protect Guest Experience

* Handle serious cleanliness complaints personally
* Respond immediately to urgent guest concerns
* Coordinate service recovery with front office teams
* Identify root causes for repeat complaints
* Ensure issue closure and long-term prevention

**What success looks like after 12 months**

* Rooms consistently pass internal and external audits
* Guest complaints on cleanliness remain minimal
* SOP adherence remains strong across shifts
* Housekeeping costs stay within operational targets
* Team productivity becomes stable and predictable
* Zero safety or compliance violations occur
* Peak occupancy operations remain smooth and controlled

The housekeeping function begins to feel: Structured + Predictable + Scalable—not reactive.

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You have zero tolerance for hygiene compromise
* You notice operational gaps quickly
* You enforce standards firmly and consistently
* You can discipline and develop teams effectively
* You understand operational cost control deeply
* You balance speed with quality naturally

**Experience we value**

5–7 years in:

* Hotel housekeeping
* Hospitality operations
* Housekeeping leadership roles

Experience managing:

* Teams
* Audits
* Inventory
* Room readiness operations
* Strong exposure to SOP-driven environments preferred
* Hospitality background is strongly preferred.
* Operational discipline is non-negotiable.

**The impact you will have**

* Direct impact on guest ratings and reviews
* Protect room readiness and occupancy flow
* Improve housekeeping productivity and discipline
* Control operational costs and inventory leakage
* Strengthen brand credibility and hospitality standards

**Why join now**

Z Hotels is scaling rapidly. As occupancy increases: Housekeeping discipline becomes the biggest differentiator.

This role offers:

* Full ownership of cleanliness and readiness standards
* Strong operational leadership visibility
* Exposure to large-scale hospitality operations
* Growth into Cluster Housekeeping / Ops leadership roles

**APPLY NOW**

**What You’ll Do**

You will play a central role in shaping how partner enablement scales at Databricks.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role with meaningful impact, offering the opportunity to build a more efficient, governed, and AI-enabled operating model that helps our partner ecosystem grow with the business.
  
  
If you enjoy turning ambiguity into structure, building systems that remove friction, and helping teams scale through better operations rather than more manual work, this role is for you.
  
  
**Success Metrics**

title: Lead Order Manager
description:
IIn Order Management, our goal is to ensure the right rigor around schedule and cost management processes to execute the projects on-time, within budget and with right Quality. As a member of Order management team, you will be responsible for project execution activities for the India Nuclear Turbine manufacturing at Sanand factory. This role requires cost tracking and timely communication with customer as well as internal stack holders. With focus and rigor around tools, processes, operating rhythm, and people, here you shall have the opportunity to learn, contribute not limited to Order management but Project Planning
  
  
To build our future, the best energy is ours! Arabelle Solutions, part of the EDF Group, is a global leader in nuclear turbine island technologies, providing innovative low-carbon power solutions from the world’s most powerful operating steam turbine to modular SMR-optimized designs, along with generators, pumps, heat exchangers, and controls. Its technologies are used in one-third of nuclear power plants worldwide, supported by a team of 3,500 experts across 16 countries. Our cultural pillars define how we work together: Team, Expertise, Ownership. We collaborate fully and value the spirit of teamwork, where every skill is recognized to create innovative and effective solutions. Guided by safety and integrity in all we do, we take ownership of our actions and results.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Manage Nuclear new build and service projects for Sanand operations with end-to-end responsibilities including engineering, procurement & manufacturing, execution, customer management.
* Co-ordination with internal stakeholders like Project management, Quality, Sourcing, Finance, Production, Planning, Tendering, Site team etc. as well as Customer for Smooth Execution of the Project.
* Actively participating in kick off meeting to define the coordination and actions between all stake holders within Arabelle Solutions & at supplier’s place.
* Build project schedule and project budgeting.
* Control and Monitor project schedule and budget throughout project.
* Analyze schedule and cost trends and provide forecasted cost and schedules to project team.
* Identify potential schedule and cost risks & Opportunity as well as drive/support risk mitigation.
* Provides internal and external project reporting of Procurement & Manufacturing status.
* Providing 100% material visibility and tracking across the organization.
* Drives KPIs like OTD, Inventory Turn, etc.
* Identify areas of opportunity for standardization / optimization and where possible participate in a Kaizen or similar lean event to implement any identified improvements.
* Ensure compliance to Global Standards for planning and cost control.
* Ensure Alignment to established standards (WBS, process, procedures, tools usage)
* Adhere to all safe working procedures in accordance with instructions.

**Required Professional Experience**

* This role requires 10 to 12 years of rich experience is must in Industrail or technical environment and / or Project management/ Materials Plannign & Execution.
* Background in Power generation, Nuclear or heavy industrail mnufacturign setup (Turbine, Generators/ Alternators, Rotating Equipment industry) is preferable .
* Person must have Project Management or Order Management background and rpoven track recod and ability to manage complex multi-discipline Projects
* Knowledge of cost control & project execution for large complex turnkey projects.
* Ability to federate and coordinate multicultural, multidisciplinary teams without direct authority
* Excellent written and verbal communication; multi-stakeholder environment (teams, suppliers, clients)
* Capacity to analyse and synthesise complex issues; structured problem-solving
* Technical curiosity: ability to understand industrial stakes without design expertise
* Accountability, resilience, autonomy, quality mindset; aligned with Arabelle Solutions cultural pillars

**Education & Language**

* Knowledge level is comparable to a bachelor’s degree In Engineering (Mechanical / Electrical is preferable) from an accredited university or college and any additional certification in Proejct Management / Supply management will be added advantages.
* Strong understanding of procurement / sourcing processes and supply chain governance
* English — Fluent, written and spoken (professional working level)

In India, our presence spans Sanand (Gujarat), Noida (Uttar Pradesh), and Bengaluru (Karnataka), where our teams drive advanced manufacturing, precision engineering, and cutting-edge project delivery-underpinn by our commitment to safety, integrity, and sustainability. title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager (OpenSearch)
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
  
  
Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
  
  
**Job Summary**
NetApp is looking for Technical Operations Manager to join our growing NetApp Instaclustr team in India. NetApp’s Instaclustr offering provides open source as-a-service company, delivering reliability at scale. We manage cutting edge open-source technologies (OpenSearch, Kafka, Cassandra, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Valkey, Postgres, ClickHouse and Cadence) for our customers around the world.
  
  
NetApp Instaclustr makes it easy for our customers to run powerful open-source applications at the highest levels of scale. We have developed a platform that takes care of the whole lifecycle: provisioning infrastructure, installing applications and, most importantly, keeping the applications running reliably in production. Since being founded in 2013, Instaclustr has grown strongly, with over 300 customers worldwide, and over 30,000 nodes under management.
  
  
Our Technical Operations Engineers are the frontline team keeping our large fleet of cloud-hosted open-source clusters up and running. Your work will ensure the security, reliability and performance of world-class systems and databases. You will collaborate with our customer’s technical teams, from globally recognised companies in the gaming, banking and logistics industry sectors, ranging from big multinationals to emerging start-ups.[
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
As TechOps Manager, you will be a leader in our TechOps team who maintain and support our large fleet of cloud-hosted Apache OpenSearch and Kafka open-source technology clusters. Every day will raise interesting and challenging problems ranging across many different areas such as fleet management, customer support, incident response and team development. Based from our Bangalore, office, you will be working closely with other teams, including Product Management, Development Teams and Customer Success to help drive and shape the way we support our customers.
  
  
**Duties and Activities:**

* Maintain an understanding of our product offerings (OpenSearch and Apache Kafka) as well as working knowledge of Instaclustr systems.
* Lead a team of talented engineers to deliver a very high quality of customer service and outcome. Including performance reviews and other people management activities.
* Reviewing the teams work demands and support requests daily, prioritizing them and ensuring timely responses are provided to the customer
* Ensuring that customer issues are responded to within SLA timeframes through staff training, ongoing queue management, allocation of appropriate resources.
* Project management of major operational tasks such as cluster migrations and fleetwide upgrades. This includes resource allocation and scheduling.
* Participate customer calls in different geographies related to the management of major operations
* Be aware of conflicting fleetwide operations and manage these appropriately to eliminate risk (e.g. fleet upgrades targeted to clusters under migration).
* Ensuring that defined processes and procedures are adhered to.
* Manage Shift Rostering
* Participate in our Level 3 on-call roster (Major Incident Manager) which includes rotating weekend coverage and contribute to post incident activities.
* Provide training to new team members and customers in TechOps operational procedures, and ensure these processes are adhered to.
* Be a proactive, reliable and supportive member of the TechOps team.
* Identify and drive the implementation of opportunities to continuously improve TechOps activities through the development and
* Maintenance of tools and procedures and/or working closely with the product engineering team.

Education
  
  

* We require you to have the right skills and maintain professional qualifications for the role covering:
* Proven experience in a Technical Lead capacity, with a clear interest in pursuing a Technical Manager career path, or recent experience in a Technical Manager role. Should have 8+ years of overall experience.
* Exceptional ability to communicate clearly and professionally in written and verbal English is essential as this role will involve customer interaction.
* Ability to perform the role as Major Incident Manager
* Demonstrated excellent experience with managing teams in challenging environments and take measures to keep the team morale high, drive positive work culture
* Previous system administration and/or programming experience is preferred
* Demonstrated ability to multitask, this is a critical attribute to have in this role

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
  
  
**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
  
  
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
  
  
**Our culture**
We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
  
  
If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.
  
  
**Submitting an Application**
To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.

For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

title: FINANCE OPERATIONS-SCO-Proc-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-GDS: Business Consulting -SC&O (Supply Chain & Operations) – Manager (Procurement Operations)**
As part of our EY‑GDS team, you will play a critical role in shaping and elevating our clients’ Procurement Operations. As a manager, you will lead complex engagements that enhance operational efficiency, strengthen compliance and controls, and embed digital solutions across the end‑to‑end procurement lifecycle. You will guide teams in delivering measurable improvements in service delivery, process performance, and procurement maturity, while developing the next generation of operations talent. Your leadership and operational expertise will directly influence how our clients modernize their procurement function. Additionally, you will contribute to building our procurement operations capability, supporting go‑to‑market initiatives, and leading key operational excellence pursuits.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Manager with 8–10 years of strong procurement and supply chain operations expertise, backed by a solid Managed Service background and deep knowledge across core procurement sub‑functions such as P2P, sourcing operations, supplier management, contract, spend analytics and operational governance. The ideal candidate will be a strategic, operations‑focused leader capable of designing and optimizing procurement operating models, driving process excellence, embedding digital procurement capabilities, and leading large‑scale transformation initiatives. This role requires exceptional stakeholder management, the ability to build trusted relationships at senior levels, and the leadership skills necessary to guide high‑performing teams while delivering measurable, high‑impact improvements in procurement operations.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The Manager will lead end‑to‑end Procurement Operations across PR‑to‑PO processing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Management, Spend Analytics, and Managed Services Governance. Responsibilities include overseeing the requisition‑to‑order process, ensuring contract activation, amendments, renewals, and compliance, and aligning all transactions with contracts, catalogs, and pricing agreements. The role will also manage transitions through knowledge transfer, documentation, readiness assessments, and stabilization while ensuring SLA performance and continuous improvement. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* PR to PO Operations & Contract Management

+ Lead end-to-end PR to PO operations, including requisition processing, approvals, PO creation, amendments, and closures.
+ Oversee Contract Lifecycle Management, including contract activation, amendments, renewals, expiry management, and compliance.
+ Ensure alignment between PR/PO transactions and active contracts, catalogs, and pricing agreements.
+ Govern procurement controls, approval matrices, and audit readiness across operations.

* Transition Management & Service Stabilization

+ Lead transition activities for procurement operations, including knowledge transfer, process documentation, and readiness assessments.
+ Manage transition planning across PR-PO and Contract Management processes, ensuring minimal business disruption.
+ Drive stabilization post-transition, including SLA tracking, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.

* Managed Services & Stakeholder Management

+ Manage managed services engagements, including service governance, SLA/KPI management, and performance reviews.
+ Act as the primary interface with client stakeholders, service providers, and internal teams.
+ Drive effective communication, issue escalation, and resolution across procurement operations.

* Procurement Process Integration & Enablement

+ Apply working knowledge of adjacent procurement areas such as supplier onboarding, sourcing handoffs, spend visibility, and compliance.
+ Ensure smooth integration between procurement operations, contracts, and downstream finance processes (e.g., invoice compliance, accruals).
+ Leverage procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, ServiceNow, ERP systems, and supplier portals to enable operational efficiency.

* Continuous Improvement & Governance

+ Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation.
+ Support reporting, governance forums, audits, and internal control reviews.
+ Mentor and guide team members within procurement operations.

* Supplier Management & Governance

+ Lead supplier onboarding, performance management, compliance monitoring, and issue resolution.
+ Establish and manage supplier governance frameworks including KPIs, SLAs, scorecards, and review cadences.
+ Monitor supplier risk, dependency, and compliance, and escalate issues to senior stakeholders as required.
+ Act as the primary interface between suppliers, procurement teams, and business stakeholders.

* Spend Analytics & Optimization

+ Lead spends analytics to identify cost reduction, demand management, and value optimization opportunities.
+ Analyse spends across categories, suppliers, and regions to generate actionable insights.
+ Develop and present dashboards, reports, and management insights to support decision-making.
+ Partner with sourcing and finance teams to track savings and benefits realization.
+ Systems Enablement, Managed Services & Stakeholder Leadership
+ Leverage procurement and analytics platforms such as SAP Ariba, ServiceNow, ERP systems, BI tools, and supplier portals to enable supplier governance and spend visibility.
+ Ensure data accuracy, reporting integrity, and adherence to controls.
+ Lead supplier and managed services governance forums, including SLA and performance reviews.
+ Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior client and internal stakeholders.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8–12 years of experience in Supplier Management, Spend Analytics, Procurement Operations, or related roles.
* Strong experience in supplier governance, spend analysis, and stakeholder management.
* Hands-on exposure to procurement and analytics tools such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, iValua, Jaggaer, ServiceNow, ERP platforms, and BI tools.
* Proven ability to operate in managed services and transformation environments.
* Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills.
* Supply chain consulting experience in Big 4, Supply chain global consulting firms preferred
* Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30%, depending on project requirements

**To qualify for the role, you should have**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Finance, Analytics, or related discipline.
* MBA or professional certifications (CIPS, CPSM) preferred.
* Consulting or global delivery experience is an advantage.

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide
* Opportunities to work with EY SCO practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: FP&A Manager – Revenue Operations
description:
**Position Summary**

The Manager, FP&A – Revenue Operations will support the Director of Finance – Customer Operations and partner closely with the Leasing, Collections, and Customer Care teams. This role is responsible for analyzing key business drivers impacting occupancy, ancillary revenue, and credit loss performance, while delivering actionable insights to improve financial and operational results.

This individual will also support labor forecasting for Customer Care centers, track and report on key performance indicators, and help automate recurring reporting and analysis to improve efficiency and decision-making. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with the Director of Finance – Customer Operations to support financial planning, forecasting, and performance analysis related to revenue management and national operations.
* Analyze business drivers of occupancy, ancillary revenue, and credit loss performance, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Develop insights and recommendations to improve business performance across Leasing, Collections, and Customer Care.

title: Credit Analyst
description:
Opening for Investment Banking client.

The individual will be responsible for credit analysis of existing or new financial institution clients/counterparties. Day-to-day responsibilities include:

* Assessing the creditworthiness of counterparties: prepare detailed credit application by capturing relevant information as per internal policies, perform credit outlooks, recommend risk ratings using bank’s internal rating tools, and propose global credit limits based on internal risk appetite.
* Obtain RISQ approvals on the ratings and credit limits within the specified timelines, and ensure that the internal systems are accurately updated.
* Process one-off credit requests in a timely manner to meet business deadlines and maintain the annual review cycle.
* Research and analyze financial data on the counterparty to prepare high-quality analysis in credit applications that addresses both client credit risk and transaction risk.
* Knowledge of capital markets and credit-related products, particularly derivatives, securities lending/repo, and trade finance – preferrable.
* Manage key components of counterparty credit administration such as, negotiating and controlling trading legal documentation (ISDA/CSA, GMRA, GMSLA) – preferrable.
* Perform ongoing monitoring of client credit quality to identify a possible deterioration and propose appropriate actions (changes in risk rating & limits).
* Closely monitor developments related to regulatory, industry, counterparty events, and track external rating changes.
* Assist in performing stress tests on banking sectors, and preparing sectoral research and outlook.
* Coordinate and liaise with several internal stakeholders: Relationship Managers/Bankers, Business Lines/Traders, Legal, Risk, KYC, Operations and others.

The Finance Manager is responsible for managing the organization’s overall financial operations, ensuring accurate financial reporting, statutory compliance, budgeting, and cash flow management. title: Corporate Strategy Manager (Consulting & Strategy)
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
  
  
  
  
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

**Job Description**

Freshworks is looking for a Manager to join our global Corporate Strategy team and help shape some of the most important decisions facing the company.

This is a high-impact strategy role for someone who loves solving complex business problems but wants to get closer to the decisions, the executives making them, and the outcomes that follow.

You'll work directly with Strategy leadership and senior executives on questions spanning AI, product strategy, pricing and monetization, GTM growth, market expansion, and strategic investments. One project might involve evaluating how we monetize a new AI capability; another could focus on where Freshworks should invest to accelerate growth or how we evolve our GTM strategy.

The team operates with the rigor of a top strategy consulting firm, but with one important difference: we don't stop at the recommendation. We partner across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to help turn strategy into action and see the impact of the decisions we help shape.

**What You'll Do**

• Own high-priority strategic initiatives from initial question through recommendation and execution.
  
  
• Tackle ambiguous company-level problems, develop hypotheses, and create the analytical frameworks needed to answer them.
  
  
• Evaluate growth opportunities across AI, product, GTM, pricing, market expansion, and strategic investments.
  
  
• Build business cases, financial models, market assessments, and scenario analyses that inform investment and resource allocation decisions.
  
  
• Partner directly with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to shape decisions and drive alignment.
  
  
• Translate strategy into actionable plans and stay close to execution to understand what is working and where we need to adjust.
  
  
• Develop executive and Board-level narratives that distill complex analysis into clear choices and recommendations.
  
  
• Bring an outside-in perspective on the SaaS and AI landscape and help identify the strategic questions Freshworks should be asking next.

**Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**

• 4-6+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a combination of consulting and in-house strategy experience;
**experience from a top-tier management consulting firm, particularly MBB (Mckinsey, Bain, BCG) is preferred**
  
• Experience solving growth, product, GTM, pricing, market entry, or investment strategy problems
  
  
• Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, or technology businesses strongly preferred
  
  
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to turn data into business insights and recommendations
  
  
• Executive-level communication skills and the ability to influence without authority
  
  
• Comfortable moving between high-level strategy and hands-on analysis
  
  
• Curious, low ego, and energized by ambiguity
  
  
• Most importantly, you want to own the outcome, not just deliver the recommendation

**Why This Role**

Freshworks is at an exciting point in its evolution. We're scaling a global SaaS business, expanding our enterprise presence, and navigating how AI changes the products we build, how we monetize them, and how our customers work.

For someone coming from consulting, this is an opportunity to keep the parts of the job you love—complex problems, executive exposure, analytical rigor, and variety—while gaining something that's harder to get as an advisor: ownership.
