title: Financial Controller
description:
**About the company**

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising

the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market — economy to

mid-market — to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel

over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price

point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.

We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:

● Itsy (₹1000–1500)

● Treebo and Treebo Premium (₹1500–3000)

● Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (₹3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10

across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced finance leader to head our end-to-end finance function across hotel operations. In this role, you will take full ownership of accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, cash flow management, and internal controls to ensure financial discipline and long-term business sustainability. Beyond core controllership, you will serve as a strategic partner to operational leaders, driving bottom-line profitability, leading cost optimization initiatives, streamlining vendor management, and implementing robust SOPs. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and have a proven track record of building high-performing finance teams, this role offers the platform to make a direct impact on our operational scale and efficiency.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)**
  with
  **5-8 years**
  of post-qualification experience.
* At least
  **2–3 years**
  of proven leadership experience as a
  **Financial Controller**
  , Head of Finance, or in an equivalent senior controllership role.
* Direct domain exposure in
  **Hospitality, Retail, F&B, or Multi-unit Operations**
  (preferred).
* Strong technical command over accounting, financial reporting, AOP/budgeting, working capital/cash flow management, and internal financial controls (IFC).
* Proven track record of identifying cost leakages, driving operational efficiencies, and boosting unit-level profitability.
* Demonstrated experience in vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract lifecycle management.
* Strong leadership, analytical problem-solving, and cross-functional stakeholder management capabilities.
* Comfort and agility in navigating fast-paced, dynamic, and high-growth operational setups.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Financial Controllership:**
  Lead the full accounting and financial lifecycle for hotel operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting and month-end/year-end closures.
* **Budgeting, Forecasting & AOP:**
  Drive annual operating plans (AOP), monthly rolling forecasts, and variance analyses to provide actionable financial insights to business leadership.
* **Cash Flow & Working Capital Management:**
  Oversee treasury, fund planning, collections, and working capital cycles to optimize liquidity across all operating units.
* **Cost Optimization & Profitability Analysis:**
  Monitor unit-level and consolidated P&Ls, analyze cost drivers, plug revenue leakages, and implement targeted initiatives to enhance overall margins.
* **Internal Controls & SOP Implementation:**
  Design, standardize, and enforce robust internal financial control frameworks and operational SOPs to mitigate operational and financial risks.
* **Vendor & Commercial Management:**
  Oversee vendor payment cycles, conduct periodic supplier audits, and lead commercial negotiations to optimize procurement and operational costs.
* **Audit & Statutory Compliance:**
  Direct and coordinate internal, statutory, and tax audits (Direct & Indirect taxes), ensuring zero-defect compliance with all regulatory standards.
* **Cross-Functional Business Partnering:**
  Collaborate closely with general managers, procurement, operations, and leadership to align financial strategy with overall business growth.
* **Team Building & Leadership:**
  Recruit, mentor, and build a high-performing finance and accounts team capable of scaling with the company's expansion.

title: Category Manager
description:
**About the company**

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising

the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market — economy to

mid-market — to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel

over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price

point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.

We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:

● Itsy (₹1000–1500)

● Treebo and Treebo Premium (₹1500–3000)

● Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (₹3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10

across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

**About the Role**

The Category Commercial Manager – Hills is the category's chief strategist: the person who

figures out what actually makes a hill-station hotel perform, codifies it into a playbook, and

builds the knowledge base that lets the rest of the organization act on it consistently. This role is

less about running any single lever day-to-day and more about answering the "why" behind

performance — which factors separate a top-performing hill hotel from a struggling one — and

turning that answer into a repeatable, scalable set of actions.

Pricing execution sits with the central Revenue Management pricing team. Everything else that

drives hill-hotel performance — demand patterns, inventory strategy, positioning, marketing,

and policy — is this role's to understand, document, and turn into playbook guidance, working

closely with the teams who execute against it.

This is a high-visibility, senior individual-contributor role reporting into commercial leadership,

with regular exposure to QBR and senior management reviews.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategy & Playbook Creation (core mandate)

● Diagnose what drives performance in the hills category — pull apart top-performing vs.

underperforming hotels within each cluster (Chikmagalur, Coorg, Ooty, Shimla, Manali,

etc.) and identify the specific, repeatable factors behind the gap

● Translate those findings into a living Hills Category Playbook: a structured, prioritized set

of "what to do" actions — by cluster, by season, by hotel maturity — covering everything

from listing content to demand planning to promotions

● Continuously test and refine the playbook: treat each intervention (a pricing change, a

new cancellation policy, a promotion) as an experiment, and feed results back into the

playbook rather than treating it as one-off

● Own the category's knowledge base — a single source of truth documenting what

works, what doesn't, and why, so that the logic doesn't live only in one person's head

and can be handed off, audited, and built on

● Build decision frameworks (e.g., "when a hotel's occupancy drops below X in season Y, do

Z") that let revenue management, marketing, and ops teams act on the playbook

without needing this role in every conversation

● Benchmark the hills category against comp sets and against Treebo's other categories

(city, business) to pressure-test which "hills-specific" factors are truly unique to the

category

Revenue Management (beyond pricing) — as playbook inputs

● Study demand seasonality by destination (long weekends, festival calendars, school

holidays, wedding/honeymoon seasons) and turn it into a demand-planning framework

the category can reuse year over year

● Define the category's point of view on inventory and availability strategy —

length-of-stay controls, minimum-stay/blackout dates, stop-sells, and overbooking

approach at high-demand properties — and document it in the playbook

● Define the category's channel mix and distribution strategy, and the market/segment

strategy (corporate vs. leisure vs. drive-in) by cluster and season

● Partner with the central pricing team on rate-uplift opportunities (e.g., properties priced

below comp set despite equal or better review scores), feeding them the category insight

behind each opportunity

● Investigate root causes behind Critical No-Show % and other NBV-leakage patterns at

sold-out properties, and codify the intervention playbook (ACQ or otherwise)

Marketing — as playbook inputs

● Determine what marketing actually moves the needle for hill destinations — content

quality, listing photography, promotions, campaigns — and document what works by

cluster and season

● Build the playbook for OTA visibility and content marketing (listing standards,

ranking/boost programs) in coordination with the Listing Intelligence workstream

● Design and run promotion/campaign experiments tied to seasonality, and record which

formats and offers actually lift occupancy and RevPAR

● Track marketing-driven demand signals (e.g., hotel detail view traffic by platform) to

figure out where marketing effort pays off, and build that into the knowledge base

Policy — as playbook inputs

● Determine the right cancellation, refund, and no-show policy stance for the category,

and document the reasoning and trade-offs (guest flexibility vs. NBV protection)

● Define the category's position on rate parity, minimum-stay, blackout, and

booking-window policy for peak-season dates

● Ensure category-level policy recommendations account for OTA platform requirements

and Treebo's broader commercial policy framework

Competitive & Market Intelligence

● Track ARI (Average Rate Index) and Review Index against comp sets for each cluster

● Turn competitive patterns into playbook guidance — e.g., what a competitor is doing

that consistently correlates with better performance, and whether it's worth adopting

Portfolio & P&L Management

● Own the regional P&L narrative for the hills category — revenue, cost-to-serve, and NBV

— and present waterfall/variance analysis in QBRs, tying performance back to playbook

adoption

● Prioritize which playbook interventions to push into which hotels, based on

impact-to-effort

● Partner with acquisition/onboarding teams to apply category learnings to new hotel

signings in high-potential hill destinations

Cross-functional Execution

● Work closely with central Pricing, Distribution, Marketing, OTA/Listing, Operations, and

Category teams — both to gather the inputs the playbook needs and to get playbook

guidance actually adopted

● Represent the hills category in AMJ/quarterly business reviews — own the narrative,

data, and playbook evolution

● Maintain the knowledge base and playbook as living documents, versioned and updated

as new evidence comes in

**What We're Looking For**

● 4–8 years of experience in revenue management, commercial strategy, or program

management in hospitality/ travel, or a marketplace/platform business preferred

● Strong analytical instincts: comfortable moving from raw performance data to "here's

the underlying reason" rather than stopping at the dashboard

● Demonstrated experience building frameworks, playbooks, or SOPs that other teams

adopted and used — not just one-off analyses

● Strong quantitative fluency: comfortable working with RevPAR, ARR, NBV, occupancy,

and P&L waterfalls without hand-holding

● Working knowledge of revenue management levers beyond pricing, OTA distribution

dynamics, and hospitality marketing/policy — enough to know what questions to ask,

even without owning execution of each

● Demonstrated ability to translate data into a clear commercial narrative for senior

stakeholders

● Advanced Excel/Sheets skills; comfort with dashboards (Mixpanel or similar) is a plus

● Willingness to travel periodically to hill-station clusters to validate playbook assumptions

on the ground

● Curious and rigorous by disposition — treats every intervention as something to be

tested and documented, not just executed

**What Success Looks Like (First 2 Quarters)**

● A first version of the Hills Category Playbook live and shared with commercial

leadership, covering demand planning, inventory strategy, marketing, and policy by

cluster

● A knowledge base documenting the specific factors that separate top- and

bottom-performing Hill hotels, with evidence behind each claim

● At least 2–3 playbook recommendations piloted with a measurable before/after read

(e.g., a promotion format, a policy change, a listing fix)

● A repeatable, cluster-level QBR reporting structure adopted by commercial leadership,

framed around playbook adoption and impact

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Your Job**
Phillips Medisize, a Molex Company is seeking a
**Senior**
**Financial Analyst**
to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team in Bangalore India.
  
  
The Senior Financial Analyst will serve as a strategic finance partner supporting program financial health, forecasting, reporting, governance, and cross-functional decision-making. This role will partner closely with Program Managers, Finance Business Partners, P&L Owners, and site leadership to provide clear financial insight, identify risks and opportunities, and drive disciplined program execution.
  
  

* This is a hybrid position with 4 days/week on site.

**Our Team**
Our team is a dynamic and collaborative group of professionals dedicated to advancing medical technology through innovation and strategic execution. We bring together experts from finance, marketing, engineering, and operations who work cross-functionally to drive growth and deliver impactful solutions within the Diagnostics and regulated consumer products segments.
  
  
Our culture values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and principled entrepreneurship, empowering each team member to contribute to meaningful outcomes that improve patient care globally. Together, we leverage deep industry expertise, data-driven decision-making, and a commitment to quality to support the development and commercialization of lifesaving medical devices and technologies.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Manage the financial performance and controls of assigned programs, ensuring accurate reporting and compliance with company policies.
* Lead financial forecasting and budgeting activities, including revenue and cost planning for program milestones and pre-production phases.
* Analyze program financial results, identify variances, risks, and opportunities, and communicate insights to business and finance leaders.
* Partner with Program Managers, site leaders, and Finance Business Partners to support data-driven business decisions and program success.
* Monitor program spending and financial performance, proactively identifying risks related to scope changes, costs, schedules, and resource utilization.
* Prepare and maintain financial reports that support invoicing, revenue recognition, month-end close activities, and program reviews.
* Establish and maintain program structures within SAP Project Systems, ensuring alignment with accounting standards and governance requirements.
* Support audits, financial reviews, and process control activities while improving the accuracy and integrity of financial data.
* Consolidate program health information from multiple systems, including project schedules, milestones, risks, and financial metrics, to provide a comprehensive view of program performance.
* Drive continuous improvement by implementing standardized processes, automation, reporting enhancements, and AI-enabled analytics to improve efficiency and decision-making.
* Foster an environment of business partnership, knowledge sharing, accountability, and principled entrepreneurship.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or Economics
* Experience - 7-10 Years
* Experience supporting forecasting, budgeting, financial planning, variance analysis, or program financial management.
* Experience applying finance and accounting principles, including cost management, revenue recognition, accruals, and financial controls.
* Experience using SAP or similar enterprise resource planning systems to support financial analysis, reporting, or program governance.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel experience, including formulas, pivot tables, data consolidation, and financial modeling.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience with SAP Project Systems, work breakdown structures, sales order linkages, or project accounting.
* Project or program management experience, especially in manufacturing, engineering, medical device, or product development environment.
* Experience with project management or tools such as Planisware, CoCo, Claude, Streamlit, Power BI, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting monthly invoicing, financial status reporting, program reviews, or cross-functional governance routines.
* Demonstrated ability to improve processes, automate manual reporting, strengthen controls, and translate financial data into actionable business insights.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and proactively address issues in a dynamic environment

*At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.*
**Who We Are**
At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.
  
  
Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

title: Corporate Controller - CP&O
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
At Hitachi Energy, we are looking for a Finance Controller Specialist to join our Finance Function and play a critical role in driving financial planning, controlling excellence, and process standardization across a global organization. In this role, you will partner with key stakeholders to support financial performance management through robust planning, forecasting, budgeting, and reporting processes.
  
  
You will contribute to the development and continuous improvement of functional controlling processes, ensuring alignment with global standards while supporting business growth and operational excellence. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with finance leaders, process owners, and business teams across regions, gaining exposure to a multinational matrix environment.
  
  
As a trusted finance professional, you will provide actionable insights through financial analysis, performance monitoring, and process governance. You will help strengthen financial transparency, improve decision-making, and support the organization's strategic objectives through effective process management and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
If you are passionate about financial controlling, process excellence, data-driven decision making, and continuous improvement, this role offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a global technology and industrial leader.
  
  
How You'll Make an Impact
  
  

* Drive global standardization and continuous improvement of financial controlling processes across the organization.
* Manage and support end-to-end processes related to Profit & Loss (P&L), Balance Sheet review, and Variance Analysis.
* Coordinate and execute budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Monitor process performance through KPIs and recommend actions to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Collaborate with finance teams, Centers of Excellence (CoE), and business stakeholders to ensure compliance with process standards.
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities, and support implementation of corrective actions.
* Facilitate process governance activities, including process documentation, policy adherence, and change management.
* Review and support process enhancement initiatives, ensuring alignment with global finance standards.
* Foster strong stakeholder relationships and provide guidance on finance process requirements and best practices.
* Leverage AI, digital technologies, and reporting tools to improve financial insights, productivity, and decision-making.

Your Background
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost and Management Accountant (CMA).
* 2 to 5 years of experience in Financial Controlling, Accounting, FP&A, or related finance functions.
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and financial analysis.
* Strong understanding of P&L management, Balance Sheet analysis, and variance reporting.
* Experience working within multinational and matrix organizations.
* Knowledge of finance process management, process improvement methodologies, or business process management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem-solving, decision-making, and productivity while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in manufacturing, industrial, engineering, energy, or similar sectors.
* Exposure to ERP systems, planning tools, and financial reporting solutions such as SAP or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of process governance, standardization, and continuous improvement frameworks.
* Experience collaborating with global and cross-functional teams.
* Additional language capabilities beyond English are considered an advantage.

More About Us
  
  
At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We foster an inclusive and collaborative environment where innovation, continuous learning, and diversity are valued. We offer opportunities for professional growth, global exposure, and meaningful work that contributes to the energy transition.
  
  
*Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem-solving, decision-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.*

title: Finance Manager, INFC
description:
**Description**
Amazon seeks a Finance Manager to partner with the First Mile network for the India business. The role owns the planning and management of costs billed by third-party warehousing partners across the network - optimizing rate card structures, reviewing contracts before they are entered into for commercial terms and cost exposure, and working with key stakeholders across Operations and Procurement to identify and execute cost-reduction initiatives. The role partners with Procurement on rate card negotiations with third-party warehousing partners and provides the financial analysis behind each negotiation and commercial decision.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Responsible for financial planning, forecasting, and reporting models for the first mile 3P network
* Partner with teams across Operations and Procurement to drive cost out initiatives and optimal cross functional decisions that maximize Amazon's long-term free cash flow
* Own rate card structures and provide the financial analysis behind partner negotiations and commercial decisions, including reviewing contracts for commercial terms and cost exposure before they are entered into
* Own the month-end close (MEC) for the first mile 3P network - including partner requisitions and POs, and controls over partner billing
* Partner with Procurement to drive YoY cost optimization through rate card negotiations with third-party warehousing partners
* Develop and maintain key reporting metrics and review mechanisms for the segment
* Drive adoption of AI and automation to reduce manual effort across planning, close, and reporting

**About The Team**
Operations is at the heart of what we do at Amazon, delivering hundreds of thousands of items each day. Operations finance is the financial engine and trusted business partner for our operations leaders. We use data to solve hard problems and advise our customers on business decisions and opportunities. Everything we do is through the lens of controllership and to increase goodness for customers – we are home to continuous improvement champions, automation advocates, and all who love to work at scale. If you obsess over customers, people, and productivity, come join us!
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* MBA, or CMA or CPA
* Experience in commercial finance business partnering or FP&A (at a multinational organisation), or experience or equivalent experience in finance roles
* Experience building or deploying automation or AI tools in a finance function

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CA or MBA with 7+ years of progressive experience in finance

title: Finance Manager- Digital & IT
description:
**About Us**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**Role Overview**

The Finance Manager is the finance partner to the Digital & IT leadership team. The role connects financial stewardship with technology strategy, translating plans, delivery choices and supplier commitments into clear financial outcomes. It combines FP&A, investment appraisal, cost management, management reporting and business partnering, with a strong focus on forward-looking insight and constructive challenge.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic finance partnership**

· Advise the CDIO and Digital & IT leadership on financial implications, trade-offs, risks and opportunities across the technology portfolio.

· Translate functional strategy and roadmaps into integrated financial plans, resource choices and measurable outcomes.

· Provide clear, concise and decision-oriented insight for senior leadership and relevant governance forums.

**Planning, forecasting and performance management**

· Lead the annual budget, rolling forecast and periodic outlook processes for Digital & IT, aligned with enterprise planning requirements.

· Coordinate inputs from capability or COE leads, regional finance partners and relevant business stakeholders; challenge assumptions and eliminate unsupported cost carry-over through zero-based thinking.

· Develop driver-based forecasts, scenarios and sensitivity analyses covering demand, capacity, inflation, foreign exchange, supplier commitments and delivery timing.

· Monitor actuals, commitments and forecasts; explain variances, identify corrective actions and maintain a reliable view of the full-year position.

**Technology cost transparency and control**

· Own a coherent view of Digital & IT run, change and transformation costs, including internal resources, software, cloud, infrastructure, managed services and professional services.

· Develop and maintain cost allocation, showback or chargeback logic where required, with transparent drivers and clear ownership.

· Establish robust controls for purchase orders, accruals, prepayments, capitalization inputs, intercompany charges and supplier invoices in partnership with Accounting, Procurement and other control owners.

· Identify structural savings and productivity opportunities while protecting service resilience and strategic priorities.

**Investment governance and value realization**

· Partner with initiative sponsors and delivery teams to build credible business cases, including baseline, benefits, costs, cash flow, risk, dependencies and alternative scenarios.

· Assess project and portfolio proposals using appropriate financial measures and provide an independent recommendation to decision makers.

· Maintain financial oversight from approval through delivery, including stage-gate reviews, forecast-at-completion, benefits tracking and post-implementation review.

· Challenge scope, sequencing and solution economics to improve return on investment and portfolio affordability.

**Vendor and commercial finance**

· Partner with Procurement, Legal, service owners and vendor managers on sourcing strategies, contract economics, indexation, consumption commitments, renewals and commercial negotiations.

· Maintain visibility of committed and contingent supplier spend, unit rates, volume drivers, contractual milestones and termination or transition implications.

· Support fact-based vendor performance and cost reviews and verify that negotiated benefits are reflected in plans and actual results.

**Reporting, analytics and data stewardship**

· Design a concise management reporting suite covering financial performance, portfolio economics, cost drivers, risks, opportunities and benefits.

· Automate recurring reporting and improve self-service insight using approved ERP, planning and business intelligence tools.

· Apply predictive analytics, scenario modelling and, where appropriate, AI-enabled methods to forecasting and cost insight, within applicable governance standards.

· Maintain clear definitions, reconciliations, controls and ownership so that management information is trusted and auditable.

**Teamwork and continuous improvement**

· Build effective partnerships across Digital & IT, Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, regions and business units.

· Simplify finance processes, standardize ways of working and document key controls and decision rights.

· Coach budget owners and delivery leads to strengthen financial literacy, accountability and commercial discipline.

· Contribute to an inclusive, high-performing culture based on integrity, collaboration and constructive challenge.

**Measures of success**

· Accurate, timely and decision-useful plans, forecasts and management reporting.

· Improved visibility and ownership of run, change, committed and forecast technology costs.

· Investment proposals supported by transparent assumptions, options and value measures.

· Early identification of financial risks and opportunities, with clear corrective actions.

· Demonstrable tracking of approved benefits, savings and productivity outcomes.

· Strong stakeholder confidence in the quality, independence and commercial relevance of finance support.

**Qualifications and Experience**

· Chartered Accountant, CPA, CMA or equivalent recognized professional finance qualification.

· Typically 8-10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, business partnering or technology finance within a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.

· Demonstrated experience of budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, investment appraisal and cost control.

· Practical understanding of technology cost structures and commercial models, such as software subscriptions, cloud or consumption-based services, infrastructure, managed services, professional services and project delivery.

· Experience partnering with senior leaders and translating complex financial analysis into clear decisions and actions.

· Advanced Excel and PowerPoint capability, experience working with large datasets, and proficiency with ERP and business intelligence tools. SAP experience is strongly relevant.

**Preferred experience**

· Finance experience in a global consumer, manufacturing, commodity, technology services or consulting environment.

· Experience with technology business management, cost allocation, showback or chargeback, portfolio governance, FinOps or benefits realization.

· Working knowledge of SQL, Tableau, Power BI or comparable analytics and visualization tools.

· Experience improving finance processes through automation, predictive analytics or AI-enabled insight.

· People leadership, coaching or team development experience.

**Capabilities and behaviours**

· Commercial judgement: balances value, affordability, risk and delivery realities.

· Analytical rigour: works confidently with detail while identifying the few insights that matter.

· Constructive challenge: tests assumptions objectively and is willing to make clear recommendations.

· Influence and communication: builds credibility across finance and non-finance audiences, including senior leaders.

· Ownership and pace: operates independently, prioritizes effectively and follows through on commitments.

· Collaboration and inclusion: works across organizational boundaries and values diverse perspectives.

· Integrity and control mindset: protects data quality, confidentiality and financial discipline.

· Learning agility: quickly understands new technologies, commercial models and business contexts.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**About Simplismart**

Simplismart is a GenAI inference platform to deploy, scale, and monitor any GenAI model (LLMs, speech, vision, or diffusion) across cloud or on-prem. Built for strict SLAs, enterprise-grade security, and full observability. Its modular design lets you optimize for cost or latency or auto-select the best topology per workload.

**About the role-**

You will own the finance function at Simplismart, covering everything from monthly payment runs and financial reporting to consolidated financials across our India parent and US subsidiary.

This is a hands-on role combining financial control, compliance, treasury, and strategic decision support. You will work closely with the founders and business teams to manage cross-border financial operations, build financial models, and understand the economics of GPU infrastructure, cloud costs, customer commitments, and business growth.

**What is expected from you-**

* Financial Close & Reporting: Own monthly closing, MIS, consolidated reporting, intercompany reconciliations, foreign exchange translation, and annual statutory audits across India and the US. Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
* Revenue Recognition: Establish and manage revenue recognition for consumption-based and committed contracts, including prepaid credits, deferred and unbilled revenue, overages, and multi-year commitments.
* AI Compute Economics: Build financial models for GPU and cloud infrastructure covering capacity, utilisation, pricing, costs, gross margins, payback periods, and cash requirements.
* Financial Planning & Analysis:Own annual operating plans, rolling forecasts, integrated financial models, and scenario planning. Translate infrastructure commitments, demand changes, and pricing decisions into profitability and cash-flow implications.
* Treasury & Working Capital: Manage accounts receivable, collections, DSO, accounts payable, vendor terms, payment calendars, banking relationships, multi-currency accounts, cash management, and working capital.
* Foreign Exchange Management: Track USD inflows against USD cloud and GPU costs, assess natural hedges, manage residual FX exposure, and establish a documented FX management policy.
* Cross-border Finance: Design and manage invoicing and payment flows between India and US entities, including entity-level contracting, withholding tax, tax treaty positions, and remittance documentation.
* Tax & Statutory Compliance: Own India compliance covering GST, LUT, TDS, advance tax, ROC/MCA filings, transfer pricing, FEMA, and RBI reporting. Manage US federal and state taxes, sales tax, franchise tax, and payroll compliance.
* Audit, Fundraising & Investor Reporting: Lead finance due diligence, maintain the data room, prepare investor and board reporting packs, manage financial schedules and reconciliations, and respond directly to diligence queries.
* Controls & Systems: Establish financial controls, approval workflows, delegation of authority, payment authorisation protocols, vendor onboarding checks, and segregation of duties.
* Unit Economics & Cost Attribution: Build visibility into GPU-level, workload-level, and customer-level economics. Track infrastructure utilisation, provider costs, gross margins, and profitability across customers and deployment models.
* Infrastructure Investment Decisions: Support management in evaluating whether to buy, reserve, lease, or commit to GPU capacity based on expected demand, utilisation, returns, and cash-flow requirements.
* External Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with auditors, chartered accountants, tax advisors, banks, and other financial partners to ensure accurate reporting and timely compliance.

**What We're Looking For-**

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, controllership, or a similar role.
* CA or MBA in Finance preferred; CS qualification is an added advantage.
* Experience in a startup or technology/SaaS company, preferably in a multi-entity environment.
* Strong understanding of Indian accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, and cross-border transactions.
* Working knowledge of US accounting, taxation, and compliance requirements.
* Hands-on experience with monthly financial close, audits, MIS, accounts receivable/payable, treasury, and working capital management.
* Familiarity with revenue recognition for SaaS and consumption-based business models.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, FEMA, RBI regulations, transfer pricing, and international taxation.
* Strong financial modelling, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to build finance processes and controls from the ground up and work independently.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work directly with founders, investors, auditors, banks, and advisors.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.

**Good to have-**

* Experience with GPU infrastructure, cloud computing, data centres, or infrastructure-heavy business models.
* Understanding of capacity utilisation, infrastructure commitments, unit economics, and gross margin analysis.
* Experience with multi-currency treasury, FX exposure management, and cross-border payment structures.
* Experience supporting fundraising, investor reporting, and financial due diligence.
* Familiarity with financial automation, reporting tools, and scalable finance systems.

**Why Join Simplismart?**

* Opportunity to define and lead the brand identity of a fast-growing GenAI company.
* Work closely with leadership on high-impact initiatives from global event campaigns to overall storytelling.
* Be part of a team that values design as a strategic lever, not just execution.
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunities in a high-energy startup environment.

title: Assistant Manager Accounts
description:
**Company Description:**
Poetry Designs, founded in 2020, specializes in architectural and sustainable construction services for clients seeking environmentally conscious homes in and around urban and rural Bengaluru. The company focuses on sustainable materials and climate-responsive construction methods to create meaningful, functional living spaces. Poetry Designs offers integrated architecture and construction solutions to simplify project management, coordination, and communication for clients. With decades of collective experience, the team provides end-to-end services under one roof, improving design quality, planning, execution, and coordination while helping clients reduce their carbon footprint. The company is committed to building future-ready homes inspired by proven practices from the past.

**Location**
: Whitefield, Bengaluru

**Role Description:**
The Assistant Manager Accounts will oversee day-to-day financial operations, including managing accounts payable and receivable, maintaining ledgers, vendor payments and ensuring timely invoicing and collections. The role involves preparing and reviewing financial statements, assisting with budgeting and forecasting, and supporting internal and external audits. The Assistant Manager Accounts will monitor cash flow, reconcile bank statements, and ensure compliance with accounting standards, GST & TDS regulations, and company policies. This position will also collaborate with project and operations teams to track project costs, support financial reporting, and provide data for management decision-making. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru. You will be the single point of contact with the company Auditors for GST, TDS, Professional tax and other company related compliances.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 3-4 years for accounting experience preferably in the construction/interior industry.
* Candidates should possess strong accounting and bookkeeping skills, including experience with ledgers, journal entries, and reconciliation.
* Candidates should possess skills in financial reporting and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, and preparing management reports.
* Candidates should be experience in ZOHO Books and Payroll.
* Candidates should possess proficiency with accounting software and spreadsheets, and be comfortable working with MS Excel and financial tools.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of GST, Income Tax, compliance, and regulatory requirements relevant to construction or real estate sectors.
* Candidates should possess strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to maintain organized financial records.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
* A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field is preferred; professional certifications (e.g., CA Inter, CPA, CMA) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in accounts roles within construction, architecture, or project-based businesses will be beneficial.

title: Senior Fund Administrator - Financial Reporting
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Senior Fund Administrator – Financial Reporting.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* The traditional Accounting & Valuations team has daily, monthly and weekly Net Asset Value valuations with stringent timelines. The team is responsible for performing capital activity bookings, accruals, amortization, yields leading to final generation and validation of Net Asset Value through diagnostic checks, Financial Mainframe Report and post Net Asset Value activities. The team also performs other Monthly & Reporting activities which includes Fee Reviews. Ex Dividend Distribution, Trustee Packs and Queries, Regulatory & Client Reporting. The Accounting & Valuations team is responsible functionally across multiple jurisdictions (where applicable) serviced out of Markets and Securities Services Bangalore.
* The role will be of individual contributor nature and will not have team reporting to the role. Responsible for core processing/reviewing activities and will require strong technical knowledge to achieve target deliverables. The role will demand a daily balance of delivering an excellent client service within the standard Net Asset Value model of promoting continuous improvement of Net Asset Value processes and of identifying and capitalizing opportunities to create capacity and generate efficiencies. The role would also require the individual to ensure that process and procedures are continually reviewed and improved, and the changes are communicated and implemented effectively. The job also entails checking on internal control and measures undertaken and regularly reviews them to maintain quality and productivity at the optimum level. Perform any additional responsibilities that may be required by the manager in support of specific projects, on-going management and development of the process.
* Actively participate in the deployment of defined business solutions to remove manual processes. Proactively identify and reduce manual processes for enhanced operational control while also supporting and implementing technology upgradation. Lead User Acceptance Testing for the business (as and when required).
* Primary responsibility of preparing Net Asset Value packs and performing checker activities. Proactively identify and resolve problem situations to give maximum customer satisfaction and escalated where necessary and undertake appropriate measures to improve quality and prevent recurrence. Establish and maintain effective relationship with customer business areas and identify areas of service improvements. Act as a key escalation point in resolving issues with the Business Partner on a timely & ongoing basis. Ensure packs are delivered with quality and within set deadlines with an additional focus on priority clients and strategic approach on valuations should be done keeping the priority clients in mind.
* Procedural changes/new initiatives are reviewed, agreed with the business areas, fully communicated to staff and implemented. To share process related best practices with the team. Initiatives to demonstrate the application of principles in the day-to-day work environment Participation and support provided to initiatives taken by other teams. Perform any additional responsibilities that may be required by the Supervisor in support of the on-going management and development of the division
* Be involved in the project / support related activities as and when it arises. Undertake/conduct training/cross training for all staff including existing and new staffs. Being proactive in identifying root cause for process related challenges and share qualitative resolution. Be flexible to adopt in different working environment with counterparts across the globe.
* Maintains HSBC internal control standards, overseeing the timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators. Proactively be aware of the Operational Risk scenario associated with the role and ensure that all actions during your employment with HSBC take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring. Ensure escalation process is in place and is effective. Ensure Gross Asset Value / Net Asset Value operating procedure is followed with management of risks (if any).
* Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures. Additional review of Job-Aid Matrix, Standard Operating Procedures, process notes, checklists and other internal process related documents periodically. Undertake any additional responsibilities that may be required by the manager in support of specific projects, on-going management and development of the process. Undertake the fund’s activities correctly as per the Standard Operating Procedures. Ensure timely and accurate publishing of Management Reports / Reports. Ensure completion of all mandatory training on time.

**To Be Successful, You Will**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce or qualifications related to accounting / finance industry or relevant experience.
* 3-6 years of relevant Funds administration experience. Detailed understanding of single sub-process, control points, end to end process risk. Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting.
* Decent knowledge in Accounting & Valuations process with clear understanding of the end-to-end Fund Accounting Model. Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds, Corporate Actions, Financial Instruments and reconciliations.
* Ability to speak and understand English. Excellent Team Management skills with ability to handle personnel issues and strong team bonding. Efficient Time Management and ability to multitask work and priorities to meet defined deadlines. Proactive in implementing and driving solutions. Ability to build excellent rapport and working relationships with other departments and jurisdiction thus ensuring smooth operations.
* Strong working knowledge on Microsoft Office. Will be expected to maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, together with any issues raised by external regulators.
* Must be aware of the operational risk scenarios associated with this role and act upon pertinent risk (if any). Should have demonstrated behavior in line with HSBC values throughout.
* Additional qualifications related to financial industry will be given preference. Knowledge of Derivatives Instruments. Earlier experience in custody / brokerage / funds services / depository industry.
* Detailed understanding of end-to-end product and process, multiple market and regulations pertaining to the fund services industry. Working knowledge of Bloomberg / Reuters, other reconciliation and accounting applications used across industry Life cycle of Net Asset Value process.

title: Operations Early Career Entry Program
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****
Our
**Operations Early Career Entry Program is**
designed to develop graduates both technically and professionally towards becoming our future leaders. You’ll learn from some of the most respected highly qualified people in the industry and be supported by individual mentors and development programs.. From day one you will be exploring collaborative and dynamic environment company culture, and you will receive:
  
  

* A structured learning and development program, specific job-related trainings, professional

development and soft skills trainings.
  
  

* A buddy who can offer you their experience, knowledge and guidance throughout your internship.
* Dedicated networking events for the Interns.
* Leadership and business-related sessions with Senior Management.
* Possibility to grow your professional network by joining an Employee Committees include Professional PWN, Families Network, Disability & Inclusion Network, Pride & Friends Network, Environmental Sustainability Network.

**Internship dates**
: January 2027 – July 2027
  
  
You must be available to participate in the program in person, starting from day one and for its full duration and
**you are required to work from the office 5 days a week.**
**Why this role is important to us**
Our Global Delivery Function helps our clients achieve better investment outcomes by serving as the foundation of our organization. We perform all operational functions required to produce the back and middle office products and services that clients have contracted with State Street to provide. Our services include custody, accounting, fund administration, transfer agency, middle office and cash processing services for asset managers, asset owners, alternative investors and insurance companies across the full range of asset classes.
  
  
****What You Will Be Responsible For:****
Participants or Program Participants you will be part of any one of the below department State Street is catering:
  
  
**Fund Accountant**
The Fund Accountant is responsible for calculating the net asset values of funds by processing daily accounting related functions to ensure funds prices are accurate and delivered to the client in a timely fashion. The Fund Accountant is the central point of contact for all accounting support functions and analyzes the information received thereby ensuring any discrepancy is monitored and resolved professionally.
  
  
**Financial Reporting Specialist**
The Financial Reporting Accountant is responsible for preparing financial statements for annual and interim cycle. They also prepare and complete first draft of audited annual and un-audited interim financial statements from trial balance including Profit and Loss Account Balance Sheet Cash Flow Schedule of Investments notes to financial statements.
  
  
**Derivatives Specialist**
The team deals with the complex futures and options processing for the entire European exchange traded derivatives, Centre of Excellence book of business and supplementary business offshored from other State Street sites. The Derivatives Group is the central point of contact for the clearing banks and client service teams on all sites. Other services include some cash instructions and the improvement of processes for recording derivative instruments accurately and efficiently.
  
  
**Financial Accountant**
Financial Accountant performs the accounting processes that may include [but is not limited to]: accounting documents processing, journal processing, payments preparation, account reconciliation preparation and verification of the reports performing other projects as assigned etc.
  
  
**Treasury Accountant**
Treasury Accountant performs the treasury processes that may include [but is not limited to]: treasury transactions processing (money market stock market), prepare/approve payments, collateral management/margins, monitor minimum required reserve in national central bank, reconciliation bank accounts (cash positions balance sheet) reports, performing other projects as assigned etc.
  
  
**Transfer Agency Administrator**
Transfer Agency Administrator is responsible for trade processing, investor account maintenance, issue reporting and resolution. You will be responsible for processing investor transaction: review documentation to ensure anti-money laundering documentation has been received and enter subscription on ISS and save documentation on to DMS.
  
  
**Middle Office Administrator**
Middle Office Administrator is responsible for processing trade file submitted by the Fund daily on trade-date, trade-date confirmation (electronic telephonic or hard copy) based upon the trade file transmitted by the Fund and trade details provided by the Fund’s approved counter parties and monitor trade fails with prime brokers counter parties and the Fund including review of prime broker/custodian fail or mismatch of reports.
  
  
**Pricing Administrator**
Pricing Administrator’s role is to assist in the accurate and efficient pricing of a range of securities held by investment funds. The principal tasks of this role is to price exchange traded securities and validation to sources such as Bloomberg Reuters and FTID.
  
  
**Risk Analyst**
The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) division within State Street Corporation establishes and maintains appropriate risk management policies guidelines and limits and assists executive and business-level management with minimizing operational credit legal regulatory reputation and other risks to the company.
  
  
**Compliance Analyst**
Investment Compliance Analyst will be responsible for monitoring compliance results on client portfolios related to Regulatory and Investment Manager (IM) mandates. Utilizing State Street’s Investment Compliance & Reporting platform the qualified candidate will complete the research analysis and reporting to ensure portfolios are in compliance with their investment restrictions.
  
  
**Data Management Analyst**
The Data Analyst(s) will be responsible to work comprehensively with both IT and the Investment Compliance/Market, Conformity Business Units to procure data necessary for daily compliance and conformity checks. Furthermore the Data Analyst will be responsible for the update and maintenance of market data, static data and holdings data that is not otherwise fed to the core application MIG 21 via automated data feeds.
  
  
**Anti-Money Laundering Specialist**
Anti-Money Laundering Specialist will be involved in reviewing investor Anti Money Laundering documentation in line with the AML policies and liaising with the Transfer Agency team’s in order to request and obtain the required data from the investors and/or clients.
  
  
****What We Value****
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Combination of academic aptitude, analytical capabilities, and excellent communication.
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving and decision-making skills.
* Display a culture of individual ownership of tasks to embed a clear individual sense of accountability in performing the role.
* Ensure that the highest level of the Code of Conduct is displayed in your behavior.
* Support the ‘Risk Excellence’ culture within the business.
* Adhere to limits of delegation and escalation procedures required by your manager so that you comply with internal policies and external regulations.
* Desire to develop Your career in finance industry.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Basic knowledge in MS Office.

****Education & Preferred Qualifications****

* Final Year Students Enrolled in full time education at undergraduates in the penultimate year of degree in one of the following areas: Finance, Accounting, or Economics are preferred; applicants from other disciplines may also apply.
* Enthusiastic about building a long-term career in a dynamic organization.
* Effective communicators with the ability to collaborate in a team-oriented environment.
* Open to feedback and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Motivated by real-world problem solving and eager to contribute innovative ideas.

****About State Street****
**What we do.**
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance, and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
  
  
**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.**
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

Works closely with cross-functional stakeholders, auditors, and finance teams to resolve accounting issues, improve reporting effectiveness, and support timely financial close processes.The position exercise professional judgment in interpreting accounting guidance, resolving moderately complex issues, and ensuring compliance with internal and external reporting requirements.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
Financial Reporting & Closing Activities
  
  

* Coordinate and support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.
* Prepare and review financial statements, disclosures, supporting schedules, and reporting packages in accordance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
* Analyze financial results and significant account movements to identify exceptions, risks, and reporting implications.

Accounting & Technical Expertise
  
  

* Apply professional accounting judgment in assessing complex transactions and ensuring appropriate accounting treatment under applicable accounting frameworks.
* Evaluate accounting implications arising from commercial agreements, contractual arrangements, and business transactions.

Reconciliation & Financial Control
  
  

* Oversee balance sheet reconciliations and identify aged or unusual items requiring investigation and resolution.

* Partner with business stakeholders to resolve outstanding items impacting financial reporting accuracy and close timelines.

Audit & Compliance Management
  
  

* Serve as a primary finance contact for statutory, internal, and external audit activities within assigned areas.
* Coordinate preparation of audit schedules, supporting documentation, and responses to auditor queries.
* Support the maintenance of a strong internal control environment and compliance with SOX requirements and company policies.

Stakeholder Partnership & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Collaborate with business functions to obtain critical financial information, improve reporting quality, and facilitate timely completion of accounting activities.
* Provide insights and recommendations on financial data, accounting treatment, and reporting requirements to support operational decision-making.
* Build effective working relationships across departments to ensure smooth execution of finance processes and reporting obligations.
* Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting efficiency, control effectiveness, and quality of financial information.
* Contribute to standardization, automation, and process enhancement initiatives within the finance function.
* Support implementation of best practices that enhance operational effectiveness and reporting accuracy.

Education

* Experience managing financial reporting, statutory audits, internal controls, and compliance-related activities.
* Exposure to US GAAP, lease accounting, and multinational reporting environments preferred.

Skills/Certifications
  
  

* Strong knowledge of Indian GAAP, Companies Act requirements, and financial reporting practices.
* Working knowledge of US GAAP and multinational reporting environments.
* Sound understanding of accounting controls, compliance requirements, and audit processes.
* Ability to interpret accounting standards and assess accounting implications of business transactions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Effective stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: Manager, Forecasting
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**The Future Begins Here:**
At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
  
  
Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
  
  
**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity:**
Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
  
  
**OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE:**
We are seeking a dynamic Manager to join Takeda's GCC Commercial Analytics & Insights (CA&I) organization in India as part of the Forecasting capability supporting International Business Units (IBU). This people leadership role combines hands-on forecasting expertise with team management, stakeholder partnership, and operational accountability for forecasting workstreams that support brand planning, launch readiness, scenario planning, S&OP, and long-range planning across Ex-US markets and multiple disease areas. The Manager is accountable for the quality, timeliness, and business relevance of forecasting deliverables produced by their pod.
  
  
**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
**Forecast Delivery and Quality Ownership:**

* Oversee end-to-end delivery of assigned forecasting deliverables, including short-term and long-term demand forecasts, in-line and launch forecasts, patient-based (prevalence, disease-progression) and demand-based models, scenario and sensitivity analyses, assumption updates, and forecast accuracy reporting across IBU markets and disease areas.
* Define forecasting approaches for complex planning questions by translating stakeholder asks into scoped workplans and assigning tasks based on skill, priority, and capacity.
* Review forecast models, assumptions, outputs, dashboards, and presentation materials for analytical rigor, internal consistency, narrative quality, and stakeholder readiness before distribution to affiliate and global stakeholders.
* Conduct and oversee analyses of commercial performance, patient dynamics, market events, epidemiology inputs, payer dynamics, and competitive trends across EU, Asia, and LatAm to inform forecasting assumptions and scenarios.

**Stakeholder Management and Ways of Working:**

* Serve as the primary GCC point of contact for assigned EU, Asian, and LatAm affiliates and Global IBU stakeholders, clarifying requirements, setting delivery commitments, communicating risks, and ensuring alignment to brand planning, S&OP, and long-range planning cycles.
* Represent the GCC Forecasting pod in brand planning, forecast review, S&OP, LRP, and cross-functional forums with commercial analytics, finance, marketing, market access, and global partners.
* Establish efficient ways of working between the GCC pod and IBU affiliate teams, including intake routines, version control, assumption documentation, forecast calendar management, and quality review expectations across multiple geographies and time zones.

**People Leadership and Team Development:**

* Directly manage 3-4 Analysts and Senior Analysts across forecasting sub-capabilities, setting clear goals, conducting regular one-on-ones, providing performance feedback, and building individualized development plans.
* Build forecasting capabilities within the team through coaching on model design, methodology selection, assumption management, scenario planning, forecast accuracy measurement, and business storytelling.
* Foster a high-engagement team environment defined by ownership, intellectual curiosity, cross-functional collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Contribute to talent acquisition and onboarding for the GCC IBU analytics team, helping establish consistent expectations and development pathways for forecasting talent.

**Process Improvement and Operational Excellence:**

* Lead automation and efficiency initiatives across recurring forecasting workflows, applying AI and GenAI tools to accelerate assumption research, deviation reasoning, narrative generation, and model documentation.
* Review and rationalize the forecast reporting and model asset portfolio on a regular basis, identifying opportunities to standardize, automate, or enhance deliverables as IBU priorities evolve.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience:**
**Education:**

* Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Advanced degree (Master's or MBA) in Analytics, Economics, Data Science, Business, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred.
* Relevant certifications in forecasting, analytics, cloud platforms, or statistical methods are a plus.

**Experience:**

* 6-8 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical forecasting with early people or project leadership experience.
* Hands-on forecasting experience across the full range of forecast types - including prevalence and disease-progression (patient-based) models and demand-based models, across short-term and long-term, in-line and launch horizons, including scenario planning and forecast accuracy measurement.
* Experience across different geographies and multiple disease / therapeutic areas is required, with mandatory experience supporting EU markets (e.g., EU4, UK, Nordics, or other European affiliates); exposure to Asian and Latin American markets is a strong plus.
* Experience directly managing at least 3-4 people (analysts and/or senior analysts) is required.
* Deep knowledge of pharmaceutical forecasting methods, demand drivers, patient flow approaches, launch planning, scenario planning, assumption management, and forecast accuracy measurement in Ex-US environments.
* Working knowledge of pharma data assets such as IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, prescription and claims data, and epidemiology sources for Ex-US markets.
* Familiarity with statistical and machine learning forecasting techniques - including time-series methods (ARIMA, exponential smoothing, regression, Prophet) and patient-based modelling - sufficient to direct methodology selection, review model outputs, and identify technical risks across the team's work.
* Advanced Excel skills required.
* Experience with agile business planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, SAP IBP) for forecasting and planning is a strong plus.
* Strong experience with Tableau or Power BI for forecast tracking, scenario reporting, and commercial performance dashboard development.
* Proficiency in coding techniques such as SAS, R, or Python for data manipulation, analysis, and workflow automation is a nice to have, not a mandatory requirement.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* **People Leadership –:**
  Motivates, develops, and retains a team of analysts; sets clear direction, provides growth-oriented feedback, and holds the team to high delivery standards.
* **Forecasting Project Management –:**
  Manages multiple forecast cycles and scenarios with rigorous prioritization, quality control, version discipline, and timeline adherence.
* **Pharmaceutical Forecasting Expertise –:**
  Deep proficiency in demand forecasting, patient-based models, scenario planning, assumption management, and accuracy measurement for commercial decisions in Ex-US markets.
* **Methodology Breadth –:**
  Directs the selection and application of patient-based (prevalence, disease-progression), demand-based, and hybrid approaches across geographies and disease areas.
* **Stakeholder Partnership –:**
  Builds trusted, productive relationships with EU, Asia, LatAm, and Global commercial analytics, finance, marketing, market access, and portfolio planning partners across multiple affiliates.
* **Data Storytelling –:**
  Distils forecast outputs, assumptions, risks, and scenarios into clear narratives with practical business implications and decision points.
* **Operational Excellence –:**
  Identifies and implements opportunities to automate, standardize, and scale forecasting workflows using modern tools and practices.
* **Cross-Cultural Communication –:**
  Fluent communicator across India-EU-Asia-LatAm time zones and organizational levels; adapts style for technical and commercial audiences.

**TAKEDA LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS:**
In alignment with Takeda’s Values-Based Culture, this role requires demonstration of the following leadership behaviors
  
  

* Act with Integrity — Deliver accurate, transparent work and take full responsibility for quality.
* Collaborate Cross-Functionally — Contribute positively to GCC-IBU team workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
* Drive Accountability — Take ownership of all assigned tasks and deliver on commitments.
* Embrace Learning — Continuously build analytical and domain capabilities through feedback and self-driven development.

**BENEFITS:**
It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are
  
  

* Competitive Salary + Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working

* As an organization, we are committed to our cloud-driven business transformation and believe the ICCs are the catalysts of change for our global organization.
