title: ASSISTANT GENERAL MANAGER – OPERATIONS
description:
**Soho House Mumbai | Juhu, Mumbai**
**Department:**
Operations
  
  
**Reports to:**
General Manager
  
  
**Dotted-line reporting:**
Regional Director
  
  
**About Soho House Mumbai**
Soho House Mumbai is a private members' club bringing together a diverse community of creative people through hospitality, culture, food and drink, wellness and memorable experiences. With accommodation, restaurants, bars, member spaces, events, a cinema, gym and swimming pool, the House operates across multiple business areas, requiring a leader who understands the connection between operational excellence, commercial performance and member engagement.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are looking for an energetic, commercially minded and people-focused Assistant General Manager to partner with the General Manager in driving the overall performance of Soho House Mumbai.
  
  
The candidate may come from a strong
**Food & Beverage or Rooms background**
, but must demonstrate the ability to lead beyond their specialist discipline, work collaboratively with diverse operational leaders and understand the business as a whole.
  
  
This is an opportunity for a hands-on hospitality leader who knows Mumbai's market, builds meaningful relationships across its diverse social and business communities, identifies opportunities for revenue growth and develops teams that consistently deliver exceptional experiences.
  
  
People management and development are fundamental to success in this role. We want a leader who brings energy, enthusiasm, accountability and a genuine drive to deliver measurable business results.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Business Leadership & Commercial Performance
* Partner with the General Manager to deliver the House's annual business plan, revenue objectives, EBITDA targets and operational priorities.
* Understand the financial performance of individual business areas and the wider operation, identifying opportunities to grow revenue, optimise costs and improve profitability.
* Review daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly business performance, translating data and trends into actionable plans.
* Identify new opportunities across membership, food and beverage, accommodation, private hire, events and other revenue-generating areas.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity and emerging hospitality and lifestyle concepts across Mumbai.
* Ensure that operational initiatives are delivered within agreed budgets and timelines, with measurable outcomes.
* Operational Excellence
* Provide visible, hands-on leadership across front-of-house and back-of-house operations, ensuring consistent service standards and effective problem-solving.
* Work closely with the House Manager and other operational leaders to ensure seamless coordination across the House.
* Understand the guest and member journey across accommodation, food and beverage, member spaces, events, facilities and other services.
* Establish clear accountability, follow up on operational priorities and drive continuous improvement.
* Support leaders in maintaining service standards, operational readiness and effective communication between departments.
* Be comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, multifaceted environment while balancing immediate operational requirements with long-term business priorities.
* Membership, Relationships & Mumbai Market Connectivity
* Develop a strong understanding of Soho House's membership proposition and the needs of its diverse member community.
* Build authentic relationships across Mumbai's hospitality, creative, cultural, entertainment and business communities.
* Work with Membership, Member Relations, Marketing, PR, Private Hire and Events & Programming to strengthen engagement and identify commercial opportunities.
* Support initiatives that improve member satisfaction, loyalty, retention and the overall relevance of the House within Mumbai's lifestyle landscape.
* Bring market insight, social awareness and an entrepreneurial mindset to business development and relationship-building opportunities.
* People Leadership & Development
* Build, coach and develop a strong team of operational leaders, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and shared success.
* Work closely with People & Development, Recruitment and Learning & Development to strengthen talent pipelines, succession planning, leadership capability and employee engagement.
* Set clear expectations and performance objectives for direct reports, conducting regular reviews and following through on development plans.
* Identify high-potential talent and create opportunities for internal progression and cross-functional development.
* Drive employee retention by building an inclusive, supportive and high-performance working environment.
* Lead by example, demonstrating the Soho House values through everyday decisions, behaviours and interactions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work collaboratively with Finance, People & Development, Recruitment, Learning & Development, Membership, F&B, Rooms, Marketing, PR, Events & Programming, Housekeeping, Engineering, IT and Facilities.
* Build strong working relationships with support-office and regional teams to implement business priorities, global standards and operational initiatives.
* Share information effectively, resolve interdepartmental challenges and ensure that all teams work towards common business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, use technology effectively and introduce innovative ways of working.
* Health, Safety & Compliance
* Ensure adherence to company policies, food safety standards, allergy procedures, security protocols and health and safety requirements.
* Maintain readiness for internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of identified actions.
* Work with Engineering, Security, Facilities and relevant leaders to maintain a safe, compliant and welcoming environment.
* Ensure applicable local authority requirements and statutory obligations are met.

Direct Reports
  
  

* House Manager
* Engineering
* IT
* Private Hire Manager
* Member Relations
* Security

The role requires close collaboration with all other operational and support-function leaders across the House.
  
  
Position Profile
  
  
**Experience And Background**

* Strong management experience in a high-profile hotel, lifestyle hospitality business, premium restaurant group or private members' club.
* Candidates from either F&B or Rooms will be considered, provided they can demonstrate the ability to lead across multiple operational functions.
* Sound understanding of hospitality business operations, commercial performance, revenue optimisation, budgets and EBITDA.
* A strong understanding of Mumbai's hospitality landscape and an ability to build meaningful relationships across diverse industries and communities.
* Demonstrated experience in managing, engaging and developing teams.
* Experience working within complex, fast-paced operations with high service expectations.
* International hospitality experience or exposure to global service standards would be advantageous.

**Leadership attributes**

* Energetic, enthusiastic and proactive, with a strong bias for action and results.
* Commercially astute, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities.
* A hands-on leader who can influence, coach and collaborate with experienced department heads.
* Strong interpersonal, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Highly organised, detail-oriented and dependable.
* Comfortable working across diverse cultures, teams and business functions.
* Passionate about hospitality, service, member engagement and people development.
* Proficient in relevant operational systems; experience with Opera, Micros or equivalent platforms is advantageous.

Measures of Success
  
  
Performance will be assessed against agreed business targets and leadership objectives, including:
  
  

* Service Excellence: Mystery shopper Service Scan scores and consistent delivery of Soho House standards.
* Financial Performance: Achievement of annual and quarterly EBITDA targets, revenue objectives and cost-control measures.
* Member Retention: Achievement of agreed membership retention targets and improvement in member experience.
* Team Retention: Achievement of staff retention targets, engagement and development objectives.
* Health & Safety: Successful completion of Health & Safety audits, compliance with standards and timely closure of corrective actions.
* Operational Performance: Effective execution of business improvement plans, operational priorities and cross-functional initiatives.
* People Development: Strength of succession planning, internal progression, leadership capability and team performance.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
A successful Assistant General Manager will be a trusted business partner to the General Manager and a credible leader to the wider operational team. They will connect commercial thinking with exceptional hospitality, develop leaders who take ownership of their departments, strengthen member and team retention, and ensure that the House continues to deliver outstanding experiences while achieving its financial objectives.

title: Store Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced
**Store Manager**
with strong exposure to the
**hospitality industry**
, particularly
**hotels, restaurants, banquet operations, resorts, and large-scale F&B establishments**
.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete store operations, including receiving, inspection, storage, inventory control, stock issuance, documentation, wastage control, and coordination with Purchase, Kitchen, F&B, Accounts, and other departments.
  
  
Key ResponsibilitiesStore Operations
  
  

* Manage day-to-day operations of the hotel/restaurant/banquet stores.
* Handle receiving, checking, storing, and issuing of food, beverages, non-food items, housekeeping supplies, kitchen consumables, and other materials.
* Ensure all incoming materials are checked against purchase orders, invoices, quantity, quality, and specifications.
* Maintain proper storage conditions for food, beverages, chemicals, crockery, cutlery, linen, and other materials.
* Ensure proper labeling, stacking, categorization, and organization of all stock.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable.
* Ensure temperature-controlled storage requirements are maintained for perishable items.
* Monitor expiry dates and prevent wastage or stock deterioration.

Inventory Management
  
  

* Maintain accurate inventory records for all store items.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and periodic inventory audits.
* Reconcile physical stock with system records and investigate discrepancies.
* Monitor minimum and maximum stock levels and initiate replenishment requirements.
* Track consumption patterns and identify slow-moving, fast-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory.
* Monitor food and beverage stock consumption and wastage.
* Maintain proper records of stock transfers between stores, kitchens, restaurants, and banquet operations.

Hospitality & F&B Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate closely with Executive Chef, Kitchen, F&B, Banquet, Restaurant, Housekeeping, Purchase, and Accounts teams.
* Ensure timely availability of materials required for daily hotel and restaurant operations.
* Coordinate with banquet and events teams for special functions, weddings, conferences, and large events.
* Ensure adequate stock availability before major events and banquet functions.
* Handle urgent material requirements during peak operations.

Purchase & Vendor Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate with the Purchase Department regarding stock requirements and replenishment.
* Assist in evaluating received materials against approved specifications.
* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers regarding shortages, damages, replacements, and quality issues.
* Maintain proper documentation for goods received and returned.
* Support management in identifying opportunities for cost control and efficient procurement.

Cost & Wastage Control
  
  

* Monitor stock consumption and identify unusual variances.
* Control wastage, damage, expiry, and unnecessary stock accumulation.
* Maintain proper records of breakage, wastage, returns, and adjustments.
* Support management in controlling food and operational costs.
* Ensure proper authorization for stock issues and transfers.

Documentation & Reporting
  
  

* Maintain GRN, stock issue, stock transfer, return, and adjustment records.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory/MIS reports.
* Maintain stock registers and system records accurately.
* Provide inventory reports to management, Accounts, Purchase, and F&B teams.
* Assist during internal and external inventory audits.
* Ensure all store documentation is complete and properly maintained.

title: Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence
description:
**Head of Retail Audit & Operational Excellence**

* **The Opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're building the world's most admired tattoo company.

With 16+ premium studios, a team of 160+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become a global lifestyle brand, we believe great businesses are built by great leaders.

We're not looking for managers who simply maintain operations.

We're looking for leaders who build businesses, develop people, obsess over customer experience, and think like owners.

If you thrive in high-performance environments, love solving complex business challenges, and enjoy leading teams to extraordinary results, we'd love to meet you.

As a Cluster Manager, you will be the CEO of your region.

* **The Mandate**

You will own quality across the entire studio network end to end — compliance with how a studio is meant to run, the customer experience it delivers, the physical readiness of the floor, and the integrity of every rupee that passes through it. You'll design the audit system itself — what gets checked, how often, through what method — and build and run the team that executes it. You'll report to the Director of Operations AT, with the standing to raise what you find directly and have it acted on.

* **What you'll be doing**

Checking every studio against its own standard — how it opens, how it closes, the process it's supposed to run — through visits that are sometimes announced and sometimes not, in person and on camera, so what you see is what's actually happening, not what's being reported.

Following through on what you find. A gap logged and forgotten is worse than no audit at all — you'll drive every finding to a real fix, and when the same issue shows up in more than one studio, you'll catch that it's not five separate problems but one system that needs to change.

Defining what a great customer experience looks like in an Aliens studio, and checking every visit against it — real visits and unannounced ones — so the standard is more than a document nobody's held to.

Owning the physical readiness of every studio — hygiene, safety, the equipment a session actually depends on — and catching what's broken before a customer does.

Protecting the integrity of what happens at the till. Every rupee collected reaches the business, every invoice gets raised, every number in the system can be trusted — and when it can't, you're the one who catches it and escalates it.

Building the entire audit system from nothing — the calendar, the criteria, the dashboards that make every studio's status visible without anyone needing to ask — designed to keep running whether or not you're the one checking that day.

Hiring and growing the team that makes all of this real at network scale — holding the bar on every seat, and coaching the kind of discipline that makes an audit actually mean something.

* **What we're looking for**

You've done this before — run quality or audit work across multiple locations.

You know that a standard which only holds where someone's watching isn't a standard at all.

Your eye for detail borders on the obsessive. You catch what other people walk past — the small drift that becomes the big failure six months later.

You think in systems, not incidents. You don't just find problems; you build the process that catches the next hundred before they happen.

You are exacting with numbers, especially where money and trust intersect. When a finding is inconvenient for someone — a studio manager, a high performer, someone senior — you report what you found, not what's comfortable.

Most people who are good at meticulous, detailed inspection work are not naturally the kind of person who can also design a system and build a team. This role needs both — the person who'll walk a studio floor at 7am checking a washroom, and the person who'll sit down and design the dashboard that makes a hundred studios' worth of that visible at once.

Bachelor's degree, with a track record in quality assurance, audit or operations across a multi-location retail, hospitality or service business. That's the baseline — what we're actually hiring is the judgment that comes from having done this at scale before.

* **What success looks like**

every studio in the network is audited on a published cadence, with nothing left unaccounted for. The compliance status of any studio is answerable in a moment, without needing to call and check. Cash and billing integrity is verified everywhere, and the leaks that used to go unnoticed get caught before they become losses.

The audit system runs as a system — not as you personally visiting every studio, but as a team you've built and trained, working to a standard you designed and can walk away from without it slipping.

* **Practical details**

Education: Bachelor's degree, any discipline

Preferred Industry - Retail Only

A quality or process-audit certification — Six Sigma, ISO auditing or equivalent - This is optional, However this is an added advantage

title: Partner Enablement Operations Manager
description:
FEQ327R583
  
  
The Partner Enablement Operations Manager is a senior operator and builder responsible for designing and running a scalable, predictable, and data-driven operating model for partner enablement at Databricks.
  
  
This role serves as the operational backbone and strategic integrator for partner enablement, connecting global strategy to regional execution across AMER, EMEA, and APJ regions while ensuring programs are delivered consistently, efficiently, and at scale.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong executive presence, systems thinking, and a bias for automation. They know how to reduce operational friction, build governance that scales, and introduce AI-enabled workflows that improve responsiveness without adding unnecessary complexity or headcount.
  
  
We are looking for A builder who can architect operating systems, drive cross-functional alignment, and convert recurring operational friction into structural improvement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the partner enablement operating model, including core planning cadences, governance mechanisms, and execution frameworks that connect strategy to execution.
* Run QBRs, MBRs, and executive reviews for partner enablement leadership, using clear metrics and forward-looking insights to drive accountability and decision-making.
* Lead end-to-end execution of partner enablement initiatives, ensuring timelines, dependencies, and deliverables are managed effectively across functions and regions.
* Build and maintain dashboards and operating reviews that surface partner engagement, program performance, risk signals, and areas requiring intervention.
* Act as a key point of contact for cross-regional operational issues and escalations, resolving immediate friction while converting recurring issues into structural improvements.
* Design and implement scalable workflows, SOPs, SLAs, and intake mechanisms that improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and create a better experience for internal stakeholders and partners.
* Introduce AI-enabled and automation-first workflows for intake, reporting, support, certification, and partner operations where they can safely improve speed, quality, and scale.
* Collaborate closely with the Partner organization, Learning and Enablement, Professional Services, and other cross-functional teams to remove friction and improve execution across the partner ecosystem.
* Partner closely with the broader operations business to drive cross-functional leverage of ideas and excellence, ensuring new methods and operational innovations are scaled beyond just partner operations.
* Establish clear ownership models, decision rights, and governance guardrails to support regional nuance without creating shadow processes or operational inconsistencies.
* Architect and maintain automated intake management workflows and SLA tracking mechanisms to optimize request processing and eliminate wait-time bottlenecks.
* Establish standardized metric definitions and executive reporting frameworks that pair activity and outcome indicators to ensure reporting integrity across cross-functional teams.

**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in Learning Operations, Program Management, Professional Services Operations, or a related operational leadership field in a high-growth technology environment.
* Proven experience supporting global or multi-region teams and translating central strategy into executable operating plans.
* Preferred experience in the Data & AI space, with a strong understanding of Databricks' platform capabilities, key differentiators, and end-to-end solutions, and the ability to work effectively with technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ownership of operating cadence, forecasting, planning, and execution frameworks in a complex, matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn data into executive insight, operational decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience improving processes and workflows, with a clear track record of reducing manual effort and increasing scale through automation or AI-enabled solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions without direct authority.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities across time zones, and drive execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Must be open to working a flexible schedule, including frequent late hours to accommodate discussions with the broader enablement team and partner liaisons, the majority of whom are based in the AMER timezone.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment and lead strategic delivery across matrixed global organizations.
* Experience designing and optimizing workflow automation, structured intake management, and operational reporting engines with strict metric definition discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in partner enablement, customer education, learning operations, or training operations.
* Deep expertise working with and for System Integrators (SIs) and ISVs, with a strong grasp of their core operational principles and business models.
* Fluency with AI tools, workflow automation, and analytics platforms used to streamline operations and generate actionable insights.
* Strong commercial and operational acumen, including comfort with utilization, forecasting, partner spend, margin thinking, or RevOps-aligned execution.
* Experience operating in a highly matrixed international environment with sensitivity to regional and cultural nuance.

**Why Join Us**
You will play a central role in shaping how partner enablement scales at Databricks.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role with meaningful impact, offering the opportunity to build a more efficient, governed, and AI-enabled operating model that helps our partner ecosystem grow with the business.
  
  
If you enjoy turning ambiguity into structure, building systems that remove friction, and helping teams scale through better operations rather than more manual work, this role is for you.
  
  
**Success Metrics**

* Operational Predictability: Build a disciplined partner enablement operating cadence where risks are surfaced early and execution is measurable and consistent.
* Stakeholder Experience and Self-Sufficiency: Increase the percentage of standard partner enablement requests handled through structured, low-touch, or self-service workflows.
* Escalation Management and Process Resilience: Reduce recurring operational friction by improving escalation handling, clarifying ownership, and improving systemic resolution of recurring issues.
* Scalable Execution: Improve throughput, consistency, and delivery quality across global partner enablement programs without relying on incremental manual work.
* AI-Enabled Transformation: Deploy practical AI-enabled workflows that improve speed, visibility, and efficiency across intake, reporting, support, and partner operations.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Manager – IT Operations
description:
**Job Summary**
As Manager – IT Operations, you will be responsible for the administration, security, governance, and operational excellence of the organization's enterprise IT ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Active Directory, Enterprise applications, Network infrastructure, Backup platforms, and Compliance controls. The role requires an L2/L3-level technology professional capable of managing business-critical systems while ensuring availability, security, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Identity & Access Management**

* Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Exchange Online, and Intune.
* Manage user and asset lifecycle, access governance, privileged access management (PAM), MFA, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust controls.
* Conduct periodic access reviews, entitlement audits, and privilege validation exercises.

**Enterprise Applications**

* Administer and support CRM, HRMS, Attendance, Service Desk, and other business applications.
* Manage configurations, workflows, integrations, user permissions, upgrades, and application security.
* Ensure application availability, performance, and continuous improvement.

**Information Security & Compliance**

* Implement and manage Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls and support DPDPA compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams on governance, risk mitigation, vulnerability remediation, audit readiness, VAPT closure, and incident response activities.
* Monitor compliance with organizational security standards and policies.

**Network, Infrastructure & Business Continuity**

* Oversee enterprise network operations including firewalls, routers, switches, VPNs, SD-WAN, wireless infrastructure, and internet connectivity.
* Manage backup, recovery, disaster recovery testing, business continuity planning, operational runbooks SOP, and recovery documentation.
* Support infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, and operational resilience initiatives.

**Governance & Vendor Management**

* Maintain operational dashboards, MIS, compliance reports, service metrics, and management reviews.
* Ensure adherence to Incident, Change, Problem, and Access Management processes.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and operational governance initiatives.
* Manage relationships with OEMs, vendors, service providers, and implementation partners while supporting technology upgrades, renewals, and escalations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in IT Operations, Enterprise Systems Administration, Infrastructure Management, Application Administration, or Information Security Operations.
* Experience managing enterprise platforms in compliance-driven or regulated environments is preferred.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
Microsoft 365
  
  

* Microsoft Entra ID
* Intune
* Active Directory
* Exchange Online
* IAM
* Conditional Access
* MFA
* PAM
* DLP
* DPDPA Controls
* Enterprise Application Administration
* Windows Server Administration
* Network Administration (Firewalls, Routers, Switches, VPNs, Wireless)
* Backup & Recovery
* IT Governance & Operational Controls
* Reporting & MIS.

**Preferred Skills & Certifications**
**Skills:**
Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, SIEM Platforms, PowerShell Automation, API Integrations, AWS/Azure, ITIL Framework, ISO 27001, CRM Administration.
  
  
**Certifications:**
Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Identity & Access Administrator, Security Administrator, Intune Administrator, ITIL Foundation/ITIL 4.
  
  
**Core Competencies**
Strong ownership, analytical and problem-solving skills, enterprise operations expertise, stakeholder and vendor management, documentation and reporting excellence, independent decision-making ability, accountability, integrity, and attention to detail.
  
  
**Working Conditions**
Participation in maintenance windows, audits, security incidents, disaster recovery exercises, and occasional travel to branch offices, datacentres, or vendor locations may be required.

title: Prime Services Operations, Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
The Prime Services Operations Vice President is a leadership role responsible for overseeing the operational support of Prime Services borrowing and lending activities, including settlement processes, collateral management, recon, billing, and corporate action event processing. This role ensures accurate trade processing, proper collateralization, asset servicing, risk mitigation, and regulatory compliance, while leading a global team and driving strategic improvements. The position also involves close collaboration with business partners to drive innovation in processes and systems to enhance efficiency, scalability, and risk management, ensuring operational solutions are closely aligned with State Street’s business objectives, industry practices, and evolving market needs.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to the SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As a Prime Services Operations Vice President you will lead –
  
  

* Trade & Transaction Management
* Oversee daily processing of Prime Services transactions across markets (borrowing and lending transactions, collateralization/margin calls, triparty transactions, cash movements/wires, billing, and corporate actions)
* Ensure timely and accurate trade capture, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation
* Partner with global custody teams on trade statuses and adjustments
* Manage trade lifecycle events, like cash dividends, and mandatory/voluntary corporate actions, monthly billing processes
* Collateral Management
* Initiate and support client(borrower) side financing/collateralization waterfall, as well as Lending agent side collateralization(bilateral/triparty) processes
* Manage initial collateral, collateral returns, margin calls, collateral disputes
* Assist in optimizing collateral usage across funding, risk, and trading desks
* Intraday and End of Day collateral sufficiency monitoring
* Risk & Control
* Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and corporate event risks
* Ensure strong internal controls and adherence to audit requirements
* Investigate and resolve cash/share internal/external breaks, fails, and counterparty discrepancies
* Provide viable solutions and KRI’s to reduce and/or eliminate risk to Prime Services, State Street, and its clients
* Regulatory Compliance
* Ensure all Prime Services operational processes comply with relevant regulations, internal policies, and industry standards
* Support reporting requirements and regulatory audits
* Participate and track internal and external audits throughout the year, ensuring all deliverables and action items are handled timely
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of evolving regulatory/market changes
* Stakeholder Management
* Partner with Front Office, Risk, Treasury, Finance, and Technology teams to understand requirements, delivering solutions that support business growth and risk mitigation
* Act as escalation point for operational issues working with teams to resolve and/or remove road blocks, and ensuring management transparency
* Maintain relationships with counterparties, custodians, and clearing agents
* Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners, ensuring optimal performance and value from third-party platforms and services
* Team Leadership
* Manage and coach operations staff and AVPs
* Drive performance, training, and development
* Promote a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
* Process Improvement & Projects
* Identify emerging technologies and process improvements to drive operational efficiency, trading profitability, risk reduction, and enhanced client experience with Prime Services products
* Participate in system implementations and strategic transformation programs
* Enhance scalability and efficiency of operations
* Partner with business leaders, risk, compliance, and technology teams to understand requirements, delivering solutions that support business growth and risk mitigation

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or related field is preferred
* 12+ years of experience in financial services operations, with focus on Prime Services and principal trading
* Strong understanding of Prime Services products and processes (e.g., trade lifecycle management/settlement/collateral, corporate actions, vendors)

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Leadership and team management
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Attention to detail and risk awareness
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Process improvement and project management

**Additional Details**

* Fast-paced environment
* High interaction with trading desks/client management, counterparties, and global custody teams
* Time-sensitive operations aligned with market hours

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: ASSISTANT GENERAL MANAGER – OPERATIONS
description:
**ASSISTANT GENERAL MANAGER – OPERATIONS**
==========================================

**Soho House Mumbai | Juhu, Mumbai**

**Department:** Operations  
**Reports to:** General Manager  
**Dotted-line reporting:** Regional Director

### **About Soho House Mumbai**

Soho House Mumbai is a private members' club bringing together a diverse community of creative people through hospitality, culture, food and drink, wellness and memorable experiences. With accommodation, restaurants, bars, member spaces, events, a cinema, gym and swimming pool, the House operates across multiple business areas, requiring a leader who understands the connection between operational excellence, commercial performance and member engagement.

### **The Opportunity**

We are looking for an energetic, commercially minded and people-focused Assistant General Manager to partner with the General Manager in driving the overall performance of Soho House Mumbai.

The candidate may come from a strong **Food & Beverage or Rooms background**, but must demonstrate the ability to lead beyond their specialist discipline, work collaboratively with diverse operational leaders and understand the business as a whole.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on hospitality leader who knows Mumbai's market, builds meaningful relationships across its diverse social and business communities, identifies opportunities for revenue growth and develops teams that consistently deliver exceptional experiences.

People management and development are fundamental to success in this role. We want a leader who brings energy, enthusiasm, accountability and a genuine drive to deliver measurable business results.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Leadership & Commercial Performance**

* Partner with the General Manager to deliver the House's annual business plan, revenue objectives, EBITDA targets and operational priorities.
* Understand the financial performance of individual business areas and the wider operation, identifying opportunities to grow revenue, optimise costs and improve profitability.
* Review daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly business performance, translating data and trends into actionable plans.
* Identify new opportunities across membership, food and beverage, accommodation, private hire, events and other revenue-generating areas.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity and emerging hospitality and lifestyle concepts across Mumbai.
* Ensure that operational initiatives are delivered within agreed budgets and timelines, with measurable outcomes.

**2. Operational Excellence**

* Provide visible, hands-on leadership across front-of-house and back-of-house operations, ensuring consistent service standards and effective problem-solving.
* Work closely with the House Manager and other operational leaders to ensure seamless coordination across the House.
* Understand the guest and member journey across accommodation, food and beverage, member spaces, events, facilities and other services.
* Establish clear accountability, follow up on operational priorities and drive continuous improvement.
* Support leaders in maintaining service standards, operational readiness and effective communication between departments.
* Be comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, multifaceted environment while balancing immediate operational requirements with long-term business priorities.

**3. Membership, Relationships & Mumbai Market Connectivity**

* Develop a strong understanding of Soho House's membership proposition and the needs of its diverse member community.
* Build authentic relationships across Mumbai's hospitality, creative, cultural, entertainment and business communities.
* Work with Membership, Member Relations, Marketing, PR, Private Hire and Events & Programming to strengthen engagement and identify commercial opportunities.
* Support initiatives that improve member satisfaction, loyalty, retention and the overall relevance of the House within Mumbai's lifestyle landscape.
* Bring market insight, social awareness and an entrepreneurial mindset to business development and relationship-building opportunities.

**4. People Leadership & Development**

* Build, coach and develop a strong team of operational leaders, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and shared success.
* Work closely with People & Development, Recruitment and Learning & Development to strengthen talent pipelines, succession planning, leadership capability and employee engagement.
* Set clear expectations and performance objectives for direct reports, conducting regular reviews and following through on development plans.
* Identify high-potential talent and create opportunities for internal progression and cross-functional development.
* Drive employee retention by building an inclusive, supportive and high-performance working environment.
* Lead by example, demonstrating the Soho House values through everyday decisions, behaviours and interactions.

**5. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work collaboratively with Finance, People & Development, Recruitment, Learning & Development, Membership, F&B, Rooms, Marketing, PR, Events & Programming, Housekeeping, Engineering, IT and Facilities.
* Build strong working relationships with support-office and regional teams to implement business priorities, global standards and operational initiatives.
* Share information effectively, resolve interdepartmental challenges and ensure that all teams work towards common business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, use technology effectively and introduce innovative ways of working.

**6. Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to company policies, food safety standards, allergy procedures, security protocols and health and safety requirements.
* Maintain readiness for internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of identified actions.
* Work with Engineering, Security, Facilities and relevant leaders to maintain a safe, compliant and welcoming environment.
* Ensure applicable local authority requirements and statutory obligations are met.

### **Direct Reports**

* House Manager
* Engineering
* IT
* Private Hire Manager
* Member Relations
* Security

The role requires close collaboration with all other operational and support-function leaders across the House.

### **Position Profile**

**Experience and background**

* Strong management experience in a high-profile hotel, lifestyle hospitality business, premium restaurant group or private members' club.
* Candidates from either F&B or Rooms will be considered, provided they can demonstrate the ability to lead across multiple operational functions.
* Sound understanding of hospitality business operations, commercial performance, revenue optimisation, budgets and EBITDA.
* A strong understanding of Mumbai's hospitality landscape and an ability to build meaningful relationships across diverse industries and communities.
* Demonstrated experience in managing, engaging and developing teams.
* Experience working within complex, fast-paced operations with high service expectations.
* International hospitality experience or exposure to global service standards would be advantageous.

**Leadership attributes**

* Energetic, enthusiastic and proactive, with a strong bias for action and results.
* Commercially astute, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities.
* A hands-on leader who can influence, coach and collaborate with experienced department heads.
* Strong interpersonal, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Highly organised, detail-oriented and dependable.
* Comfortable working across diverse cultures, teams and business functions.
* Passionate about hospitality, service, member engagement and people development.
* Proficient in relevant operational systems; experience with Opera, Micros or equivalent platforms is advantageous.

### **Measures of Success**

Performance will be assessed against agreed business targets and leadership objectives, including:

* **Service Excellence:** Mystery shopper Service Scan scores and consistent delivery of Soho House standards.
* **Financial Performance:** Achievement of annual and quarterly EBITDA targets, revenue objectives and cost-control measures.
* **Member Retention:** Achievement of agreed membership retention targets and improvement in member experience.
* **Team Retention:** Achievement of staff retention targets, engagement and development objectives.
* **Health & Safety:** Successful completion of Health & Safety audits, compliance with standards and timely closure of corrective actions.
* **Operational Performance:** Effective execution of business improvement plans, operational priorities and cross-functional initiatives.
* **People Development:** Strength of succession planning, internal progression, leadership capability and team performance.

### **What Success Looks Like**

A successful Assistant General Manager will be a trusted business partner to the General Manager and a credible leader to the wider operational team. They will connect commercial thinking with exceptional hospitality, develop leaders who take ownership of their departments, strengthen member and team retention, and ensure that the House continues to deliver outstanding experiences while achieving its financial objectives.

title: BMS Operations Manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
A) BMS Operations, Exploitation & Reliability (primary)
  
Operate & “exploit” BMS for performanceContinuously optimize HVAC plant and building controls through setpoint tuning, schedules, PID/logic adjustments, demand control strategies, and alarm rationalization.
  
Drive energy and comfort performance using trend analytics, baselining, and seasonal strategy changes.
  
  
Advanced troubleshooting & root-cause analysisLead diagnosis of recurring alarms, equipment trips, communication failures, and control loop instability.
  
Perform end-to-end fault isolation across field devices (sensors/actuators/VFDs), controllers/DDCs/PLCs, gateways, and supervisory servers.
  
Use trends, histories, packet/network checks, and point-to-point validation to determine true root cause (not symptom closure).
  
  
System health, availability & lifecycle managementEnsure uptime and resilience of BMS servers, workstations, databases, historian/trending, backups/restore validation, and user access controls.
  
Manage preventive maintenance for BMS infrastructure (panels, power supplies, UPS, network switches where applicable, controller firmware, etc.).
  
Maintain cybersecurity hygiene in coordination with IT (segmentation, access rights, patch/firmware planning as permitted, password management, audit trails).
  
  
Alarm management & operational governanceBuild/maintain alarm philosophy: prioritization, thresholds, delays, suppression rules, escalation matrices, and on-call/response routines.
  
Improve operator effectiveness through dashboards, SOPs, runbooks, and shift handover quality.
  
  
Vendor/OEM and SLA managementLead BMS AMC/vendor performance (response time, fix quality, spares readiness, documentation completeness).
  
Validate OEM recommendations, ensure technical correctness, and prevent unnecessary replacements.
  
  
Documentation & compliance readinessMaintain accurate as-built drawings, point lists, network architecture, controller programs/versions, cause-effect matrices, and change logs.
  
Support audits and internal reviews through evidence-based records (backups, trend logs, incident RCA, maintenance logs).
  
  
B) Projects / Enhancements (secondary but essential)
  
Deliver BMS upgrades and minor projectsManage enhancements such as new floor/area integrations, sensor additions, control logic modifications, dashboard/reporting buildouts, alarm rationalization projects, and server/workstation refresh support.
  
Own scope, requirements, vendor coordination, site execution planning, and handover.
  
  
Commissioning, testing & handoverCreate and execute commissioning plans: point-to-point checks, functional testing, trend verification, and UAT with stakeholders.
  
**Ensure clean handover package:** updated as-builts, programs, backups, O&M, training, and SOPs.
  
  
Support larger MEP/fit-out initiativesPartner with project teams to ensure BMS design compliance, integration feasibility, and maintainability.
  
Review control drawings, IO schedules, network designs, and sequences of operation.
  
  
Key deliverables / KPIs (examples)
  
Reduction in repeat alarms and nuisance alarms (alarm rationalization effectiveness)
  
MTTR improvement for BMS-related incidents; quality of RCA closure
  
BMS uptime/availability; backup/restore success rate
  
Energy performance improvements attributable to controls optimization (where metering supports)
  
On-time delivery of BMS enhancements/projects with compliant documentation handover
  
Vendor SLA adherence and first-time-fix rate
  
Required qualifications & experience
  
**Experience:** Typically 8–12+ years in BMS/IBMS operations, with multi-site exposure preferred; at least 3–5 years in a lead/manager role.
  
**Education:** BE/BTech in Electrical, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Electronics, or equivalent.
  
**Core technical skills:** Strong hands-on in BMS platforms (any major OEM acceptable), including supervisory layer, DDC/controller level, and field integration.
  
**Protocols & integration:** BACnet (IP/MS-TP), Modbus (TCP/RTU), OPC, Lon (if legacy), gateways and multi-vendor integration.
  
**HVAC control concepts:** AHU/PAHU, VAV, chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers; control loops, sequencing, interlocks.
  
**Networking fundamentals relevant to BMS:** IP addressing, VLAN basics (as applicable), switch ports, latency/packet loss troubleshooting, basic cybersecurity coordination.
  
Trend analysis, reporting, and data-driven troubleshooting.
  
  
Preferred / nice-to-have
  
Exposure to DC-grade critical environments or high-availability buildings, command centers, or regulated workplaces.
  
Experience implementing analytics/FDD tools or advanced dashboards.
  
Project management capability (basic scheduling, BOQ review, vendor evaluation, change control).
  
**Certifications (nice to have):** OEM BMS certifications, PMP/Prince2 (lightweight), energy management fundamentals.
  
Behavioral competencies
  
Strong ownership and calm incident handling; can lead from the front during outages.
  
Structured problem solving (hypothesis → test → isolate → validate fix → prevent recurrence).
  
Stakeholder management across engineering, IT, security, and vendors.
  
**Clear communication:** converts technical issues into business impact and action plans.
  
Work conditions
  
Portfolio travel across West India sites as required.
  
On-call support for critical incidents/escalations (define roster as per operating model).

title: Production Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

The
**3P Manager (Personal Care)**

will own the end-to-end operational execution of the manufacturing value chain—moving seamlessly from New Product Development (NPD) implementation to sustained market availability.

This role is highly cross-functional. The ideal candidate isn't just a coordinator; he is  a matrix leader who treats 3P/ Own plants as an extension of Ghar Soaps own ecosystem, deeply understands how changes in the business environment.

 This role is responsible for ensuring that Raw Materials (RM), Packaging Materials (PM), and Finished Goods (FG) are delivered
**On-Time In-Full (OTIF)**

while strictly managing the
**Cost of Conversion (COC)**

, inventory health, AQL & defect free products  and Third-Party (3P) manufacturing performance of new products as well as existing products.

**· Key Stakeholders:**

NPD, Planning & WH, Procurement, Quality, and 3P Manufacturers

**· Category Focus:**

Personal Care (Soaps, Face wash, Body wash, Creams, Gels, lotions etc.)

**Core Responsibilities**

**1. NPD Commercialization & Launch Execution:**

· Partner closely with the NPD team to transition formulations and packaging concepts from lab-scale to commercial 3P manufacturing lines.

· Own the supply chain readiness timeline for all new launches, ensuring RM/PM pipelines are primed to meet first-production deadlines without market entry delays.

· Closure of costing – P2P / COC to deliver desired margins .

· Coordinate trial runs at 3P sites with Quality and Production teams to establish baseline production standards.

**2. End-to-End Availability (OTIF) & Materials Management**

· Ensure 100% availability of RM, PM, and FG across the network to satisfy fluctuating demand signals.

· Collaborate with the Central Planning team to convert demand forecasts into actionable production and material requirement schedules.

· Proactively identify supply bottlenecks (e.g., long-lead active ingredients, custom packaging laminates) and implement mitigation strategies.

**3. Cost Control & Conversion Frameworks (COC)**

· Manage and optimize the
**Cost of Conversion (COC)**

across all manufacturing locations, tracking the precise mix of variable costs, fixed overheads, wastages and co-packer margins.

· Identify and execute cost-saving initiatives within the value chain (e.g., freight optimization, batch size scaling, throughput improvements).

· Negotiate service levels and operational cost structures with 3P partners alongside the Procurement team.

**4. 3P Manufacturing & Project Management**

· Oversee day-to-day operations at Third-Party (3P) contract manufacturing sites, holding them accountable to agreed capacities and timelines.

· Lead operational excellence and capacity expansion projects at 3P/Own locations to support brand scaling.

· Monitor compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and safety guidelines at external facilities.

**5. Inventory & Value Chain Health**


**at 3P locations**

· Optimize inventory levels across the network (RM, PM, and FG) to maximize working capital efficiency while preventing stockouts

· Minimize aging and slow-moving stock by setting up robust tracking systems for material shelf-life and expiration dates (critical for active personal care ingredients).

· Develop and maintain clear, structured inventory frameworks (such as standardized bin systems and location identifiers) at storage sites to ensure flawless traceability.

**Profile Requirements:**

**· Experience:**

6–10 years of robust supply chain, operations, or category management experience within the
**FMCG / Personal Care / Cosmetics**

sector.Must have handled atleast a cluster of 5 or more CMO for a minimum of 3years

**· Technical Domain Knowledge:**

Deep familiarity with personal care manufacturing processes (emulsions, hot/cold compounding, high-speed filling lines for tubes/bottles/jars) and primary packaging barrier properties.

**· Competencies:**

Strong project management, analytical problem-solving, and a clear understanding of manufacturing cost structures (Variable/Fixed/Margins).Negotiation skills. People skills

**· Interpersonal Skills:**

A collaborative, direct communicator capable of alignment across cross-functional units (NPD, Quality, Procurement) and external vendors.

title: Cluster Business Manager

Your cluster.

description:

Report to Head Logistics / Head Supply Chain / Plant Logistics Manager

title: Assurance- Financial Services/WAM -Manager - Pune
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Manager**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
  
  
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
* Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement team’s expectations
* Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
* Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
* Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
* Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
* Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
* Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
* Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
* Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
* Experience in either

+ Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
+ MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment.
+ Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Billing Supervisor
description: Role Overview The Billing Supervisor is responsible for overseeing day-to-day billing and billing adjustment operations, ensuring timely and accurate invoice generation, credit/debit note processing, pricing corrections, and other billing-related adjustments. Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and company policies. Analyze billing performance metrics and prepare periodic reports for management. 100%

:

* Develop executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and performance reporting.

:

* Professional level written and spoken English

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-M&A-Senior Consultant-I&DFin
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - Mergers & Acquisition – I&D Fin - Senior Consultant**
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Sr. Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
We guide M&A initiatives for companies to help expand and accelerate revenue and cost synergies, reduce transaction risk, and retain key talent, even as they make structural changes to their business, operating model, or capital model. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Develop client deliverables and documentations
* Identify and select the most relevant set of tools/techniques to meet client requirements such as business case development, financial modeling, and analysis, etc.
* Analyze and interpret project data, draw conclusions, and develop recommendations based on the result of the specific outputs.
* Use analytics to build strategic insights for the client.
* Define project standards, methodologies, and execute process improvement initiatives
* Engage in client interaction:
* Conduct client interviews to verify and validate assumptions, hypothesis, and analysis.
* Participate in workshops and training sessions.
* Synthesize and present insights and recommendations.
* Develop and maintain working relationships with client counterparts.
* Participate in engagement management including:
* Own and manage specific work threads.
* Develop plans for components of engagements.
* Coordinate activities between different work threads.
* Identify and help manage changes in scope.
* Manage and mentor junior resources.

**The Team:**
The M&A team bring deep industry experience, rigorous analytical capabilities, and a pragmatic mindset to solve clients' most complex business problems. Our operational capabilities address the unique issues faced by manufacturing organizations, service businesses and infrastructure operations. These are combined with capabilities in finance, performance management and business restructuring. Our teams take the lead on delivering all aspects of the people side of transactions to our clients. We leverage commercial awareness and professional expertise, along with using the skills and expertise of others, to deliver the best possible experience and outcomes for our clients.
  
  
Capabilities of an M&A I&D Finance & Supply Chain practitioner will include the following:
  
  

* Advising clients on separating/carving out a business unit for divestiture and integrating newly acquired target with buyer’s organization with focus on the Finance and / or Operations (Supply Chain, Procurement and/or Manufacturing) workstreams.
* Preparing for Day-One (legal ownership transfer) / Day-Two (focus shifts from deal execution to operational transition / TSA exit) planning, business continuity planning, synergy identification / capture and commercial/ operational due diligence with focus on Finance and / or Operations workstreams.
* Preparing and executing Legal Entity Readiness, Finance Function / Operations (Supply Chain, Procurement and/or Manufacturing) Integration & Carve-Out, Transformation planning, Contracts review, Sourcing Strategy Revamp.
* Mapping and documenting current state and future state processes with a focus on Finance Operating Model and / or Operations Operating Model.
* Understanding the end-to-end finance processes such as Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Close-Consolidate, Taxation etc.
* Conducting contract metadata extraction, contract separation, supplier negotiation Support, operational benchmarking, supply chain ops cost baselining etc.
* Analyzing financial statements and large financial and non-financial data sets.

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Masters in Business Administration
* Masters Degree in Actuarial
* 3-5 years of relevant experience for Sr. Consultants

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Consulting Background
* M&A advisory experience
* Program/Project Management office experience
* Investment banking experience on the sell/ buy side
* Industry M&A strategy experience
* Specific functional knowledge in areas of Finance, Operations, Procurement etc.
* Demonstrated experience in financial statement and operations analytics

**Education:**
MBA or Master’s Degree (Actuarial)
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune

title: Banking Specialist - Reconciliations
description:
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
  
  
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Reconciliation team plays a critical role in Banking Operations in maintaining control over cash nostro accounts, securities, and derivative positions. It is responsible for ensuring that all reconciliations are conducted in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to meet our obligations and mitigate the operational risk. The team identifies, investigates, allocates, and closely monitors any discrepancies in cash, securities, and derivatives positions.
  
  
**Your key tasks**

* Identify, investigate, allocate and monitor cash breaks, securities, and derivatives position differences
* Ensure the effective and efficient management of all aspects of service delivery in collaboration with the internal stakeholders, respecting the agreed communication process and in line with the Service Level Agreements obligations
* Support Global Reconciliation in the automation initiatives
* Continuous focus on streamlining the processes and improve control on operational risk
* Propose system enhancements and analyse defects

**Qualifications**

* Banking or other professional education, business school and/or relevant experience
* 1-2 years’ experience in Banking Operations
* Good command of VBA (Visual Basic for Applications) and Excel formulas (Pivot, Vlookup, etc.) is an asset
* Have an affinity to numbers and be able to analyse large quantities of data
* Be a highly motivated, proactive, committed, and adaptable individual, with a “can do” attitude
* Be able to collaborate with and influence internal stakeholders to reach the business area objectives
* High level of attention to details
* Proficient in English, both spoken and written

**Additional Information**
We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
  
  
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
  
  
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

title: Finance: Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe
description:
Job Title
  
  
Finance Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe
  
  
**Job Description**
Are you a finance professional with a strong background in tax, compliance, and financial governance? Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with team leadership, process improvement, and collaboration across multiple European countries?
  
  
At Vanderlande, we are looking for a Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe who will lead the regional Tax & Compliance team and help ensure a strong and compliant tax framework across our European operations.
  
  
In this role, you will contribute to managing tax risks, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving processes and controls, and supporting the business with practical tax solutions in a dynamic international environment.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
As Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe, you report to the Team Lead Tax & Compliance EU / LATAM and lead a team of tax and compliance professionals supporting the European organization.
  
  
You will oversee day-to-day tax compliance activities within Europe and provide guidance on tax matters across multiple countries, working closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders.
  
  
You will combine solid tax expertise with people leadership and a continuous improvement mindset, ensuring tax compliance processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and consistently across the region.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you will
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop the Europe Tax & Compliance team.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of tax compliance and reporting activities across Europe.
* Coordinate corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and other relevant tax compliance activities in cooperation with Group Tax and local Finance teams.
* Support transfer pricing compliance activities and documentation requirements.
* Act as a key contact for tax authorities, auditors, external advisors, and internal stakeholders on operational tax matters.
* Identify and manage tax risks, ensuring issues are escalated and addressed appropriately.
* Translate changes in tax legislation into practical guidance and actions for the business.
* Maintain and improve tax controls, documentation, and compliance processes.
* Drive standardization and process improvements across European tax and compliance activities.
* Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions.
* Support business projects and operational activities with practical tax advice.
* Contribute to finance transformation, compliance, and process improvement initiatives.
* Build strong relationships with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business teams.
* Support knowledge sharing and consistent application of Group Tax policies across Europe.

**What do we ask from you?**
We ask you to bring experience, education, and personality
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Tax, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in tax, tax compliance, or a related finance function within an international environment.
* Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating a team.
* Good knowledge of corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and general tax compliance requirements.
* Experience working with tax authorities, auditors, and external advisors.
* Experience with process improvement and standardization initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* A proactive, pragmatic, and solution-oriented mindset.
* A collaborative leader who combines technical expertise with a strong service-oriented approach.

**About The Team**
You will join the global FSSC organization and become part of a collaborative international finance community. The Europe Tax & Compliance team supports the region in meeting tax and regulatory obligations while helping the business operate efficiently and compliantly in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment.
  
  
The team works closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders to strengthen compliance, mitigate risks, and continuously improve ways of working.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer a position in an international and professional working environment with room for personal development and growth.
  
  
This position offers a competitive salary range of € 6.500 to € 7.600 gross per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance).
  
  
On top of your fixed salary, you’ll receive the following secondary benefits
