title: Analyst II, Gross-to-Net (GTN)
description:
**Company Description**
IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.
  
  
We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your mission at IntegriChain:**
Gross-to-Net is the gap between a drug’s list price and the net revenue a manufacturer realizes after rebates, chargebacks, discounts, and fees. Grss-to-Net is central to how pharmaceutical companies forecast, report, and plan.
  
  
As a GTN Analyst II, you will support multiple external clients by reconciling transactional data, validating pricing calculations, explaining variances, and producing the reports they rely on to meet contractual deadlines. You will work across our GTN systems and Excel, partner with colleagues in Pune and remote teams in the U.S. and build expertise in pharmaceutical revenue management.
  
  
**Working hours:**
This is a hybrid role based in Pune. Because you will work closely with U.S.-based clients and managers, the role requires some overlap with U.S. Eastern working hours
  
  
**What you’ll do to thrive in this role:**

* Data and reconciliation

+ Gather client transactional data, reconcile it to the general ledger, and load it into the source system.
+ Identify and resolve errors in the GTN system according to defined business rules, applying corrections as needed.
+ Monitor and review system output for consistency, accuracy, and formatting.

* Reporting and delivery

+ Produce client deliverables and reports from system results and explain the variances behind them.
+ Meet contractual SLAs by planning and prioritizing your workload around fixed deadlines.
+ Escalate issues promptly when they fall outside defined business rules or put a deadline at risk.

* Process and collaboration

+ Keep process documentation and work instructions current and aligned with RACI standards.
+ Build strong working relationships with internal colleagues and remote team members across multiple locations.

**Where You’ll Grow:**

* As you build confidence in the core role, you will cross-train in adjacent areas of Net Revenue and Compliance, as appliable:
* Government Pricing (GP): transactional and master data, GL reconciliations, and data extraction across client, internal, and external systems, fundamentals including Class of Trade (COT), PHS 340B validation, and monthly pricing calculations.
* State Price Transparency Reporting (SPTR): reporting requirements and the U.S. state regulations behind them: portfolio setup, reporting activities, and preparation of client deliverables.

**Qualifications**
**What you’ll bring to the table:**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Information Management, or another business discipline.
* 2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, reporting, accounting, or a related field.
* Experience producing financial reports, with strong Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, and large datasets) and working knowledge of MS Office.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with large data volumes and complex financial models.
* Sharp attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in data and reporting.
* A process-oriented, organized approach to planning work across multiple client accounts.
* Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to collaborate with cross-functional and U.S.-based teams.
* Ability to pick up new software and systems quickly.
* Initiative to support value add projects and drive process improvements

**Nice to have**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Working knowledge of Managed Care, Medicaid, GPO contracting, or Government Pricing.

title: Senior Financial Systems Analyst - CPM / Financial Planning Systems
description:
**Education :**
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; Master's degree or relevant finance/CPM certification preferred.
  
  
**Experience :**
At least 5 - 8 years of experience in financial systems, corporate finance, or FP&A, including planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, data analysis, or financial systems administration; experience in a global organization preferred.
  
  

* Strong understanding of financial concepts, including P&L, cost center/account structures, planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting.
* Hands-on experience with CPM/EPM platforms such as CCH Tagetik, OneStream, Oracle EPM/Hyperion, Anaplan, SAP Analytics Cloud Planning, Adaptive Planning, or similar.
* Experience with ERP and financial systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar enterprise platforms, including upstream and downstream financial data flows.
* Proven ability to configure and administer complex financial system components including dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, business rules, metadata, and security.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently assess complex issues, evaluate multiple sources of information, and drive root-cause resolution.
* Experience leading or coordinating system enhancements, testing/UAT, upgrades, releases, or finance transformation workstreams with minimal guidance.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial modelling, data analysis, and reporting tools; experience with Power BI or similar analytics tools is a plus.
* Strong business acumen, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate finance requirements into system solutions and build consensus across teams.

**Technical Skills :**

* Strong working knowledge of CPM/EPM platforms for planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting; CCH Tagetik experience preferred.
* Advanced system configuration and administration skills across metadata, dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, business rules, user roles, access, and permissions.
* Experience with data integration and transformation, including ERP connectivity, mappings, validations, reconciliations, and financial data import/export management.
* Ability to perform system monitoring, issue diagnosis, maintenance, testing, release support, and controls to maintain system reliability and data integrity.
* Advanced reporting and data analysis capabilities; knowledge of SQL, TGKML, scripting, or automation/data integration tools is a strong plus.

**Soft Skills :**

* Independent and accountable professional who can manage complex activities with minimal guidance and exercise sound judgment.
* Strategic and analytical thinker who connects financial process needs with scalable system design, governance, and controls.
* Strong problem solver who anticipates risks, performs root-cause analysis, and drives practical, sustainable improvements.
* Effective communicator who can explain difficult financial and technical concepts clearly to both business and technology stakeholders.
* Collaborative influencer who builds trust, works across global cross-functional teams, and helps establish alignment and consensus.
* Proactive and adaptable team member who acts as a resource for colleagues, manages competing priorities, and thrives in a dynamic environment.

**Essential Duties**
**System Management & Governance**

* Own advanced configuration, administration, and ongoing support of CPM/EPM and related financial systems supporting the Health organization.
* Administer user access, roles, permissions, hierarchies, workflows, metadata, business rules, and other system configurations, ensuring appropriate governance and controls.
* Monitor system performance, scheduled processes, data loads, and integrations; investigate complex issues and coordinate timely resolution across Finance, IT, vendors, and business teams.
* Lead system maintenance, updates, regression testing, UAT, and release activities while maintaining detailed system documentation, SOPs, and support materials.

**Planning, Forecasting & Reporting**

* Support and enhance planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting processes, ensuring financial data is accurate, complete, and available according to business timelines.
* Partner with Finance and FP&A stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze financial and process needs, and develop management reports, dashboards, and system solutions.
* Perform advanced data and variance analysis, reconcile financial information across systems, and translate business requirements into configurations, validations, automations, and data flows.

**Continuous Improvement & Project Leadership**

* Identify and implement opportunities to automate, simplify, and standardize financial processes, controls, system configurations, and reporting.
* Lead or independently manage workstreams for CPM/EPM enhancements, integrations, upgrades, implementations, and other finance technology initiatives.
* Apply best practices and lessons learned to improve system reliability, scalability, user experience, and governance across Finance Shared Services and supported business teams.

**Stakeholder Management & User Support**

* Provide comprehensive support to finance system users, including complex issue resolution, guidance, training, and knowledge transfer.
* Coordinate with Health Finance, Shared Services, IT, external partners, and other stakeholders to align priorities, requirements, solution design, and delivery timelines.
* Serve as a subject matter resource for colleagues and leadership by providing clear status updates, metrics, recommendations, and insights on financial systems and improvement initiatives.

title: Principal, Capital Planning & Portfolio Lead, Infrastructure Services
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Principal Technology Portfolio Lead is a senior strategic leadership role responsible for overseeing the planning, forecasting, governance, optimization, and financial management of the organization's technology portfolio across Infrastructure, Cloud, Applications, Cybersecurity, Data Platforms, and Enterprise Technology Services.
  
  
This role serves as the critical bridge between Technology Leadership, Finance, Vendor Management, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to ensure effective management of both Capital (CapEx) and Operating Expenses (OpEx). The individual will drive financial transparency, portfolio optimization, investment prioritization, cost efficiency initiatives, and long-range technology financial planning.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen with deep understanding of technology domains including cloud computing, infrastructure, applications, software engineering, software licensing, hardware lifecycle management, data center services, and managed services. They must possess the ability to influence senior leaders and drive strategic decisions through data-driven insights and innovative financial management practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Portfolio Financial Management**

* Own and manage the end-to-end technology financial portfolio across Infrastructure, Cloud, Application Development, Cybersecurity, Data Platforms, and Enterprise Services.
* Lead annual budget planning, quarterly forecasting, monthly financial reviews, and multi-year strategic financial planning processes.
* Develop and maintain technology investment roadmaps aligned with business and enterprise technology strategies.
* Create financial models to support investment decisions, business cases, technology transformations, and modernization initiatives.
* Partner with technology executives to optimize allocation of technology spend and resources across strategic priorities.

**CapEx and OpEx Governance**

* Establish governance frameworks for technology capital and operating expenditures.
* Monitor portfolio performance against approved budgets and forecasts.
* Drive financial accountability among portfolio owners and technology leaders.
* Provide variance analysis, trend reporting, risk assessments, and remediation plans.
* Ensure compliance with corporate financial controls, capitalization policies, and audit requirements.

**Cloud and Infrastructure Financial Optimization**

* Lead cloud financial management (FinOps) practices across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Drive optimization of cloud consumption, reserved instances, licensing utilization, and infrastructure costs.
* Analyze technology spending patterns across compute, storage, networking, SaaS, platform services, and managed services.
* Identify cost reduction opportunities while maintaining service quality and operational resilience.
* Support technology modernization initiatives with robust financial analysis and return-on-investment assessments.

**Hardware, Software and Licensing Management**

* Develop strategic plans for hardware refresh cycles, infrastructure modernization, and asset lifecycle management.
* Partner with Procurement and Vendor Management teams to optimize software contracts and licensing strategies.
* Monitor software license utilization and ensure cost-effective licensing models.
* Evaluate vendor proposals, renewals, and technology investments from a financial and business value perspective.
* Drive enterprise-wide software rationalization and optimization programs.

**Strategic Planning and Technology Investments**

* Facilitate investment prioritization across competing technology initiatives.
* Support executive governance forums responsible for portfolio review and investment approvals.
* Build executive-level dashboards and KPI frameworks to measure portfolio performance.
* Develop scenario planning and financial forecasting models to support strategic technology decisions.
* Provide recommendations to optimize technology ROI and business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, Technology Executives, Finance Leaders, and Business Partners.
* Collaborate with PMOs, Engineering Leaders, Infrastructure Teams, Cloud Teams, Application Leaders, Procurement, and Finance functions.
* Present financial insights, recommendations, and portfolio performance updates to senior leadership.
* Drive alignment between technology strategy, financial objectives, and enterprise priorities.

**Process Improvement and Automation**

* Modernize technology financial management practices through automation and analytics.
* Drive adoption of portfolio management and financial governance tools.
* Implement data-driven reporting, forecasting, and planning capabilities.
* Leverage AI, automation, and analytics platforms to improve forecasting accuracy and financial decision-making.
* Champion continuous improvement across portfolio governance and financial operations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 15+ years of experience in technology portfolio management, technology finance, strategic planning, PMO leadership, or technology operations.
* 5+ years managing large-scale technology budgets and investment portfolios exceeding $50M+ annually.
* Strong experience managing both CapEx and OpEx within enterprise technology organizations.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with senior technology and finance executives.
* Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and business case development skills.
* Strong understanding of technology cost structures across infrastructure, cloud, applications, software engineering, cybersecurity, and enterprise platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA, CFA, CPA, PMP, PgMP, or equivalent professional certification.
* Experience within Financial Services, Banking, Asset Management, Insurance, or highly regulated industries.
* Knowledge of FinOps, TBM (Technology Business Management), ITFM (IT Financial Management), and Portfolio Governance frameworks.
* Experience managing global technology portfolios across multiple regions.
* Familiarity with Agile Portfolio Management and Product Funding models.

**Technical Exposure**
**Infrastructure & Operations:**
Data Center / Colo, Network, Storage, Compute, DB, Resiliency, Cloud Platforms
  
  
**Applications & Software:**
SaaS, PaaS, Licensing Models, Software Asset Management
  
  
**Financial & Portfolio Tools:**
Apptio (TBM), ServiceNow SPM/ITBM
**,**
Power BI
**,**
Tableau
**,**
Anaplan, MS Excel Advanced, etc.
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Strategic Financial Planning
* Technology Portfolio Management
* Executive Communication
* Business Partnership
* Financial Analysis & Forecasting
* Investment Governance
* Cost Optimization
* Vendor & Contract Management
* Data Analytics
* Risk Management
* Leadership & Influence
* Program and Portfolio Governance
* Negotiation & Stakeholder Management

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Accounting Associate - Project Accounting
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
This position is fully responsible for the project accounting & billing process, including responding to Management inquiries, verifying employee’s billable time with the time recording system & making sure that revenue leakages are avoided; front face with Operations staff on this account and making sure that the process is compliant with the Company Procedures & prescribed Accounting Practices & standards.
  
  

* Set up new projects, open and close time classes in company system (ORACLE), apply transaction controls, budget, payment terms and configure the contract in the Project Accounting System.
* Analyse and understand the contract terms & conditions and accordingly ensure that correct billing is done to the client for T&M and Fixed Price projects.
* Understand the impact of price escalation or change notices as per contract conditions and ensure that there is no loss of revenue for the company.
* Effectively communicate with Project Managers (PM) and Principals-in-Charge (PIC), regarding contract documents, change orders and other contract modifications, approvals, and any additional services-related to billing.
* Have a good understanding of accounting standards for revenue recognition.
* Prepare final invoice package containing draft and final invoices for all billable projects, including all applicable backup for approval by the Accounting Supervisor.
* Ensure timelines for raising and submission of invoices to the clients.
* Research any unbilled issues to optimize the billing possibilities for the billing period.
* Maintain folders / files for all projects, with all the appropriate documents, including expenses, consultant invoices, and monthly invoices, in accordance with standard procedures.
* Work with the Accounts Receivable team member to reconcile variances that occur in the application of cash.
* Work with Accounts Payable team members where certain expenses are billable to clients at actuals.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Location:**
Kharadi, Pune

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Department:**
Finance & Accounts

**Employment Type:**
Full-time | Work from Office

About QKS Group

QKS Group is a global strategic advisory and market research firm, working with leading technology companies across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other international markets.

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Senior Accountant with 3–5 years of relevant experience**
to manage day-to-day accounting operations, taxation, financial reconciliations, international invoicing, and statutory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have strong accounting fundamentals, practical experience with Zoho Books and Excel, and the ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities with accuracy and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Accounting & Bookkeeping**

* Manage daily accounting transactions, journal entries, ledger maintenance, and reconciliations.
* Maintain accurate and update books of accounts using Zoho Books.
* Handle accounts payable, vendor payments, reimbursements, and expense accounting.
* Assist in monthly and annual book closures.
* Prepare and maintain supporting financial schedules and documentation.

**2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Handle GST calculations, reconciliations, and return filings, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.
* Manage TDS deductions, payments, quarterly returns, and reconciliations.
* Assist with income tax, advance tax calculations, and other statutory requirements.
* Maintain compliance calendars and ensure timely completion of applicable filings.
* Coordinate with external Chartered Accountants and auditors.

**3. Client Invoicing & Receivables**

* Prepare and maintain invoices for domestic and international clients.
* Track outstanding receivables and maintain customer ageing reports.
* Coordinate with internal teams regarding invoicing and payment status.
* Reconcile foreign inward remittances and maintain necessary supporting documentation.
* Account for foreign exchange gains and losses.

**4. Banking & Financial Reconciliation**

* Perform regular bank reconciliations and monitor financial transactions.
* Maintain records of fixed deposits, loans, investments, and other banking transactions.
* Coordinate with banks for routine financial documentation and transactions.
* Prepare weekly reports on bank balances, outstanding payments, and upcoming obligations.

**5. Payroll & Employee Accounting**

* Assist with monthly payroll processing and salary-related accounting.
* Maintain employee reimbursement and expense records.
* Coordinate with HR for payroll inputs, final settlements, and applicable statutory deductions.

**6. MIS & Financial Reporting**

* Prepare monthly MIS reports covering revenue, expenses, receivables, and cash flow.
* Assist in preparing Profit & Loss statements and Balance Sheet schedules.
* Track monthly expenses and highlight discrepancies or unusual transactions.
* Provide accounting reports and financial information to management as required.

**7. Audit Support**

* Coordinate documentation for statutory and tax audits.
* Prepare reconciliations, ledgers, and supporting schedules requested by auditors.
* Assist in resolving audit observations and accounting discrepancies.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* B.Com or M.Com degree; CA Inter or CMA Inter preferred but not mandatory.
* **3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience**
  , preferably with a service-based, IT, consulting, or professional services company.
* Strong working knowledge of GST, TDS, and Indian accounting practices.
* Proficiency in Zoho Booksand MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and reconciliations.
* Experience handling international invoices and foreign currency transactions will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of financial statements and accounting reconciliations.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with management, HR, banks, and external auditors.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented accounting professional who can take ownership of routine accounting operations, ensure timely compliance, maintain accurate financial records, and provide reliable financial information to management.

The candidate should be comfortable working in a growing organization with international clients and multiple financial transactions.

* Maintains the confidentiality of sensitive and proprietary technical, financial and commercial information.

title: Production Engineer - Heavy Engineering Fabrication
description:
**About Zeeco**
Zeeco is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced combustion and environmental solutions serving the refining, petrochemical, oil & gas, power, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries. Headquartered in the United States, Zeeco designs and manufactures world-class burners, flares, thermal oxidizers, vapor recovery systems, and fired equipment that help customers improve process efficiency while reducing emissions.
  
  
With manufacturing and engineering facilities across the globe, Zeeco combines innovative technology, engineering excellence, and superior manufacturing capabilities to deliver customized solutions that meet the highest international quality standards.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Zeeco India is seeking an experienced
**Production Engineer**
to lead and coordinate the fabrication and manufacturing of heavy process equipment including
**pressure vessels, process skids, columns, ducting, stacks, structural assemblies, and other static equipment**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess
**8 to 12 years of hands-on shop floor experience**
in heavy engineering fabrication and should have a strong understanding of fabrication methodologies, welding processes, production planning, resource optimization, quality requirements, and statutory fabrication codes. The individual will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and timely execution of manufacturing activities while maintaining the highest standards of quality and productivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Production Planning & Manufacturing Execution:****

* Plan, schedule, and monitor fabrication activities to achieve project delivery milestones.
* Prepare daily and weekly production plans based on project priorities and manufacturing capacity.
* Coordinate fabrication activities involving pressure vessels, process skids, structural assemblies, ducting, stacks, and other static equipment.
* Review engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), welding maps, and manufacturing specifications before production.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, consumables, and shop floor resources.
* Monitor production progress and proactively resolve manufacturing bottlenecks to achieve committed delivery schedules.
* Coordinate closely with Engineering, Planning, Procurement, QA/QC, and Project Management teams throughout the manufacturing cycle.

****Heavy Fabrication & Shop Floor Management:****
  
  

* Supervise fabrication activities including:

+ Plate cutting
+ Rolling
+ Forming
+ Fit-up
+ Welding
+ Assembly
+ Structural fabrication
+ Equipment integration
+ Final assembly

* Ensure fabrication activities comply with approved fabrication procedures and project requirements.
* Monitor welding activities and ensure compliance with approved WPS, PQR, and welder qualifications.
* Oversee fabrication of Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel, Duplex Stainless Steel, Alloy Steel, and other process equipment materials.
* Ensure dimensional accuracy through regular inspections during fabrication and assembly.
* Coordinate lifting, handling, and movement of heavy fabricated components within the workshop.

****Quality, Codes & Compliance:****
  
  

* Ensure manufacturing activities comply with applicable international standards including:

+ ASME Section VIII Div.1
+ ASME Section IX
+ API Standards
+ ISO Standards
+ Customer Specifications

* Coordinate with QA/QC during:

+ Fit-up inspections
+ Welding inspections
+ Visual inspection
+ NDT activities
+ Hydrostatic testing
+ Pneumatic testing
+ Dimensional inspection
+ Final release inspections

* Maintain complete fabrication documentation, weld traceability, material traceability, and production records.
* Support customer inspections, third-party inspections, and statutory audits.

****People Management & Shop Floor Leadership:****

* Lead welders, fitters, fabricators, riggers, and technicians.
* Allocate work based on manpower capability and production priorities.
* Monitor productivity and implement corrective actions where required.
* Mentor junior engineers and supervisors on fabrication best practices.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, quality, and operational excellence.

****Safety & Continuous Improvement:****

* Ensure strict adherence to company HSE policies and safe fabrication practices.
* Conduct regular shop floor inspections to eliminate unsafe conditions.
* Identify opportunities for improving productivity, reducing fabrication cycle time, and minimizing rework.
* Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for quality issues and implement preventive actions.

**Mandatory Experience**
Candidates
**must have hands-on experience**
in the fabrication and manufacturing of one or more of the following:
  
  

* Pressure Vessels
* Process Skids
* Heat Exchangers
* Columns
* Reactors
* Storage Tanks
* Static Equipment
* Fired Heaters
* Thermal Oxidizers
* Process Equipment
* Heavy Structural Fabrication

**Experience From Industries Such As**

* Oil & Gas
* Petrochemical
* EPC
* Heavy Engineering
* Process Equipment Manufacturing
* Boiler Manufacturing
* Pressure Vessel Manufacturing
* Industrial Equipment Manufacturing

will be highly preferred.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Excellent understanding of heavy fabrication processes.
* Strong knowledge of welding processes (SMAW, GTAW, GMAW, SAW, FCAW).
* Knowledge of fabrication sequence planning.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and fabrication documents.
* Knowledge of welding symbols, GD&T, tolerances, and dimensional control.
* Familiarity with WPS, PQR, WPQ, and welding documentation.
* Working knowledge of NDT methods and inspection requirements.
* Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

**Key Competencies**

* Heavy fabrication planning and execution
* Shop floor production management
* Resource planning and optimization
* Pressure vessel manufacturing
* Welding and fabrication supervision
* Manufacturing quality assurance
* Cross-functional coordination
* Production scheduling
* Problem-solving and decision-making
* Team leadership and people management
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Strong commitment to safety and quality

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering.
* 8–12 years of relevant manufacturing experience in heavy engineering fabrication is preferred.

title: Store Manager - Furniture
description:
**Company Description**
Royaloak Incorporation Pvt. Ltd. is India’s premier furniture brand, known for its wide range of stylish, high-quality products at competitive prices. Backed by over 25 years of industry expertise from its founders, the company focuses on “International furniture, Elevating Lifestyles” through its unique Country Collections inspired by designs from the USA, Italy, Turkey, Malaysia, India, and more. These collections are curated by in-house designers to help customers select furniture that aligns with different concepts and tastes. Royaloak offers a one-year warranty on manufacturing defects for most items and operates an expansive network of 200+ stores across the country, supported by a strong online presence at royaloakindia.com.

**Role Description**
The Store Manager – Furniture is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India, responsible for overseeing daily store operations and ensuring an excellent customer experience. The role includes managing the showroom floor, supervising and motivating sales teams, and ensuring product displays and visual merchandising standards are consistently maintained. The Store Manager will monitor sales performance, handle customer queries and escalations, manage inventory levels, and coordinate with logistics and back-office teams to ensure timely deliveries. Responsibilities also include implementing retail loss prevention measures, tracking store KPIs, preparing sales and performance reports, and maintaining compliance with company policies and procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Sales & Customer Service skills to deliver a high-performing, customer-centric store experience.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to interact with customers, mentor team members, and coordinate with internal stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess proven Store Management capabilities, including staff supervision, inventory oversight, and daily operations handling.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Retail Loss Prevention practices to reduce shrinkage and safeguard store assets.
* Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in business, retail management, or a related field are beneficial.
* Prior experience in furniture retail or lifestyle/home décor stores, with exposure to sales targets and performance metrics, is an advantage.
* Strong organization, problem-solving, and leadership skills, along with the ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, are preferred.

title: Assistant Manager - Restaurant
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! Overseeing daily restaurant operations to ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently, you will create a warm and welcoming atmosphere where every guest feels like a VIP. You are responsible for developing a menu that creates unique dining experiences that will leave our guests in awe. As an
**Assistant Manager - Restaurant**
, you’re not just elevating the dining experience – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
  
  

* Operational Oversight: Manage daily outlet operations to ensure smooth service and adherence to brand standards.
* Team Leadership: Supervise, train, and motivate staff to deliver exceptional guest experiences and maintain high performance.
* Guest Experience Management: Ensure personalized service, handle guest feedback, and resolve issues promptly to enhance satisfaction.
* Inventory & Cost Control: Monitor stock levels, manage ordering, and control costs to optimize profitability.
* Sales & Revenue Support: Drive upselling initiatives, monitor sales performance, and support revenue targets.
* Compliance & Hygiene: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and hygiene regulations across all outlet areas.
* Coordination & Communication: Collaborate with kitchen, housekeeping, and other departments for seamless service delivery.
* Food Safety Regulations: Ensuring that all food safety standards are met.

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**

* Proven experience as an Assistant Manager - Restaurant or similar role in a high-end restaurant or hotel, or 2-3 years as an Assistant Manager.
* Assistant Manager: The ideal candidate should possess at least 1 year of experience as an Assistant Outlet Manager.
* High school diploma or equivalent; hospitality training is a plus
* Excellent communication, grooming, and interpersonal skills
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
* Friendly, professional, and guest-focused
* Able to work flexible shifts

**About Us**
**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
  
  
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
**Clinical Study Manager (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your clinical trial management expertise could directly shape how AI understands and advances healthcare research? We're looking for experienced Clinical Study Managers to oversee the operational execution of clinical trials — ensuring studies run on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards — while contributing to some of the most exciting AI development happening in the medical research space today.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for seasoned clinical operations professionals who want meaningful work on their own terms.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Manage clinical trial timelines, milestones, and deliverables to keep studies on track and stakeholders aligned
* Oversee study budgets, financial forecasting, and cost tracking across multiple vendors and research partners
* Coordinate with CROs, investigative sites, and internal teams to ensure smooth, high-quality study execution
* Identify operational risks early, resolve issues proactively, and maintain clear communication across the trial lifecycle
* Apply your real-world clinical research expertise to help evaluate and improve AI systems being trained on healthcare data

**Who You Are**

* Experienced clinical trial project manager with a strong track record managing budgets, timelines, and deliverables
* Skilled at coordinating CROs, external vendors, and cross-functional research teams
* Comfortable managing multiple complex workstreams simultaneously without losing sight of the details
* A clear, structured communicator who keeps stakeholders informed and aligned
* Self-directed and reliable when working independently in a remote environment

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality evaluation, or AI training workflows
* Familiarity with AI tools or clinical data platforms
* Background spanning multiple therapeutic areas or study phases

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI and healthcare research projects alongside leading AI labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact project work
* Gain unique exposure to how advanced AI models are trained using real-world clinical data
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Sr. Cost Manager - MEP
description:
**Job Description**
Undertake quantity works for Building projects - Residential, Commercial, Hotel, Hospital, Fitout, Industry / warehouse (depending on project requirement)
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Perform advanced quantification across complete MEP works Electrical, HVAC, Fire Fighting, Plumbing, DG, Lift, IBMS.
  
  
Draft or modify trade-specific preambles, quantify preliminaries and general items, review cost plan quantities, audit team measurements.
  
  
Apply suitable assumptions (when required) where project information is incomplete.
  
  
Lead preparation and review of cost plans at various stages and tender estimates.
  
  
Analyse and evaluate items of work unit rates to project specifics by incorporating risk factors.
  
  
Carryout benchmark against similar projects, price preliminaries, reconcile BOQs with budgets, and provide input on cost strategies, sustainability elements, and fee allowances.
  
  
Oversee and review pricing work prepared by junior team members.
  
  
Advise on procurement strategies and contract selection based on project needs. Draft or review special contract conditions, manage end-to-end tender processes, review documentation and reports, and present to Client.
  
  
Prepare formal correspondences such as letters of intent, award, or agreement. Provide guidance to junior team.
  
  
Oversee post-contract cost management, including review and approval of payment recommendations, cost reports, and cash flow forecasts and present to Client. Establish change control protocols, advise on risk mitigation, evaluate claims and variations, monitor expenditure of provisional sums, and review Final Account Statement.
  
  
Lead and support junior team members in cost control tasks.
  
  
Apply working knowledge of construction technologies and methods in cost planning tasks. Assess cost implications of materials, labour and construction methods during design and execution stages.
  
  
Should be proficient in CAD, Cost-X (qty take off tools) and other quantification / estimation software.
  
  
Good skills on MS excel and word and ability to learn and adapt to customized software
  
  
**Qualifications**
Qualification- Degree in Mechanical Engineering

title: Clinical Business Intelligence Manager
description:
**Clinical Business Intelligence Manager (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your deep expertise in healthcare analytics could directly influence how AI understands and reasons about clinical data? We're looking for an experienced Clinical Business Intelligence Manager to lead analytics work that sits at the intersection of healthcare intelligence and cutting-edge AI development.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for senior professionals who know how to turn complex clinical and operational data into decisions that matter. You'll bring your healthcare BI leadership experience to a team working on some of the most advanced AI projects in the industry.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and mentor a business intelligence team in building dashboards, reports, and analytics that support clinical and operational decision-making
* Design, maintain, and optimize BI infrastructure — including data models, SQL queries, and reporting pipelines — ensuring accuracy, reliability, and performance
* Analyze clinical, operational, and performance data to uncover meaningful trends and surface insights that support leadership decisions
* Translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, trusted outputs that drive improvements in care delivery and organizational efficiency
* Apply your domain expertise to evaluate, quality-check, and improve AI-generated outputs related to clinical analytics and healthcare data reasoning

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in healthcare or clinical analytics, business intelligence, or data management within regulated environments
* Proven track record designing and managing BI systems — including dashboards, reporting pipelines, and data models
* Comfortable working with clinical, operational, and administrative datasets and understanding their real-world implications
* Strong communicator who can translate technical findings into meaningful narratives for both clinical and operational stakeholders
* Self-directed and reliable — you deliver quality work independently without hand-holding

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM outputs, or AI training workflows
* Background in health informatics, population health, or value-based care analytics
* Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI platforms

**Why Join Us**

* Work alongside world-leading AI research labs on genuinely cutting-edge projects
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high-impact work
* Gain direct exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated
* Contribute clinical intelligence expertise to AI systems that will shape how healthcare data is understood at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: life insurance team leader
description:
**Company Description**
SMC Insurance Brokers Pvt Ltd is a Composite Insurance Broker registered with the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), offering a wide range of life and non-life insurance solutions under professional guidance. The company serves both corporate and retail clients with products such as group medical coverage, fire, burglary, and motor insurance, supported by trusted partnerships with leading car dealerships across India. Headquartered in Delhi with a pan-India service network, SMC combines decades of domain experience with a dynamic, growth-oriented culture. Its philosophy centers on client-first advice, comprehensive claims support, and fair resolution, reflected in millions of policies sold and claims assisted. With multiple insurance partners and extensive business volume, SMC provides customers and team members with strong industry exposure and career development opportunities.
  
**Role Description**
The Life Insurance Team Leader is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India. This role is responsible for leading and mentoring a team of life insurance advisors or sales representatives, setting targets, monitoring performance, and ensuring adherence to compliance and quality standards. Daily activities include guiding the team on product offerings, overseeing client onboarding, reviewing proposals, and supporting the closure of sales opportunities. The Team Leader will collaborate with internal stakeholders to optimize processes, provide regular training and coaching, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and policy retention. The role also involves reporting key metrics, forecasting sales, and contributing to strategic initiatives that drive growth in the life insurance portfolio.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of Finance and Insurance, particularly in life insurance products and regulatory requirements.
* Candidates should possess effective Team Management skills, including mentoring, performance tracking, and coaching diverse teams.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service skills, with the ability to handle queries, resolve issues, and maintain long-term client relationships.
* Candidates should possess proven Sales skills, including target achievement, pipeline management, and consultative selling.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in business, finance, or a related field; experience in brokerage or insurance distribution; strong analytical and reporting abilities; proficiency in MS Office; and clear, professional communication skills in English and local languages.

title: Service Manager
description:
**Location:**
New Delhi (Sarita Vihar)

**Working Hours:**
Any 9 hours between 9am - 9pm

**Working Days:**
5 days per week

**Weekly Offs:**
2 rotational offs between Monday and Friday

**Saturday & Sunday:**
Mandatory working

**Experience:**
5–9 years

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Service Delivery Manager**
to lead service delivery operations for a premium customer segment within a leading consumer internet organization.

The role will involve managing a team of
**Relationship Managers and Team Leads**
, ensuring high-quality customer service, effective escalation management, and strong customer retention and renewal outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and manage a team of approximately
  **30–40 Relationship Managers and Team Leads**
  .
* Drive consistent service delivery and ensure a high-quality customer experience.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure timely, structured resolution of issues.
* Monitor team performance against defined service and business objectives.
* Drive customer engagement, retention, and
  **renewal outcomes**

* Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve operational and customer-related challenges.
* Coach and mentor Team Leads and Relationship Managers to improve productivity, service quality, and performance.
* Identify recurring customer issues and work with relevant teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Maintain strong relationships with
  **high-value/HNI customers**
  and ensure a premium service experience.
* Track operational metrics and provide regular performance updates to leadership.
* Ensure adherence to organizational processes, service standards, and compliance requirements.

What We’re Looking For

* **5–9 years of relevant professional experience**
  , preferably in service delivery, customer success, customer experience, relationship management, or operations.
* Experience managing
  **large customer-facing teams**
  of 30+ members.
* Strong experience in
  **escalation management and customer relationship management**
  .
* Exposure to customer retention, renewals, or account management.
* Strong people-management, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment.
* Experience handling premium, high-value, or HNI customer segments would be an advantage.

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to work with a
  **leading consumer internet brand**
  .
* Manage a high-performing customer-facing team.
* Work with a premium and high-value customer segment.
* Opportunity to influence customer experience, retention, and service delivery at scale.

**Work Location:**
New Delhi

* **Work Schedule:**
  5 days a week, with Saturday and Sunday working and two rotational weekly offs between Monday and Friday.

title: Regional Business Manager
description:

**The ideal candidate will bring proven account management experience and be comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. They must demonstrate the ability to develop and implement strategic initiatives, as well as proficiency in technology platforms such as Microsoft Office Suite, Zoom, SAP dashboards, and similar tools.**

Travel within the region to foster alignment with sales leaders around corporate initiatives, provide training, and promote the business opportunity to potential distributors.

* Analyze competitive and program data; identify gaps and recommend solutions that drive/support Regional Strategy

title: Area On Premise Manager
description:
**PURPOSE OF THE JOB**
The Area On Premise Manager is responsible for the On Premise volume and the development of the brand in the assigned region by leading the musketeers in an effective way, and by managing and optimizing the available resources, in order to achieve Business Plan objectives. The ROPM trains and develops the Musketeers permanently to secure a high performing team.
  
  
**All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:**
**Key Responsibilities**

* “Living” the Red Bull On Premise culture:

Assume and live the Red Bull OP Culture. Creation of “kindred spirits”. Being brand ambassador in front the Musketeers and the On Premise network. Monitoring image standards within the Musketeer team regarding the brand premium values of Red Bull.
  
  

* Communication:

Fluent communication and know-how exchange with his/her Musketeers and the National On Premise Manager. Permanent teamwork with other On Premise Regional Managers. Securing and optimizing the relation with all regional business units, especially Off Premise and Culture in the region.
  
  

* Event Activation:

Ensures availability, premium On Premise activation and High 5 execution at third party and Red Bull events. Attendance on key 3rd party and Red Bull events. Monitor customer incentives by searching the profitability of all invitations.
  
  

* Area Management:

Planning and continuously developing of her/his area in the regional business plan. Secure the implementation of the national business plan in the region. Manage team to drive horizontal and vertical growth by putting the national On Premise strategy into practice. Permanently searching for new opportunities and securing the existing ones. Setup a proper route planning to secure perfect outlet coverage in the respective area. Builds and maintains relationships with key On Premise partners in the assigned area.
  
  

* Administration:

Ownership of the regional On Premise budget in relation with the national business Plan. Keeping records of all Musketeer activities in the region. Fulfilment of reports dead lines. Compile and reports of competitors activity in the region.
  
  

* On Premise Marketing

Development of the regional On Premise marketing strategy together with the National On Premise Marketing Manager and putting it into practice. Locate offset financial contribution with added value solutions to main accounts which build long term credibility & partnership.
  
  

* Training, Coaching, Motivating and Assessing

Set up and execute the regional training plan for the Musketeer team. Responsible for conducting training sessions with the team towards desired outcome. Coaching and training of Musketeers on the job based on observed strengths and opportunities. Spends a minimum of four days a week in the field with his/her Musketeers.
  
  

* Art of Musketeering

Seek out and engages continuously potential qualified candidates that best fit Musketeer job description. Screen Applicants based on resume and referrals, ask relevant questions during interview process. Assess Candidates on both substantive answers to interview questions as well as overall communication and sales skills and presentation.
  
  
**Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:**

* EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS
* University – Bachelor’s degree preferred (business, marketing or similar).
* EXPERIENCE
* Recommended 3-4 years sales experience with a strong track record of success.
* Recommended 2-3 years of management experience (in the On Premise beverage industry is a plus).
* Strong On Premise industry knowledge, contacts and experience in “the scene”.
* KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
* Strong analytical, planning and financial skills.
* Clear understanding of markets, sales & distribution, competitor activity, consumer behaviour in FMCG context
* Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Very high negotiation and communication skills.
* Fully understands and embraces the musketeer profile.
* Must be proficient in EDV (Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.).

title: Planning Lead
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices.
  
  
CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
  
  
CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2.
  
  
CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* We are seeking a Planning Lead to manage the planning team while maintaining a hands-on role in project planning, scheduling, monitoring, and reporting using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project (MSP).
* The successful candidate will provide planning leadership across projects, ensure consistent scheduling standards, and personally develop and maintain schedules for assigned projects. This is a working leadership role that combines team management with practical project delivery.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the planning team, managing workloads and ensuring quality and consistency of schedules and reports.
* Establish planning standards, procedures, and reporting templates; support recruitment, training, and performance reviews.
* Develop, baseline, and maintain integrated project schedules using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project (MSP), including WBS, milestones, dependencies, and resource/cost loading.
* Monitor progress against baselines, analyse critical paths and variances, and develop look-ahead and recovery plans.
* Prepare progress reports, dashboards, S-curves, and performance indicators; communicate schedule status, risks, and corrective actions.
* Assess the impact of changes and delays, support delay analysis and extension-of-time assessments, and maintain schedule records.
* Coordinate with project teams and clients to align schedules, lead progress reviews, and resolve or escalate delivery risks.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Typically 8–12 years of relevant planning and scheduling experience, including experience leading a planning team.
* Demonstrated hands-on proficiency in Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project; experience must extend beyond reviewing schedules prepared by others.
* Experience developing and controlling schedules through the full project lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of critical path methodology, resource planning, progress measurement, and schedule recovery.
* Experience coordinating multiple projects or complex work packages.
* Relevant industry experience in infrastructure projects.
* A relevant planning, scheduling, or project management certification is desirable.

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!

title: Head/Director – National Conservation Programme
description:
**Background**
WWF India is consolidating its National Conservation Programme to strengthen and deepen its engagement and outreach on key conservation issues of national importance. The Director, NCP will help to strategise and lead theprogramme, building on the current initiatives.
  
  
Initially, the NCP will bring together WWF India’s work on raptorconservation, small grants and conservation initiatives being run out of our State Office network. Future directions and new initiatives can also be developed based on strategic priorities and funding opportunities. The NCP will complement and work in synergy with other WWF India programmes including wildlife & landscape conservation; freshwater & wetland conservation and coastal & marine conservation.
  
  
The role's core responsibilities will initially be focused around managing the Raptor Conservation Programme which brings together science, innovation and stakeholder engagement to design and implement high-priority interventions for vultures, other threatened raptors, and their habitats. The Director, NCP will also be responsible for the management of the Conservation Catalyst Programme which channels targeted small-grant resources and technical mentorship to local partners for conservation of lesser-known, threatened species & habitats. Providing strategic & technical support and coordinating the conservation activities undertaken by WWF India’s branch offices in different states will also be a core responsibility. In addition, as a senior member of the WWF India conservation programme team, the Director, NCP will also be expected to contribute to the larger strategic vision and conservation priorities of the organisation.
  
  
He/she should be a strategic, dynamic, resourceful and organised conservation professional. This senior leader must have at least ten years of experience managing field conservation and research projects. Experience in raptor or avian ecology would be an added advantage. This role will be based at the WWF-India Secretariat in New Delhi and will report to senior management at WWF-India.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**RAPTOR CONSERVATION PROGRAMME (RCP)**

* Provide strategic vision and leadership for the raptor conservation programme to establish WWF-India as aleader in the raptor conservation space.
* Manage and build the raptor conservation team in the Secretariat and landscapes.
* Support implementation of innovative and scientific approaches for raptor conservation.
* Ensure timely data analysis and report publication and coordinate outreach activities.
* Coordinate with stakeholders as required for the long-term survival of threatened raptors including government and civil society partners
* Collaborate with the central and state governments to support policies that might have immediate or long-term effects on the conservation of vultures & other raptors and their habitats
* Lead the preparation of half-yearly technical & financial reports and scientific publications for RCP.
* Keep track of the finances of the RCP including budgeting and adaptive management.

**CONSERVATION CATALYST PROGRAMME (CCP)**

* Continue development and evolution of the strategy for CCP to achieve the larger objective of strengthening small, grassroots conservation organizations.
* Work with the CCP team to coordinate with grantees, develop and implement capacity building approaches.
* Assess grant proposals for technical quality, feasibility, and alignment with organizational priorities
* Oversee grant disbursement schedules, compliance with financial and procurement norms, and timely submission of narrative and financial reports by grantees.
* Provide technical backstopping to grantees, including advice on project design, field methodologies, data management, and communication of results.
* Coordinate periodic field reviews and audits of grant‑supported projects; document lessons learned, success stories, and scalable models for integration into WWF-India’s wider programmes.
* Compile programme‑level synthesis reports on the CCP, highlighting contributions to biodiversity conservation in the country

**STATE AND BRANCH OFFICES**

* Provide strategic oversight to WWF-India State and Branch offices to ensure alignment with WWF-India’s conservation strategy, annual work plans, and compliance requirements
* Support state and branch teams in planning, implementing, and monitoring biodiversity conservation projects
* Establish and periodically review branch‑level performance indicators (e.g. project delivery milestones,takeholder and partner engagement, financial utilisation, reporting quality) and support course‑correction where needed
* Facilitate cross‑learning between branches and landscape programmes

**Requirements**

* PhD or equivalent in the field of ornithology/ecology/wildlife/environment/biology.
* At least 15 years’ experience in the field of conservation or a related area.
* Ability to design and implement strategies and programmes independently.
* Experience in managing teams and working collaboratively.
* Ability to drive high-level discussions with stakeholders, including government departments, scientific institutions and NGOs.
* Strong written and spoken communication skills in English, with knowledge of any regional language.

Last date for application - 2 October 2026
  
  
**WWF-India is an equal opportunities employer. We encourage applications from women and diverse candidates.**

title: Chief Field Office (P-4), FT, #82112, Hyderabad, India - APRO
description: UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.For every child, a brighter futureThe Hyderabad Field Office covers Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka and provides strategic leadership for UNICEF's engagement with state governments and key stakeholders across the Area of Responsibility.In line with UNICEF India's evolving differentiated programme approach, the Hyderabad Field Office plays a strategic role in advancing upstream engagement and strengthening UNICEF's position as a convener and catalyst for results for children.The office fosters innovation, generates evidence and supports the development of sustainable, scalable approaches aligned with state development and governance priorities. The CFO represents UNICEF in their Area of Responsibility (AoR), leads and oversees the various program sectors and operational service teams ensuring the delivery of quality results in accordance with UNICEF’s programme of cooperation, country programme management plan and overall vision set forward by the Representative. The incumbent is also expected to provide strategic leadership in partnership development, resource mobilization, policy advocacy and innovation, while positioning UNICEF as a trusted thought leader and partner of choice.Key Functions And Accountabilities Effective management of UNICEF presence, staff and assets Partnership, Coordination and Collaboration Knowledge Management for Programmes Programme Development and Management Optimum Use of Program Funds Programme Monitoring and Evaluations Rights-Based and Results-Based Programme Management Approach National and Local Capacity Building/Sustainability Rights Perspective and Advocacy at the National, Community and Family Levels Partnership and Resource MobilizationIf you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here: Job Description Chief Field Office.pdfTo qualify as an advocate for every child you will have…Minimum RequirementsEducation: An advanced university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in one of the following fields is required: social sciences, international relations, public administration, government and public relations, public or social policy, sociology, social or community development, or another relevant technical field.Work Experience: A minimum of eight (8) years of professional work experience in programme management, planning, monitoring and evaluation, project administration or another relevant area is required. Demonstrated experience in advancing upstream programming, policy dialogue and systems strengthening through strategic engagement with senior government officials, development partners, academia, private sector and civil society stakeholders that advance children's rights and development outcomes is required. Experience leading and managing teams, with the ability to nurture talent, foster collaboration and innovation, and build high-performing teams capable of delivering results in increasingly upstream and partnership-focused programming environments is required.Skills: Strong strategic leadership, programme management, stakeholder engagement, partnership development, advocacy, negotiation and resource mobilization skills, with demonstrated ability to lead high-performing teams, foster collaboration and innovation, and deliver results for children.Language Requirements: Fluency in English is required.DesirablesLanguage: Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish) is an asset.Experience in identifying, cultivating and leveraging strategic partnerships and in resource mobilization in support of children's rights and development outcomes is considered a strong asset.Experience working in a developing country is considered as an asset.Relevant experience in a UN system agency or organization is considered as an asset.For every Child, you demonstrate...UNICEF's Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Additional vetting and assessment for elevated risk roles in child safeguarding (potentially including additional criminal background checks) apply.UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. title: Front Desk Manager
description:
**Job Description**

* maintain a high customer service focus by approaching your job with the customers always in mind.
* To have a positive impact, taking personal responsibility and initiative to resolve issues, always clearly communicating with both customers and colleagues.
* To be motivated and committed, approaching all tasks with enthusiasm and seizing opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve your personal performance.
* To be flexible, responding quickly and positively to changing requirements including the performance of any tasks requested of you.
* To maintain high team focus by showing co-operation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.
* To maintain an environment that promotes flair, creativity and consistency in the quality of customer service delivery and presentation.
* To ensure that all Front Office related polices and guidelines are followed and implemented.
* Staffing and Scheduling of the shift and allocation of duties.
* Implement systems and procedures that achieve higher cost efficiency and guest satisfaction.
* Facilitate learning and development for all the team members of the outlet
* Performance Appraisal/ Management of the staff in the department.
* Maintain the Log Book and effective follow up system, Check the daily arrival list and monitor all VIP movement.
* Ensure that the guest has a pleasant stay by supervision of;
* Room allocation
* Smooth Check In & Check Out
* Special requirements of the guest
* Co-ordinate with departments like Security and Housekeeping to ensure that all the security, hygiene and aesthetic standards of the hotel are met.
* Act as a ‘One Point Contact’ for the guest ; constantly interact with guests in order to solicit feedback.
* Prepare reports on Occupancy, Average rates, Reservations etc.
* Monitor daily performance and manage revenue through revenue and yield management techniques.
* Ensure through regular monitoring of SALT and feedback, prompt, efficient and accurate service to all guests.
* Maintain the Guest History System and updating of all the guest profiles.
* Monitor the business of competition hotels in terms of new accounts and rates.
* Ensure that all the operational standards set for all the processes are followed.
* Co-ordinate operations with Concierge, Travel Desk, Guest Services Hotline or any other sub departments, through the guest cycle.
* Ensures norms, procedures and systems for safety and security of guest belongings (e.g. Lockers, Left luggage etc.) are followed.
* Maintain regular contacts with corporate and individual customers, and build strong relationships with them.
* Ensure that all the statutory requirements for in house guests are met (C–Forms etc.)

title: Area Debt Manager-Call Centre
description:
**Job Requirements**
About the Role
  
  
The Area Debt Manager – Call Centre is responsible for managing a team and coordinating operational recovery activities for a credit portfolio within an assigned territory. This includes administering corporate policies and procedures to minimize front-end delinquencies. The role involves close collaboration with the legal team to obtain sound legal advice on managing delinquencies. The role bearer holds end-to-end responsibility for collections in the allocated area, contributing to the bank’s broader organizational objectives. This is a critical role with direct impact on the financial institution’s budget planning.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Handle collections for specific products in the assigned area.
* Ensure collection efficiency and manage the cost of collections.
* Track and control delinquency bucket-wise and DPD-wise, with a focus on non-starters.
* Review account allocations and set collection targets by bucket for agencies and in-house teams.
* Follow up regularly with defaulting customers through a dedicated team.
* Ensure adherence to legal guidelines by collection agencies and executives.

Secondary Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage productivity by setting parameters for in-house teams, agencies, and collection executives, and monitor performance daily.
* Ensure adequate 'Feet on Street' availability area-wise, bucket-wise, and segment-wise.
* Conduct detailed background and reference checks for appointed agencies and DCTs and evaluate them regularly.
* Collaborate with the legal team to initiate legal action on specified cases.
* Build relationships with key clients to ensure timely collections.
