title: Cargo Export Control Manager, Ahmedabad (India)
description:
General Information
  
  
**Ref #**
260000ET
  
  
**Location:**
India-Ahmedabad
  
  
**Job family:**
Corporate & Commercial
  
  
**Closing Date:**
2026-11-02
  
  
**Description**
Qatar Airways is recruiting for the role of
**Cargo Export Control Manager**
based at our Global Business Services (GBS) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat (India).
  
  
The Cargo Export Control Manager will lead and manage the day-to-day implementation, oversight and continuous improvement of Qatar Airways Cargo’s export controls and sanctions compliance programme across the global cargo network. The role will ensure that requirements relating to dual-use, military and strategic goods, controlled technology, restricted end-use and end-users, destination controls and sanctions screening are embedded within cargo booking, acceptance, documentation, escalation and shipment-handling processes. The successful candidate will provide practical specialist guidance to the Cargo Compliance Support Center (CCSC), Cargo Operations, Commercial teams, Ground Handling Agents and outstations, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, escalated and managed consistently and effectively.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the implementation and maintenance of export-control and sanctions policies, procedures, screening rules, commodity controls and escalation workflows across Qatar Airways Cargo operations globally.
* Assess high-risk shipments involving dual-use, military, strategic or otherwise controlled goods and recommend appropriate operational, legal or compliance action.
* Manage sanctions-screening governance, including list matching, false-positive resolution, potential-match escalation and the implementation of applicable regulatory controls.
* Conduct and oversee end-user, end-use, consignee, intermediate-consignee and destination-risk assessments, ensuring decisions are supported by clear and complete records
* Interpret regulatory requirements and provide commercially practical guidance to Cargo Operations, Commercial teams, outstations, Ground Handling Agents and other relevant stakeholders.
* Review export-control and sanctions incidents, exceptions and investigations; identify root causes; and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented and closed effectively.
* Govern screening criteria, system rules and enhancements, and drive automation and continuous improvement of export-control and sanctions processes.
* Monitor compliance performance through quality reviews, audits, KPIs, dashboards, trend analysis and management reporting, escalating material risks in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with the Cargo Sanctions and Crisis Manager, Legal, Security, Customs and other stakeholders on complex or sensitive matters.
* Provide functional leadership, coaching and operational direction to assigned resources; allocate work, monitor quality and progress, manage time-sensitive escalations and support capability development.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**
Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
  
  
Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
Together, everything is possible
  
  
Qualification
  
  

* High School / Diploma or Equivalent with minimum 5 years of job-related experience or Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with minimum 4 years of job-related experience.
* Relevant experience should be in air cargo operations, international trade compliance, export controls, sanctions compliance, customs, logistics compliance or a related regulatory environment.
* A strong candidate will have at least six years of relevant experience, including supervisory, specialist or compliance-advisory responsibility.
* Professional certification in cargo systems, sanctions compliance and/or export controls is preferred

**Job Specific Skills**

* Strong knowledge of export-control regulations, dual-use, military and strategic goods, restricted commodities, end-use and end-user controls, and sanctions-related trade restrictions.
* Practical experience in restricted-party screening, false-positive resolution, potential-match escalation, due diligence and documented risk assessment.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, workable operational controls and escalation procedures.
* Experience in compliance investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective-action management, audits, KPIs and management reporting.
* Demonstrated leadership, work-allocation, coaching, stakeholder-influencing and decision-making capability in a compliance or operational environment.
* Excellent written and spoken English, strong analytical and presentation skills, and proficiency in Microsoft Office; knowledge of business-intelligence or data-analysis tools is preferred.

**About Qatar Airways Group**
Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries, and be part of a truly global community.

title: CS Executive Articleship
description:
**Company Description**
DPSM & CO is a Chartered Accountants firm formed through the merger of three recognized audit firms, bringing together extensive professional expertise under one name. The firm delivers audit and assurance, tax advisory, accounting, and management consultancy services to national and international clients. Headquartered in Cochin, Kerala, DPSM & CO operates branches in Kannur, Calicut, Malappuram, and Trivandrum, offering broad regional coverage. Its core strengths include internal and operational audits, statutory audits, MIS reporting, due diligence, business valuation, tax advisory, and comprehensive accounting services. The firm focuses on reliable, high-quality consultancy solutions that support clients’ compliance and strategic decision-making.
  
**Role Description**
The CS Executive Articleship role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi, providing hands-on exposure to corporate secretarial and compliance work within a professional chartered accountancy environment. The CS Executive will assist in preparing and filing ROC forms, maintaining statutory registers and records, and supporting board, committee, and general meeting documentation. Daily responsibilities include drafting notices, minutes, resolutions, and other corporate documents, coordinating with clients for required information, and helping ensure adherence to Companies Act, SEBI, and other applicable regulations. The role also involves supporting due diligence assignments, assisting with corporate governance reviews, and collaborating with audit and tax teams on matters requiring secretarial input. The position offers structured learning, mentoring, and practical experience aligned with professional CS training requirements.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of corporate laws, Companies Act provisions, and basic understanding of SEBI and allied regulations.
* Candidates should possess skills in drafting corporate documents, including notices, minutes, resolutions, and statutory registers.
* Candidates should possess analytical and research skills for interpreting legal provisions, compliance requirements, and regulatory updates.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Office tools and basic accounting concepts to work effectively with documentation and reports.
* Candidates should possess good written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage deadlines.
* Company Secretary students pursuing executive level or equivalent, with a strong interest in corporate compliance and governance, are preferred.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a professional team environment and maintain high ethical and confidentiality standards is essential.
* Prior internship or exposure in a CA or CS firm, and familiarity with MCA/ROC online filing systems, will be considered an added advantage.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
Position: Quality Executive
Experience: 3+ Years
Industry: Travel & Tourism
Location: Mumbai

 Job Summary 
We are looking for a Quality Executive with 3+ years of experience to monitor and maintain the quality of customer interactions and ensure that the team follows the required processes and service standards. The person will be responsible for monitoring calls and other customer interactions, identifying gaps, sharing feedback with the team, and working with the operations team to improve overall quality and customer experience.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Monitor and evaluate customer calls to check the quality of communication, information shared, and process adherence. Conduct regular quality audits for sales and customer service teams. Check calls for proper customer handling, product knowledge, accuracy, and adherence to company processes. Identify mistakes, gaps, and areas of improvement during call audits. Share regular feedback with team members and Team Leaders. Maintain daily and monthly quality reports and audit records. Track quality scores and highlight recurring issues to the concerned team. Coordinate with Team Leaders and Operations Managers on quality-related concerns. Conduct calibration sessions whenever required to ensure consistency in quality evaluation. Check whether the team is following the defined SOPs, scripts, and company guidelines. Monitor customer interactions related to travel bookings, amendments, cancellations, refunds, and other travel-related queries. Identify training requirements based on quality observations and coordinate with the training team. Escalate serious quality issues or process violations to the reporting manager. Suggest improvements in processes and customer handling based on audit findings. Maintain proper documentation of quality audits, feedback, and action taken. Requirements 
 Minimum 3 years of experience in Quality / Quality Assurance. Experience in the Travel & Tourism industry will be preferred. Candidates from Travel, OTA, BPO, Customer Service, or Sales processes can be considered. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong observation and analytical skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel and reporting. Ability to identify gaps and provide clear and constructive feedback. Good understanding of customer service and process compliance. Ability to work closely with Operations, Sales, Training, and Team Leaders. Should be comfortable handling multiple audits and meeting timelines. Key Skills 
Quality Auditing | Call Monitoring | Customer Handling | Process Compliance | Feedback &Coaching | Reporting | MS Excel | SOP Adherence | Customer Experience

About us and the role At DS Stream, we help global enterprises move beyond AI pilots and build AI at scale. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions across Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Data Science, Generative AI, Agentic AI and AI Platform Engineering. 
 We work with organizations across CPG, Retail, Manufacturing, Telecom, Financial Services and Healthcare, helping them build AI Factories, modern data platforms and production-ready AI solutions. 
 We are looking for experienced Backend/AI Engineers to join our growing Team in India. 
 Role Overview As an AI Engineer at DS Stream, you will bridge the gap between traditional data science and modern AI applications. Leveraging your strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, and data engineering, you will design, train, and deploy ML models while integrating GenAI capabilities into existing data pipelines. You will be responsible for the full ML lifecycle - from experimentation and model development to production deployment and monitoring - ensuring our AI solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business objectives. 
 Key Responsibilities Design and operate AI-driven pipelines that automatically ingest, analyze, and classify operational incidents and tickets. Leverage LLMs with structured prompt logic and few-shot prompting (using historically similar tickets) to deliver consistent, scalable triage replacing manual classification and accelerating resolution. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and contribute to scaling AI capabilities across projects. Drive tasks independently with minimal supervision. 
 Required Skills 4+ years of hands-on experience in GenAI/Machine Learning/Data Science with strong background in Python. Proficiency in deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or Tensorflow preferred). Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational/vector databases Solid understanding of ML fundamentals (supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering). Practical experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph or LlamaIndex). Understanding of GenAI integration patterns and LLM APIs. Experience building and deploying ML models to production. Hands-on exposure to at least one cloud ML platform (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI, Databricks). Familiarity with software engineering best practices (GitHub, CI/CD, testing, code review). Understanding of workflow orchestration (Airflow, Kubeflow). 
 Nice to Have Strong foundation in statistics and mathematics (linear algebra, probability, optimization). Experience with Spark (PySpark, Databricks). Open-source contributions to AI or data projects. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Mechanical Design Engineer to support the design, development, and improvement of wrapping machines and other special-purpose machinery. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in mechanical machine design, automation, fabrication, and the development of cost-effective engineering solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design and develop wrapping machines, special-purpose machines, and End-of-Line Automation systems. Prepare 3D models, 2D manufacturing drawings, and assembly drawings using CAD software, preferably Solid Edge. Design machine frames, sheet-metal components, bent metal parts, and welded assemblies. Develop and integrate pneumatic systems, actuators, sensors, and mechanical automation components. Understand automation control concepts and coordinate with electrical and controls engineers for machine integration. Apply Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and cost-optimization principles. Select suitable mechanical and pneumatic components based on functionality, performance, availability, and cost. Coordinate with manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, suppliers, and service teams to resolve technical issues. Support machine assembly, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous product improvement. Ensure designs meet requirements for safety, reliability, ease of maintenance, and manufacturability. 
 Skills: Strong mechanical design and machine development skills. Good knowledge of automation control systems and End-of-Line Automation. Experience in metal sheet bending, fabrication, welded assemblies, and machine structures. Proficiency in Solid Edge CAD software is an added advantage. Knowledge of pneumatic systems and component selection. Basic understanding of electrical diagrams, sensors, actuators, and mechatronics. Ability to develop economical, practical, and manufacturable design solutions. Good English communication skills. Ability to work independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams. 
 Experience: 3-10 years of relevant experience in wrapping machines, special-purpose machinery, packaging machinery, or End-of-Line Automation. Candidates with substantial hands-on experience may be considered irrespective of formal educational qualifications.

title: Senior US Payroll Specialist
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We are seeking a Senior Payroll Specialist to join our in-house North America (NAM) payroll team. This is a high-impact, hybrid role that owns the most complex payroll processing, escalations, and systems and compliance initiatives, while overseeing and reviewing the day-to-day transactional work delivered by the Payroll  team. As part of Toast’s internal payroll organization — not a third-party payroll bureau or outsourced provider — you will act as a subject-matter expert across payroll operations, compliance, and systems; mentor Payroll Specialists and help prepare them for advancement; and serve as a key backup to the Payroll Team Lead. Based in India, this position supports payroll for employees in the NAM region; it does not involve India payroll processing.  A day in the life (Responsibilities)  Payroll Operations & Volume: Oversee accurate and timely processing of bi-weekly multi-state payrolls for more than 5,700 employees across the US, Canada, and Mexico, with day-to-day transaction processing primarily executed by the Payroll Specialist team. Personally owns and processes the most complex, escalated, and Mexico payroll cycles.  Complex Transactions & Global Mobility: Own complex and escalated payroll transactions that fall outside standard Specialist-level processing, including benefits-in-kind processing and overpayment calculations and repayments. Coordinate with third-party consultants and Global Mobility to input transferred employees' payroll information accurately and in a timely manner.  Employee Ticketing & Tier 2 Support: Support our internal and external customers who have payroll inquiries. Manage and respond to ServiceNow tickets accurately on the first instance. Proactively ensure all errors and issues are being resolved as indicated in the Service Level Agreement (SLA).  System & Data Management: Ensure Workday is maintained as the primary source of data integrity. Responsible for Workday EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder) mass data uploads, global mobility transactions, and serving as the lead tester for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and semi-annual Workday system releases.  Reporting & General Ledger: Review and analyze payroll and data analysis reports — including those generated by the Payroll Specialist team — to ensure audits are completed accurately and on time. Maintain and reconcile General Ledger accounts, ensuring accounts are balanced. Create content for dashboards and metrics as needed.  Compliance, SOX & Audits: Work with the Payroll Team Lead on quarterly reviews of the SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) payroll process and support Internal Audit requirements. Manage audits for 401K (US retirement savings plans), ESPP, Workers' Compensation, and review/approve monthly, quarterly, and annual equity audits. Review annual tax statements (W-2’s, T4’s) for all expatriate personnel to ensure accuracy.  Vendor Management & Tax Filings: Coordinate with ADP SmartCompliance and CloudPay on tax filings, notice resolutions, and reconciliations. Own ADP tax-registration administration, including applying for new SIT, SUI, and local tax IDs and maintaining accurate payroll tax records. Process Prior Quarter/Prior Year Tax adjustments as needed. Manage responses to all tax agency inquiries through ADP Tax Service and CloudPay.  Process Improvement & Troubleshooting: Audit current processes to reduce the number of payroll-related errors. Determine the root cause of payroll errors by collecting and analyzing information under strict deadlines. Assist with the development and final review of payroll policies, workflows, knowledge bases, and contingency plans. Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documentation, which is under the care of the Specialist.  Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the accounting team to assist with complex variance queries and balance sheet reconciliations, drawing on supporting data and documentation prepared by the Payroll Specialist team. Partner with Total Rewards to ensure smooth integration of payroll with other HR functions.  Leadership & Mentorship: Assist the Payroll Team Lead with training and mentoring the payroll team, including onboarding, upskilling, and preparing Payroll Specialists for advancement into the Senior Payroll Specialist role. Serve as a primary backup for Payroll Specialists.  What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical payroll experience preferred.  Experience: 8+ years of hands-on payroll processing experience, including 4+ years working directly in Workday, and ownership of complex, high-volume payroll cycles across multiple jurisdictions. US Workday Payroll & Absence Proficiency (Hard Requirement): Demonstrated hands-on experience processing US payroll and absence management in Workday is required. This must include executing EIB data loads, release and regression testing, and troubleshooting configuration or calculation issues.  Regional Expertise: In-depth working knowledge of NAM payrolls (US, Canada & Mexico), including multi-jurisdiction statutory and year-end requirements.  In-House / Corporate Payroll Environment: Demonstrated experience operating within an in-house or corporate payroll function, as opposed to a third-party payroll bureau or BPO, including direct partnership with internal stakeholders (HR, Total Rewards, Accounting) and end-to-end ownership of the payroll process.  Work Environment & Soft Skills: Ability to work independently as part of a team in a fast-paced environment and deliver results against deadlines, including performing effectively under sustained pressure.  Shift Commitment: Willingness and ability to work aligned to US Eastern business hours on an ongoing basis, including adapting to US daylight saving time transitions.  Leadership: Experience mentoring, training, or providing technical guidance to junior payroll staff.  US payroll certifications such as FPC (Fundamental Payroll Certification) or CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) are a plus.  Preferred Qualifications: Escalation Ownership: Experience acting as the primary point of escalation for complex payroll issues within an in-house or corporate payroll team.  Advanced Tools: Experience leveraging AI-powered reconciliation, analytics, or reporting tools (e.g., automated exception management, intelligent transaction matching, AI-assisted dashboards) to strengthen audit readiness.  Software Familiarity: Familiarity with ADP Smart Compliance, Cloud Pay, ServiceNow, or similar global payroll and tax software.  AI at Toast At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

 Our Total Rewards Philosophy We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

We help working professionals and career changers develop practical skills through applied learning, real-world projects, and career development support.

The role involves developing sales strategies, monitoring revenue targets, optimising lead conversion, and ensuring a high-quality learner engagement experience across international markets, particularly the UK.

Drive sales performance through effective lead allocation, pipeline reviews, conversion tracking, and follow-up planning. Analyse sales data, identify performance gaps, and implement strategies to improve conversion rates and revenue growth. Establish effective sales processes, reporting mechanisms, and performance tracking systems to improve operational efficiency. Support and guide sales advisors or counsellors in programme positioning, consultative selling, objection handling, and closing techniques, as applicable to the team structure. Ensure prospective learners receive accurate information about programme curriculum, learning outcomes, fees, payment options, and enrolment procedures. Coordinate with marketing, academic, and operations teams to improve lead quality, programme positioning, and the overall enrolment experience. Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and management dashboards.  Required Qualifications and Skills Graduate degree in any discipline. Relevant experience in international sales, EdTech sales, B2C sales, inside sales, or programme sales management. Proven track record of achieving revenue targets, improving sales conversions, and driving enrolment growth. Strong understanding of sales pipeline management, forecasting, performance reporting, and conversion metrics. Excellent communication, negotiation, consultative selling, and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency in CRM platforms, sales reporting tools, and pipeline tracking systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven approach to sales performance. Ability to manage priorities, drive accountability, and work towards ambitious business targets. Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to engage international prospects and working professionals. 
 Preferred Experience Experience in EdTech, professional certification, career upskilling, or online education sales. Exposure to international markets, particularly the UK. Familiarity with programmes in Data Analytics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI (GenAI), Machine Learning (ML), or related technology domains. Experience managing or mentoring sales advisors, admission counsellors, or business development professionals. Experience building sales processes, improving team productivity, and scaling enrolment operations. Experience in the preferred domains is an advantage. Candidates with strong sales management capabilities, a consistent record of revenue achievement, and the ability to learn new programme offerings are encouraged to apply. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue and enrolment targets. Improvement in lead-to-enrolment conversion rates. Improved learner engagement and enrolment experience. Development and implementation of strategies to support sustainable sales growth.

title: Network Manager
description:
Network Manager L2/L3 SME & Network Architecture Lead Location: Noida or Gurugram, India
 Shift: Evening/Night Shift (5:30 PM – 2:30AM) Both side Cab facility will be provided 
 Experience Required: 10+ years in networking
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role We are looking for a Network Manager who is both a hands-on L2/L3 Subject Matter Expert (SME) and a proven people leader. You will own network architecture, stability and roadmap for our voice-led KPO/BPO operations, lead the network engineers and IT SWAT team, and remain the final technical escalation point for the toughest issues. You are accountable for outcomes, not only fixes: uptime, voice quality, team capability and client confidence in our network. You will balance deep technical credibility with strong communication and people management. 
 Environment You Will Own Firewall: SonicWall (primary + secondary/HA), dual ISP, IPSec site-to-site VPN to client peer IP Switching: approx. 15 L3/core devices and 100 L2 access switches Wi-Fi: approx. 30 access points Servers: approx. 10 servers Voice: Vonage DID over internet, VDI-based agent desktops Locations: 3 sites (Noida 2, Gurugram) Monitoring: Zabbix, OPManager (distributed, proxy per site) with SNMP, syslog and scripted path monitoring 
 Key Responsibilities Network architecture and strategy Own the end-to-end network architecture across three sites: WAN/ISP design, dual-ISP and SonicWall HA failover, IPSec VPN to client peers, L3 core and L2 access design, Wi-Fi, and the VDI and voice traffic paths. Define and maintain the network roadmap, capacity plan and lifecycle/refresh plan, with business cases and budgets for IT leadership. Lead design reviews for new sites, new client onboarding, client-mandated connectivity and security requirements, and changes to voice infrastructure. Align the network design with global client security, compliance and audit expectations (for example ISO 27001 and client-specific requirements). L2/L3 SME and escalation ownership Be the final technical authority for firewall, switching, VPN, WAN, VDI connectivity and voice-path issues, and decide whether an issue is fixed on the spot or escalated to a vendor or ISP. Lead triage and the incident bridge on major disruptions, isolating LAN, WAN, VPN, firewall, VDI or carrier-side causes while giving clear updates to leadership and client stakeholders. Diagnose complex IPSec VPN problems (Phase 1/Phase 2 failures, IKE negotiation errors, SA lifetime mismatches, DPD misconfiguration) and interpret traceroute/MTR output and firewall and switch logs. Own root cause analysis and problem management for recurring issues, and track permanent fixes to closure instead of repeating quick fixes. Voice quality and resilience Own voice-quality escalations (jitter, packet loss, MOS, one-way audio, call drops) and decide whether the fix is internal (QoS, shaping, configuration) or needs Vonage engagement. Design, tune and validate QoS so voice (RTP/SIP) is prioritised on shared internet links. Validate dual-ISP failover behaviour and confirm the VPN and voice services re-establish cleanly after a failover. Monitoring, reporting and governance Own the Zabbix monitoring strategy: templates, triggers, severity mapping (P1–P4), dependencies and escalation actions, plus VPN tunnel and MTR/path monitoring to the client peer IP and US voice/application endpoints. Own the weekly issue-trend report and client-facing service reviews: recurring root causes, closure status and permanent-fix proposals. Define and enforce incident, change and problem management processes (ITIL), change windows, runbooks, and network DR/BCP documentation. Team leadership Lead, coach and develop the network engineers and the IT SWAT team across shifts: set goals, review performance, plan skills growth, manage rosters and coverage, and build succession. Build runbooks, escalation matrices and training so that one-engineer-per-shift coverage works without depending on a single person. Hire and onboard network talent, and set the standard for technical interviews and capability assessment. Build a blameless culture of root cause analysis and continuous improvement. Vendor and stakeholder management Own the relationships and SLAs with SonicWall, ISPs and Vonage; manage escalations and provide input on renewals and contracts. Communicate with global clients, operations heads and IT leadership, explaining technical issues and trade-offs in business terms. Partner with Operations, Information Security and Infrastructure teams on changes, audits and client requirements. Required Skills and Experience 12+ years in enterprise networking, with deep experience in the KPO/BPO/ITES industry or a similar voice-dependent, client-facing operation. Global experience: has supported or delivered networks for international clients and worked with multi-region stakeholders and teams. Proven network architecture capability: multi-site design with HA, dual-ISP, IPSec VPN and QoS for voice. Expert, credible hands-on L2/L3 knowledge: firewalls (SonicWall strongly preferred), switching, VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, STP and routing. Advanced IPSec VPN troubleshooting, and strong QoS and traffic-shaping knowledge for VoIP; Vonage or similar SIP trunk/DID experience is a plus. Practical experience with network monitoring platforms (Zabbix preferred; OpManager, PRTG, SolarWinds or similar): SNMP, traps, syslog, NetFlow, trigger and alert design. 5+ years of solid people management: building, coaching and rostering a team, handling performance, and growing capability. Excellent communication: confident with senior leadership and clients, calm and clear during incidents, and strong in written RCAs and reports. Working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and change management, vendor and SLA management, and budgeting. Comfortable making independent decisions during evening/night operations. Preferred Qualifications CCNP or CCIE; SonicWall certification (CSSA/CSNSA or advanced); ITIL Foundation or higher. Prior role as Network Manager or Network Lead in a global BPO/KPO. ISO 27001 awareness and exposure to client audits; exposure to cloud networking (Azure or AWS). Basic Linux and scripting (Bash/Python) for monitoring checks. Key Performance Indicators Reduction in recurring incidents (VDI disconnects, network interruptions, latency) week over week. Mean time to resolve (MTTR) for escalated incidents. Voice quality indicators (jitter, packet loss, MOS) within agreed thresholds. VPN and WAN availability throughout Quality and timeliness of root cause analysis and weekly reporting. Monitoring quality: alert accuracy and low false-positive rate. Team health: shift coverage, runbook coverage, skills development and retention. Client and stakeholder satisfaction in service reviews. What We Are Looking For A network leader who is still technical enough to be the final escalation point, and strong enough with people and stakeholders to run the team and the client conversation. Someone who thinks in architecture and root causes, communicates calmly under pressure, and turns every incident into a stronger network and a more capable team. 
 If interested Kindly share your resume at Muskan.shukla@nlbtech.com

 The role requires strong expertise in Apex programming, Lightning Web Components (LWC), integrations, and Salesforce platform customization. The candidate will work closely with business analysts, architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions while ensuring adherence to Salesforce development best practices, security standards, and performance optimization. 
 In an AI-enabled delivery environment, the candidate is expected to leverage AI tools in daily development activities to drive efficiency, quality, and faster delivery. 
 Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, and Visualforce. Implement custom business logic using Apex classes, triggers, batch Apex, queueable Apex, and scheduled jobs. Develop and customize Salesforce features including custom objects, fields, validation rules, record types, page layouts, and Lightning App Builder components. Build modern user interfaces using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce Lightning Experience. Implement integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, External Services, and Platform Events. Develop asynchronous and event-driven solutions using Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and Streaming API where applicable. Design and implement secure and scalable integrations using OAuth, connected apps, and API-based authentication mechanisms. Perform code reviews, debugging, and optimization to ensure high-quality and maintainable code. Write and maintain unit tests and achieve required Apex test coverage in accordance with Salesforce deployment requirements. Manage version control and CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Git, Salesforce DX (SFDX), and DevOps tools. Participate in technical design discussions, sprint planning, and agile development ceremonies. Collaborate with functional teams to analyze requirements and propose optimal Salesforce-based solutions. Ensure adherence to Salesforce governor limits, platform security, and performance best practices. Leverage AI tools in daily development activities to drive efficiency, quality, and faster delivery. 
 Must Have Minimum 3 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience (SFDC). Salesforce Certified Platform Developer certification. Strong experience in Apex programming, triggers, and asynchronous Apex (Batch, Queueable, Future methods). Hands-on experience developing Lightning Web Components (LWC) and working with Lightning Experience. Experience building REST/SOAP integrations with external systems. Solid understanding of Salesforce data model, relationships, and security model (Profiles, Permission Sets, Sharing Rules, Role Hierarchy). Experience with Salesforce DX (SFDX), metadata deployment, and version control systems such as Git. Experience working with Salesforce APIs including REST API, Bulk API, and Metadata API. Experience with Salesforce Flow (Record-Triggered Flow, Scheduled Flow, Screen Flow) for automation. Strong knowledge of Salesforce governor limits, performance optimization, and debugging techniques. Experience writing Apex unit tests and ensuring high code coverage. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies. Hands-on experience in AI prompt writing and effective use of AI tools to drive productivity improvement.

We are looking for a visual thinker and storyteller who understands how to build a visual narrative, develop a creative direction and communicate an idea through design, imagery, typography, motion and video. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Job Description: 
 DeeVita is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the vision, roadmap and delivery of our regulatory compliance software products and services for the pharmaceutical industry, spanning digital labelling, serialization and track-and-trace, and supply chain traceability. You will work directly with global pharma clients, translating complex regulatory requirements and industry standards such as GS1, DSCSA, EU FMD, ePI and GxP into validated, scalable products. You will partner closely with engineering, QA and validation teams, and with client stakeholders in regulatory affairs, quality and supply chain, from discovery through release. 
 We are a team of talented, collaborative engineers who are passionate about making a difference in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industry. Join us to help shape how medicines are labeled, tracked and safely delivered to patients worldwide, using modern technology in a fast-paced, supportive environment. 
 Roles & Responsibilities: 
 Program Management 
 Work with cross functional teams across the client organization spread worldwide spanning regulatory, business, partners, engineering, clinical trials, labelling, etc. to drive program objectives end to end from inception to delivery Monitor evolving global regulations and guidance from health authorities (US FDA, EMA, CDSCO and others) and convert them into product requirements and roadmap priorities. Influence stakeholders across the organization through effective communication, excellence in subject matter expertise and systems knowledge to plan, design and deliver programs and systems objectives that create greater impact for clients Act as the primary product contact for global pharma clients (US, EU and other regions), leading requirement workshops, product demos and roadmap reviews. Communicate product status, release plans, risks and decisions clearly to internal leadership and client stakeholders. Collaborate with client-side regulatory affairs, quality, supply chain and IT teams, as well as technology partners and vendors where applicable. Ensure data privacy and security requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA where applicable) are built into product design, in collaboration with IT and security teams. Product Strategy & Roadmap Own the product vision, roadmap and prioritized backlog for pharma regulatory compliance solutions across digital labeling, serialization, traceability and supply chain. Conduct market, competitor and customer research to define product features, differentiation and release plans. Define product success metrics (client adoption, regulatory coverage, release quality, time-to-compliance) and track outcomes after release. Regulatory Compliance & GxP Translate regulatory requirements into clear PRDs, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, with end-to-end traceability from requirement to test (Requirements Traceability Matrix). Ensure products are designed and released as GxP-compliant systems in line with 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11 and GAMP 5 (CSV / CSA), including audit trails, electronic signatures, role-based access and data integrity (ALCOA+). Partner with QA and validation teams on validation deliverables such as URS, FS, risk assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ and validation summary reports, and support client audits and vendor qualification. Embed industry standards into product design, including GS1 (GTIN, GLN, SSCC, GS1 DataMatrix, EPCIS) and structured product information standards (HL7 FHIR ePI, ISO IDMP, FDA SPL). Delivery & Execution Drive Agile delivery with engineering and QA, including sprint planning, backlog refinement and release planning, aligned with formal change control for validated releases. Identify and manage risks, issues and dependencies across workstreams; drive timely mitigation and escalation. Ensure quality gates (testing, UAT, validation sign-off) are met before every release goes live. Drive Agile delivery with engineering and QA, including sprint planning, backlog refinement and release planning, aligned with formal change control for validated releases. Identify and manage risks, issues and dependencies across workstreams; drive timely mitigation and escalation. Ensure quality gates (testing, UAT, validation sign-off) are met before every release goes live. Required Qualifications: 7+ years of experience in software product management or product ownership, including at least 3 years in the pharma or life sciences industry Hands-on experience building or managing regulatory compliance systems in one or more of the following areas: digital labeling / ePI, labeling and artwork management, regulatory information management, serialization, track-and-trace, or pharma supply chain. Working knowledge of GS1 standards and at least one major traceability regulation, such as US DSCSA, EU Falsified Medicines Directive (FMD), or India's DGFT / CDSCO track-and-trace and QR code requirements. Experience delivering GxP-compliant applications, with working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5 and computer system validation (CSV / CSA). Proven experience working directly with global clients (preferably US / EU) in client-facing product or delivery roles. Excellent English communication skills across listening, reading, writing and speaking, with the confidence to present to senior client stakeholders from different cultural and language backgrounds Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams (engineering, QA, validation, business) simultaneously. Strong experience with Agile / Scrum and tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps and Confluence; ability to write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria. Preferred Qualifications: Knowledge of structured content and regulatory data standards such as HL7 FHIR (ePI), ISO IDMP, FDA SPL and EMA SPOR / PMS. Exposure to labeling workflows and documents (CCDS, USPI, EU SmPC / PIL) or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) platforms such as Veeva Vault. Experience with serialization and traceability platforms (e.g., TraceLink, SAP ATTP, rfxcel, Antares Vision, Optel) and EPCIS-based data exchange. Familiarity with ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) and ICH Q10, or with ISO 13485 and UDI requirements for medical devices and combination products. description:
About the Role   We are looking for a passionate  Data Engineer  to join our Mobile Advertising Platform engineering team. In this role, you will build highly scalable data platforms powering  Mobile Programmatic Advertising, RTB bidding systems, attribution, campaign optimization, fraud detection, and real-time analytics . You will design and implement distributed systems capable of processing  billions of mobile advertising events every day, including  ad requests, impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, in-app events, and auction logs . You'll leverage modern Big Data technologies, cloud platforms, and Generative AI to build intelligent analytics and automation solutions. 
 You'll collaborate with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and Backend Engineers to build next-generation Mobile AdTech products.   What You'll Do: Design and build highly scalable data platforms capable of processing billions of mobile advertising events with low latency and high availability.  Design and build ultra-low-latency, high-throughput data pipelines processing the full mobile event funnel — ad request impression click install in-app conversion event — including OpenRTB bid request/response logging, auction analytics, and win-rate/bid-landscape reporting across multiple SSPs and ad exchanges, using Kafka, Spark Streaming, Hadoop, and Snowflake on AWS.  Architect real-time campaign pacing and budget delivery systems, applying bid optimization techniques so spend controls and bid strategy adjustments react to live auction signals within seconds.  Architect and implement real-time streaming pipelines to ingest, process, and analyze billions of advertising events including impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, and in-app events.  Design and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models supporting Mobile AdTech use cases such as campaign reporting, attribution, audience segmentation, fraud detection, and revenue analytics. Design large-scale Invalid Traffic (IVT) and ad fraud detection systems — click spam, install hijacking, SDK spoofing, device farms — using rules-based and ML-driven detection across billions of daily events.  Develop backend services (Java, REST APIs, JDBC) supporting DSP bidding logic, campaign management tools, and reporting APIs. 
Design and develop GenAI-powered agents for analytics, operations, and data enrichment using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or custom orchestration frameworks.  Design systems that are highly available, fault tolerant, and optimized for low latency and high throughput.  Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and customer experience.  Work with Product Managers to define and implement new analytics capabilities and platform features.  Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation, retrospectives, and release planning. Perform architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews while promoting software engineering best practices. We'd Love for You to Have:
 1–5+ years of professional experience in Java backend development and data engineering.  Strong computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design principles.  Hands-on experience developing scalable backend services using Java, REST APIs, JDBC, and relational databases.  Strong experience building distributed data pipelines using Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS.  Experience designing and optimizing large-scale analytical data platforms for Mobile AdTech using Java, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS. Strong understanding of real-time event processing, distributed data systems, and data warehouse architectures. Familiarity with distributed query engines, modern data lake technologies, and high-performance analytical databases (e.g., Trino, Presto, ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi) is an added advantage.  Experience processing high-volume streaming data using Spark Streaming, Kafka Streams, or similar technologies. Good understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT design, and distributed computing concepts. Mobile AdTech Experience  Experience working with Mobile AdTech platforms or digital advertising ecosystems is highly preferred, including knowledge of: 
Direct experience with Real-Time Bidding (RTB), OpenRTB protocol, and Mobile DSP/SSP/Ad Exchange architecture. Familiarity with mobile SDK event tracking (impressions, clicks, installs, in-app events) and Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) integrations. Understanding of attribution methodologies (click-through, view-through, multi-touch based attribution).  Knowledge of mobile identity solutions (IDFA, GAID, IDFV) and the privacy landscape driving their deprecation.  Experience with campaign pacing, bid optimization, and budget delivery algorithms.  Background in ad fraud/IVT detection — click spam, install fraud, SDK spoofing.  Generative AI Experience  Experience building production-grade GenAI applications including: 
LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, etc.)  LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks Prompt engineering and prompt optimization  AI evaluation and observability  AI agents and workflow automation  Additional Preferred Skills  Experience building scalable, production-grade AI or data platforms. Strong SQL optimization and query performance tuning skills.  Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application development.  Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or AWS.  Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in distributed environments.  Demonstrated ability to achieve stretch goals in a fast-paced, highly collaborative engineering environment.  Ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams. description:
Job Title: Project Manager (PM) Rebar Detailing 
 Department Engineering / Structural Reinforcement Detailing 
 Job Purpose The Project Manager (PM) – Rebar Detailing will be responsible for managing structural reinforcement detailing projects in accordance with UK standards, relevant international metric standards, client requirements, and project specifications. The role involves leading rebar detailing teams, ensuring the quality and accuracy of reinforcement drawings and bar bending schedules, coordinating with clients, and ensuring timely project completion. 
 The candidate should have experience in UK rebar detailing standards or relevant international metric-standard projects, including UAE projects, with a strong focus on reinforcement detailing and project management rather than BIM. 
 Key Responsibilities Project Management Manage and supervise rebar detailing projects in accordance with applicable standards and client requirements. Ensure timely delivery of reinforcement detailing drawings, bar bending schedules (BBS), and related documentation. Monitor project schedules, deliverables, resource allocation, and team productivity. Coordinate with internal teams and clients to resolve project clarifications and technical queries. Plan project activities and ensure effective utilization of resources to meet delivery targets. 
 Technical Responsibilities Prepare, review, and oversee reinforcement detailing drawings and bar bending schedules. Ensure detailing compliance with applicable standards, including BS 8666, relevant BS EN standards, and project specifications, as applicable. Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, constructability, and correct reinforcement arrangement. Support the team in resolving complex reinforcement detailing and technical issues. Ensure correct interpretation of structural drawings, reinforcement layouts, sections, and schedules. Verify reinforcement quantities, bar marks, bending dimensions, and scheduling requirements. Ensure detailing deliverables comply with project-specific requirements and applicable standards. 
 Team Management Lead and guide a team of rebar detailers and checkers. Monitor team productivity and ensure adherence to project timelines and quality requirements. Conduct technical reviews and provide mentoring to team members. Support skill development and training within the rebar detailing team. Allocate tasks based on project priorities, team capabilities, and delivery schedules. Monitor individual and team performance to ensure project objectives are achieved. 
 Quality & Compliance Ensure all deliverables meet company quality standards, applicable detailing standards, and project-specific requirements. Implement quality checks and drawing reviews before submission to clients. Maintain accuracy and consistency in reinforcement drawings, bar bending schedules, and related documentation. Identify recurring detailing errors and implement corrective and preventive measures. Ensure compliance with client drafting guidelines, drawing procedures, and project documentation requirements. 
 Client Coordination Participate in client meetings to discuss project requirements, technical clarifications, and progress. Address client comments and ensure timely incorporation of feedback. Maintain effective client communication for smooth project execution. Coordinate with clients and other project stakeholders to resolve technical issues and avoid delays. Ensure client expectations regarding quality, scope, and delivery schedules are met. 
 Reporting Provide weekly project status updates covering progress, risks, deliverables, and resource utilization. Track project milestones and identify potential delays or resource constraints. Identify and escalate project issues, technical challenges, and delivery risks to management when necessary. Maintain project records, drawing submission status, and quality review documentation. 
 Required Qualifications B.E. in Civil Engineering is mandatory. 
 Experience 12–15 years of experience in structural reinforcement detailing or rebar detailing. Experience in UK rebar detailing standards or relevant international metric-standard projects, including UAE projects. Strong experience in managing rebar detailing teams, project delivery, quality control, and client coordination. Experience handling reinforcement detailing projects from initial drawing review through final submission. Proven ability to manage project schedules, resources, technical reviews, and client requirements. 
 Technical Skills Knowledge of UK reinforcement detailing standards, particularly BS 8666, and applicable BS EN standards and project requirements. Experience with relevant international metric standards and project-specific detailing requirements, including UAE projects. Strong understanding of reinforcement detailing, bar bending schedules (BBS), reinforced concrete structures, and construction drawings. 
 Proficiency in rebar detailing and drawing software, including : AutoCAD Rebar CAD CADSRC Revit 
 Ability to interpret structural engineering drawings, reinforcement layouts, sections, and reinforcement schedules. Experience checking reinforcement drawings, bar bending schedules, bar marks, bending dimensions, and detailing deliverables for accuracy and compliance. Familiarity with detailing workflows, drawing coordination, and BIM processes; however, the primary focus of the role is rebar detailing and project management. 
 Key Competencies Strong technical knowledge of reinforcement detailing. Project planning, execution, and delivery management. Team leadership and mentoring skills. Client communication and coordination skills. Quality control and technical review capabilities. Resource planning and workload management. Problem-solving, decision-making, and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

description:
Job Description: Accounts Executive Fees Management & Collections 
 Organisations: Rise N Shine Nursery & Radiant Minds Education
 Job Title: Accounts Executive Fees Management & Collections
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Location: Completely Remote / Work From Home
 Working Days: Monday to Saturday (6 days a week)
 Working Hours: 9-hour shift per day
 Monthly Salary: 50,00060,000, depending on experience and suitability 
 About the Role We are looking for a highly organised, proactive, and detail-oriented Accounts Executive to manage fee collection, invoicing, payment tracking, outstanding balances, and accounts-related follow-ups across two organisations: Rise N Shine Nursery and Radiant Minds Education. 
 Rise N Shine Nursery provides early years childcare and education, while Radiant Minds Education is a training provider offering professional qualifications and training programmes. 
 The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records for nursery children and training learners, ensuring invoices are raised on time, payments are recorded correctly, and outstanding fees are followed up promptly. 
 This role requires a strong sense of ownership, excellent communication skills, confidence in making payment reminder calls, and the ability to manage a high volume of accounts without overlooking any outstanding payment. 
 The ideal candidate will take responsibility for ensuring that every invoice, payment, instalment, and overdue balance is properly tracked and followed up until resolved. 
 As this is a fully remote position, the candidate must be self-motivated, disciplined, comfortable working independently, and capable of maintaining consistent communication with parents, learners, and internal management. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Nursery Fee Management Rise N Shine Nursery 
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of fees payable by all enrolled children. Prepare, raise, and issue invoices to parents in accordance with the nursery's fee structure, payment schedules, funding arrangements, and agreed terms. Track monthly nursery fees, deposits, registration fees, settling-in fees, additional charges, and any other applicable payments. Monitor all incoming payments and update the relevant records promptly to ensure that receipts are correctly allocated to the appropriate child and invoice. Identify overdue invoices, missed payments, underpayments, and discrepancies in fee accounts. Proactively contact parents by telephone, email, or other approved communication channels to remind them of upcoming and overdue payments. Follow up consistently with parents until outstanding payments are received or the matter is escalated to management. Maintain a clear record of all communication with parents, including call outcomes, payment promises, expected payment dates, and agreed arrangements. Monitor changes in children's attendance, room allocation, funding eligibility, and fee arrangements where these affect invoices, in coordination with the nursery management team. Ensure that payments, adjustments, credits, and funding-related changes are accurately reflected in the accounts. Escalate persistent non-payment, disputed invoices, or unresolved account discrepancies to management in a timely manner. 
 2. Learner Fee Management – Radiant Minds Education 
 Maintain complete and accurate fee records for learners enrolled in the organisation's training courses and qualification programmes. Track course fees, registration charges, instalment plans, payment deadlines, outstanding balances, and any agreed payment arrangements. Ensure that every learner has a clear payment record and that no instalment or scheduled payment is overlooked. Monitor upcoming instalment dates and contact learners in advance to remind them of their payment obligations. Make regular follow-up calls and send appropriate reminders to learners whose payments are due or overdue. Follow up on missed instalments, partial payments, failed transactions, and outstanding course fees until the matter is resolved or escalated. Maintain clear records of learner payment commitments, follow-up dates, responses, and reasons for delayed payments. Coordinate with admissions, course administration, assessors, and management where learner enrolment details or course changes affect payment arrangements. Identify learners with recurring payment delays and provide timely updates to management. Ensure all learner accounts remain accurate, transparent, and up to date throughout the duration of their enrolment. 
 3. Invoicing, Payment Tracking and Reconciliation 
 Raise and issue invoices accurately and within the required timelines. Maintain a centralised record of invoices raised, payments received, outstanding balances, and overdue accounts for both organisations. Verify payment information against available bank statements, payment confirmations, or authorised payment records. Record and allocate payments to the correct parent, child, learner, invoice, and payment period. Identify discrepancies between invoices, payments received, and outstanding balances. Investigate missing payments, duplicate entries, incorrect allocations, and differences in account balances. Maintain a clear audit trail of invoices, payment records, adjustments, and follow-up actions. Prepare regular reports showing total invoiced amounts, collections received, outstanding fees, overdue accounts, and upcoming payment deadlines. Support month-end account reviews and provide management with accurate collection and outstanding-payment summaries. Ensure that no invoice, payment, instalment, or overdue account is left unrecorded or without an appropriate follow-up action. 
 4. CRM and Financial Record Management 
 Maintain accurate and current records in the organisation's CRM, accounting software, spreadsheets, and other approved systems. Update each child's and learner's account with invoices, payments, outstanding balances, follow-up notes, and next action dates. Record every relevant phone call, email, reminder, payment commitment, and escalation in the CRM system. Ensure that the status of each account is clearly visible, such as paid, partially paid, due, overdue, awaiting confirmation, disputed, or escalated. Maintain a reliable follow-up schedule so that upcoming instalments and overdue accounts are never missed. Regularly review CRM records to identify missing information, overdue follow-ups, duplicate entries, and inconsistencies. Ensure that all financial records are organised, accessible to authorised staff, and maintained in accordance with internal procedures and data protection requirements. 
 5. Fee Collection and Follow-Up 
 Take full ownership of the fee collection process from invoice issuance through payment receipt and account closure. Make regular outbound calls to parents and learners regarding upcoming payments, overdue fees, and missed instalments. Follow a structured reminder process, including advance reminders, payment-due notifications, overdue follow-ups, and escalation where required. Communicate payment expectations, deadlines, outstanding balances, and approved payment arrangements clearly and professionally. Obtain realistic payment commitments from parents and learners and follow up on the agreed dates. Maintain a daily list of payments due, payments expected, overdue accounts, and pending follow-up actions. Prioritise high-value outstanding balances, long-overdue accounts, and accounts with repeated missed commitments. Ensure that no account remains unattended simply because a reminder was missed or a follow-up was not recorded. Escalate accounts that remain unpaid after the prescribed follow-up process, following management-approved procedures. Maintain a professional, respectful, and solution-focused approach while ensuring that payment obligations are communicated firmly and consistently. 
 6. Reporting and Management Updates 
 Prepare daily updates on payments received, payments expected, overdue accounts, and follow-up activities. Provide weekly collection reports separately for Rise ’N’ Shine Nursery and Radiant Minds Education. Maintain an updated list of all outstanding accounts, including the amount due, due date, duration overdue, last contact date, and next action. Highlight accounts where payment has been promised but not received. Report recurring collection issues, unusual payment patterns, and potential risks to cash flow. Support management with monthly summaries of total fees invoiced, total collections, outstanding balances, and collection performance. Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and supported by the underlying financial records. Proactively notify management of discrepancies, system issues, or any matter that could affect fee collection or financial accuracy. 
 Essential Skills and Requirements 
 Previous experience in accounts, billing, fee collection, credit control, accounts receivable, or payment follow-up. Strong numerical and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail. Experience preparing invoices, tracking payments, managing outstanding balances, and maintaining financial records. Confidence in making regular outbound calls to parents, learners, customers, or clients regarding payments. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts, payment deadlines, and follow-up schedules simultaneously. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including maintaining trackers and preparing reports. Experience using CRM systems, accounting software, or other financial record-management tools. Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate payment issues, and maintain accurate records. Strong follow-through, accountability, and a proactive approach to resolving outstanding payments. Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and manage time effectively. Professional handling of confidential financial and personal information. 
 Preferred Qualifications and Experience A degree, diploma, or relevant qualification in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or Business Administration. Experience in accounts receivable, credit control, collections, or fee administration. Previous experience working with a nursery, childcare setting, education provider, training institute, or course-fee payment system. Familiarity with recurring monthly payments, learner instalment plans, invoice management, and payment reconciliation. Experience maintaining CRM systems and preparing daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be assessed against the following measures: 
 Invoice accuracy: Invoices are raised correctly and issued within the agreed timelines. Payment tracking: All payments received are recorded and allocated accurately. Collection follow-up: Every due and overdue account receives the required follow-up within the agreed timeframe. No missed instalments: All scheduled payments are tracked, with reminders and follow-ups completed as required. CRM accuracy: Account records, call notes, payment commitments, and next action dates are maintained consistently. Outstanding account management: Overdue balances are actively monitored, followed up, and escalated where necessary. Reporting: Daily, weekly, and monthly reports are submitted accurately and on time. Reconciliation: Payment discrepancies are identified and resolved or escalated promptly. Accountability: Promised payments and pending actions are monitored until resolved. Professional communication: Parents and learners receive clear, timely, respectful, and consistent payment communications. 
 Confidentiality and Professional Conduct 
 The Accounts Executive will have access to sensitive financial records, parent and learner contact details, and internal business information. The successful candidate must maintain strict confidentiality, follow approved data protection and information-security procedures, and use financial information only for authorised business purposes. 
 The candidate must not make unauthorised changes to fee structures, payment terms, refunds, discounts, or account adjustments. Any disputed payment, exceptional arrangement, or suspected discrepancy must be documented and referred to the appropriate manager. 
 What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and understands that accurate fee management is essential to the smooth running of both organisations. 
 The ideal candidate will not simply update spreadsheets or make occasional reminder calls. They will actively monitor every account, anticipate upcoming payments, follow up on missed instalments, maintain accurate CRM records, and ensure that management always has a clear picture of the financial position. 
 The primary objective of this role is to ensure that every fee due is accounted for, every payment received is recorded, every outstanding balance is followed up, and no payment is missed due to a lack of tracking or follow-through. 
 How to Apply Candidates with relevant experience in accounts management, invoicing, payment collection, and outstanding-fee follow-up are encouraged to apply. 
 Please submit your CV highlighting your relevant experience, accounting or CRM software knowledge, and experience managing customer or learner payments.

Location : Hyderabad, Bangalore and Mumbai  Job Description  As a Senior Data Engineer , you will own the end-to-end data platform, from raw data ingestion through transformation to trusted, business-ready datasets. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, reliable, and high-quality data pipelines that power analytics and decision-making across the organization. This role requires someone who can make sound architectural decisions, balance trade-offs, and deliver production-grade solutions in a fast-paced environment. You'll partner closely with analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders, ensuring data solutions are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with business needs. A strong bias for action, systems thinking, and expertise in modern data engineering practices are essential. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines from ingestion to curated, trusted data models. Develop scalable and maintainable data transformation layers using modern transformation frameworks. Design and optimize data warehouse schemas and data models to support reporting and analytics. Write highly efficient, production-grade SQL and optimize complex queries for performance. Build, maintain, and monitor orchestration workflows, ensuring proper dependency management and data lineage. Implement data quality, validation, monitoring, and reliability practices to ensure trusted datasets. Make architecture and design decisions while balancing scalability, maintainability, and delivery speed. Collaborate closely with analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into robust data solutions. Proactively identify improvements in data architecture, pipeline performance, and engineering practices. Leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and accelerate delivery. Build solutions that are production-ready, scalable, and resilient while maintaining high development velocity. Must-Have Skills Technical Skills Expert-level proficiency in SQL , including complex query optimization, performance tuning, and advanced data modeling. Strong expertise in data warehousing concepts , dimensional modeling, and analytical database design. Hands-on experience with modern data transformation frameworks such as:
 dbt SQLMesh Strong understanding of workflow orchestration, DAG design, dependency management, and data lineage. Experience designing and maintaining reliable, production-grade data pipelines. Strong knowledge of data quality frameworks, testing, validation, and monitoring. Excellent systems thinking with the ability to design scalable and maintainable data architectures. Proven ability to deliver high-quality solutions in fast-paced, agile environments. AI & LLM Skills (Mandatory) Demonstrated hands-on experience using Large Language Models (LLMs) as a core part of the software development lifecycle, including: Prompt engineering Context engineering Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Vector embeddings and vector search Token optimization and context management LLM evaluations and quality assessment Guardrails and hallucination mitigation Function calling, tool use, and AI workflow orchestration Candidates should have practical experience integrating AI into engineering workflows rather than limited exposure or experimentation. Professional Skills Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to challenge requirements constructively and provide technical guidance. Strong ownership mindset with the ability to make informed technical decisions independently. Bias toward execution, continuous improvement, and delivering business value. Nice-to-Have Skills Hands-on experience building and operating data platforms on Databricks . Experience with AI-assisted or "vibe coding" approaches to software development. Exposure to fintech, banking, payments, or financial services data platforms. Experience designing scalable data architectures in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with modern DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and observability practices. Experience working in high-growth startups or small engineering teams with broad ownership.
