title: L3 Observability
description:
Job Description for L3 Managed Service Engineer - Observability 
 Role Summary 
Level 3 Managed Service Engineer serves as the senior escalation point and technical authority for end-to-end observability across the environment. This role is responsible for resolving or driving resolution of highly complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies, while owning observability strategy, Datadog architecture, monitoring standards, and continuous improvement. The engineer is expected to guide L1 and L2 engineers, lead root cause analysis and major incident reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve detection, reduce noise, and strengthen operational resilience for both 3-tier and cloud-native applications.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Serve as the final escalation and technical authority for complex, cross-domain incidents involving application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies. Own the end-to-end observability architecture and strategy in Datadog, including instrumentation standards, tagging strategy, dashboard governance, and monitor design principles. Lead root cause analysis for major/critical incidents and drive post-incident reviews, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring are implemented. Define and continuously improve monitoring coverage for new and existing services, including 3-tier applications, microservices, and cloud-native workloads. Design and govern SLOs/SLIs aligned to business-critical services, and advise application and platform teams on instrumentation best practices. Drive automation initiatives: Datadog-as-code (Terraform/API-based configuration management), auto-remediation workflows, and integration with CI/CD pipelines. Partner with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to close monitoring gaps and reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR). Own capacity planning and performance engineering insights derived from long-term observability data trends. Manage Datadog platform health: cost optimization, license/usage governance, data retention, and integration management. Mentor L1 and L2 engineers, review their RCA quality, and build enablement material (runbooks, training, best practices). Act as a key stakeholder in client governance calls, presenting trends, risks, and improvement roadmaps. Evaluate and pilot new Datadog features or complementary observability tools, and lead their rollout. Define escalation matrices and coordinate cross-team response during major outages. Required Skills and Experience 
 6+ years of experience in Managed Services, SRE, or platform engineering roles, with at least 3 years of hands-on ownership of a Datadog (or equivalent) observability platform at scale. Expert-level knowledge of Datadog, including: Platform architecture: organization/team structuring, RBAC, tagging strategy, and multi-environment setups. APM: distributed tracing at scale, service dependency mapping, and instrumentation strategy across polyglot environments. Synthetics and RUM: designing comprehensive digital experience monitoring strategies tied to business KPIs. Log Management: pipeline architecture, log-based metrics, and cost/volume governance. SLOs, error budgets, and anomaly/forecast-based alerting at an advanced level. Deep understanding of infrastructure and cloud architecture: compute, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes), auto-scaling, and multi-cloud/hybrid environments. Deep understanding of networking: routing, load balancing, CDN, DNS, and complex connectivity troubleshooting across hybrid environments. Strong incident and problem management leadership experience, including major incident command and post-incident review facilitation. Experience defining and governing observability standards across multiple teams or business units. Application & Architecture Understanding (technology-agnostic) 
 Expert-level understanding of 3-tier and N-tier application architectures, including how failures cascade across presentation, application, and data layers. Expert-level understanding of cloud-native and distributed architectures: microservices, event-driven systems, service meshes, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging. Ability to advise application teams on observability best practices (instrumentation, tracing context propagation, structured logging) without needing to write code in a specific language. Strong grasp of resiliency and failure patterns (retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, caching, graceful degradation) and how to detect their failure modes through observability data. Good to Have 
 Datadog advanced/expert certifications, or equivalent recognized observability certifications. Strong scripting/automation background (Python, Terraform, or similar) for Datadog-as-code and custom tooling. Experience with FinOps or cost governance for observability tooling at scale. Exposure to multiple observability ecosystems (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Experience presenting to senior stakeholders or clients on observability maturity and roadmaps. Soft Skills 
 Strategic thinking with the ability to balance immediate incident needs against long-term platform health. Strong leadership and mentoring capability across L1/L2 engineers. Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills. Calm, decisive leadership during major incidents. Strong documentation and process-governance discipline. Education 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Work Details 
 Level: L3 (Senior/Lead, Managed Services) Shift: Primarily general shift, with on-call responsibility for major incident escalations Reporting To: Observability Practice Lead / Delivery Manager

title: Supply Chain & Warehouse Manager (Food Processing Unit)
description:
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced and strategic Supply Chain & Warehouse Manager to lead end-to-end supply chain operations at our food processing unit in Hyderabad. The ideal candidate will be responsible for procurement of raw materials and packaging, inventory planning, warehouse management, logistics, and distribution. You will ensure uninterrupted material availability for production, maintain optimal inventory levels, and drive cost efficiencies while upholding food safety and FIFO/FEFO standards in storage. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Supply Chain Planning & Procurement: Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned with production plans and sales forecasts. Plan and procure raw materials (flours, starches, proteins, oils, seasonings) and packaging materials in coordination with the R&D and QA teams. Identify, evaluate, and onboard reliable suppliers; negotiate pricing, terms, and lead times. Monitor market trends and commodity price fluctuations to optimize procurement costs. Coordinate with Production, QA, and R&D teams to ensure material specifications and approvals are met. 2. Inventory & Demand Planning: Drive S&OP (Sales & Operations Planning) processes with Sales, Production, and Finance teams. Maintain optimal inventory levels (RM, PM, WIP, FG) to avoid stockouts and excess inventory. Monitor inventory turns, ageing, and slow-moving/non-moving stock; implement corrective actions. Ensure accurate MRP (Material Requirement Planning) and production scheduling support. 3. Warehouse Management: Oversee all warehouse operations receiving, storage, issuance, and dispatch of raw materials, packaging, and finished goods. Ensure strict adherence to FIFO/FEFO , food safety, and GMP standards in storage areas. Maintain warehouse layout, space utilization, and cold/ambient storage conditions as per product requirements. Implement and monitor WMS (Warehouse Management System) and barcode/stock accuracy systems. Conduct regular cycle counts, physical stock verification, and reconciliation of discrepancies. 4. Logistics & Distribution: Manage inbound and outbound logistics transporter selection, freight negotiation, and route optimization. Ensure timely dispatch of finished goods to distributors, modern trade, and institutional customers. Track shipments, resolve transit issues, and monitor OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance. Handle documentation for GST, e-way bills, and statutory compliance related to logistics. 5. Compliance, Cost & Team Management: Ensure compliance with FSSAI storage norms, statutory requirements, and internal audit standards. Drive cost reduction initiatives across procurement, warehousing, and logistics. Lead, train, and mentor the supply chain and warehouse teams. Maintain MIS reports on procurement, inventory, dispatch, and supply chain KPIs. Key Requirements (Must-Have) Education: MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Logistics, or a related field Experience: 4 to 8 years of experience in supply chain and warehouse management within the Food Processing / FMCG industry . Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of MRP, inventory planning, warehouse operations, and food safety storage norms (FIFO/FEFO, GMP). Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP/Oracle/Microsoft Dynamics) and WMS; strong MS Excel skills. Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with FSSAI storage norms, GST/e-way bill compliance, and logistics documentation. Strong Experience in Handling Logistics & Transport Companies in Hyderabad. Skills & Competencies Strong negotiation and vendor management skills. Excellent planning, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Proven leadership and team management capabilities. Effective communication and cross-functional coordination skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume manufacturing environment.

Key Skills: Operations,Store management,Processing,Stores,UNIT,SCM,Supply chain,Sourcing

title: Senior Lead Production Engineer
description:
Main Purpose:- 
 The Senior Lead Production Engineer will drive production optimization and performance enhancement across conventional oil & gas fields and CBM assets. The role is responsible for maximizing hydrocarbon recovery through integrated production engineering, well performance analysis, network modelling, artificial lift optimization, flow assurance, and field operations support. The incumbent will work closely with operations, subsurface, drilling and completions teams to identify production opportunities, resolve technical bottlenecks, manage production risks, and develop sustainable strategies for long-term asset performance while ensuring compliance with Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) standards. 
 Job Accountabilities 1. Production Performance Analysis & Optimization Monitor and analyse well, field and network production performance against production potential, identifying production losses, deferrals and improvement opportunities. Conduct well inflow and outflow analysis, nodal analysis and integrated production system modelling to optimize well and network performance. Build and maintain well and network models using industry-standard simulation tools such as OLGA, PIPESIM, PROSPER and GAP. Identify and implement opportunities to improve well productivity, production rates, recovery and overall network efficiency. Analyse production constraints and recommend remedial actions to sustain and enhance field performance. Support the development of short-, medium- and long-term production optimization strategies aligned with asset and business objectives. 2. Well, Production Operations & Artificial Lift Support Provide hands-on technical expertise in production operations, well completions,well interventions and sand control. Evaluate,design and optimize the performance of artificial lift systems, including PCP, SRP and Gas Lift, considering well and field operating constraints. Support the development and execution of well intervention and artificial lift optimization strategies to sustain and enhance production. Troubleshoot production and operational challenges in collaboration with field operations and technical teams. Provide technical support and recommendations on basic surface processing facilities and production systems. Drive the adoption of innovative technologies and best practices to improve production efficiency and operational reliability. 3. Flow Assurance & Production Risk Management Develop and implement effective flow assurance strategies to identify, prevent and mitigate production risks. Address operational challenges related to hydrate formation, sand production, wax deposition and scale management to minimize production losses and downtime. Apply integrated well and network analysis to identify and resolve flow-related bottlenecks. Provide support on subsea flow assurance requirements, where applicable. Collaborate with surface, subsurface and operations teams to develop integrated solutions for complex production and flow assurance challenges. 4. Technical Assurance & Compliance Provide independent technical review and assurance for production optimization plans, production management proposals and key engineering decisions. Conduct technical risk assessments and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are incorporated into production strategies and operations. Ensure compliance with company standards, applicable regulations and international oil & gas industry practices. Promote and uphold the highest standards of Health, Safety and Environment (HSE)across all production-related activities. 5. Collaboration & Technical Leadership Partner with multidisciplinary and site-based teams to identify and implement production optimization initiatives. Lead and mentor production engineers, strengthening technical capability and fostering a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement. Act as a key technical interface between operations, subsurface, drilling,completions and other stakeholders. Support knowledge sharing, technical problem-solving and the implementation of best practices across assets. Functional Competencies Strong hands-on experience in production operations, production engineering,well completions and well interventions. Expertise in well performance analysis, including inflow and outflow analysis, nodal analysis and production optimization. Strong experience in well and network modelling using tools such as OLGA,PIPESIM, PROSPER, GAP or equivalent simulation software. Experience in the design, analysis and optimization of artificial lift systems, including PCP, SRP and Gas Lift. Strong knowledge of sand control and sand production management. Good understanding of basic surface processing facilities and production systems. Expertise in flow assurance, including hydrate, wax, scale and sand management. Experience in subsea flow assurance will be an added advantage. Strong understanding of production optimization methodologies, integrated asset modelling and production network management. Sound knowledge of HSE regulations, technical assurance processes and upstream oil & gas industry best practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management and technical leadership skills. 
 Education B.E./B.Tech in Petroleum or Chemical Engineering. 
 Experience Minimum 14 years of relevant experience in the upstream oil & gas industry. Demonstrated expertise in production engineering, field operations, production optimization, well performance management and integrated production systems.

title: Export Logistic || Chemical Manufacturing || Santacruz (East) - Mumbai
description:
We are looking for an experienced export logistics professional to handle shipments from our EOU and SEZ manufacturing units. A large share of these shipments are hazardous chemicals. The person will manage day-to-day exports, work closely with internal teams and logistics partners, and understand how shipment decisions affect safety, compliance and cost. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Export Operations 
 Plan and carry out sea and air export shipments with Sales, Production, Planning, Stores, QA and Customer Service. Arrange freight bookings, containers, transportation and customs clearance. Handle factory stuffing and self-sealing in line with the permission conditions. Track vessel and flight schedules, cut-offs and shipment progress, and inform stakeholders of any changes. Resolve booking issues, delays and documentation problems. 
 Hazardous Cargo (DG) Shipments 
 Handle hazardous chemical exports by sea and air safely and in line with the applicable dangerous goods rules. Read Safety Data Sheets (SDS), especially the UN number, hazard class, packing group and marine pollutant status. Check that packaging is UN-approved and that marking, labelling and placarding are correct. Prepare and check DG declarations and other hazardous cargo documents before submission. Get DG approvals from shipping lines and airlines in advance, and plan around port, terminal, vessel and aircraft restrictions. Check segregation and compatibility when hazardous products are shipped together or with non-hazardous cargo. 
 EOU / SEZ Compliance 
 Handle export procedures for both EOU and SEZ units. Make sure shipments follow the unit's approval conditions and applicable procedures. Coordinate with plant teams, customs brokers and the relevant authorities. Keep up to date with relevant Customs, DGFT, SEZ and GST changes, and flag anything that affects operations. 
 Documentation and Export Incentives 
 Review invoices, packing lists, shipping bill checklists and BL/AWB drafts. Make sure quantities, values, HS codes, consignee details, Incoterms and SDS details match across all documents. Ensure correct declarations on export documents, including the scheme (EOU/SEZ), LUT, self-sealing details and export incentives such as RoDTEP. Coordinate Certificates of Origin, insurance and other shipment requirements. Follow up for final shipping documents and proof-of-export records. 
 GST and Incoterms 
 Apply basic GST knowledge to export transactions and work with Finance on invoicing, e-way bills and refund records. Use Incoterms to decide responsibility for freight, insurance, delivery and customs. Check customer terms against freight quotations and shipping instructions before confirming arrangements. 
 Freight Costs and Accounting 
 Get and compare freight quotations, including DG surcharges, and support negotiations. Check vendor invoices against agreed rates, Incoterms and the services actually provided. Understand debit and credit entries, vendor balances, advances and debit/credit notes. Find incorrect or duplicate charges and follow up on pending credits. Work with Finance on invoice processing, vendor reconciliation and payment follow-up. Avoid unnecessary detention, demurrage and storage charges. Reporting 
 Prepare SAP-based sales, pending-order and freight-cost reports. Maintain shipment trackers and pending-action lists. Keep shipment records ready for audits, reconciliations and management reviews. Suggest practical improvements to reduce delays and errors.

Key Skills: Freight,Export Logistics,Chemical Manufacturing,Export,EOU,Logistics,Chemical,Export documentation

title: Brand Visualiser (Video Editing / Design / Motion)
description:
Design, Motion & Visual Communication Experience: 6-7+ Years Function: Brand / Marketing / Creative Company: DTDC Express Ltd. 
 About the Role 
 DTDC is looking for a Senior Brand Visualiser who can translate brand and communication objectives into compelling visual ideas and execute them across multiple formats. This is not a traditional graphic design or video-editing role. We are looking for a visual thinker and storyteller who understands how to build a visual narrative, develop a creative direction and communicate an idea through design, imagery, typography, motion and video. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable conceptualising a campaign, creating its visual language, designing the static assets and bringing the idea to life through motion and video. The role also requires strong hands-on knowledge of Generative AI and AI-powered creative workflows, including image generation, video generation, voice, avatars and prompt engineering. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Visualisation & Creative Conceptualisation Develop creative concepts and visual directions based on brand, marketing and communication objectives. Translate a brief or business problem into a strong visual idea or creative concept. Develop Key Visuals (KVs), campaign territories, moodboards, storyboards and visual narratives. Decide how an idea should be communicated visually across different platforms and formats. Think beyond individual creatives and build connected visual systems for campaigns. Develop visual storytelling through composition, typography, imagery, colour, illustration, motion and sequencing. Present and communicate creative concepts clearly to internal stakeholders and explain the thinking behind the visual direction. Ensure that creative ideas are both conceptually strong and relevant to the DTDC brand. Brand & Graphic Design Design high-quality creative assets across digital, social, print, internal communication and marketing platforms. Develop campaign KVs, social media creatives, digital banners, mailers, presentations, OOH creatives, internal communication and other brand collaterals. Maintain strong visual consistency and adherence to DTDC's brand identity. Have a strong understanding of typography, layout, colour, hierarchy, composition and visual communication. Adapt a single creative idea into multiple formats while retaining its core visual identity. Create designs that are not only aesthetically strong but also communicate the intended message clearly and quickly. 
 Video & Motion 
 Conceptualise and create videos, reels, motion graphics and short-form brand content. Translate static campaign ideas into motion and video narratives. Create storyboards, shot concepts and visual sequences before production. Edit and produce videos using professional video-editing and motion-graphics tools. Understand pacing, transitions, visual rhythm, sound and storytelling. Collaborate with internal teams, production partners, photographers, videographers and other creative stakeholders where required. 
 AI & Generative Creative 
 Use AI as an integral part of the creative process to improve ideation, experimentation, production and visual storytelling. Hands-on experience with tools such as: ChatGPT: ideation, creative development, research and prompt engineering Nano Banana: AI image generation and image manipulation Seedream: AI image generation Seedance: AI video generation and animation Runway: AI video generation and creative production Adobe Firefly: generative design and image creation ElevenLabs: AI voice generation and sound HeyGen: AI avatars and video generation Other emerging AI image, video, audio and creative tools The candidate should be able to evaluate different AI tools and determine which tool and workflow is appropriate for a particular creative requirement. 
 Software & Technical Skills Design Adobe Photoshop Adobe Illustrator Adobe InDesign Video Adobe Premiere Pro Adobe After Effects DaVinci Resolve AI / Creative Technology ChatGPT Nano Banana Seedream Seedance Runway Adobe Firefly ElevenLabs HeyGen Other emerging Generative AI platforms Knowledge of Blender / 3D would be an added advantage.

The Factor Analytics Product Specialist team is technically and analytically skilled team that develops and presents solutions to prospective and existing clients to help them improve their investment process. The spectrum of knowledge and activities is very broad and includes Risk, Performance, Optimization, Stress Testing, ESG, Climate Risk and Private Assets.   The team contributes to success of sales and associated revenue generation by delivering and presenting analytical content during the positioning stage of the sales cycle. The team is focusing on the functional positioning, product differentiation and client driven solutions. Through in-depth understanding of the prospective client’s business needs, the team helps find practical solutions that may involve multiple MSCI products and cross team collaboration. The team also supports the upselling and cross-selling opportunities with existing clients. The candidate should also be a quick learner, productive and creative with an ability to thrive in a global organization. Excellent communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills. Client relationship management experience in the financial services industry. Bachelor’s Degree in engineering/quantitative background/computer science/finance/economics/mathematics. Master’s Degree is preferred. Hands-on experience with programming and data visualization tools like, python, Spotfire, Power BI, tableau is a must .   What we offer you Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing. Job Description: Field Sales Engineer Department: Sales & Business Development
 Company: BlueMaarlin
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Experience: Experienced candidates only
 Work Location: Maharashtra Pune, Mumbai, Nashik, Nagpur and Sambhajinagar Job Overview BlueMaarlin is looking for an experienced, proactive, and result-oriented Field Sales Engineer with strong business development capabilities and a sound understanding of technical sales. The candidate should have experience in identifying new business opportunities, developing customer relationships, generating inquiries, and converting leads into orders. The candidate will be responsible for handling both OEM sales and end-user sales , regularly visiting customers, understanding their technical requirements, preparing basic proposals and quotations, conducting follow-ups, and achieving business development targets across Maharashtra. The ideal candidate must have good market knowledge, excellent communication and convincing skills, and the ability to professionally represent the company in front of customers. Key Responsibilities 1. Business Development & Market Expansion Identify and develop new business opportunities across Maharashtra. Generate new customers, inquiries, and sales leads through field visits, market research, references, networking, and other business development activities. Develop and maintain relationships with OEMs, EPC contractors, consultants, industrial customers, dealers, and end users. Understand market trends, competitor activities, customer requirements, and upcoming industrial projects. Identify potential customers and convert business opportunities into qualified leads and sales inquiries. Expand the company's customer base and develop long-term business relationships. 2. OEM Sales & End-User Sales Independently handle OEM sales as well as direct end-user sales. Understand the requirements of OEMs, consultants, project contractors, and industrial clients. Develop new OEM accounts and maintain regular communication with existing customers. Visit industrial end users to understand their requirements and identify potential applications for the company's products. Coordinate with customers, internal technical teams, and management to develop suitable solutions. Follow up on ongoing projects, upcoming requirements, and repeat business opportunities. 3. Customer Visits & Field Activities Work in the field for 4 days per week and in the office for 2 days per week . Plan regular customer visits and maintain an organized field visit schedule. Take appointments before visiting customers and ensure productive meetings. Conduct frequent customer visits in Pune and Mumbai , along with planned visits to Nashik, Nagpur, and Sambhajinagar. Meet customers to discuss technical requirements, ongoing projects, new inquiries, quotations, and order status. Build strong customer relationships through consistent communication and regular visits. Submit daily visit reports and update management on customer meetings, business opportunities, and next action plans. 4. Lead Generation & Lead Qualification Generate leads through customer visits, market research, references, networking, and available business platforms. Evaluate and filter leads based on customer requirements, project status, purchase potential, budget, and business feasibility. Identify genuine inquiries and prioritize high-potential customers and projects. Maintain an updated database of customers, contacts, inquiries, and sales opportunities. Track leads from initial contact through inquiry generation, quotation, negotiation, and order conversion. 5. Technical Sales & Product Understanding Develop a strong understanding of the company's products, applications, specifications, and technical capabilities. Understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate products or solutions. Handle basic technical discussions and respond confidently to customer queries. Address technical doubts professionally and coordinate with the technical team whenever detailed engineering inputs are required. Explain product features, benefits, specifications, and commercial advantages to customers. Understand customer drawings, technical specifications, and project requirements to the extent necessary for effective technical sales. Continuously improve product knowledge and technical selling skills. 6. Quotations, Proposals & Commercial Negotiations Prepare basic technical proposals and commercial quotations as per customer requirements. Coordinate with the backend sales, proposal, and technical teams for complex or customized inquiries. Follow up on submitted quotations and proposals until closure. Handle commercial discussions, price negotiations, and customer objections within the company's approved commercial policies. Convince customers by explaining the value, quality, technical suitability, and commercial benefits of the company's offerings. Monitor quotation status, order possibilities, and reasons for lost business. Work towards converting inquiries into confirmed orders and achieving sales targets. 7. Customer Follow-Ups & Communication Conduct regular follow-ups through telephone calls, emails, WhatsApp, and customer visits. Ensure timely communication with customers regarding inquiries, quotations, technical clarifications, and project updates. Send a weekly broadcast message to relevant customers regarding new inquiries, upcoming projects, product updates, and other relevant business opportunities. Maintain professional communication and ensure no important inquiry or customer follow-up is missed. Send appointment requests and coordinate meeting schedules with customers. Maintain a structured follow-up system for all active leads and pending quotations. 8. Reporting & Internal Coordination Submit daily reports to the reporting manager covering customer visits, meetings, calls, inquiries generated, follow-ups, and next action plans. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, lead status, quotations, and order progress. Share regular updates regarding new projects, market developments, competitor activities, and customer feedback. Coordinate with management and internal teams for quotations, technical clarifications, pricing approvals, and order processing. Provide a weekly summary of business development activities, lead conversion status, and upcoming opportunities. Ensure timely and transparent reporting of all sales activities. Required Skills & Qualifications Relevant educational background in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical field. Prior experience in field sales, technical sales, industrial sales, or business development is mandatory. Experience in OEM sales and end-user sales is strongly preferred. Good understanding of industrial markets, customer acquisition, lead generation, and sales conversion. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Hindi, Marathi, and English . Strong negotiation, convincing, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Ability to understand technical products and explain their applications to customers. Good email writing, telephone etiquette, and professional communication skills. Basic working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and email. Ability to prepare basic proposals, quotations, and customer reports. Strong follow-up discipline, time management, planning, and organizational skills. Willingness to travel frequently across Maharashtra. Work Schedule & Company Support Field work: 4 days per week. Office work: 2 days per week. Primary markets: Pune and Mumbai, with regular planned visits to Nashik, Nagpur, and Sambhajinagar. Travel: Frequent intercity travel as required for customer meetings and business development. Company-provided resources: Laptop and mobile phone. Reporting: Daily reporting to the assigned manager. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for a candidate who can independently manage field sales activities, identify genuine business opportunities, develop customer relationships, and drive sales growth. The candidate should be confident while meeting industrial customers, capable of handling commercial negotiations, technically inclined, disciplined with follow-ups, and comfortable working with sales targets. This role requires an individual who takes ownership of business development rather than simply attending customer meetings. The candidate must be proactive in generating inquiries, building a strong market presence, converting leads into orders, and contributing to the company's overall growth. Candidates with relevant industrial sales experience, established market knowledge, and a proven ability to generate and convert business will be preferred.

description: Join the Power Operations team at JSM Group Services Ltd., a leading provider of integrated utility infrastructure solutions. Our combination of end-to-end technical expertise, decades of industry experience, and unlimited fresh thinking makes us a trusted partner in delivering next-generation connectivity in energy and communications across the UK, Europe, and beyond. Our Power team delivers high-value electrical infrastructure projects for some of the most demanding clients in the sector from hyperscale data centre operators to major industrial and grid clients. We are building a team of exceptional project management professionals who can drive complex programmes from award through to energisation, and we want people who take real ownership of their projects THE ROLE As a Cable Systems Engineer , you will support the development and delivery of cable system engineering activities for substation and renewable energy projects. You will work closely with primary engineering, project teams, clients, DNOs and suppliers to deliver technically compliant and optimised cable system designs. Key Responsibilities Carry out HVAC cable calculations and cable sizing in accordance with DNO requirements and ENA/IEC/BS standards. Develop cable route layouts, feasibility drawings, trench sections and cable management systems. Prepare detailed cable design calculations, reports and technical documentation. Perform cable pulling, cable thrust and cable sizing calculations and support cable/accessory procurement. Design and coordinate HV/EHV cable systems, sealing end structures and interfaces with primary engineering. Review and optimise cable routing, JB locations and overall cable system design. Raise and manage RFIs/TQs and coordinate technical information required at project start-up. Review supplier drawings, datasheets and technical submissions. Produce and review AutoCAD drawings as required. Liaise with internal disciplines, subcontractors, suppliers, clients and DNOs to identify and mitigate technical risks. Provide technical input to tender proposals and participate in client/DNO meetings. Deliver engineering activities independently in line with agreed project budgets, schedules, standards and regulations. WHAT YOULL BRING Essential 3+ years of relevant experience in cable systems engineering/design, preferably within substations, transmission or renewable energy projects. Strong experience in HVAC/HV cable system design from 11kV to 132kV. Strong knowledge of cable sizing, cable calculations, cable pulling and thrust calculations. Good understanding of HV/EHV cable routing, cable management systems, trench design and cable accessories. Experience working with ENA, IEC and BS standards and relevant DNO requirements. Experience interfacing cable systems with primary substation design. Proficiency in AutoCAD and ability to produce/review technical drawings. Experience preparing technical reports, calculations and design documentation. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple engineering disciplines, suppliers, clients and DNOs. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and deliver within project schedules. Nice to Have Experience in HVDC cable systems. Experience with offshore windfarm projects or other renewable energy projects. Experience with UK DNO/substation projects and associated technical standards. Experience in reviewing supplier technical drawings and datasheets. Previous experience contributing to tenders and client-facing technical discussions. YOULL THRIVE HERE IF YOU Enjoy working on technically challenging HV/EHV cable and substation projects. Are comfortable taking ownership of engineering activities with minimal supervision. Enjoy collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines and with external stakeholders. Have a strong focus on technical quality, safety, compliance and project delivery. Are confident communicating technical information to clients, DNOs, suppliers and project teams. Are proactive in identifying technical risks and developing practical engineering solutions. Want to contribute to major HVAC and HVDC offshore wind and renewable energy projects.

People, safety and cost Hire, train, mentor and appraise engineers and technicians; build succession and multi-skilling. Enforce workshop safety, 5S and statutory compliance. Prepare and manage the tool room budget, machine utilisation, consumables and vendor and outsourcing spend.

title: Network Manager
description:
Network Manager L2/L3 SME & Network Architecture Lead Location: Noida or Gurugram, India
 Shift: Evening/Night Shift (5:30 PM – 2:30AM) Both side Cab facility will be provided 
 Experience Required: 10+ years in networking
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role We are looking for a Network Manager who is both a hands-on L2/L3 Subject Matter Expert (SME) and a proven people leader. You will own network architecture, stability and roadmap for our voice-led KPO/BPO operations, lead the network engineers and IT SWAT team, and remain the final technical escalation point for the toughest issues. You are accountable for outcomes, not only fixes: uptime, voice quality, team capability and client confidence in our network. You will balance deep technical credibility with strong communication and people management. 
 Environment You Will Own Firewall: SonicWall (primary + secondary/HA), dual ISP, IPSec site-to-site VPN to client peer IP Switching: approx. 15 L3/core devices and 100 L2 access switches Wi-Fi: approx. 30 access points Servers: approx. 10 servers Voice: Vonage DID over internet, VDI-based agent desktops Locations: 3 sites (Noida 2, Gurugram) Monitoring: Zabbix, OPManager (distributed, proxy per site) with SNMP, syslog and scripted path monitoring 
 Key Responsibilities Network architecture and strategy Own the end-to-end network architecture across three sites: WAN/ISP design, dual-ISP and SonicWall HA failover, IPSec VPN to client peers, L3 core and L2 access design, Wi-Fi, and the VDI and voice traffic paths. Define and maintain the network roadmap, capacity plan and lifecycle/refresh plan, with business cases and budgets for IT leadership. Lead design reviews for new sites, new client onboarding, client-mandated connectivity and security requirements, and changes to voice infrastructure. Align the network design with global client security, compliance and audit expectations (for example ISO 27001 and client-specific requirements). L2/L3 SME and escalation ownership Be the final technical authority for firewall, switching, VPN, WAN, VDI connectivity and voice-path issues, and decide whether an issue is fixed on the spot or escalated to a vendor or ISP. Lead triage and the incident bridge on major disruptions, isolating LAN, WAN, VPN, firewall, VDI or carrier-side causes while giving clear updates to leadership and client stakeholders. Diagnose complex IPSec VPN problems (Phase 1/Phase 2 failures, IKE negotiation errors, SA lifetime mismatches, DPD misconfiguration) and interpret traceroute/MTR output and firewall and switch logs. Own root cause analysis and problem management for recurring issues, and track permanent fixes to closure instead of repeating quick fixes. Voice quality and resilience Own voice-quality escalations (jitter, packet loss, MOS, one-way audio, call drops) and decide whether the fix is internal (QoS, shaping, configuration) or needs Vonage engagement. Design, tune and validate QoS so voice (RTP/SIP) is prioritised on shared internet links. Validate dual-ISP failover behaviour and confirm the VPN and voice services re-establish cleanly after a failover. Monitoring, reporting and governance Own the Zabbix monitoring strategy: templates, triggers, severity mapping (P1–P4), dependencies and escalation actions, plus VPN tunnel and MTR/path monitoring to the client peer IP and US voice/application endpoints. Own the weekly issue-trend report and client-facing service reviews: recurring root causes, closure status and permanent-fix proposals. Define and enforce incident, change and problem management processes (ITIL), change windows, runbooks, and network DR/BCP documentation. Team leadership Lead, coach and develop the network engineers and the IT SWAT team across shifts: set goals, review performance, plan skills growth, manage rosters and coverage, and build succession. Build runbooks, escalation matrices and training so that one-engineer-per-shift coverage works without depending on a single person. Hire and onboard network talent, and set the standard for technical interviews and capability assessment. Build a blameless culture of root cause analysis and continuous improvement. Vendor and stakeholder management Own the relationships and SLAs with SonicWall, ISPs and Vonage; manage escalations and provide input on renewals and contracts. Communicate with global clients, operations heads and IT leadership, explaining technical issues and trade-offs in business terms. Partner with Operations, Information Security and Infrastructure teams on changes, audits and client requirements. Required Skills and Experience 12+ years in enterprise networking, with deep experience in the KPO/BPO/ITES industry or a similar voice-dependent, client-facing operation. Global experience: has supported or delivered networks for international clients and worked with multi-region stakeholders and teams. Proven network architecture capability: multi-site design with HA, dual-ISP, IPSec VPN and QoS for voice. Expert, credible hands-on L2/L3 knowledge: firewalls (SonicWall strongly preferred), switching, VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, STP and routing. Advanced IPSec VPN troubleshooting, and strong QoS and traffic-shaping knowledge for VoIP; Vonage or similar SIP trunk/DID experience is a plus. Practical experience with network monitoring platforms (Zabbix preferred; OpManager, PRTG, SolarWinds or similar): SNMP, traps, syslog, NetFlow, trigger and alert design. 5+ years of solid people management: building, coaching and rostering a team, handling performance, and growing capability. Excellent communication: confident with senior leadership and clients, calm and clear during incidents, and strong in written RCAs and reports. Working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and change management, vendor and SLA management, and budgeting. Comfortable making independent decisions during evening/night operations. Preferred Qualifications CCNP or CCIE; SonicWall certification (CSSA/CSNSA or advanced); ITIL Foundation or higher. Prior role as Network Manager or Network Lead in a global BPO/KPO. ISO 27001 awareness and exposure to client audits; exposure to cloud networking (Azure or AWS). Basic Linux and scripting (Bash/Python) for monitoring checks. Key Performance Indicators Reduction in recurring incidents (VDI disconnects, network interruptions, latency) week over week. Mean time to resolve (MTTR) for escalated incidents. Voice quality indicators (jitter, packet loss, MOS) within agreed thresholds. VPN and WAN availability throughout Quality and timeliness of root cause analysis and weekly reporting. Monitoring quality: alert accuracy and low false-positive rate. Team health: shift coverage, runbook coverage, skills development and retention. Client and stakeholder satisfaction in service reviews. What We Are Looking For A network leader who is still technical enough to be the final escalation point, and strong enough with people and stakeholders to run the team and the client conversation. Someone who thinks in architecture and root causes, communicates calmly under pressure, and turns every incident into a stronger network and a more capable team. 
 If interested Kindly share your resume at Muskan.shukla@nlbtech.com

The candidate will own the complete data science lifecycle, from understanding business problems and exploring data to developing, deploying and monitoring production-ready AI solutions. This role requires strong expertise in Python, Databricks and AWS Bedrock , along with the ability to build models and AI applications from first principles rather than relying only on AutoML or pre-built components. Key Responsibilities Partner with business and technical stakeholders to define problems, success metrics, KPIs and solution approaches. Perform data sourcing, EDA, statistical analysis, feature engineering, data-quality checks and hypothesis testing. Build and evaluate machine learning, deep learning, time-series, anomaly-detection, recommendation and optimization models. Develop production-ready LLM, RAG and Agentic AI applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Amazon Bedrock Agents or similar. Design agent workflows involving tool calling, state and memory management, human-in-the-loop approvals, retries, fallbacks and MCP integrations. Build secure and scalable solutions using Databricks Apps, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog . Develop applications on Amazon Bedrock using foundation models, Knowledge Bases, Agents, Guardrails, prompt management and model evaluation. Design advanced RAG pipelines involving hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, re-ranking, query rewriting and retrieval evaluation. Build NLP solutions for text classification, NER, information extraction, semantic search and document summarization. Develop computer vision solutions for classification, object detection, segmentation, OCR and visual defect inspection. Fine-tune LLMs, embedding and vision models using LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT and Hugging Face frameworks. Deploy AI services using FastAPI, Docker, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS and CI/CD pipelines. Monitor model performance, drift, quality, latency and cost, and communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders. Required Skills 6–8 years of Data Science experience , including at least 3 years of hands-on Generative AI experience . At least 5 years of advanced Python development experience . Strong expertise in Python, Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, SQL and object-oriented programming. Strong foundations in statistics, probability, machine learning, deep learning and model evaluation. Experience with Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM and PyTorch or TensorFlow. Hands-on experience building LLM applications using Claude through Amazon Bedrock or other foundation models. Strong understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, context management, caching and LLM evaluation. Proven experience building at least one end-to-end multi-step or multi-agent system . Experience with agent tool design, state, memory, human-in-the-loop workflows, evaluation, tracing and MCP. Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, hybrid search, re-ranking and retrieval metrics such as recall@k, MRR and nDCG. Hands-on experience with Databricks Apps, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Workflows, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog . Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock, S3, IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, OpenSearch, SageMaker and CloudWatch . title: AI Video Editor
description:
About the Role * We are looking for a creative and technically skilled AI Video Editor who can transform health, nutrition, wellness and science topics into engaging, visually powerful Instagram Reels. * The role involves taking a topic from concept to final reel, including understanding the science, developing the visual concept, creating AI assets and editing the final video. * The ideal candidate should think like a visual storyteller, not just an editor. 
 Key Responsibilities * Create high-quality AI-generated health and science reels from scratch. * Understand the topic/script and convert complex scientific information into simple, impactful and self-explanatory visuals. * Create inside-body visualisations of organs, hormones, cells, tissues, blood flow, metabolic processes and physiological changes. * Develop visual concepts independently based on the topic and identify what needs to be shown visually. * Use AI tools to create characters, environments, animations, medical/scientific visuals and cinematic sequences. * Combine AI-generated footage with professional editing, motion graphics, animation, sound design and VFX where required. * Create content in both Hindi and English, with an understanding of language-specific storytelling and pacing. * Collaborate with content/science teams while also being capable of independently executing the visual treatment. 
 Instagram & Performance Understanding * Strong understanding of Instagram Reels and social media content performance. * Understand hooks, retention, watch time, replays, shares, saves and audience behaviour. * Use content analytics and performance data to identify what is working and improve future reels. * Understand how visual storytelling, pacing and editing can influence retention and engagement. * Stay updated with emerging AI and social media trends and experiment with new formats and techniques. 
 Skills & Experience * 34 years of relevant experience in video editing, AI video creation, digital content or a similar field. * Strong experience creating AI reels/videos from concept to final output. * Proficiency across multiple AI video, image-generation and editing tools. * Strong understanding of video editing, transitions, pacing, motion graphics and visual storytelling. * Ability to independently research and understand a topic before creating its visual treatment. * Good understanding of health, nutrition, biology or science is preferred. * Strong creative judgement, attention to detail and ability to deliver within timelines. * Ability to continuously learn and adopt new AI tools and workflows. 
 Ideal Candidate * Someone who can take a science topic understand it visualise it create the AI assets edit an impactful reel analyse its performance improve the next one. * Someone who can make a complex scientific concept understandable without relying entirely on text or voice-over. * Someone who understands that great health content needs to be scientifically accurate, visually compelling and optimised for attention. 
 Portfolio * Candidates should share relevant examples of their work, particularly: * AI-generated reels * Health/science content * Inside-body or medical visualisations * Educational/explainer videos * High-performing Instagram Reels

title: Business Head SaaS Growth & Revenue
description:
Job Description: Business Head SaaS Growth & Revenue 
 Products: HelixtaHR & EazeeSign
 Location: Mohan Cooperative Industrial Estate, New Delhi
 Work Mode: Work From Office (5 Days a Week)
 Experience: 12+ Years of Relevant Experience 
 1. Role Overview We are looking for a senior, commercially driven Business Head SaaS Growth & Revenue to take end-to-end ownership of business growth, customer acquisition, sales performance, and revenue generation for HelixtaHR and EazeeSign. The role requires a proven B2B SaaS or technology business leader with direct accountability for revenue, business growth, or P&L targets and demonstrated experience leading both Marketing/Growth and Sales/BDM functions. The individual will be responsible for translating Management’s business vision into an executable go-to-market strategy, identifying commercial gaps independently, aligning cross-functional teams, improving conversion at every stage of the sales funnel, and delivering predictable, measurable, product-wise revenue growth. This is not a Digital Marketing, SEO, Sales Management, or departmental coordination role. We require a business leader who owns the complete commercial outcome, from product positioning and demand generation to customer acquisition, deal closures, revenue, and customer retention. 
 2. Products HelixtaHR: An AI-enabled Human Resource Management System offering HRMS, payroll, attendance, recruitment, and AI-assisted HR capabilities. EazeeSign: An AI-enabled electronic signature platform designed to streamline digital signing and document workflows, with capabilities such as document summaries, clause extraction, and risk analysis. The Business Head will establish and execute separate growth strategies for both products, considering their target markets, customer segments, positioning, pricing, sales cycles, and revenue potential. 
 3. Key Objective To establish a commercially accountable, data-driven growth function that consistently converts marketing investments and sales activities into qualified opportunities, paying customers, and sustainable revenue. Success will be measured by actual business outcomes rather than marketing activities, traffic, lead volumes, meetings, or team size alone. 
 4. Key Responsibilities A. Business Strategy & Revenue Ownership Develop and execute product-wise business growth strategies for HelixtaHR and EazeeSign. Establish annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue targets in alignment with Management. Translate business objectives into actionable go-to-market plans, commercial priorities, budgets, and execution roadmaps. Identify target industries, customer segments, buyer personas, geographic markets, and ideal customer profiles. Own qualified pipeline development, opportunity progression, closures, revenue forecasting, and revenue achievement. Identify new business opportunities, strategic partnerships, expansion opportunities, and additional revenue streams. Develop a repeatable and scalable commercial growth model for both products. B. Marketing, Growth & Demand Generation Lead the commercial direction and alignment of Digital Marketing, SEO, content, website, landing pages, videos, social media, and demand-generation campaigns. Ensure that marketing strategies support product positioning, target customer acquisition, qualified pipeline creation, and revenue goals. Review website messaging, product value propositions, AI capabilities, calls to action, landing-page journeys, and conversion performance. Identify gaps in organic search, paid campaigns, content strategy, audience targeting, lead quality, and campaign effectiveness. Ensure SEO and marketing activities generate relevant business opportunities rather than traffic and activity metrics alone. Establish campaign-wise and channel-wise performance measurement, attribution, budget allocation, and return-on-investment tracking. Work with functional leaders to initiate corrective actions and continuously improve commercial performance. C. Sales & BDM Leadership Lead the commercial direction, targets, processes, and performance management of the BDM/Sales function. Establish clear sales stages, qualification criteria, lead-response timelines, follow-up standards, and opportunity ownership. Improve demo-to-proposal and proposal-to-closure conversion rates. Participate in strategic client discussions, key product demonstrations, negotiations, and high-value deal closures. Review sales performance, opportunity ageing, stalled deals, customer objections, and lost opportunities. Develop effective sales playbooks, objection-handling frameworks, proposal standards, and follow-up processes. Establish accountability for individual sales productivity, revenue contribution, and target achievement. D. Product Positioning, Pricing & Competitive Strategy Define and refine the commercial positioning, value proposition, messaging, and differentiation of HelixtaHR and EazeeSign. Evaluate pricing, packaging, subscription models, commercial proposals, and discounting strategies. Conduct competitor analysis and identify opportunities to strengthen market positioning. Ensure product capabilities, including AI-related features, are communicated accurately and effectively to target buyers. Work with Management and relevant product stakeholders to align customer needs, market opportunities, and commercial priorities. Analyse customer feedback, objections, reasons for rejection, and market expectations to recommend improvements. E. Website, SEO & Conversion Optimisation Evaluate website and landing-page effectiveness from a commercial and customer-conversion perspective. Ensure product messaging, customer benefits, use cases, trust signals, and calls to action are aligned with target audiences. Collaborate with website, SEO, content, and design teams to improve user journeys and conversion rates. Review lead sources, conversion data, traffic quality, engagement, and customer acquisition performance. Identify and prioritise improvements based on their expected commercial impact. Ensure that SEO and website initiatives contribute to qualified pipeline and measurable business growth. F. CRM, Pipeline Management & Revenue Forecasting Establish CRM discipline, accurate opportunity records, sales-stage definitions, and mandatory next actions. Ensure every qualified opportunity has an owner, estimated deal value, next action, and expected closure date. Maintain separate pipeline visibility for HelixtaHR and EazeeSign. Build reliable revenue forecasts based on pipeline quality, conversion history, sales-cycle duration, and deal probability. Track lead-to-opportunity, opportunity-to-demo, demo-to-proposal, and proposal-to-closure conversion. Review lost opportunities, pipeline leakage, delayed follow-ups, and forecast accuracy. Present data-backed business reviews with corrective actions, responsible owners, and target dates. G. Commercial Leadership & Cross-Functional Accountability Establish commercial priorities across Digital Marketing, SEO, website development, content, videos, social media, campaigns, and BDM/Sales. Independently identify gaps, challenge underperforming strategies, and recommend corrective measures. Work with existing department heads, who will continue to manage their respective functional teams and day-to-day execution. Ensure cross-functional activities remain aligned with agreed commercial targets and priorities. Define expected outcomes, responsibilities, timelines, and measurable success criteria for key initiatives. Escalate resource constraints, investment requirements, and strategic decisions to Management with clear recommendations. Build a culture of accountability, analytical decision-making, continuous improvement, and revenue ownership. H. Customer Acquisition, Retention & Business Economics Monitor customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing return on investment, sales efficiency, and cost of customer acquisition. Evaluate customer quality, revenue potential, retention, renewals, and expansion opportunities where applicable. Work with relevant teams to identify churn risks, customer feedback patterns, and opportunities to improve customer lifetime value. Recommend commercially viable growth initiatives based on customer economics and business priorities. 
 5. Required Qualifications & Experience Minimum 12+ years of relevant experience in B2B SaaS, software products, or technology-led businesses. Demonstrated direct ownership of revenue targets, business growth, or P&L. Proven experience leading or integrating both Sales/BDM and Marketing/Growth functions. Track record of building qualified pipelines, improving sales conversion, closing deals, and achieving commercial targets. Strong understanding of SaaS go-to-market strategy, demand generation, sales execution, CRM, pricing, positioning, and revenue forecasting. Experience improving underperforming marketing-to-sales funnels and establishing measurable commercial processes. Experience managing teams across multiple commercial functions and aligning them with business objectives. Strong analytical, financial, strategic, negotiation, leadership, and execution capabilities. Ability to independently diagnose problems, develop solutions, and drive implementation. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

This role will be responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving world-class safety management systems that support a safe, healthy, and compliant work environment. The Director will partner closely with Facilities, Manufacturing, Engineering, Construction, Global EHS, and external regulatory agencies to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, Micron EHS standards, and industry best practices while fostering a strong safety-first culture across the organization. Key Responsibilities Safety Leadership & Strategy Lead and manage site Safety and Occupational Health programs. Champion a proactive safety culture through leadership engagement, coaching, and employee involvement. Establish annual safety goals, KPIs, and improvement plans aligned with site and corporate objectives. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to achieve world-class EHS performance. Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with all applicable Indian statutory requirements, including Factories Act, Gujarat Factory Rules, and other EHS regulations. Maintain compliance with Micron Corporate EHS requirements and industry standards. Interface with government agencies, regulatory authorities, auditors, and emergency responders. Risk Management Lead EHS risk assessments for operations, projects, equipment installations, and contractor activities. Identify potential hazards and implement effective risk mitigation measures. Conduct regular inspections, audits, and compliance assessments. Track corrective and preventive actions to closure. Incident Prevention & Investigation Lead incident, near-miss, and unsafe condition investigations. Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions. Monitor trends and develop preventive strategies to eliminate workplace injuries and illnesses. Contractor & Construction Safety Oversee contractor safety management programs. Ensure contractors and vendors comply with site safety requirements. Partner with Facilities and Construction teams to review safety requirements during project planning, installation, commissioning, and operational phases. Emergency Preparedness Develop and maintain emergency response plans and procedures. Coordinate drills for fire, chemical releases, medical emergencies, and other site-specific scenarios. Collaborate with internal emergency response teams and external agencies. Safety Systems & Governance Manage EHS committees and governance forums. Support and maintain EHS management systems aligned with ISO requirements. Prepare management reports, dashboards, and safety performance reviews. Training & Awareness Develop and deploy site-wide safety training programs. Conduct awareness campaigns and leadership engagement activities. Ensure all employees, contractors, and visitors receive appropriate safety orientation and training. Qualifications Education Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or related discipline. Advanced qualification in Industrial Safety, Safety Engineering, or EH&S preferred. Experience 20+ years of progressive EHS/Safety experience. Minimum 5 years in a leadership role within semiconductor, manufacturing, chemical, electronics, or high-tech industries. title: AVP (Accounts Receivable)
description:
We are looking for a strategic and results-oriented AVP Accounts Receivable (Order to Cash) to lead the AR function within a Shared Services environment of a leading Indian conglomerate. The role carries end-to-end ownership of billing, collections, cash application, credit and dispute management, and AR reporting, requiring strong leadership, deep accounting and statutory expertise, SAP proficiency, and the ability to drive cash-flow outcomes, control excellence, and large-scale process transformation. Key Responsibilities: 1. Lead end-to-end Accounts Receivable operations including invoicing, collections, cash application, credit and dispute management, reconciliations, and AR period-end close across multiple entities and business units. 2. Own AR performance outcomes including DSO, overdue and ageing reduction, collection effectiveness index (CEI), bad-debt and provisioning levels, and unapplied cash, and drive cash-flow improvement targets. 3. Define and govern collections strategy, dunning cycles, customer segmentation, and escalation frameworks in partnership with Sales, Credit, and business leadership. 4. Oversee credit management policies, credit limit reviews, and risk assessment; ensure appropriate ECL/bad-debt provisioning in line with IFRS/Ind AS and company policy. 5. Ensure timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for AR, including revenue-related accruals, AR sub-ledger to GL reconciliation, and cut-off adherence. 6. Drive resolution of disputes, deductions, and short payments by working with Sales, Operations, Legal, and Customer teams, and address root causes to prevent recurrence. 7. Ensure compliance with Indian statutory requirements including GST (e-invoicing, e-way bills, credit/debit notes), TDS/TCS reconciliation, and applicable accounting standards (IFRS/Ind AS). 8. Strengthen internal financial controls (including SOX, where applicable); own control testing and remediation, and ensure audit readiness for statutory, internal, and tax audits. 9. Provide senior leadership with AR dashboards, cash forecasts, ageing analysis, and insights; partner with Treasury and FP&A on collections forecasting and working-capital planning. 10. Lead, mentor, and develop a large team including Senior Managers, Managers, and Analysts; drive talent development, succession planning, performance management, and a high-performance culture. 11. Champion automation, standardization, and digital transformation (RPA, AI-based cash application, collections workflow tools), and lead transitions of new processes or entities into the Shared Services Centre. Serve as the primary escalation point and strategic partner for client entities, business unit finance heads, and global stakeholders; manage SLAs, governance forums, and service reviews.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
About Infoya : Infoya is a global IT solutions company specializing in transforming complex challenges into streamlined, AI-powered outcomes. Headquartered in Toronto, with innovation and delivery centers in Chennai (India), San Jose (Costa Rica), and Washington D.C. (USA), Infoya leverages proprietary technology accelerators and full-scale enterprise services to optimize workflows, improve operational efficiency, and drive digital transformation across industries. By combining deep technical expertise with innovative problem-solving, we deliver measurable business impact. We dont just deploy technology; we transform businesses, with AI at the core of everything we build and deliver. The Opportunity : About the Role We are looking for a highly driven and passionate Senior IT Recruiter who thrives on finding exceptional talent and turning hiring challenges into success stories. If you enjoy hunting for hard-to-find talent, building strong relationships, and working in fast-paced environments where every hire creates impact, we would love to hear from you. The ideal candidate must come from a pure IT recruitment background with strong experience recruiting across multiple technology domains, including: Backend Technologies Frontend Technologies Cloud Technologies NextGen / Digital Technologies AI / ML Technologies Data Engineering Technologies DevOps Technologies SAP Technologies Enterprise Platforms and Emerging Technologies The candidate should be comfortable working in a startup or high-growth environment, managing multiple priorities under aggressive timelines, and independently driving hiring outcomes with minimal supervision. This role demands strong ownership, urgency, execution excellence, and exceptional sourcing and headhunting capabilities, with the ability to consistently deliver high-quality talent within strict hiring deadlines. Key Responsibilities Recruitment Lifecycle Management Manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for niche, strategic, and critical IT positions. Independently drive sourcing, screening, interview coordination, stakeholder alignment, offer management, and onboarding activities. Partner closely with hiring managers, delivery leaders, and business stakeholders to understand technical hiring priorities, workforce planning requirements, and role expectations. Conduct detailed technical screening and competency-based assessments to validate candidate suitability. Sourcing, Headhunting & Talent Mapping Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for niche and difficult-to-fill technology skill sets through proactive sourcing and talent mapping initiatives. Demonstrate strong headhunting capabilities by identifying and engaging passive candidates through targeted outreach and market research. Utilize advanced sourcing strategies including: Boolean search techniques, X-Ray search methodologies, talent mapping, competitor analysis, market intelligence research, social recruiting strategies. Leverage multiple sourcing channels including: LinkedIn Recruiter, Job portals, Professional communities, Employee referrals, Social media platforms, Networking events, Candidate databases Recruitment Technology & Modern Tools Hands-on experience with modern Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment platforms such as Zoho Recruit, SmartRecruiters, or similar tools. Strong experience using talent intelligence and sourcing platforms including LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, hireEZ, AmazingHiring, Gem, Dice, Naukri Recruiter, and Indeed Resume Search. Experience leveraging AI-enabled recruitment technologies for: AI-assisted candidate sourcing Resume intelligence and parsing Recruitment workflow automation Candidate engagement automation Strong ability to utilize recruitment technologies to improve sourcing efficiency, talent pipeline development, candidate engagement, and overall hiring effectiveness. Hiring Delivery & Stakeholder Management Work effectively in a fast-paced and deadline-driven hiring environment with demanding turnaround expectations. Deliver consistent hiring outcomes against recruitment SLAs and business hiring commitments. Drive offer negotiations and improve offer-to-join conversion ratios. Demonstrate strong ownership in candidate closures and maintain high joining percentages. Ensure exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle. Maintain strong communication with hiring managers and leadership teams through regular status updates and reporting. Reporting & Recruitment Analytics Maintain recruitment dashboards, trackers, and hiring reports to monitor progress and hiring effectiveness. Track and analyze key recruitment metrics including time-to-submit, time-to-interview, time-to-offer, offer acceptance, offer-to-join ratio, source effectiveness, pipeline conversion, and candidate drop-off rates. Stay informed on evolving technology trends, talent market conditions, compensation benchmarks, and candidate availability to support hiring strategies and decision-making. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field. 10+ years of experience in IT recruitment with strong exposure to niche technology hiring. Mandatory experience working within startup environments, technology consulting firms, or high-growth organizations. Proven track record recruiting under fast-paced and deadline-driven environments. Strong experience as an Individual Contributor (IC) with the ability to independently manage hiring deliverables. Demonstrated success achieving strong offer closure and joining ratios. Strong understanding of modern technology stacks and IT terminology. Expertise in Boolean search, X-Ray sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, and talent mapping techniques. Strong experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably Zoho Recruit or equivalent platforms. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Ability to manage multiple concurrent requirements with speed, quality, and accuracy. Strong ownership mindset, accountability, and execution focus. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience within product organizations, technology startups, GCCs, IT services companies, or digital transformation programs. Experience recruiting globally across multiple geographies. Exposure to AI-enabled recruiting technologies and automation platforms. Certifications in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment Strategy, or HR Analytics are an added advantage. Key Competencies Niche Technology Hiring Strategic Sourcing & Headhunting Startup Hiring Expertise Fast-Paced Execution Individual Contributor Ownership Stakeholder Management Offer Negotiation & Closure Talent Mapping & Market Intelligence Candidate Engagement Recruitment Analytics Deadline-Driven Delivery

 Manage direct and indirect tax compliance for the company and relevant group entities. Review and oversee GST returns, reconciliations and input tax credit. Identify tax risks and ensure timely resolution of compliance issues. 

 Key Responsibilities – Accounts Payable

Monitor vendor payment commitments and working capital. Review payment proposals and ensure appropriate approvals. Establish and monitor AP controls and processes. Ensure accurate accounting of vendor liabilities, advances and accruals. Coordinate with FP&A and treasury for cash-flow planning. Oversee AP operations across relevant group entities. 

 Key Responsibilities – Leadership & Process Improvement 
 Lead and mentor the taxation and AP team. Define processes, controls and SLAs for AP operations. Standardise finance processes across group entities. Drive automation and process improvements. Support statutory, internal and tax audits. Ensure timely month-end closure of taxation and AP-related accounts.
