title: Field and Partner Marketing Manager
description:
About the role 
 eG Innovations runs a global events program and holds technology partnerships with the vendors whose platforms our customers depend on every day. This role owns both. You will plan and run our conference and event presence end to end, and you will make our existing partner relationships productive through joint marketing, shared campaigns, and the vendor funding those programs already make available. 
 This is an activation role. eG holds partner program memberships, marketplace listings and certifications across several major vendors. This role is responsible for keeping the alliances engine running in top form 
 Events and field marketing 
 Own the events calendar. Identify, recommend, schedule, and run all conferences, tradeshows, and field events. Take full ownership of planning and execution for each event, from the decision to attend through to post-event follow-up and reporting. Coordinate internal teams, external vendors and contractors, materials, and logistics so every detail lands on time. Run day-to-day event administration: sponsorship selection, purchase orders, vendor management, reservations, attendee coordination, registration, RSVP tracking, and issue resolution. Manage event registrations, invoicing, payment schedules, and the events budget. Manage tradeshow assets including booth, display items, and giveaways. Keep inventory, storage, and shipping logistics under control in both directions. Handle speaker and session management, expo logistics, and sponsorship fulfillment. Report on cost per event, leads generated, and pipeline influenced, and use those numbers to shape the following year's calendar. 
 Partner and alliances marketing 
 Build and maintain a complete inventory of eG's existing partner program memberships, certifications and marketplace listings, covering what each one entitles us to in co-marketing benefits, directory placement, event participation, lead sharing and funding. Own the accuracy of every partner-facing asset we publish: the technology partners page, partner directory listings, marketplace listing content, solution briefs and co-branded collateral. Track renewal and expiry dates for every partner certification and program membership we hold, and surface them well in advance so decisions get made deliberately rather than by lapse. Act as the marketing point of contact for partner marketing teams, and claim the co-marketing benefits and lead sharing those programs already provide to members. Plan and run joint marketing activity within existing programs: co-hosted webinars, joint event presence, co-branded content, and participation in partner campaigns. Identify which events and campaigns already in the plan qualify for partner funding and prepare the funding submission before the spend is committed. Track approvals, run the activity, and file the claim afterward with the evidence each program requires. Work with sales leadership wherever a partner conversation needs a commercial relationship or an executive sponsor behind it. 
 What success looks like 
 First 90 days 
 Events calendar for the next four quarters agreed and budgeted. A complete inventory of eG's partner programs: what we hold, what each entitles us to, and which benefits are going unused. Renewal and expiry dates recorded for every certification and program membership we hold. 
 By month six 
 Technology partners page and every partner directory listing current and accurate. At least two joint marketing activities live with named partners. First partner funding submission prepared against activity already in the plan. 
 By month twelve 
 A co-marketing plan agreed with each priority partner, built around activity we were already going to run. At least one vendor funding claim approved and reimbursed. 
 Skills and qualifications : 
 Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field. 4 to 8 years in B2B marketing with genuine ownership of events. Partner or alliances marketing experience is an advantage and will be reflected in the level of the offer. Comfortable working with international teams across time zones. Demonstrable experience running events end to end, including budget ownership. High attention to detail, with strong organization and project management skills. Partner funding depends on submitting before the activity and claiming afterward with complete evidence, so administrative rigor matters here. Confident building working relationships outside the company, with vendors, partners, and venue teams. Reliable on deadlines, with open and consistent communication to marketing and sales. Strong sense of ownership and a bias for action. Able to work with minimum supervision and inside a team. Analytical and creative problem solving. 
 Advantage 
 Experience with vendor partner programs at AWS, Microsoft, Citrix, Nutanix, Omnissa, IGEL, or similar. Experience preparing or claiming market development funds. Background in enterprise software or IT infrastructure. Working knowledge of HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform.

Shoot original videos at UNI Scans branches, laboratories and other approved locations. Produce Instagram Reels, Facebook videos, YouTube Shorts and promotional videos. Capture real diagnostic equipment, laboratory processes, sample collection activities and branch facilities. Create home sample collection videos showcasing the booking process and collection experience. Shoot staff introductions, employee interviews, behind-the-scenes videos and brand storytelling content. Produce health package promotions, service explainers and preventive healthcare awareness videos. Record interviews with authorized doctors, healthcare professionals and subject-matter experts. Handle camera operation, smartphone videography, lighting, framing, audio recording and basic production setup. Develop video concepts, scripts, shot lists and storyboards before filming. Edit footage using appropriate transitions, colour correction, sound design, subtitles, graphics and background music. Capture multiple formats and variations from each shoot to maximize content output. Ensure appropriate consent and authorization before filming employees, patients or other identifiable individuals. B. AI Video Creation — 30% of Workload Use AI tools to produce supplementary video content, creative concepts and campaign variations. Create AI-generated healthcare awareness videos and visual explainers. Produce AI-assisted promotional videos for home sample collection and preventive health packages. Use text-to-video, image-to-video and AI-assisted editing tools to develop engaging short-form content. Create conceptual visuals for topics that cannot easily be filmed in real-world settings. Use AI-generated backgrounds, animations, visual effects, transitions, voiceovers and subtitles where appropriate. Develop multiple video variations for advertising campaigns and creative testing. Use AI tools to improve editing speed, repurpose existing footage and generate supporting visual assets. Verify AI-generated visuals for medical accuracy, realistic equipment representation and brand consistency. Clearly avoid presenting AI-generated healthcare scenarios as actual patient experiences or real UNI Scans facilities. Follow company policies for data privacy, consent, copyright and approved AI tools. C. Video Editing and Post-Production Edit raw footage into polished, engaging and platform-ready videos. Create compelling opening hooks within the first few seconds. Add subtitles, captions, text overlays, logos, calls to action and approved brand elements. Maintain suitable pacing, sound quality, colour consistency and visual storytelling. Deliver videos in the required aspect ratios, including 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9. Prepare short-form advertisements, educational videos, testimonials and longer promotional videos. Maintain organized project files, footage archives, audio assets and final exports. D. Creative Strategy and Content Development Work with the marketing team to develop monthly video content calendars. Translate campaign objectives into creative concepts and video scripts. Develop video ideas around health awareness days, seasonal campaigns, festivals and package promotions. Create content tailored to local audiences across Chennai and other UNI Scans service locations. Develop original hooks, storytelling formats and creative approaches instead of relying on repetitive templates. Monitor video performance and suggest improvements based on views, retention, engagement and enquiries. E. Brand and Healthcare Communication Follow UNI Scans' approved logo, colours, fonts and visual identity. Ensure all medical information, service claims and package details are approved before publication. Protect patient confidentiality and obtain appropriate permissions for real-world filming. Use only authorized footage, music, stock assets, AI tools and other creative materials. Submit all videos for approval before publishing or using them in paid campaigns. 3. Original vs. AI Video Workload Content type 
 Allocation 
 Examples Original video production 
 70% 
 Branch shoots, staff videos, equipment footage, home collection, interviews and real service demonstrations AI-generated / AI-assisted video 
 30% 
 Conceptual explainers, AI animations, image-to-video, generated scenes and creative variations The 70:30 ratio refers to the overall video production workload, not necessarily the number of videos. The final output mix may vary by campaign requirements. Example: For every 10 comparable production assignments, approximately 7 should focus on original video production and 3 on AI-generated or substantially AI-assisted content. 4. Required Technical Skills Video production and editing Adobe Premiere Pro Adobe After Effects DaVinci Resolve or equivalent editing software CapCut or other short-form editing tools Basic camera operation, smartphone videography, lighting and audio recording AI video and creative tools Runway, Kling, Veo or equivalent AI video platforms AI-assisted image and video generation workflows AI voiceover, subtitle generation and editing automation tools Canva or equivalent design tools for supporting creative assets Experience with specific AI platforms is advantageous; candidates should demonstrate their ability to produce quality content using available tools. 5. Qualifications and Experience Degree or diploma in Visual Communication, Film Making, Multimedia, Animation, Video Production or a related field preferred. 1–3 years of relevant video production and editing experience preferred. Experience producing short-form social media videos and digital advertisements. Demonstrated experience in real-world shooting and video editing. Practical knowledge of AI video generation and AI-assisted creative workflows. Healthcare, hospital, diagnostics or pharmaceutical content experience is an advantage. A portfolio demonstrating both original footage and AI-generated video work is mandatory. 6. Monthly Performance Expectations The following are proposed starting targets for a full-time individual contributor, subject to shoot availability, project complexity and campaign priorities.  Monthly Target Original videos / Reels

A complex shoot, interview or longer campaign film may count as a larger production assignment than a simple Reel. 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated on: Adherence to the 70% original and 30% AI production mix. Quality, originality and storytelling of video content. Timely delivery of approved videos. Production efficiency and editing turnaround time. Video retention, completion rate and audience engagement. Creative contribution to paid campaign performance and qualified enquiries. Accuracy of healthcare information and brand representation. Proper use of consented footage and licensed creative assets. Organization and maintenance of project files and footage. Effective use of AI tools without compromising authenticity or quality. 8. Personal Competencies Strong creative thinking and visual storytelling. Good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to plan and execute shoots independently. Attention to detail and quality control. Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines. Willingness to experiment with new editing techniques and AI tools. Understanding of audience behaviour and social media trends. Professional conduct when filming in healthcare environments. 9. Application Requirements Candidates should submit: Updated resume. Portfolio containing at least 5 original videos. At least 3 examples of AI-generated or AI-assisted videos. Links to previously published Reels, Shorts or advertisements, where available. List of editing software and AI tools used. Details of current salary, expected salary and notice period. 10. Final Role Objective To build a consistent, high-quality video production capability for UNI Scans & Labs by combining authentic, original healthcare video content with AI-powered creative production. title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description Digital Marketing Lead Position: Digital Marketing Lead – Performance Marketing & Organic Growth 
 Location: Hyderabad
 Experience: 5 - 15 Years
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Department: Marketing & Growth
 Reporting To: CEO / Head of Marketing 
 Role Overview We are looking for a results-driven Digital Marketing Lead with strong expertise in performance marketing, paid advertising, organic growth, SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and full-funnel digital marketing. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels, including Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, search engines, and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. The candidate will be responsible for driving qualified leads, customer acquisition, website traffic, brand visibility, conversion rates, and measurable revenue growth. This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, hands-on campaign execution, analytical skills, creative experimentation, and team leadership. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing & Paid Acquisition Plan, execute, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms. Develop and manage full-funnel advertising strategies covering awareness, consideration, lead generation, conversions, and retargeting. Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting, placements, and creative testing to maximize return on ad spend (ROAS) and reduce customer acquisition cost (CAC). Execute Google Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types. Design and optimize Meta lead generation, conversion, traffic, retargeting, and remarketing campaigns. Continuously test ad creatives, copy, landing pages, audiences, and campaign structures. Track and optimize key metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, CPL, CPA, CAC, conversion rate, and ROAS. Build scalable paid acquisition strategies based on campaign performance and business objectives. 2. SEO – Search Engine Optimization Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies to improve organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation. Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis. Implement on-page, off-page, and technical SEO best practices. Optimize website architecture, internal linking, metadata, headings, schema markup, crawlability, indexing, and Core Web Vitals. Develop backlink acquisition and digital PR strategies to improve domain authority and search visibility. Collaborate with content writers and developers to implement SEO recommendations. Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, and conversions using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and relevant SEO tools. 3. AEO – Answer Engine Optimization Develop strategies to improve brand visibility in AI-powered answer engines and conversational search experiences. Optimize website content to address user questions through clear answers, FAQs, structured information, and authoritative content. Build topical authority through expert-led articles, comparison pages, how-to guides, and question-based content. Implement relevant structured data and schema markup to help search engines understand website content. Monitor brand visibility and citations across eligible answer-oriented search experiences where measurement is available. Align content with conversational queries, natural-language searches, and intent-driven discovery. 4. GEO – Generative Engine Optimization Develop and implement strategies to improve brand discoverability across generative AI search and answer platforms. Optimize content for potential inclusion, citation, and mentions in AI-generated responses across platforms such as ChatGPT search, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity. Strengthen brand authority through original research, credible information, expert content, industry mentions, and relevant third-party references. Create structured, factually accurate, and context-rich content that generative systems can interpret and reference. Audit brand presence, competitor visibility, and citation opportunities across AI-driven discovery channels. Track available indicators of AI-referred traffic, brand mentions, citations, and assisted conversions without relying on unsupported ranking guarantees. 5. Organic Growth & Content Strategy Develop an integrated organic growth strategy across search engines, social media, website content, and relevant online communities. Plan and manage content calendars for blogs, landing pages, social media, videos, case studies, and other digital assets. Drive organic reach, engagement, website visits, inbound inquiries, and qualified leads. Work closely with content creators, designers, video editors, and subject-matter experts to produce high-performing content. Identify growth opportunities through competitor benchmarking, audience research, trend analysis, and content performance data. Build repeatable growth experiments to improve reach, engagement, conversion, and retention. 6. Website Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Optimize landing pages, website journeys, forms, CTAs, and lead capture mechanisms to improve conversion rates. Conduct A/B testing on headlines, creatives, landing pages, forms, and user journeys. Identify friction points using analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, and funnel analysis where available. Collaborate with design and development teams to implement conversion improvements. Ensure campaigns direct users to relevant landing pages aligned with the advertised offer and search intent. 7. Analytics, Attribution & Reporting Set up and maintain marketing measurement using Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Meta Pixel, and relevant conversion APIs. Configure conversion events, lead tracking, campaign tagging, and UTM parameters. Build dashboards and reports covering channel performance, marketing spend, leads, qualified leads, conversions, and revenue contribution. Analyze campaign and funnel data to identify inefficiencies and growth opportunities. Coordinate with the sales team to track lead quality, lead-to-customer conversion, and marketing-generated revenue. Present actionable performance reports, insights, and recommendations to management. 8. Marketing Strategy & Team Leadership Develop quarterly and monthly digital marketing plans aligned with business growth targets. Allocate budgets across paid acquisition, organic growth, content, SEO, and emerging discovery channels. Coordinate with sales, product, design, technology, and business development teams. Manage external agencies, freelancers, and marketing vendors wherever required. Establish campaign processes, reporting standards, experimentation frameworks, and performance benchmarks. Stay updated on advertising platform changes, search algorithm updates, privacy requirements, and emerging AI-driven marketing trends. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. MBA in Marketing or a relevant digital marketing certification is an added advantage. 4–7 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, including substantial ownership of paid campaigns and organic growth initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing advertising budgets and delivering measurable business results. Strong practical understanding of SEO, AEO, GEO, performance marketing, conversion optimization, and marketing analytics. Technical Skills Required Paid Advertising: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager. SEO: Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent tools. AEO & GEO: AI search visibility analysis, content structuring, schema markup, entity optimization, and brand citation monitoring. Analytics: Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, conversion tracking, and attribution. Growth & CRO: Landing page optimization, A/B testing, funnel analysis, remarketing, and audience segmentation. Content & CMS: WordPress or equivalent CMS, content planning, keyword mapping, and content performance analysis. Reporting: Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, dashboard creation, and performance reporting. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 The Digital Marketing Lead will be evaluated against agreed business goals and measurable outcomes, including: Qualified leads and marketing-generated pipeline. Customer acquisition cost (CAC) and cost per qualified lead. ROAS and paid campaign profitability, where revenue attribution is available. Organic traffic growth and organic conversion rate. Search visibility, qualified keyword growth, and non-branded search performance. AI search visibility, attributable referrals, and brand citations where measurable. Landing page conversion rate and overall funnel performance. Lead-to-customer conversion rate and marketing contribution to revenue. Campaign tracking accuracy, reporting quality, and budget utilization. Preferred Candidate Profile Has personally managed and optimized Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns rather than only coordinating with agencies. Can demonstrate real campaign results through dashboards, case studies, or anonymized performance reports. Understands the relationship between paid acquisition, organic search, content, landing pages, and sales conversion. Can independently identify growth opportunities, launch experiments, analyze results, and implement improvements. Understands modern search behavior and the evolving role of AI-powered discovery. Is comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment with accountability for outcomes. What We Expect From This Role The successful candidate should be able to take ownership of the company's digital growth engine—from campaign planning and execution to organic visibility, lead generation, analytics, and conversion optimization. We are looking for a hands-on marketing professional who combines strategic leadership with execution excellence and can turn marketing investments into measurable business growth. Application Requirements Interested candidates should share their updated resume along with: Examples of Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns they have managed. Key campaign metrics, including budget, CPL, CAC, ROAS, or conversion improvements where available. SEO or organic growth projects demonstrating measurable results. Experience with AEO, GEO, and AI-driven search visibility initiatives.

title: Vice President - Finance
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 A. Strategic Finance and Decision Support 
 1. Strategic Participation Involving and guiding the management in strategic decisions relating to business expansion, capital allocation, and long-term growth planning. 2. Financing Strategy Design and drive the company's financing strategy, including capital structure, debt-equity mix, and sourcing of funds for working capital and growth capital expenditure. 3. Long-Term Planning Lead the development of long-term financial strategy and multi-year financial projections in alignment with the company's business plan and growth objectives. 4. Execution of Strategic Initiatives : Drive execution of strategic initiatives taken by management, including tracking implementation milestones, sourcing and funding requirements, and analysing financial impact, and report progress to management. 
 B. Financial Planning, Control and Reporting 
 1. Budget Adherence Accountable for non-deviation from the annual budget and establish a robust MIS and reporting system that provides management with timely visibility into financial and operational performance. 2. Financial Reporting Ensure preparation of financial statements in full compliance with Ind AS requirements and maintain financial reporting requirements of a listed company. 3. Internal Financial Controls Establish and continuously strengthen internal financial controls, and ensure their effective adherence across the organisation. 
 C. Treasury, Compliance and Risk 
 1. Treasury Management Oversee cash flow, working capital, and treasury operations, optimising the cost of funds and managing banking relationships. 2. Statutory and Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with all statutory, tax, and regulatory requirements applicable to the company, including SEBI Listing Regulations and the Companies Act. 3. Financial Risk Management Identify, monitor, and mitigate financial risks, including credit, market, liquidity, and foreign exchange risk where applicable. 
 D. Annual Report and AGM 
 1. Annual Report Preparation Lead the preparation of the company's Annual Report, including financial statements, management discussion and analysis, and other statutory disclosures. 2. AGM Presentation Present the company's financial performance at the Annual General Meeting, and respond to shareholder queries on financial matters. 
 E. Stakeholder Coordination 
 1. Board and Audit Committee Present financial performance, budgets, risk updates, and strategic recommendations to the Board, and Audit Committee on a periodic basis. 2. Statutory and Internal Auditors Coordinate the audit with the statutory auditor and internal auditor, ensure information is made available on time, and track closure of audit findings to completion. 3. Bankers and Financial Institutions Manage relationships with banks, financial institutions, and rating agencies for fund-raising, working capital limits, and credit rating exercises. 4. Regulators and Exchanges Liaise with SEBI, stock exchanges, RoC, and other regulatory bodies on financial disclosures, listing compliance, and statutory filings, working closely with the Company Secretary. 5. Investors and Analysts Support investor relations by providing accurate and timely financial information to shareholders, analysts, and investors, including at the AGM and other investor interactions. 6. Internal Departments Coordinate with business, operations, and other functional heads to align financial planning with operational challenges.

title: Senior Finance Specialist | MNC Chemical industry | PUNE
description:
Role & responsibilities JOB DESCRIPTION Senior Financial Specialist To manage and coordinate statutory audits, group audits, treasury operations, month-end closing activities, financial reporting, forecasting, transfer pricing compliance, and balance sheet reviews. The role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial information, compliance with applicable statutory and group reporting requirements, effective cash flow management, and adherence to internal financial controls and company policies. Key Responsibilities 1) Statutory Audit and Financial Statements * Manage and coordinate the statutory audit process, ensuring timely completion in accordance with applicable statutory requirements and reporting deadlines. * Prepare and finalize financial statements, cash flow statements, and schedules of assets and liabilities in coordination with the Finance Manager. * Reconcile the trial balance with the finalized financial statements and SAP records to ensure accuracy and consistency. 2) Group Audit and IFRS Reporting * Independently manage and coordinate the year-end group audit process as of December. 3) Treasury and Cash Management * Manage banking facilities and coordinate with banks to ensure the smooth functioning of day-to-day treasury operations. * Ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and annual banking compliances and reporting requirements. * Analyze cash flow requirements to support liquidity management and effective utilization of available funds. * Coordinate the preparation, processing, and submission of customer and vendor Letter of Credit (LC) documentation. 4) Month-End Closing Activities * Prepare and post recurring journal entries relating to treasury and other assigned accounting areas. * Review foreign exchange accounting entries and validate realized and unrealized foreign exchange gains or losses. * Prepare fixed deposit interest accrual workings and ensure accurate and timely posting of related journal entries. 5) Monthly Global Reporting * Prepare and submit the monthly Net Financial Position (NFP) breakdown in accordance with group reporting requirements. * Prepare and circulate daily cash position reports to support cash monitoring and liquidity management. * Report credit facilities, banking limits, and compliance with applicable bank conditions. * Prepare and review cash flow reports, highlighting significant movements, variances, and potential liquidity requirements. * Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timely submission of global financial and treasury reports. * Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to validate reported information and resolve reporting discrepancies. 6) Financial Forecasting and Budget Monitoring * Collect and verify financial forecast inputs received from Operations, Sales, and other relevant departments. * Prepare fixed-cost forecasts in accordance with the approved budget and applicable assumptions. * Prepare and circulate forecast updates three times per month, in line with the established reporting schedule. 7) Transfer Pricing and Tax Compliance * Coordinate the preparation, review, and filing of applicable transfer pricing reports, forms, and supporting documentation in accordance with the Income-tax Act, 1961. * Coordinate responses to tax assessment notices, prepare the required information, and liaise with external consultants for timely submission. 8) Balance Sheet Schedules and Monthly Analysis * Prepare and maintain monthly balance sheet schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for all assigned accounting areas. * Perform monthly balance sheet reviews and submit the findings to the Finance Manager. 9) Quarterly Group IFRS Package * Prepare and consolidate the quarterly IFRS reporting package in accordance with group reporting instructions and deadlines. 10). Internal Controls and Process Improvement * Ensure adherence to internal financial controls, delegated authority limits, and company policies. * Maintain appropriate records and support documentation for audit, compliance, and management review. . Key Skills and Competencies * Strong knowledge of financial accounting, financial reporting, and balance sheet reconciliations. * Working knowledge of IFRS and group reporting requirements. * Experience in statutory audits, group audits, and audit coordination. * Knowledge of treasury operations, banking facilities, foreign exchange accounting, and cash flow management. * Understanding of Indian tax compliance and transfer pricing reporting requirements. * Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Excel, with the ability to analyze financial data and prepare reports. * Ability to manage multiple deliverables and meet strict reporting and compliance deadlines.

Key Skills: Reporting,SAP,IFRS Reporting,Finance,Budgeting,Transfer,Statutory,Statutory audit

description:
Role & responsibilities 
 EHS, Compliance & Safety Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS and statutory requirements, including TNPCB, DISH, Fire & Rescue Services, CEIG, DTCP and other regulatory authorities. Manage statutory licenses, consents, approvals, renewals, registers, inspections and regulatory submissions. Drive energy efficiency, GHG emission reduction, renewable energy, water conservation, recycling and waste-reduction initiatives . Develop and monitor environmental and sustainability KPIs against corporate targets. Maintenance, Engineering & Utilities Lead overall mechanical, electrical, utility, facility and infrastructure maintenance activities. Develop and execute preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance programs to improve equipment reliability and availability. Monitor equipment performance through PM compliance, downtime, MTBF, MTTR and repeat breakdown analysis . Lead RCA for major equipment failures and implement permanent corrective actions. Ensure reliable operation of electrical systems, compressors, HVAC, water systems, fire protection systems and other plant utilities. Manage electrical safety and CEIG compliance , including preventive maintenance and statutory inspections. Plan shutdown maintenance, critical spare requirements, AMCs and maintenance service contracts. Lead engineering, safety, sustainability and energy-efficiency improvement projects. title: Manager- Offshore Chartering
description:
Role & responsibilities Purpose of the role. Marine Solutionz increasingly sits in the middle of offshore charter chains: chartering AHTS, OSVs and barges from owners and sub-chartering them to E&P operators and EPC contractors. This role builds that into a dedicated, repeatable desk, protecting margin and contractual position on both sides of every fixture. Key responsibilities 1. Business development and client enquiries Track offshore tenders and enquiries from E&P operators (ONGC, Vedanta/Cairn, Reliance, Oil India, private block holders), EPC and installation contractors, and terminal/SPM operators. Qualify requirements: vessel type (AHTS, PSV, MPSV, DSV, crew boat, tug, flat-top/ballast barge), bollard pull, DP class, deck area/loading, FiFi, accommodation, period, area of operation. Prepare technical and commercial offers, tender submissions and responses to technical clarification queries, within agreed timelines. 2. Tonnage sourcing and owner relationships Build and maintain a live network of Indian and international owners, operators and brokers (Singapore, Middle East, SE Asia). Maintain a position list and market database: vessel availability, specs, day rates, mobilisation costs, open dates. Circulate enquiries, screen vessel particulars and certificates (class, flag, DOC, bollard pull, DP FMEA/trials, OVID/CMID where required) against client specs. 3. Negotiation and fixing Negotiate head charters with owners and sub-charters with clients on a back-to-back basis, securing owner terms before committing to the client. Structure commercials: day rate, mob/demob fees, fuel and consumables, WHT and GST treatment, payment terms, performance/off-hire clauses, extension options, margin. Draft and review recaps and charter parties (BIMCO SUPPLYTIME 2017, BARGEHIRE, TOWCON/TOWHIRE, client-form contracts); align liabilities, knock-for-knock, insurance and indemnities across the chain. Work with legal/finance on bank guarantees, performance securities and EMD for tenders. 4. Regulatory and import clearances (India) Manage DG Shipping licensing for foreign-flag vessels (GTL/SPL/charter licence, Indian-flag ROFR process), customs entry/import for the charter period, and other mobilisation permissions. Coordinate with port agents for MOHA/ MOD, Naval Clerance, arrival, crew change, bunkering, supplies and husbandry. 5. Charter execution and post-fixture Oversee delivery/on-hire surveys, bunker surveys, redelivery and off-hire surveys. Monitor vessel performance, daily reports, fuel consumption and downtime against charter terms; manage off-hire and claims. Issue hire statements and invoices to clients; verify owner invoices; track receivables and payables so client collections fund owner hire. Handle disputes, variations and extensions; keep both owner and client relationships commercially sound. 6. Risk, compliance and reporting Run counterparty KYC, sanctions screening and credit checks on owners and charterers. Ensure P&I, H&M and charterers liability cover is in place and matches contractual obligations. Report weekly on pipeline, fixtures, utilisation, margin and receivables to the Business Head. Build templates, rate benchmarks and an owner/vessel database so the desk can scale. 




 Preferred candidate profile 
 Qualifications and experience Essential Graduate in any discipline; nautical, marine engineering or shipping/maritime business background preferred. 6-10 years in offshore vessel chartering, broking or OSV commercial operations, with at least 3 years fixing charters independently. Hands-on experience of BIMCO SUPPLYTIME and related forms, recaps and back-to-back charter structures. Working knowledge of Indian offshore market rules: DG Shipping licensing for foreign tonnage, customs/import for charter vessels, GST and withholding tax on hire. Established contacts with offshore owners and brokers in India, Singapore and the Middle East. Preferred Sea-going or offshore operational background (e.g. Master/Chief Officer, DPO, or marine superintendent). Qualification from ICS (MICS) or a recognised chartering/shipbroking course. Exposure to barges, towage and project marine spreads for pipelay, platform installation or SPM/terminal projects. Experience with tenders for ONGC, Oil India, Vedanta/Cairn or major EPC contractors. Skills and attributes Strong negotiator who protects the companys position on both sides of a chain. Commercially sharp: costs a fixture quickly, including mobilisation, fuel, taxes and FX. Clear writer of offers, recaps and clarification replies; fluent English. Responsive under time pressure; comfortable with calls across time zones. Good with MS Excel and market tools; keeps disciplined records. Compensation and how to apply Compensation: Up to INR 60 lakh per annum (CTC), depending on experience. Variable pay: Annual bonus plus performance-linked incentive tied to chartering margin. Benefits: Medical insurance, travel perks and other company benefits. Why join: Build and lead a growing offshore chartering desk within Marine Solutionz Group, an integrated offshore group of four companies and 90+ professionals working with oil majors, EPC contractors and offshore operators across India, the Middle East and Asia. To apply: send your CV, a list of recent fixtures (vessel type, region, charter form) and current/expected compensation to chanda@marinesolutionz.com, subject line Manager - Offshore Chartering.

title: Network Manager
description:
Network Manager L2/L3 SME & Network Architecture Lead Location: Noida or Gurugram, India
 Shift: Evening/Night Shift (5:30 PM – 2:30AM) Both side Cab facility will be provided 
 Experience Required: 10+ years in networking
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role We are looking for a Network Manager who is both a hands-on L2/L3 Subject Matter Expert (SME) and a proven people leader. You will own network architecture, stability and roadmap for our voice-led KPO/BPO operations, lead the network engineers and IT SWAT team, and remain the final technical escalation point for the toughest issues. You are accountable for outcomes, not only fixes: uptime, voice quality, team capability and client confidence in our network. You will balance deep technical credibility with strong communication and people management. 
 Environment You Will Own Firewall: SonicWall (primary + secondary/HA), dual ISP, IPSec site-to-site VPN to client peer IP Switching: approx. 15 L3/core devices and 100 L2 access switches Wi-Fi: approx. 30 access points Servers: approx. 10 servers Voice: Vonage DID over internet, VDI-based agent desktops Locations: 3 sites (Noida 2, Gurugram) Monitoring: Zabbix, OPManager (distributed, proxy per site) with SNMP, syslog and scripted path monitoring 
 Key Responsibilities Network architecture and strategy Own the end-to-end network architecture across three sites: WAN/ISP design, dual-ISP and SonicWall HA failover, IPSec VPN to client peers, L3 core and L2 access design, Wi-Fi, and the VDI and voice traffic paths. Define and maintain the network roadmap, capacity plan and lifecycle/refresh plan, with business cases and budgets for IT leadership. Lead design reviews for new sites, new client onboarding, client-mandated connectivity and security requirements, and changes to voice infrastructure. Align the network design with global client security, compliance and audit expectations (for example ISO 27001 and client-specific requirements). L2/L3 SME and escalation ownership Be the final technical authority for firewall, switching, VPN, WAN, VDI connectivity and voice-path issues, and decide whether an issue is fixed on the spot or escalated to a vendor or ISP. Lead triage and the incident bridge on major disruptions, isolating LAN, WAN, VPN, firewall, VDI or carrier-side causes while giving clear updates to leadership and client stakeholders. Diagnose complex IPSec VPN problems (Phase 1/Phase 2 failures, IKE negotiation errors, SA lifetime mismatches, DPD misconfiguration) and interpret traceroute/MTR output and firewall and switch logs. Own root cause analysis and problem management for recurring issues, and track permanent fixes to closure instead of repeating quick fixes. Voice quality and resilience Own voice-quality escalations (jitter, packet loss, MOS, one-way audio, call drops) and decide whether the fix is internal (QoS, shaping, configuration) or needs Vonage engagement. Design, tune and validate QoS so voice (RTP/SIP) is prioritised on shared internet links. Validate dual-ISP failover behaviour and confirm the VPN and voice services re-establish cleanly after a failover. Monitoring, reporting and governance Own the Zabbix monitoring strategy: templates, triggers, severity mapping (P1–P4), dependencies and escalation actions, plus VPN tunnel and MTR/path monitoring to the client peer IP and US voice/application endpoints. Own the weekly issue-trend report and client-facing service reviews: recurring root causes, closure status and permanent-fix proposals. Define and enforce incident, change and problem management processes (ITIL), change windows, runbooks, and network DR/BCP documentation. Team leadership Lead, coach and develop the network engineers and the IT SWAT team across shifts: set goals, review performance, plan skills growth, manage rosters and coverage, and build succession. Build runbooks, escalation matrices and training so that one-engineer-per-shift coverage works without depending on a single person. Hire and onboard network talent, and set the standard for technical interviews and capability assessment. Build a blameless culture of root cause analysis and continuous improvement. Vendor and stakeholder management Own the relationships and SLAs with SonicWall, ISPs and Vonage; manage escalations and provide input on renewals and contracts. Communicate with global clients, operations heads and IT leadership, explaining technical issues and trade-offs in business terms. Partner with Operations, Information Security and Infrastructure teams on changes, audits and client requirements. Required Skills and Experience 12+ years in enterprise networking, with deep experience in the KPO/BPO/ITES industry or a similar voice-dependent, client-facing operation. Global experience: has supported or delivered networks for international clients and worked with multi-region stakeholders and teams. Proven network architecture capability: multi-site design with HA, dual-ISP, IPSec VPN and QoS for voice. Expert, credible hands-on L2/L3 knowledge: firewalls (SonicWall strongly preferred), switching, VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, STP and routing. Advanced IPSec VPN troubleshooting, and strong QoS and traffic-shaping knowledge for VoIP; Vonage or similar SIP trunk/DID experience is a plus. Practical experience with network monitoring platforms (Zabbix preferred; OpManager, PRTG, SolarWinds or similar): SNMP, traps, syslog, NetFlow, trigger and alert design. 5+ years of solid people management: building, coaching and rostering a team, handling performance, and growing capability. Excellent communication: confident with senior leadership and clients, calm and clear during incidents, and strong in written RCAs and reports. Working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and change management, vendor and SLA management, and budgeting. Comfortable making independent decisions during evening/night operations. Preferred Qualifications CCNP or CCIE; SonicWall certification (CSSA/CSNSA or advanced); ITIL Foundation or higher. Prior role as Network Manager or Network Lead in a global BPO/KPO. ISO 27001 awareness and exposure to client audits; exposure to cloud networking (Azure or AWS). Basic Linux and scripting (Bash/Python) for monitoring checks. Key Performance Indicators Reduction in recurring incidents (VDI disconnects, network interruptions, latency) week over week. Mean time to resolve (MTTR) for escalated incidents. Voice quality indicators (jitter, packet loss, MOS) within agreed thresholds. VPN and WAN availability throughout Quality and timeliness of root cause analysis and weekly reporting. Monitoring quality: alert accuracy and low false-positive rate. Team health: shift coverage, runbook coverage, skills development and retention. Client and stakeholder satisfaction in service reviews. What We Are Looking For A network leader who is still technical enough to be the final escalation point, and strong enough with people and stakeholders to run the team and the client conversation. Someone who thinks in architecture and root causes, communicates calmly under pressure, and turns every incident into a stronger network and a more capable team. 
 If interested Kindly share your resume at Muskan.shukla@nlbtech.com

title: Sr. Manager - Legal (M&A)
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Transaction Advisory & Deal Structuring 
 i. Lead legal workstreams across the deal lifecycle for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic investments, including structuring advice from term sheet through signing and closing. ii. Draft and negotiate transaction documents, including share purchase agreements, shareholders agreements, business transfer agreements, and related ancillary and definitive documents. iii. Collaborate with corporate development, finance, and tax teams to design deal structures that align with commercial objectives and appropriate risk allocation. Due Diligence & Risk Management 
 i. Lead and coordinate legal due diligence on target entities, identifying material legal risks, liabilities, and deal issues, and translating findings into actionable recommendations and risk-mitigation steps. ii. Manage external counsel and advisors across jurisdictions, including instruction, coordination, and review of due diligence and transaction deliverables. Regulatory & Compliance Oversight 
 i. Advise on regulatory approvals and conditions applicable to transactions, including competition/antitrust, FEMA/foreign investment, securities, and relevant sectoral regulations. ii. Liaise with regulatory authorities and advisors to secure clearances and ensure transactions comply with applicable Indian and GCC/UAE legal requirements. Leadership & Stakeholder Management 
 i. Serve as a legal business partner to deal teams and business leadership, advising on the legal implications of strategic transactions, restructuring, and investments. ii. Advise internal stakeholders on emerging legal and regulatory developments relevant to M&A and their impact on live and prospective deals. iii. Contribute to playbooks, templates, and governance frameworks that improve the efficiency and consistency of transaction execution. Group Legal Integration 
 i. Work closely with Essar Group Counsel to align transaction structures with entity-level legal frameworks and contribute to group-wide M&A, restructuring, and reorganisation initiatives. ii. Contribute to drafting and implementing group policies on transaction risk (e.g., representations and warranties, indemnities, and post-closing integration frameworks).

About M&G India 
 We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune. 
 Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues. 
 Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business. About M&G 
 Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions. 
 Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions. 
 Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent. 
 Provide support across Tagetik Consolidation and PPS SII solution tools as part of the BAU (Business As Usual) support team. Maintain operational knowledge of interface schedules, dependencies, support contacts, control points and recovery procedures. Evaluate new requirements by coordinating with business stakeholders and manage and co-ordinate the implementation lifecycle. 
 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. title: AMP Regional Manager
description:
Regional Manager (Earthmoving & Mining Equipment spare parts and attachments) Position Summary We are looking for a dynamic and passionate Spare Parts Sales Professional to drive sales growth across the assigned territory through direct customer engagement and dealer network development. The role involves promoting and selling high-quality spare parts for earthmoving, construction, and mining equipment, identifying business opportunities, building strong customer relationships, driving the sales team and achieving sales targets. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge of heavy equipment spare parts, excellent communication skills, and a growth-oriented mindset with a passion for aftermarket sales. Qualification & Experience Educational Qualification Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in: Mechanical Engineering Automobile Engineering Related Engineering Discipline Experience Minimum 15 years of experience in spare parts sales within the: Construction Equipment (CE) Industry Earthmoving Equipment Industry Mining Equipment Industry CE/Mining aftermarket Industry. Proven experience in team handling , direct customer sales and territory management. Experience in aftermarket parts sales and dealer management preferred. Technical Skills Good working knowledge of: Microsoft Excel Microsoft Word Microsoft PowerPoint Hands-on experience with: SAP ERP Other ERP platforms (added advantage) Key Roles & Responsibilities Sales & Business Development Lead and support the team across the assigned territory while effectively engaging with prospective and existing customers to achieve business objectives. Conduct regular customer visits, sales calls, and business reviews to generate sales opportunities. Promote and sell high-quality spare parts for earthmoving, construction, and mining equipment. Prepare and present sales proposals highlighting product benefits, reliability, and value proposition. Identify market opportunities and develop strategies to increase market penetration and revenue growth. Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Customer Relationship Management Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with key customer accounts, fleet owners, contractors, mining companies, and dealers. Understand customer requirements and provide suitable spare parts solutions. Develop long-term partnerships through exceptional customer service and technical support. Handle customer inquiries, quotations, and follow-ups effectively. Market Development Increase market share by identifying competitor activities and developing growth strategies. Expand customer base and generate new business opportunities. Gather market intelligence, customer feedback, and industry trends to support business decisions. Product Promotion & Customer Education Educate customers on the advantages, quality, performance, and value of our spare parts offerings. Conduct product demonstrations and technical discussions with customers and dealers. Promote preventive maintenance and parts replacement programs that add value to the customer's operations. Reporting & System Management Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales pipelines, quotations, and business opportunities. Use SAP and Tuffex Stores Management System for: Quotations Order processing Inventory checks Lead tracking Customer data management Sales reporting Prepare periodic sales reports and territory performance updates. Desired Candidate Profile Passionate about Spare Parts Sales and Aftermarket Business . Strong customer focus with excellent relationship-building skills. Proven team handling skills. Self-driven, result-oriented, and proactive approach to business development. Strong negotiation and communication skills. Ability to work independently and thrive in a target-driven environment. Growth mindset with a commitment to expanding market share and business profitability. Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory. Key Competencies Spare Parts Sales
 Territory Management and team management
 Customer Relationship Management
 Mining & Construction Equipment Knowledge
 Business Development
 SAP / ERP Systems
 Dealer Management
 Negotiation & Presentation Skills
 Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
 Growth Mindset & Customer Centricity Passion for Spare Parts, Customer Success, and Business Growth is essential for this role. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the Regional Manager will be measured against the following Key Performance Indicators: Sales & Revenue Performance Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Revenue growth from assigned territory. Gross margin achievement against budget. Year-on-year business growth percentage. Customer Acquisition & Retention Number of new customers acquired per quarter. Customer retention rate and repeat business. Growth in business from existing customer accounts. Number of active customer accounts in the territory. Market Development Recruit experienced team to ensure adequate coverage. Increase in market share within assigned territory. Penetration of new geographic areas and customer segments. Conversion rate of identified sales opportunities into orders. Competitive account conversions and business wins. Customer Engagement Number of customer/dealer visits and meetings conducted per month. Number of sales calls completed versus planned. Customer satisfaction and relationship management scores. Timely resolution of customer inquiries and complaints. Lead Management & Pipeline Development Number of qualified leads generated each month. Value of sales pipeline maintained. Lead-to-order conversion ratio. Follow-up closure effectiveness on quotations submitted. Quotation & Order Management Number and value of quotations submitted. Quotation-to-order conversion percentage. Order booking value versus target. Accuracy and timeliness of quotations and order processing. Reporting Compliance Timely and accurate updating of customer activities. Submission of weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports on time. Accuracy of sales forecasts and demand planning inputs. Inventory & Product Focus Promotion of strategic and fast-moving spare parts. Sales growth of focus product categories. Support in reducing non-moving inventory through sales initiatives. Identification of stocking opportunities with key customers. Dealer & Channel Development Recruit capable dealers to cover and scale up the business. Dealer sales growth in assigned territory. Dealer engagement and training programs conducted. Dealer coverage and account performance improvement. Achievement of channel partner sales objectives. Success Metrics for the Role Achieve 100%+ Sales Target attainment. Deliver 25-30% annual business growth in assigned territory. Increase market share and customer penetration year-on-year. Maintain high customer retention and satisfaction levels . Generate sustainable growth through new customer acquisition expansion of existing accounts and new business ventures. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong passion for Spare Parts Sales, team handling, customer relationship management, territory expansion, and aftermarket business growth in the Earthmoving, Construction Equipment, and Mining industries.
